tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 11 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas snang skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rting dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༵sna/sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyesabu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bai ro ska cog zhang / /gzhibs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ to dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhud bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khra/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mche mon mche’na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyasashing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying posadaben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu zhi las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyam/sa po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bsdo/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos chan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'jam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4 —

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nasapo khru bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen pyu du 7 5 pa rtag spre 1 6 3 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas thegs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi spyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhus gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid/ lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi ge rgor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rte nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod r+ṣa po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi zhwa shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel ho pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras skrungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khore bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

rgyud rgyal gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa yid tshes ngo mtshar bzhugs/ 1bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i brgyud 'debs dang bkra 3|sa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 139sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhugs/ 145dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs snying po bzhugs/ 147dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ 161dpal rdo rje 'jigs ma/jad lha bcu gsum ma'i cho ga 'don pa bsgyur lugs yang dag pa'o// 208bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nag po lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 221dpal ldan gzhan rje nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 249gshi/na rje gshe/da nag po'i khrid yig zhang lugs bzhugs/ 297—1—

sbyo/ba thabs zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 302bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal skyon rje lted dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor ra gyi bdag 'jug bzhugs/ 318lted dmar rnal wor bzhi rim gyi khrid yig ma rdzo tu ba/bro5nga ba bsdon/bro sdo/ 356spros med kyi khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/ 369

rgyas pa yid ches ngo mtshar bzhugs/oX snya sti/ na mo gu ru burnya bo dhi satwa maṇ+ḍal de ba twabh+yaX seng ge 'phrogabyed ser skya sogs/ /kun gyis bzlog par mi nus pa'i/ gzhin rje'i dmagadapung 'joms pa po/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /de nyid gduladaka' 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bo'i rgyal por sku bzhengs pa/ /ya snyan ta kalabatud nas/ /gleng bslang 'jug sgo cung zad rtsom/ /'dir phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'phrin las phyogs med du sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni/ bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yin la/ de ni sa pasargyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa gcig du 'dus pa/ rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul bzunganas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa sgrub pa/ 'phags pa 'ang sdus dpalanyid khro bo'i skur bzhengs par kun tu grags pa ltar yin la/ sngags kyi theg pa 'dir de lta bu'i tshul ston dang mthun par/ byang chub sems dpa' slob pa'i tshul du bsgrub pa dang / gnas tshul la sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi spyi gzugs yin pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ri phyug gas kun gyi khyab bdagardo rje 'dzin chen po nyid kyi tshul du ba/ba pa rnam pa gnyis 'byung ba las/ rgyud

sde 'og ma rnams su ni snga ma shas che la/ rnal 'byo(ra bla na med pa lo dor ni phyi mgatso bor gyur pa'o/ /'on kyang rgyud 'di dag tu spund pa'i yang sgo skyong thob rdorje gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams dang / rgyud gzhan gyi phyogs mtsha༅sardeskyong ba'i khro bo la sogs pa zhor byung gi sgrub thabs rnams na/ byang chub sems/dpa'i tshul du bsgrub pa yang theg pa bla na med pa 'dir mang po zhig bshad do/ /de dag las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nang tshan/ dmar naga'ajigs gsum du grags pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud don la 'jug pa'i sngon du 'gro ba 'di ltar nges par bya/ de la lnga ste/ rgyud rgyal 'di rnams mchog sgrub min par 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag 'di rnams rgyud kyi sde tshan gar gtogs ngosabazung / 'di rnams kyi brjod par bya ba'i bsdus don dzind/ ston pas rgyud de dag ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ de nyid mi yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ zab mo'i mthar rgyud rgyal 'di rnams kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu snyam na/ theg pa spyi'i don dang / mdo sngags kyi dbye ba dang/ rgyud sdebazhipo'i spyi'i rnam gzhag rags pa tsam go zin pa'i dbang du byas nas de'i rjes la 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ 'o skol gyi ston pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ rnal 'byordo ra bla na med pa ni mthar thug pa ste/lam gyi rim pa gang la dbang bzhi dang / rim pa gnyis dang/ dam tshig dang/brtul zhugs dang / nye rgyus mtshams sbyor ba rnams ma tshang ba med par ston cing gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyang phyin ci ma log par rdzogs par ston pa'i rgyud do/ /de ni rang nyid gang la dgongs nas ston pa'i yul/ ne du bya ba'i —2—

gdul bya de bar rbad glo bur ba ma byung na/tshe gcig lus gcig gis phyagargyawo po'i dngos grub la spyor nus pas khyab pa yin no//de'i phyir 'a nakhacig spyir yang bla med pha rgyud la rdzogs rim nges pa ston dgos pa min snyam pa dang /dgos su 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyud rtog pa bdun pa ni/byang chubasgrubapa la bar go sel byed kyi chos yin gyi/byang chub thob byed dngos thi zerabadang /sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud waṃ yang/than dbangabazhi yang dngos bstan la gsal po med pas dpal 'dzin gyis kyang tshig zur la snyad bcol te/dbang bzhi po ston byed tsam dka' tshegs kyis btsal nagarnal 'byor bla med du sgrub dgos byung ba yin pas/nag po skor gsum gyi dngos bstan la rdzogs rim med do zhes smra ba ni/chos kyi gnad gtan nasamago bas/chos spong gi las gsog pa kho nar snang zhing /ra dang blo mams pa'i grub mtha' ba'i sde gzhan 'ga' zhig chos 'di gtso bor byed pa la brnyasardethabs su snang yang /khyed kyi tshig de bden na/sangs rgyas thos byed ma yin pa'i cho sog pa la/khyed rang yang dbang bskur nyan zugad rtsal gon byed pa ltar 'dug pa shin tu blun zhing byed rgyu zad pa yin la/yang 'di la phugs kyi 'bras bu med kyang cho ses 'di gzhan tsho la 'dug pas/nged kyang gragashog/pa'i go du'o zer na/khyed rnams rang gis rang gi 'dod don gsal bar smras te de ni bden no//de lta na yang 'dir dpyad de/gawa te rtog pa bdun pa'i la5gyis byang chub mi thob na/rtog bdun gyi bshad pa skyo lugs dang/oṃ5lugs ni mchog tu gyur pa'i chas su khyed rang 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/las

phran tshegs tsam 'gru ba du zin yang mu stegs kyi chos dang mtshungs par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sel zhes zer ba la yang brtagasan/ 'di ltar bar chad thams cad sel ba yin na ni/ byang chub sgrub byed blan med par 'gyur te/ bar chad thams cad spangs nas byang chub ma thob pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe 'di'i nad dang gnod byed dang / 'pho pa༅pa sal ba 4/labyed na ni/ de tsam gyis byang chub kyi bar chad sel byed du 'jog mi thub cing/de 'dra ni sman dang rdzas dang rig pa dang / dgra thabs la sogs pa'i blo grosakyis kyang nus pas na/ grong pa'i skye bo rnams dang thun mong du 'gyur bas/'dir khyed bar chad srung ba dang 'joms pa'i tshad gang la 'jog skye ba phyi mgacig gam gnyis su sdug bsngal sel ba la 'jog na yang / mu stegs/dang thun mong du 'gyur la/ bdud dang gshin rje thub pa la 'jon na ni/ de la ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes skye dgos pas/ de ka la byang chub thob pa'i thabs zhes zer ba go dgos so/ khyed kyi go yul na rnam bcad kyim nas/bar chad la sogs pa'i skyon spangs pa yin pa la/ yongs gcod kyi chanas yon tan mngon par ma bsgrub pa cig srid/ mtshan gzhi chos skor 'di rnams yin/dpe zangs gzhong gi dri ma bkrus nas bcud ma blug pa dang 'dra snyam pa cig 'dug ste/ rig gras tsam ma gtogs lam gyi rim pa dang / spang gnyen sog༅rdekyi go ba phyogs re tsam yang shar ba der 'dug des na gnyen po ma skyes par spang bya spong mi thub/ tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na sgrib gnyis/mi dag ste/ dperan snang ba ma byung na min pa mi sel ba bzhin no/ /des na yongs gcod du yon —4—

tan skyes pa dang /rnam bcad du bar chad nyes skyon sel ba bang myam yoromanyam gyi tshul yin pas/bar chad sel byed mchog tu grub na yon tan skyed byed kyang mchog tu 'grub bo//dpal 'dzin gyis nag po'i rgyud bla med du bsgrub pa ni 'ga' zhig gis rgyud sde 'og mar bkral ba 'gog pa'i phyir yin gyi/bla med kyi mtshan nyid ma tshang yang /rgyud kyi tshig zur la 'brul ga/rgyab nas bla med du kha bsgyur zhing bcos pa ga la yin/de ltar yin na rgyud kyangablamed ma yin pa dang /slob dpon yang rdzun po cher thal bar 'gyur ba las/khyed rang yang de 'dra mi 'dod la ra gnag po'i rgyud dang rtog bdun waṃ khosaganas bla med kyi rgyud yin na/bla med kyi rgyud kyi mtshan nyid tshang dgos pa gzhir bzhag brlan gsher med kyang chu yin pa srid dam ci/nag po skoragasum gyi rgyud 'di/rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin te/bskyed ri5mawo nyid dang ldan pa ston pa'i phyir/rtags mngon sum gyis grub/khas kyang blangasaso//yang 'di skad ces/gang bskyed ris mtshan ṣ+ka tshab ston na/tswasasbas gang rung la rdzogs rim ston pas khyab/dper na gsang ba 'dus pa bzhin/nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud kyang /bskyed rim rdzogs par ston pa'i rgyud yin no//zhes bya'o//slob dpon da pa la 'edzin gyis4gad pa ni 'ga' zhig gis dgra nag gsang sngags phyi bar bkral/gtso bo yum can mi dra5b.ra'adod pa la/zhal phyag ston byed kyi skabs su mi gsal/yang/gsang dbangadang /sher dbang gi skabs su gnyis sbyor yod/de'i phyir gsang sngags phyi rgyud min/gtso bo yum can dgos zhu ba glus/bskur yod pas sgo/zhes sgrub

byed bko nas pha rol pa'i 'dod pa de la gnod byed zur tsam zhig bstan pa yin gyi/dbang gong ma dang rdzogs rim 'a ho rgyu med nag spras byed gzhanagyis 'phongs pa ga la yin/lar rdzogs rim la sogs pa'i man ba na zabamornams/slob ma mchog la dus su bab pa na ston par byed kyi/gzhan dngakhashags 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa'i dus su ga la smra/khyed rnams nyid gang yod kharukhyer ba'i rigs 'gre de dpal 'dzin sogs tshes che ba rnams la'ang sbyor ba 'di ga skyon che bar gda'o//des na pha rgyud kyi gshed skor/gsang 'gasasgyu'aphrul drwa ba sogs dang /ma rgyud kyi mnyam sbyor sogs le/rgyud kyi khosabastan rdzogs rim gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par med do//yang mi mkhas pa de dag gsang ba'i de kho na ṣ+ka kyi/rnal tsos rabaskyed pa bstan pa ske/rdzogasapa rnal 'byor ma ru dran//zhes pa'i tshig gis zab don rgya chen po gzhan lko par ma shes par/pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi khyad par rnyan pa yin no zhes/chen po gzhan su yang mi smra ba la/khyed rang rnams kho nas dran byung gsar skyes kyi 'grulog rgyab pa de ka rgyu mtshan du khyer nas/bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud dang /rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud yin pas/pha rgyud la rdzogs zemamed kyang chog go zhes khungs med blo bzo byung rgyal du smra bas rmongs pa'i tshogasarnams mgo bskor bar byed de/de la 'di skad bya ste/pha rgyud bskyed rimagotsobor ston pas rdzogs rim med kyang sngo na/ma rgyud rdzogs rim gtso bor r+sā pas bskyed rim med kyang chog par thal lo//yang khyed rnam na(pha rgyud lasarderdzogs rim rgyas par mi ston ces pa dang /gsang 'dus las rdzogs par ston 6

zer ba yang 'gal/yang de skad smra bzhin du gsang 'dus kyi de mi zab pa'irdzogs rim yin/ma rgyud dang kyai rdor gyi de shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs mis yin zer ba yang de ma thag tu shin tu nang 'gal te/mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim ni/rdzogs rim ma yin pa'i phyir dang /dbye ba de ltar 'byed pa ni/rdzogs ritsharang yang ngos ma zin pa'i bslab col du 'dug pa'i phyir ro//yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi thob thang la rdzogs rim med tshul 'bad nas smras zin pa'i rjes su/skyo ba rnams zhu ba'i bsam gtan dang /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rdzogasarderim dum tsam 'chad pa 'di/re legs zhig 'dug go zer ba 'di ni brtad med kyi spyon gtam ste/thob thang la med pa zhig smras pa de/legs por 'gro ba bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir dang /rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa skyo ba'ilugs de legs na/rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa gzhan byas pa la'ang mi legasardepa'i rgyu mtshan ci/man ngag gi sbas bshad du ni de dag kyang 'dod cing/rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni cig shos kyang ma yin pa'i phyir ro//skyo bas zhu ba'i bas5gtan rdzogs rim du bkral ba'i rdzogs rim ni gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa yin la/de ni khyed kyi lugs la zab mo'i rdzogs rim du 'dod cing/yang khyed kyi pha rgyud la spyir rdzogs rim dgos rgyu chung zhing /dgos su zab mo'i rdzogs rimami yong zhes smras zin la/'jigs byed kyi rgyud pha rgyud du yang 'dod pas/'gal 'du'i phung po 'di 'dra ba ji lta bu yin/khyed rnams nyid kyis soms shiganam zhig na khyed rang rnams kyi rang tshul go bar 'gyur ram snyam/gzhan gyisasmras na ni khyed la zhe sdang mi bzad pa 'bar bar 'gyur ro//

gnyis pa ni/ 'di ltar nges pa bya ste/ bla med kyi rgyud sde gang la/ lha yab kyi sngags dang / dkyil 'khor dang / las tshogs kho na gtso bor ston pa de ni pha rgyud yin la/ der ma zad lha yum rnams kyi yang sngags dang dkyil 'khoradang las tshogs rtsal du 'don pa yang yod pa ni ma rgyud yin no/ /de yang don thabs shes gnyis la/ rgyud sde de gnyis kyis bgo bsha' byas pa lta bu nimayin te/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud phal che ba las kyang thabs kyis lha sngags sbyoragasum yang rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thabs rgyud la yab khon rtsaladu 'don pas khyab/ ma rgyud la ni gdan bzhi'i bsdus rgyud 'edi lta bu/ yumakhon rtsal du 'dod pa'ang yod mod/ phal cher las gnyis ka rtsal du zhe 'dan no/ /des na thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi ming khyad par can la thob ste/ rnala'abyor ma rgyud ces bya ba ni/ gnas gzhi'i mo g.yen zer ba dang 'dre'o/ ṣenganyid snying rje'am/ bskyed rdzogs sam/ sgyu lus 'od gsal lam/ bsod nams ye shes sam/ bde stong gsal stong sogs kyi sgo nas/ pha me'i rgyud kyi dbye ba mi rung ste/ gnyis kas kyang de thams cad ston par mtshungs pa'i phyiraro/ /'o na pha rgyud la ni rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni ma rgyud kyi ming ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir thabs rgyud bla med du le sdog snyam na/pha rgyud ma rgyud rdo/na gyi 'gangs 'dra yang / khyad par can gyi byin rlabs 'jamotshul 'ga' zhig ma rgyud la lhag por yod par bsams nag rgyud sde lnga 'dod pa la sogs pa'i 'dod tshul ltar na de bzhin yin mod kyi/ rgyud sdebazhiraphyeba'i bla med kyi dbang du byas na/ gsang sngags nang rgyud thams cad la rnawa—8—

wor ldi med ces bya'o//de la 'di go sas te/rdorje snyingaX dzī gyi o las/gid ༵sa yang dkri bshad byā ba/tshe/'di tshes lo : /na po ni par o//gang sa gas parda ༷nas nas snyo//she che'i~Xslongs grwa kha / shad da / ngab 'a na par shad//she ba snyus she kau phrag spra/rda she ga brgyan/khye/dkrings pa ni stan stang phrag ༷g.yi/sna mab pa'i rbang dam kho/ spya' rgyud la nyas yed brgyad//ye b.rang ga bsta༅/rded pa rgyud//dam r+pā phag gcib lnga//rda 'a lnga snyus 'a ga/la 'bazang dra/ga ༵༷༷maphrag gcag/spyaX she ge brgya nyi nyas she sngu/rje/zla bzang dra / ba / 3ngardethig le brgya//rda rja sa ye da shu/kha pan do snyun brgya 'a/khra zla kyi 'bum she khri//rda rja rnam rgyal dgu brgyad she ༷sngi//par ce/sherdebastang sngi lnga//sang thig 'bam stang phra lha na lnga phrag ga 6 ka//do gas pa ma lngard shegabadun/she/dzod sgyu gsang sheg ga glo ༷rje tho/'a sgyu brgya de/ dungabargya/she/rda rja ngh+ru rgyan stang phrag rdzo/she cwa pa she brgya// nyad brgya stang brgya3 nga bdun//sbyi ma~X/ /༅ stang phrag gsum//rtsa khyo/rdewo sdo she ba 'bum phrag gag/gas 1 pa blo za kyi thig le bsdus pa brgya lnga she// she sdang pa dgu brgya 'a//dus she 'i be ba glo ḍā//lha ༵bstan bcas lnga brgya bdu sten//'ad rnams dgas pa bye brag //nga yas yangadag bstan par byas//'di ni gnyis lte༅'gyud pa yig a kyi dbyeb ra 7 no 'a 'a ra rka 3nirdebastan da//pe : sngo/zhesda pa me thig khri tā/da rna //sto dang ltas pa 'ang dod gi ri ye ba ( 2 4 rasapar bya//da ba sdang gta mug/rde9khri yid rnams/kun kyang rkyosgar bya//

mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud kun yang //'di yi rim pas shes par bya//zhesagasungs te/yang 'dir grangs tshad bshad pa rnams ni/rgyud kyi rkang grangasaston pa yin gyis/glo ka'i grangs ma yin te/'dir gsang ba 'dus pa stengaphrag gcig tu bshad la da lta'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa gcig po rang la yang glo ka stong dang brgyad brgya yod pas so//zhes mkhas mo chon dag gtso ste/slo ka'i grangs ma yin pa ni cis kyang 'thad la/ud ta ra tan tra'am phyi ma'i rgyud ni/rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma zhes bya ba logs pa zhig yin te/'di nasabashad pa'i rta mgrin lha lnga'i sgrub thabs zhig sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na'ang yod la/rgyud 'di snga mo zhig nas bod du 'gyur 'dug na'ang /rgyud 'bum phal cher du ma chug go/kun las bshus pa zhes pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'o//mnyam nyid rnam rgyal ni gnyis med rnam rgyal lo//rdo rje phreng ba sog༅kasanga'adus kyi bshad rgyud yin zhes grags na yang /'phags skor ba'i lugs/la de dag bshad rgyud du sbyor ba yin mod/gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud yin na/gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig gi nang du 'du dgos pa las/de dag rgyud sde'i rnam grangs so sor bgrangs pa'i phyir/gdod nas bshad rgyud du grub pa ni ma yin te/cha mthun gyi rgyud tsam mo//'o na dgongs pa lung ston ni/gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel du mngon sum nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ci'i phyiragasang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud ma yin snyam na/da ltar rgya bod gnyis na yod pa'i dgongs pa lung ston/'di kho na'i dbang du byas na/khrus pa'i sand rnyu du mi 'gal yang /rgyud de yongs rdzogs yod pa'i dbang du byas na/mtshan dang 0

mthun par rgyud gzhan rdzi snyed pa zhig la'ang /gsang 'dus la yod pa bzhin du dgongs bshad mang po yod pa dang /gzhan la ma ltos par rang rkang tshugasapa'i lha sngags cho ga rnams yod par snang bas/rgyud de yongs rdzogs kyi dbangadu byas na/rang rkang tshugs pa yin gyi/rgyu gzhan nye tshe pa gcig khona'i bshad rgyud yin wo brjod du mi yo ngo //rdo rje sa 'og kyang da khri war ba 'a mayin te/da lta'i 'di kri ya yin la/'dir bshad pa ni gnyis sbyor gyi rgyud cig yin dgos pas so//rdo rje snying ma dang/gang yo dang/nor thikagasum po'ang 'dir gnyis sbyor gyi rgyud du bshad pas/rnal 'byor gyi a yī no//'jam dpal dpa' bo zhes pa la dpa' bo ni khro bo'i ming ste/skyon rje gshed kyi rgyud do//de ltar na 'di dag 'dod chags kyi rgyud yin zhing/de'i nang nas kyang gnyis sbyor lam byed de/rgyud sde bzhi las bla med yin la/de bzhi du lag bcangs kyi rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang /rgod pa'i rgyud spyo rgyud dang /ltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rgyud bya rgyud la yod pa 'dod chags kyi rgyud yin la/de bzhin du zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud dang /gte mug/go rigs kyi rgyud kyang /rgyud sde bzhi kar la yod pa shes par bya zhing/mkha' 'gro ma ste lha mo'i rgyud kun yang gong du bshad pa 'di'i rim pas rgyud sde bzhi car la'ang yod la/ma rgyud de re re la'ang 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum yod par shesapar bya'o//mags chen gyi rgyud rnams tshe gcig la dngos grub ster byed yin gsungs pas/gzhan gnyis la'ang go bar bya ste/tshig de the ge ma'i gsalardebyed du 'gyur bas so//de ltar na 'di'i grub don la/tshe go gi/lus chug

la lam bsgoms pas dngos grub thob par nus pa ni/ sngags kyi theg pa mtha' dag yin cing / de thams cad la spyir 'dod chags lam byed yod pa 'ba' zhig yin kyang gtso che chung gi dbang du byas nas/ chags sdang gti mugagorigs gsum du dbye zhing / de gsum du 'dus kyang 'dus pa yin no/ khyud sde bzhi kar la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis gnyis su phye bas brgyad yod/ brgyad po thams cad la chags sdang gti mug gi rigs gsum gyis phye bas/ rgyud sde nyi shu rtsa bzhin 'gyur/ de'i nang nas bla med thabs rgyud 'dod chags kyi rigs ni gsang ba 'dus pa nas/ lha mo'i bstan bcos kyi bar/ sde tshan nyer brgyan po 'di dag yin zhing / nyer bdun po ni/ 'dus pa la mthon du phyogs shing de'i cha mthun pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na kha cigs pha rgyud kyi dbyeb la sde gsukhokho na dgos pa dang / ma rgyud kyi dbye ba sgo drug kho na dgos zer ba dang / pha rgyud la rigs lnga'i rgyud kyi dbye ba med ces pa dang / rin chen pad+ma las rigasagasum gyi rgyud med zer ba dang / rnam snang sgyu drwa gti mug gi rigs yin zer ba dang / gzhin rje gshed dmar nag zhe sdang gi rigs yin zer ba rnams ni rgyud tshig 'dis shin du bkag pa yin te/ ma rgyud la yang rigs gsum gyi dbye ba bshad pa dang / pha rgyud la rin chen rigs rin chen sdong po dang / las rigs dam tshig chen po dang / dam tshig mngon mkhyen gsal bar ga sdangs pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje lnga 'dus zhes gsungs pas 'di ni rigs lnga 'dus pa yin la/de'i shugs la gzhan rnams rigs lnga so so ba yin par nges par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / zla gsang thig le yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su mthon sum gyis—12—

grub pas/ pha rgyud la yang rigs drug gi dbye ba gsal bar thon pa'i phyir ro/gzhan yang pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po pha rgyud pad+ma'i rigs su kun tu grags la/ de'i dum bu rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa ni pha rgyud kyang yin la pad+ma'i rigs yin pa yang mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rnam snang sgyu drwa dang / gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed bya ba'i rgyud gnyis po 'di dga'adod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sgyu drwa dang dmar nag de gnyis ni/ tshig don gnyis kar gyi phyogs nas gsang 'dusadang shin tu 'dra bar dngos su grub pa'i phyir yang / gsang 'dus chags rgyud yin na de dag kyang yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rnam snang gte mug dag pa dang / gzhin rje gshed khro bo yin pas rigs de dang der 'gyur snyam na/gsang 'dus kyang zhe sdang gi rigs su thal bar 'gyur te/ mi bskyod pa zhe sdangadag pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir dang / yang na chags sdang gnyis ka'i rigs su thalabar 'gyur te/ dkyil snyen ra gyi lha la zhi khro gnyis kar yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod chags kyi rigs gcig pu la'ang rgyal ba rigs lnga'am drug gi dbye ba yod cing / de'i rigs pas gzhan gnyis la'ang yod du mngo/ /desan dug gsum lam byed kyi dbye ba'i skabs 'dir/ lha sku zhi khro'i rnam 'gyuradang / rigs lnga las gang du gtogs pa'i sgo nas mi 'jog gi sa du wa bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i lam ston tshul cung zad tsam mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'jog ste/ de yang las dang po pa 'jug sgo'i lam gyi skabs su mi 'dra ba yin gli ye —13—

shes la dbang ba nas gzung mi 'dra ba ye med cing / de'i sngon ye shes phebasapa nas kyang phal cher mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na bya rgyud dang rtog pa'i rgyud so sor phye ba'i/ rgyud sde lnga ltar na rnal 'byor chen po dang/ rnal 'byor pha ma so sor phye ba'i rgyud sde lnga ltar na/ rnal 'byor bla me'i rgyud dang/ kun khyar+pāyongs su grags pa'i rgyud sde bzhi ltar na/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi nang tshano thabs kyi rgyud 'di la/ 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud dang/ go ho mugagyirigs dang / zhe sdang gi rigs te gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang/ rdorje 'phreng ba dang / rdo rje snying rgyan dang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma dang / rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa rnams rang dbangacan gyi rgyud yin la/ dgongs pa lung ston dang/ lha mo bzhigazhus dang/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rnams ni spyir yongs su tshang ba yod na/ rang rkangagi rgyud yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa yin mod kyang / da lta rgya bod na yod pa 'di rnams ni/ dogs gcod dang / zab don gtan la 'bebs byed dum bu retsam logs su phyung pa yin gyi/ skal ldan gyi gang zag gcig gi ma rkyen rdzogasapa ma yin te/ lha dang / sngags dang / bskyed rim dang / dbang bskur dang /las tshogs dang / dngos grub rab 'byams sogs gang yang mi ston pa'i phyiraro/ /yang 'dus pa la sogs pa rgyud 'di dag ni dbang gi gnas skabs dang/bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi rgyu'i gnas skabs dang / thun mongagodangos grub rnams la/ dngos sam yid kyis sgom pa'i rig ma la brten nas—14—

gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam byed rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir chags can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phru/la drwa ba khri drug pa lta bu yin yang / da lta bod du 'gyu/rab ni/ 'jamadapal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nyid yin te/ 'di las gti mug goganyen por stong pa nyid dang / rten 'brel dang / rnam par rig pa'i de nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rnam pa thams cad pa dang / bde ba chen po sogs 'gal 'dus skyon med rnams dang / byang phyogs phar phyin sogasardegazhi lam 'bras bu'i rab tu dbye ba mtha' yas pa ston cing / ji ltab dang dzisnyed pa'i sgo nas/ blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par byed pa'i thabs zhu ba gtso boraston pa dang / yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ gti mug gi gnyen po rnam par mi rta go pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i lam kho na ston/ gti mug can rjes su won pa'i rgyud ces bya yi/ chags lam phal pa dang / mngon spyod ge tsobor mi ston pa'iphyir/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gi rigs zhes mi bya'o/ /zhe sdang go rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa'am/ 'jamadapal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa yin mod kyang / bod du 'gyur ba ni 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di dag ni dbang bskur ba dang / rtsa ba'i sgub thabs kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs nas kyang / mngon spyod kyi kyilas rten 'brel khyad par can sgrig cing / mngon spyod nyid la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dag pa rdzogs pa dang / drag las la brten nas phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi rten —15—

'brel mtha' dang sgrig pa'i thabs ston pa dang / mngon spyod nyid tshogs gsogapa'i thabs mchog tu ston pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud cesabya'o/ /spyir gsang sngags yin pas chags lam ston/ bye brag tu nang pa'amaglamed yin pas/ gnyis sprod kyi chags lam nyid dbang dang/ rim gnyis dang /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang / nye rgyu'i skabs kun tu ci rigs par dgas pa tsam gzhir bcas shing / der ma zad dngos grub mchog la gzhol ba'i skabasasu/ sgrub pa pos nyams su blang bya'i lag len gyi rim pa la/ gsang/'dusalasogs pa de dag dang / phyi ma 'di gnyis la 'dod chags chen po lam byed shasache chung gi khyad par yang gtad nas med mod kyi/ mchod pa dang / dbang bskur dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i skabs su cho ga'i yan lag phra momang po zhig dang / ril lu la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub tshuwa gyi skabs mang por/ 'dod chags lam byed dngos su dgos mi dgos kyi khyad par chen po yod cing / rgyud kyi dngos bstan tshig zin 'a'ang/ le dod chagasolam byed rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par cher yod do/ /de bzhin du cha shas kyis na/gti mug dang / zhe sdang lam byed gsang 'dus sogs las kyang mang du gsungs mod kyi/ 'phros don dang / yan lag tsas yin la/ phyi ma'i de dgatugati mug dang / zhe sdang lam byed lam gyi gtso bor byed cing/ lhag par rtsaladu 'don pa'i phyir/ rgyud kyi tshig zin la yang khyad che zhing/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi sgo nas kyang / gti mug lam byed rgyas pa dang / zhe sdang lam byed rgyas pa bsgom dgos mi dgos kyi khyad yod do/ /bod phal cher gyi blo la zhe sdang la5—16—

byed kyi go ba/lha khro bo dang /mngon spyod kyi las ci rigs ston pa las/gzhan go ba gang yang ma shar 'dug cing /'dod chags lam byed kyang las/rgya bsten tshul tsam las go ba gzhan ma shar ba dang /kha cig gti mug lam byed med zer ba dang /phal cher zhig kyang gnyid dang rmi lam gyi gdams(ngag lta bu nye tshe ba'am/stong rkyang bsgom pa tsam las gti mug lam byed la gzhan gob mi snang ste/de tsam gyis ni don 'di dag dpyis phyin go bar mi snang ro//spyiragasang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' dag chags lam yin par 'jog pa'i skabs yod la/de las kyang 'di dag thams cad spyir 'dod chags chen po'i la5ston byed yin pas/'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud yin kyang de'i nang sel la ltosanas gsum du phye ba yin pa dper na rigs chen rigs chung gi dbye ba dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o//des rigs mtshon nas lam dngos gzhi bsgom tshul/'dod chags kyi rigs yin mnyam la yang /lha'i rigs kyi dbye ba sogasarde'abyed tshul dang /dbye sgo gzhan gyi sgo nas/dug lnga la5byed sogs kyi dbye ba byed na ni mi 'gal lo//bod kyi phyogs 'dir sngon dgra spong 'gasogasum la/nag 'jigs skor gsum zhes ming 'dogs shing/bshad bka' stabs gcig tu byed pa mang du byung /ba ri lo tsā ba ni de'i steng du skyon rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud bsnan nas/nag po skor bzhi zhes tha snyad mdzad kyang /rjes 'jug dar rgyas chung bas yig snar 'khod pa cher med pa 'dra'o//phyis gshed dmar gyi skor 'gyur ba nas bzung ste/dgra na gag dongadrug gnyis la nag po zhes gcig tu sdom ste/dmar nag 'jigs gsum zhesarde

tha snyad 'dogs shing / chos skor chab gcig tu sgrig pa sems pa dag byung ngo / /'on kyang nag po skor gsum dang / gshed dmar le'u bcu dgu pa ni pha rgyud yin la/ gshed dmar le'u nyer gnyis pa ni ma rgyud yin pas/ pha mo'i rgyud so sor gnas pa dang / gshin rje gshed rnam rgyal spyod rgyud yin zhing/gzhan rnams bla med yin pas rgyud sde'i dbye ba khyad che ba dang / dgra nagagadong drug gshed dmar le'u bcu dgu pa rnams 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud yin zhing / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rnams zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud yin pas/las dang po pa'i lam rim mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ chos skor 'di dag rnams phyogasagacig tu bsgrig dgos pa dang / gcig gis gcig la nges par kha'agengasadagos pa dang / nges par rgyas 'gebs byed dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de lasakyang khyad par du bod pa 'ga' thig nag po skor gsum las dgra nag rtsa ba 'a rgyud yin/ de'i bshad rgyud gzhan gnyis yin te/ gdong drug ni zhabru 5 ge boragasal byed yin/ 'jigs byed las tsho gos gsal byed yin zhes sam/ dragalas bsal byed yin zhes zer ba ni/ pho tshod tsam mam/ thos thos bon du khyer bar zad kyi/ rgyud kyi glegs bam zhib mor bklags pa tsam yang mo byasapa'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud 'di dag rtsa bshad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang med la/ rtsa bshad yin no zhes khungs dang ldan pa sus kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir dpa/gdong drug las 'khor lo ston byed kyi tshig rgyas po med cing / de'i zhabrula'akhor dang / dgra nag gi 'khrul 'khor gnyis shin tu mi 'dra ba'i phyir/gdong drug gi rgyud dgra nag gi 'khrul 'khor gsal byed du ji ltar bu pa/ rtog—18—

bdun las/las tshogs kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs mod/rtog bdun las kyang dgra nag las tshogs mang la/mngon spyod kyi las la rnam grang༅rtogabadun mang du chug kyang /mngon spyod kyi cho ga'i rim pa dgra nag rgyas pa'i phyiradang /dgra nag dang 'jigs byed 'khrul 'bor gcig par lhod pa dang/thadad du 'dod pa lugs gnyis/'dug kyang /tha dad 'dod pa ltar na ni chugardegi gsal byed du cig shos gang rung zhing /gcig par 'dod pa ltar na yanga'akhrul 'khordo ra de rtog bdun du gsal po med la/dgra nag tu gsal ba'i phyir/rtsa mug da go bzlog par thal bar 'gyur ro/khyed dag slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa dang /dgra nag gi 'grel pa shwan ti pas mdzad zeng ba tshad marabyed par 'dug na/de gnyis ka las dgra nag dang 'jigs byed ma mthun gyi rgyud du bshad pa'i phyir/khyed dag la gnod byed yin no//des na lha'i rnala'abyor dang /las tshogs la sogs pa'i skabs phal ra du/gcig ni don bshad byar bzhag nas cig shos kyis 'chad pa'i tshul du med de/so so raparkang btsugs pa'i tshul du 'chad pa yin pas/rtsa bshad du sbyor rgyu ni ma yin par nges la/lha sngags cho ga sogs phan tshun 'dra min mang po yod pa'i phyir/cha mthun du byas na don la 'gal ba cher ma mthong mod/rigs so jo'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir/nag 'jigs gnyis cha mthun gyi tha snyad mi spyod la/dgra gdong gnyis po ni cha mthun du wo ngo //lten rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba dang /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la khyad par gyi 'dra chos du ma 'dun kyang/rgyud sde'i mtho dman che mtha'i phyir cha mthun gyi rgyud du mi 'jog mod/phan tshun 9

kha 'gengs ni rung ste/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdusapa bzhin no//gzhan yang gdong drug 'jigs byed gnyis/kyis gang bshad par bya ba'i rtsa rgyud de/nges par dgra nag yin na gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'urdebacu dgu pa yang /gdong 'jigs gnyis kyi bshad bya'i rtsa rgyud du thal b.ra'agyur te/dgra nag rtsa rgyud du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin pa thams cad/gshed dmar gyi rgyud de la'ang tshang ba'i phyir ro//de yang khas len na gdonga'ajigs gnyis la rtsa rgyud gnyis su thal bar 'gyur ro//de ltar na yang/blama'i man ngag gis rtsa bshad kyi tshul du sbyor ba ni mi 'gal ba cig kyang srid mod kyi/'dir ni rtog bdun dang gdong drug la dgra nag gi rgyud nas ston kha bskang na nyer mkho mang zhing /'di gnyis nas dgra nag la phar kha 'gengasadagos shin tu yi ba'i phyir dang /gdong drug dang rtog bdun gnyo༅i dbang du byas na'ang /gdong drug nas rtog bdun la kha bskang na nyer mkho mngazhing /rtog bdun gyis phar kha 'gengs dgos shin tu nyung ngo/ṣi ste rtsa pond du mi sbyor kha med kyi u tshugs rang byed na/dgra nag la gzhan gnyis/po bshad rgyud 'dra mtshungs su mi 'byor gyi/rtog bdun la gzhan gnyis po bshad rgyud 'dra mtshungs su 'byor ba'i phyir/man ngag gi rim pas rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas kyang /nag po rtsa rgyud kyi tshul dang /gzhan gnyin/bshad rgyud kyitshul du 'jog pa mi rigs so//de ltar na gzhin rje gshed rnam rgyal kyi rgyud smos ma dgos/nag 'jigs skor gsum/dmar yi rgyud rnyas te/lnga po 'di dag kyang /gcig la gcig ma ltos par rang rkang tshugs pa'i rgyud re re 0

yin par shes par bya'o//rgyud gang la yang rtsa bshad kyi rgyud ni ltos pa ho zhes bya ste/rtsa rgyud ni phar bshad rgyud la nges par lhos/pa kho yang/bshad rgyud yin phyin chad rang rang gi rtsa ba'i rgyud la nges par ltos dgos so//chamathun gyi rgyud ni gnyis ka phan tshun du cha mthun pa tsam yin gyi/gnyis/lagacig ltos dgos pa ma yin no//gsum pa ni/de la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di dag gi brjod bya nya tshul/ragasardepa ni 'di ltar yod de/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/snyan rje lted nag po'i rgyud ni/dang por gleng gzhi ni spyi dang 'drab wo/gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor tshogs rgyas par bstan/gleng bslang ba zha boratshogs rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas phyag na rdo rje la bos te ga sdangs/de nas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin bskyed chog dang /yi ge bcu bdun cob dang/lha bstobadun gyi mngon rtogs dang /dkyil 'khor gyi lha gas snyun pa'i sngagasardernams gsungs te/mngon rtogs kyi rim pa phye ba ste dang pho// //de nas le'u gnyis pa ni/tshigs bcad lngas bstod pa dang /skye mched byin rlabs dang /dkyil 'khordo ra 'bri ba rnams so//le'u gsus pa las/sachog/ gi gsol btab dang /bdud rtsa myang ba dang /ye shes dgug/gzhug dang/gtso bo lnga'i gdan dang /las bzhi'i lha bsgom tshul dang/mig/sman lasogs pa dngos grub 'ga' zhig gsungs so//bzhi pa 'an/zhu tshig sngon du 'gro bas/zhi ba/rgyas pa/dbang sdud/dgas/pa/zengs/pa/ngag/yon/bsad pa'i las rnams gsungs/lnga pa las/dbye bdang/bskra/da pa dang/

de rnams kyi 'al 'khor gyi go rim mo/khrug pa las/gsol ba bto pa dang /rig bdag dang /dam gho dang /dbang go grang gdang/gongaghodang /'khru kyil 'khor rdel sngags 'god tshul/lo//bdu / na pa las/yum po lti ri rdelas sbyor dang /dbang bskur rdzo dang /dgug pa la cho gos pa'i sbyor ba tsirigs pa'o//brgyad pa las/bka'i 'khore lo bka' bsgo dang/sa lha stagon dang /dkyil wor lkog pa'i cho ga dang /dbang skrar gyig65btab dang /stong nyid sogs sngags gsum dang /las bzhi re sbyin bsreg/gokhyad par bstan to//dgu pa las/lo lebs dang/ཿmas rtse ca/pa dang /lha mji ba dang /sbrul gyis zin pa gso ba dang/sho boragagazer sel ba dang /rbod stong gis bsad pa dang /dgra bo 'khya༅sa par byed pa ste/las phra mo bdun gas rtsa(so//bcu pa las/ro 'angs bsgrub pa/sgo skyong bzhi'i mngon rtogs/mkha' nang gi dkyil wor spro ba/sgob dang lha mo'i gdan/rjes dran sgom pa'o//bcu gcig pa las//lha das dag pa/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i bya ba/phyag rgya'i mtshan ṣ+ka/rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa/phyag ba rgya pa'i sgrub thabs/sgo spyon 'dzirin gshin rje gshe/da kyi sgrub thabs/phyag bye ba'i sgrub thabs/dam tshig go sgrub thang/sa/bdud rtsi bsten pa rnams so//bcu gnyis pa las//yum bzhis bstod pa'i glu/bzlas pa dang /bgrang phreng dang /gdon tshar bcad pa dang /bzlas pa'i 3 dang /gong 'bya ba dang/zas phud 'bul ba/yī bal ba tshwas sgo/bcu gsum pa las/dang por rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lha snyugasum/rnya yum

bka'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yin/de nas gnod mdzes lha bcu gsum gyisasa'og bsgrub/rta mchog lha bcu gsum gyis mkha' spyod sgrub po rdo bcu bzhi pa las/thig gi bya ba/slob ma gzhug pa/thig/gi bya ba'i 'phros/gsol ba btab pa/sa'i bya ba/thig gi cha dbye ba/dkyil 'bor sgrub pa/rdu wa tshon dgye ba/dgang blugs kyi tshad/ye shes dbab pa/sku gzugs kyi char tshon dang bcas dra ral gcig ma bcu gsum ma dang /puska sri rkyang pa dang/misna nga ba sgrub pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sgo/bco lnga pa las/dug sel ma lha bcu gsum/ku ru kul+le phyag brgyad ge tso rkyang/lusamed rdo rje lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs so//bcu drug pa las/mchogagodangos grub kyi don du he ru ka lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub bas so//bcu 'a skyen pa las/gtso bo bskyed pa/zhu ba glus bskul/bskul nas bzhes/pa/rnal/'byor bsto ngos 'dzin/rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sogs nga/ma li rgyud kyi tshe brjod/rdzogs rim don dam byang chub kyi sems rnams gsungs/le'u bco bgyod pasargyud gsungs pas gtam rgyud kyi tshul gyis phyag na rdorje la bka' bsgos pa'o//'di la dngos su dkyil ge nar dgu yod de/skyon rje lted dang mas / wo ma//gnod mdzes rta mchog ral ga gam//'jam rdor du gsel lus med dang //he ru ka yi dkyil wor ro//thi sridang rig byed ma//dpa' mogacig pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis//zhes so/khyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni nyi zla ltaragrags pa yin la/rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i gzhin rje gshed skor shes para'adod pa dag gis/rgyud 'di la nges pa 'jug par bya ste/rdze'i don la bes

pa phyin ci ma log pa rnyed na/gshed skor gzhan rnams kyang 'bad kho du rtogs par nus so//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugasaskyon rje lted dmar po'i rgyud kyi le'u dang po las/lha lnga'i 63rde rtoltorgyas par gsungs shing /rdzogs rim cung zad wad/le'u drug pa/bdun pa/bgyod pa/dgu pa'i stod rnams su/bcud len dang /slab/gzhug/sgrub pa la sogs pa/las tshogs dang dngos grub mang du gsu / ngas/le'u bcu gcig pa nas gtor chog rgyas par bstan/le'u tha mar gtam rgyud kyi rjesasu'apho ba dang /grong 'jug gsungs/de rnams lhag po yin/gzhan le zhi nyi 3 'jog tshul dang /go rim mi 'dra zhing /'gyur migacig/pa ma gtogs//nagapo'i rgyud dang tshig don gnyis ka la khyad par med pa las/phran tshegs 'o don pa bsgyur ba lta bu yin/'di la le'u bcu dgu yod/dkyil 'kho me gyi grangasakyang gzhan rnams dgra nag dang 'dra ba las/ga tha/na rje gshe/da la lha lnga dang bcu gsum ma gnyis su dbye ste bcu'o//de yang le'u dang po las lha lnga'idakyil 'khor bshad cing /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs dang /snga phyi'i tshigarigs gung bsgrigs pa la bcu gsum ma ste/gnyis byung ba gnyis kar rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ra yin par grags kyang /gshed dmar gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil sgo bor ni lha lnga nyid do//gzhin rje tshi shed dmar po'i rgyud le'u nyer ge nyis yod pa de ni/rnal 'byor ma rgyud yin par bshad pas skabs 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad mod/zhabrul 'khor la sogs pa cho ga'i rim pa rnams ni/dmar nag spyi dang phalacher mthun la/las tshogs dang /chags lam gyi skor rnams migayo rdeb gla4

med dang tshig rigs gcig pa shas che/rdzogs rim dang/dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes gsal rgyas su bstan cing /dbu ma rten 'brel snying po zhes bod na gragasapa'i gzhung chung 'di yang /rgyud 'di'i nang nas bton pa lta bur snang ngo//gshin rje gshed nag po gdong drug pa'i rgyud ni/le snya dbye ba pho/sdomatshe'abring chung gsum gyi brjod bya'i don rnams bsdus pas/rgyud sdom gsum paragrags so//rgyud rang gi dngos ming ni/gshin rje gshed nag po kho pa lo'i las thams cad grub par byed pa'i rgyud ces bya'o//de yang gleng gzhi sngon du 'gro bas/gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi dbus sa rdo rje ro langasams bdud 'dul ba'i thabs zhus/bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge won sngon du mdzad nas snying po gsungs shing /gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa'i skurabasgyur/sngags rnams gsungs pas bdud rnams thams cad skrag ste/de dgani gleng bslang ba'o//de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mngon rto stodang /lha nyi shu'i sngags dang /thig gdab pa dang /mtshan ma 'god pa dang /mchod pa'i phyagargya dang /sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/skye mched byin rlabs/bdud rtsi myangab/phyogs mtshon dang /rtsig pa'i rim pa/tshad med bzhi/lteng pa nyid bsgom tshul/srung 'khor/chos 'byung /dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub pa po labasngags pa rnams gsungs/de nas mtshams der lha mos gsol ba btab nas re mig zhe dgu pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'bri tshul/rmi 'a8/gyi rtags/'byung ba rim brtsegs/gzhal yas khang /lha'i gdan/ye shes spyan 'dren/dgug/gzhug dkyil 'khor mchod pa/dam tshig bstan pa/re mig la yi go 'bo de

tshul/'khor lo 'bri dus kyi bya ba'i rim pa 'khor lo'i phan yon rnamasagasungs so//yang zhu ba zhus te/'kho 3 lo 'bri/ba'i gnag gzhug/pa'i gnas/dkri ba'i skud pa/kha blta phyogs/mchod pa 'bul tshul/tingange'adzin dang sngags kyi bskul tshig tha dad pa'i sgo nas/zhib dang /rengs pa dang /bsad pa dang /dbye ba dang /rims kyis thebs pa dang/rgyas/pa dang /dbang dang /dgug pa dang /mi snang ba dang/chu la mi bying ba dang/mtshon cha bsrung ba dang /mkha' la 'gro ba rnams gsungs/yang zhus/nas/sdom rdzo dang po gsungs/de rjes/ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i rnyaghodang /bstod pa dang /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/dbang gyi dgos pa/dbangabasnya ngo bo/de kho na nyid bsgom tshul/bla lo ma li rjes tho kyi ba45gtan/'dod yon gyi ma rdzo pa/dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgyas khang bskuratshul/'khor lo'i bstod pa/'khor lo bsten tshul/sa chog slob maladabang bskur tshul/spyin sreg dgang blugs kyi 3/sbyin sreg gi nges don/drag po'i spyin sreg rnams bshad nas/sdom tshig bar pa gsungs/de rjesarig ma brtag pa/skyed rgyu'i bye brag ā li kā li'i ces/don/sdom mi bo/thamarnams gsungs so//'di la dngos bstan dkyil 'khor ge ciganyid gsu pas/rgyud 'di zhal gsal zhing /gsang sngags spyi'i go ba dang/gshed skor nangadu'ang nyer mkho mang ba zhig snang ngo //de dag ni gong du smos pa ltar/rdzaṅga'abyor bla na med pa'i gshed skor gyi nang nas/'dod sas r+ṣa po'i rigasardekyi rgyud yin mod/rgya bod gnyis kar du nag 'jigs phan tshun khoskong ba shas6

che zhing /bod yul 'dir sngon dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang/phyis dmaranag 'jigs gsum zhes grags shing /phal cher phan tshun du kha skong bar byed do/de ltar legs pa'ang yin/lha dang/sngags dang/choga'i rim pa rnamasacha mthun 'dra mtshungs yod pa'i phyir dang /chos rgyun rnams kyang 'brel chagasasu gnas pa mang du mthong ba'i phyir dang /rgyud ni rgyud gzhan las shes paragasungs pa'i yang phyir ro/khyad par can gyi gshin rje lted/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud ni zhe sdang chen po'i rgyud ces bya ste/bla mgongatsharnams 'di la'ang rgyud rgyas pa 'bum par bzhed pa dang /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i gsung las/rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phragasutshacu rtsa drug par gsungs pa dang /slob dpon rdo rje grub pa ni/rgyud rgyas pa stongaphrag bco brgyad pa zhig yod ces gsungs pa thams cad mi 'gal/mod/gtsobor sems dpa' wo po'i gsung la yid rton no//da lta'i rtog pa bdun pa 'di ni/rmyo ka sum brgya'i tshad du gnas pa yin zhes grags so//de'i phyir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa su5brgya pa zhes pa yang 'di khon yin sgo le'u su skabargya pa yin na5sems pa dag ni zhabrul go/'di la gleng gzhi ni med de/bshad par zhal gyis bzhes shing dgos pa bstan nas/gnas kyi dbye ba dang /'bras bu las dang shos grub dang /bsnyen pa dang /rdul rdzo gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang /mchod pa dang /rdzo pa dang /sgrub chen rnams bstan te/rtog pa dang po'o//dzinas dang dkyil 'khor 'grib dang /mchod pa bstan pas dbang bskur gyi dkyil 'khor gri sgrub dang /nye

she dang /sgrub pa sgrub sgi seng rimang nga 'a sa sngos tshwa boX/ṭāzar zang shā༈she//she ma cib rnyis sagaXsdu ge ge zhe sde sde sde ye yi/thun she dngas rdza 'ang kya~X chag she ngon yin ci sne she na pas/che bzhi/ring / ste ༷'a lag kā mo mi/ga she phyan tshal/༷ togs b.rardepa gal ba she sa/khog sgrib nga phal da gyas dngas bstan tsam di'i lam ri~X' she nas/da~Xgya khag shes tshul zi shas ni snaX ༈/spyo 'a lamardegya ye pa 'a 'u dang pa mi las ga rdzo dgas pa ga bar gyas byegaspyortag she brjong gtso bor 1 /las sa bshad 'i ku ye ye she~X dang /mngan rims kri bar bstan pa dang /rkyang rdo 'khor los bci/ba she/ spras 'i /gyi sbong pa dza khor lo sba ba las/she/'a nya~Xdzo she brnyan phyi 'a ba la brten sna sa 'dzilalhor gya bsad ༷rjeb ( gsum dngasaXja bsang brga pa spyo/'an gcig gsungs/da sa bya ba dug shes gya sbyar bas /pa brga pa nye / sde don spyi na gi bas rdebs dpag ༵/ gsum/yang dbye brdo rnam jus/re na sdud gcigardebs dpa ga~X/she dang ye she sre 'i/she snyen pa sde pas stog yan gzhug tsho/na gyis 'bra bag pa sgaXsna pa/yang dbya ba g.yan lag ma gyas 'bugs pa dang/bu mo zengs/parabyed pa snyag rnams gsungs te/spyir na bcwa las/drug bskrad pa lnga/dbye:rgo/sbyonge mu 3nge ge tshob bshe/rengs pa zoms bsa'/ she/po the/dho/dbang/da.asmyab/bu marangs pa rnams bstan par skyi da// sa las/sgrub pa gsangarde

zhas pa dang /spyang la bya ba 'a dang /ba spo pa she ༷ dang rdzo/63rde spyad kau lum du ma bya bar rgyud gzhan gya rti drangs pa rnams yib lco/rde//ye pa gsum pa las/mtshaX'i che bang nga/sngags snyi she/'thu ba che dang /rtsa sngags btu ba da' ba dang/dang che nga/ nga pa nga khu ba dang/ 'a ༷/rdzus sngags 'thu she dang ba dang grangs3 stso btu 'tshe bsnam pa dang dzhai ga nga tsam skyed / spre sa// snye 'ishetsobor sgru ba pa las /das bad gi sgrub thabs ban paX zigag bar gyur pa gsungs te/'a 'jag cha 'a 'a/sa kya spyad pa kau /gnas dang /ye sa dang /rtsa sngags kyabazlas pa 'grangs dang /phan kau rnams gsungs gā// ye she she 'iri mo mkhan thim 'a na/shes sngan du 'gra bas/sa ji lnga rngo~Xrte/ ma mkhan gya mtsha/ nyad dang /'a sbyan spya dang /sku gzugs/sherab daX /bzhugs pa' 'a dang /bras spya mgo ye rnams ye sa/phi/rtag pa drug pa las na/mtsham/sa sbyar ba sngan du 'gra bas sprin pa spyin sreg gi gnas bstan to//de rjes bsad pa gnyis/dbye ba gnyes/0ri 3nge 'i ge tsho lju|rdebaskrad pa she gcag grang ༷sku : de ze ri shā pa/༵༷/bsgrub dro ༵smin sdus spre dang /sa 'a sko che / ba/ par bstan sa 'a/bu ༵ ༷sa pa sbyar ba/zha ba sbyan ga' pa' she ba / dgug pa 'a sbyan she ba dang/༵sa chud do ni kyi tshon zu/pa gnyas slar 'a ba dang ra rdzo pa/yuX phyags dbang she she pa/ nyams/par gnas pa' thabs/nar dbang du rdod pa/rgyal pa zha4ba bcas dbang du

byed pa/skyes pa dbang du byed pa/bud med dbang du byed pa/yang bskrad las gnyis/dbang sdud dang dgug pa re re rnams gsungs te/thams/cad sbyin sreg gi las 'ba' zhig go/de rjes bye brag mi bya ba dang/gtsin busabasgrub par spyod do//rtog pa tha ma bdun pa las ni/bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang/mdor bstan pa dang /ye shes khro bo'i bsam gto gyis bsad pa/pho nya gtum po'i sbyor bas bsad pa/dbye ba'i bsam gto gcig bskrad pa'i bsam gtan gnyis/dgug pa'i bsam gtan gcig du gagaso ba'i bsam/gtan/zhu ba'i bsam gtan/rgyal po sogs dbang du byed pa'i bsam gtan rnams gsungs nas/las thams cad mnyam par bzhag cing brtul zhugs/brtan pas bsgrub dgos pa dang /rgyud sngags cho ga bris sku rnams shin tugasang dgos pa dang /slob ma mchog mashaṃ nyid dang ldan pa la ston pa dang/gzhan la bka' rgyas btab pa rnams gsungs so//'di rgyud rgyas pa'i dum bu legs su phyung ba bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud du bgo pa dang /snying po'i don phyung ba'i bsdus rgyud du ba lko pa dang /rgyud rgyasapa'i 'jug thogs su gsungs pas phyi ma'i rgyud lta bur 'dod pa skego da tshul gsum yod kyang /bar ba ltar 'thad de/bsdus rgyud nyid yin parasems so//yang 'di'i 'jug tu bla ma dam pa dkyil kho bzhi po'i slob dpon/la li ta badz+ra sa phyung nas mdzad pa rdzogs so//zhes 'byung bas rgyud rgyas pa las la li ta badz+ra gyis mthus pa yin pas dgongs 'grel gyi bstan 0

bcos so zhes rgya bal 'ga' zhig 'dod skad kyang / de ni mi 'thad de/ rgya garagyi rtsom pa bstan bcos tshad ldan la rgyud kyi rnam par byas pa mi 'byung bas sgo /la li ta badz+ra gyis phyung zhes pa ni/ rgyud rgyas pa las 'thus rgyud byas pa'i don min/ des rdo rje'i gnas o rgyan nas spyan drangs zhes pa'i don yin no/ /rtogapa bdun pa 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i rgyud yin la/ mtha' na glegs bam bzhugs pa tsam la'ang byin rlabs kyi ga khri byin 'gran zla med pa zhig go /yang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bzhi pa bya ba cig kyang yod de/ de dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i rtog pa dang / migayo ba phyag brgya pa'i rtog pa rnams/ mar pa cho che/ kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba yod/ de rnams 'ga' zhig brtsam brgyud du 'dod la/ kha cig mar dosabasgyur zer yang / mar do'i mtshan gyi mtha' la grags pa'i ming med pag lotsā ba gzhan zhig yin la/ rgyud le'u bzhi pa 'di la/ der ma zad thar losarde'agyur bcos kyang mdzad do/ zhes grag go /rtog pa gtsin pa gtam/rgyudakyirtog pa zhes bya ba ni/ sngon gyi skyo pa rnams rgyud rnam dag tu byed la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams 'di rdzun rgyud yin te/ srog snying 'i phul ba skabs na/ btsan gyi ca cos sogs sde brgyad kyang bod ma'am bon lugs su byung ba dang / dzalatsa ba kha pa shin du ma dag pa'i phyir ro gsung yang / 'di'i dpe rnying pa ra'aga' re na/ tshig de dag mi snang bas/ gzhin rje ya phul ma mos ma/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad de/ rang bzo mkhan gyis lhad du bcug par mo bo/ pagartog pa dngos de rang rnam dag ka yin par mngon/ sgrol ba'i gying du byin gyis—31—

brlabs//zhes pa ni/bsod byed pho nyar byin gyis brlabs//zhes pa'i don la da sdo/ra khyad tsam yin pas gsal lo//rtog pa gsum pa'i rgyud 'di ni/rwa bod kyi dkar chag tshigs bcad slan/dgra nag gi chos skor du bgrangs la/kha cag sngags kyi rgyal po bcu pa yang//zhes 'byung bas/rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis kyi bshad rgyud yī zer/can kyangade tsam la nges pa med pas/gshin rje gshed spyi la 'gro ba'i chos skor yin zhing /bskyed rim sgrub thabs sogs logs pa med pas/gsang sngags/lanyer mkho rab gnas kyi rgyud sogs dang 'dra bar/gshin rje'i wor lobaskor ba'i man ngag gi rgyud dam/rgyud rgyas pa cig las phyung ba'i bkol ba dum bu'i rgyun yin pa yang srid do//'di ni lo tsā ba rong thos chos bzangago'agyur yin la/lo tsā ba gzhan dang gzhan gyi 'gyur yin zer ba'i/'gyur byang btab pa 'dra yod na'ang /gzhung gi ngo bo la 'gyur bcos pa cung zad kyangamed do//bu ston chen po'i rgyud sde spyi rnam na/rtog gsum dang gto/rgyud kyi rtog pa skyo ba rnams rgyud du 'dod do//zhes rgyud min gyu ba byung ba la lhan nas/ngor pa rnams blo gsar pa skyes te/rtog gsus rgyud ma yin/rgya gar ba cig gis brtsams sam/bod mkhas pa cig gis byas mi shes te/bstan bcos rnam dag ni yin/de yang skyo ba'i lugs la yod/rwa la med ces zer ro//rgyud rnam dag ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu ni gcig kyang med pas/khye spogs gang yang med pa'i chos spong yi/ las dam bca' skam po cig tu zad la/yang bstan bcos rnam dag tu 'dod pa dang /khungs med sus byas tsa ma yangam
