med pa pa 'dod pa 'di yang 'gal ba ltag sprod yin la/ res 'ga' 'o de skyo ba'i sngab sa pa cig gis brtsams pa yin yang zer te/ de lta na bstan bcosarnam dag zer ba yang 'ja' tshon ltar yal lo/ khyed dag gnyos rwa mar do sogs lo tsā ba dngos kyis byas pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyang ma dag par 'dod bzhin du skyo ba'i sngags pa su yin med pa zhig gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos shin tu rnam par dag par 'dod pa yang / ches bzhad gad kyi gnasayin zhing / yang kha cig 'di skad ces/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ /de lasbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog go ba/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring / /zhes 'byung bas/ rgya gzhud rin zhes zer te/ rgyu mtshan can gyi 'brel ni ci yang med do/ /de'i don tha snyad la blun yang/ dad pa dang ldan pa la dngos grub nye ba dang / tha snyad mkhas kyang rtog ges dpyod pa ladangos grub ring zhes pa yin pas/ de ni gsang sngags spyi'i lugs yin na mi'athad pa ci zhig yod/ tshig shin tu kha gsal bas bod ma yin snyam na/ mdo sde rnams dang / grub thob rnams kyi gzhung klogs shigazhal shin tugs la ba mtha' yas te/ khyod kyi log rtog sel bar 'gyur ro/ /tshig la brjid bgamed pa'i phyir/ bod ma'o snyam na rtog gsum ni tshig brjid bag dang ༅ pa khon yin pas skyon de med la/ spyir ni tshig rngam brjid tshe chung lo tsuba'i 'gyurakhyad pa yin pas/ de tsam gang gi yang rgyu mtshan du mi rung zhi pa/ khyed kyis ni tshig brjid bag che chung yang nyams kyis mi chod cing ngo ma shes par snang ro/ /yang khyed kyi ngor thal ba'i skad 'phang ste/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang yang—33—

bod rtsom yin par thal te/dga' la g.yang za/ngo tshal skrun bro zhes dang/'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas rgod bro/zhes sogs tshig brjid bag chung zhingami mdzes pa du ma 'dug pa'i phyir ro//des na rgya gzhud bstan dza : sa rnam dgadang /rgyud tshig gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ji ltar yod/de gnyis dang /bod rtsom la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang 'dra yod/bod rtsom bsnya bcos rnasladag dang /rnam dag ma yin pa gnyis la/tshig sbyor gyi khyad par rdzi lta bu yod/zhes dris na gsal te/rdzun dang tshod dpogs 'ba' zhig gis phyugs/kyi skye bo'i tshogs pa rnams dang /mtshan nyid mkhas por rlom pa'i nyams med kolong dam po rnams mgo bskor ba lhur len pa las/dkar po'i chos go ye/kyang ma 'dres pa'i spyod pa'o//spros pas chog go/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa 'di ni/rgyud rgyas pa'i nang nas lalitas bkol ba yin pas/rgyud kyi rnam grangs yin zhing/gshin rje gshed spyi khyab kyi cha lag tu sbyor/tshu tshun dha ri'i cho ga zhib mo dpa/te'u lo'i rtog pa chung ba gnyis ni/rtog bdun gyi 'phros don yin pas/rdorje le sdigs byed khona'i chos skor du bsdu'o//de dag ni spyir gsang sngags gsar ma/de'i nangagornal 'byor bla med/dmar nag 'jigs gsum du grags pa'i rgyud skor yin la/gzhan yang dus kyi 'bo ra lo dang /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsholas/gzhin rje gshed spyi'i 'khor lo bsgrub tshul gsal bar gsungs shing /gzhin rje gshed kyi las tshogs 'thor bu ni/rgyud gzhan mang po las kyang 'byung tho//yangalten rje gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud ces bya ba 'di ni/a kyi ngo bo 4

gcigatab seba'i/kha ci~X bya rgyud du 'go jug mi kyang 4 /'go / /bstan pa snga 'a tu bsre ba 'a lugs na pas rgyu 'di zhes ༷ga rde wo la/nyis ba 1 stan pa sngadar gya ༄sa su ba ri/shes/nga stonga~Xdadzosgrung /phya dar la gu la tsā bsdo 'i le 'ad cung zad bshad 'i cho/dkyal chagardesags kyang pa phyi ra//rgyud 'phyi ༷'u brgyud ni ho rtsab rtag pa/le'urde'aXrtog dang po zhe/bya / de zhi/rde ya pa phya ma/'a she pa la'i bar g.yo sgo rdzo ba 'a rtag pa dang rdo/tsheg pa/ ba du sko pa gi ba 'a /༵/ pa lnga bar du yad/༷ yang le'u she ga she rnogs bdun kha gzhan gyi smo na la/dzaX glo pa 'dir gsang rtag ri gru pa /zhi/zi grangs ga3na sga nas bstan rdo///khyud 'ar bsnyen sdib ma pa ba sga 'a/she grub bsgrub shed tshul she tuXbar gsungs spege /she bstan dkyal lhor dru3 yad ༵/she she dung /ge sto/nga she/nga po'i dkyil 'khor gi rin zu/sgo' ni shog/thad pa mang pa dang /dur khrad mang pa dkyal 'khang rnams/ga/'a rtagardebadun dang mthun shas che zhing /rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po'i chog skor la nye ge rka ra ra de ma yig yi mi ra rna tī)rdo nyi 3ngerde'adi cha mkha ba yang she she yad mje kya/sheXju / ga sga ༵dad pa ra/ zhag sdogazhi /ma slas sa rje gshed po/'i/rgyud mtha dman snyams pa dbang du byas nagatshul ni na rje lted pa rgyud rnams kyi gtso bo re sngags lnga spyi bslazhi/rdegasatshul /rnam grangs mang po yo~X mod 'a/ga bar rmo 1 nga 'dra la 'khar lan/myur bas krid par wogs ༵ na/de'i nang sa 'a zhabrul 'khar gyalas/stobs che zhang myur la/the med par 'gru/ba pa' phyar khyad par du wogasarde

pa ste/ji skad du/brtul zhugs mthar thug thod pa chen po dang //zhabrula'abor mthar thug gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud//rgyud kyi mthar thug pa niḥs pa ste//byung bar ma gyur 'byung bar mi khyur ro//zhen/dmar nag gyi rgyud gnyisardeka las mgrin gcig tu gsungs so//thod pa chen po'i brtul zhugs ni/nang gi rnal 'byor gyi stobs las/kun+da lta bu 'pho med du 'ching ba'i ming yin gyi/kha cig rig pa'i brtul zhugs tsam 'chad pa la sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud mchog yin no ba'i don no//zhes zer ba ni/ba4 tshwa mgo phur gyi tod pa'o//de la sngon gyi gshin rje mkhan po bod mā rnams na ge rgyud lgesacad las las tsho gos mang du gsungs kyang /las dang po pas 'phul du 'grus pa/gshin rje gshed kyi las tshogs rnams nyid rang yin/rgyud la nangagokhams che ba/gsang 'dus/dus 'khor/bde mchog/rnams yin te/gsangarde'adus kyi las tshogs 'grub pa la/bskyed rim la brtan pa thob dgos/dusa'akhor la rlung bum pa can grub dgos/bde mchog la pho nya mo grub dgos/gzhin rje gshed la grangs bsnyen song na/ge bor lo bcas chog yin zer te rgyud de rnams kyi cha rgyus rags pa yod par 'dug phyogs 'dra go rtsa pag ngo/yin/spyir rgyud gzhan de dag nas gsungs pa'i las tshogs rnams kyang/las dang po pas mi 'grub pa ta ma yin mod/grangs bsnyen song tsam gyisakalas tshogs bsgrub na/gshin rje gshed kyi zhabrul 'khor nyid/las tshogasardegazhan thams cad las mchoge tu gyur par tshad mas grub bo//spyir lha zhi ba las khro bo 'grub thag nye ba dang /khro rgyal gzhan las kyang gshin rje gshed nye/6

khyad par du mngon spyod drag shul gyi las la/'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha sngags las sbyor rnams dang mtshungs pa 'ga' yang med do//bzhi pa ni/da ni rgyud de rnams ji ltar byung tshul bshad de/dmar nagaganyis la ston pa rdo rje gdan du bzhugs te/byang chub brnyes par bzhed pa la/bdud kyi dmag bye ba sum cu so drug lhags pa'i tshe/ston pa nyid gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs te/bdud kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs 'byungapo thams cad tshar bcad nas byang chub kyi lam la bkod de rgyud gsungs shing /mthar phyag na rdo rje la rgyud gtad nas/khyod kyis kyang gzhin rje gshed kyi tingange 'dzin dang cho ga 'dis/bdud rnams thul zhig ces gsang bdagalagadams pa'i tshul gyis/phyi rabs rjes 'ju / ga gi gang zag rnams la dgong༅rdepar mdzad do//'di ni dmar nag gi rgyud kyi le'u thamalas 'byung ro//gdong drug las ni/bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po'i skur ba pas nas/wahe'i bdag po chung mar bcas pa zhabs kyi 'og tu brdzis zhes/gshin rje'i bdag po khyo shug tshar bcad pa tsam cig gsungs/de yang gzhin rje'i bdagapo dang /drag po dbang phyug gcig par 'dod pa'ang yod do//de bzhin du gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba las/de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed//mtshon ma me lce 'bar ba 'khrigs//'de mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan//thams cad kyi ni lag cha shor//zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jam dbyangs kyis gshin rje gshed sprul bas/khro bo gzhan thamasacad skrag pa'i r+sā du brjod pa sogs yod do//'jam dpal rdo rje 'gas

byed chen po'i rgyud la rtog bdun las/de yis lha rnams thams cad la/tab/shugs che zhing 'jigs par byed//ces pa'i tshig zur gyis cung zad tsatsha'aphangs pa ma gtogs/rtog bdun las lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs/pa med/gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa las/de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin wo po'i skugasung thugs kyi sprul pa/rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ri rab kyi rtse mor sku sprulanas/gdul bya gshin rje rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen te/lhophyogs kyi rgya mtshor phar brgal te/gshin rje'i gnas lcags mkhang bcu drugagis bcom/ye thes rdo rje'i ling gas dbus kyi lcags mkhar bskyel/zhi pa/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po gnad nas gzir/bdud tshogs gzhan thams cad bcom nas rmeg med par mdzad/sdebargyad thams cad kyis srog snying phul/mna' dor/lten rje dang ma mo thams cad sgrol ba'i gying pho mor byin gyisabarlabs/bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos go/zhes/pa tsa me zhig 'byung ste/gdul bya'i gtso bo gshin rje pho mo kho nar ston pa'i lugs gcig go/yangagrub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gtam rwa lo wo po'i gsung rgyun las 'byung ba ni/sngon du dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i sngon rol na/lha dbang phyug wo po'i bu lha'i dmag dpon wo po gzhon ge tshe nu gcwardedrug dang /lha mig dol pa drag po gnyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi bdag po su byed la ma mthun nas/yun ring du 'thabs pa las/gdong drug ni pham/gdolapa drag pos 'dzam gling la dbang bsgyur ba na/lha dbang phyug chen po rir ba kyi khong seng na gnas pas de shes te/sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa mkha' la8

spyod pa'i lha rnams dang / nad brgyad gdon brgyad sogs sa steng go 'byung po thams cad dang / lha min klu la sogs pa'i sa 'og na spyod pa thams cad dmagatshogs su bskul zhing / drag po dbang phyug chen po nyid/ drag shul dang bcasate 'ongs pa na/ gdol pa drag po ni mgon skyabs gzhan med pas shin tu'ajigs shing skrag pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs yid la sprin te/ gdong nam mkhar phyogs te skad kyi gdangs chen pos/ mtshan nas bosashing gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs der 'jam dpal mthon sum du khyon pa/gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa las/ zhal gzhan brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams kyi 'jigs byed brgyad gsol bar mdzad/ rtsa zhaladang ling gas ni 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po khros pa nyid btul/ ma he'i rwaganyis kyis lha ma yin gyi rta ba rnams bcom/ glang lpags 'dzin pa'i phyagaganyis kyis brgya byin dang / phyag gzhan so gnyis kyis nye dbang su5cu soganyis tshar bcad/ zhabs g.yas brgyad kyis gdon brgyad/ g.yon brgyad kyis nad brgyad mnan/ klu rnams rgyan du bcings/ gzhan yang lha gdon marungs pa rnams/ la la zhal du gsol/ lal zhabs kyis rma nan/ zhes de ngosasu 'byung la/ de'i shugs la/ gzhan yang zhal dgus gza' dgu dang/phyogs skyong dgu dang / 'jigs byed brgyad dam dgu/ zhal dgu dang/ spyan nye bdun gyis rgyu skar rnams btul ba'ang don gyis thob bo/ /de ltar na gdugapa can gyi lha klu lha min/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin tha pas cad/ dus dang poratshar bcad cing bsgral nas/ snying khrag gsol ba la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen —39—

po bstan nas/slar yang gso shing rjes su bzung ste ye shes kyi dkyil zhaboradu dbang bskur/yang dag pa'i lam la bkod nas/gdod nas grub pa dang/gsar du thob pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang /sangs rgyas byang sems natshamakha' gang ba'i dbus su rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa gsungs /rgyud rgyas pa des dusayun ring mor sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/skyes bu mtha' yas pa zhig gis dngos grub thob bo//de nas bar skabs su mi rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur bar mkhyen nas/o rgyan gyi gnas dharma ga lja cho se kyi mdzod du rgyas btab nas bzhugs so zhes 'byung na/rgyud 'di gdod nas grub pa'i dbang du byas te/sngon byung rtsa ba'i gleng gzhi de bzhin yin mod/ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas kyang/slarabazlos te gsungs pa yin dgos pas/de rjes o rgyan du rgyas btab bo zhesabarjod na legs par mngon no//'di dang gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa gnyis mi'adrabar byung yang /rtsa rgyud bsdus rgyud mi 'dra ba so so la dgos / pa'ang/rdzogasaldan gnyis ldan la sogs pa dus skabs tha dad du/bstan pa byung tshul sosol dgongs pa yang srid/gnas dus gcig dang rgyud gzhung gcig yin yang/sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gal ba ni ma yin no//gtam rgyud phyi ma 'di ltar na/gdul bya'i gtso bo lha dbang phyug chen po yin/gdol pa drag po ni ha la nag po'am las kyi lten rje ste/nang loragyi gtso bo sno zhes 'dod do//spyir 'jigs byed wo po zhes pa/dbang phyug40

wo po khros pa'i ming yin/yang rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po zhes rdo rje'i d+kuyi ri 9si 'a no no no 0ri chesborngo gyas btags pa 'a/tso po ngab pa pas wo(si byad kya lha ga yan ye/gdul bya' ga ba da sdig she ༷ḍi da pa yang / sgyu nag/zhen rje/ā+oṃsasbyib pa sags sprang rdzu'ang gnad cha rno zhag snad rjeg/she//'i na dang mams 'ang par gya ༷na las gh+riX pa ji/kaXn rja mu ru tha /ste sgrub yos tha pasapa dang mgan pa na kyi/rda rja ru 'a la na kyi 'a/ye rin pa zus spra shog myo pa 'a pa la kau/da she gya skyan las 'chal ba 'a tshul kyi da/gzhan gyi da sbyi ma 'ad/༷byes kyi gshinaX rwa dri rnams she/gagazha~X sa shas pa dā ma sdid /phyas gshan rja ngab ri ༷ze rla/snos chesashe/ sad thabs kyas 'a//rgyud cig lotswa ba chi/༷'a yan zar (/da gsungs sdel gya gtam rgyud saḥXtshor rdzo /ma ba 'a ma traX ru sa dpa blangs pa 'a zhag ka ྅sde 'u pas ra ba'i tshal / nga sa//sngi pa 'a gnyas/'aXkas pa' yul du ltar she ba tshul da'agra/da~X /khab bcos phrog spres sgyu sna dir ji tsam stor ba'i la she tshul/dgangs ༷la bstan bcas phyaX she she la gyi skyar pe 'di'i she cas paX/glo/shes pa na/'a skal kau pa 'a sa pa lha 'dzam bu' she dar ba rnyi gli dbang du byas she/lo 'ad dag ga jig dge ge mu tsam brjad she /'ang ra mi dang ྅gra ༷ gzhan dang /ra mi khu rtan sna khaXtshe' na nga mi pa na ༷༵ dzod ḍi/da di nyid kyi ku par nus stso sto brjad kyas yangagyilang ba 'a ra ra//glang 'ad nyad rdong /yul zhi pa gzhan/ dang gzhan/

gleng ba mi byed kyi/'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ji ltar byungatshul phyogs mtshon gyi dbang du byas na/de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan lasarde'adas pa'i rjes su/bka' bsdu ba gsum pa'i bar la/gtso bor nyan thos kyi theg pa 'gro don byung /bsdu ba gsum pa'i rjes nas mi ring bar then chen gyi mdo sde rnams cig car mi yul du byon zhing dar ba'i tshe/bya spyod tshwa5'byorargyud phal tsheb dang /gsang ba 'dus pa dang /sangs rgyan(mnyamakhasbyoralasogs pa bla med ci rigs pa'ang mi yul du byon/dus de'i tshe nyid nas khro rgyalagashin rje gshed po'i sngags rgyud kyang dar te/de yang 'phags pa'i yul na 'di skad ces grag ste/dus kyi rim pa lnga byung skad/de yang/'dod pa'i dngos grub spyod sna tshogs//gnod pa cwa dang nges spyod dang //cha shas ho te rnam lnga'o//de la dus dang po 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi dus ni/dus de'i tsherig pa 'dzin pa stong phrag brgya byung ba las/lho phyogs kyi rgyud grong khyer gsoṭagyi sa zhes bya ba na/rgyal po bi dza ya sing ha 'khor stong dang bcas pa/'dod pa'i yul lnga la rtag tu spyod kyang /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rigasngags grub pas/'dod pas ma bcings par grol te/rdorje'i sku brnyes/ri'i rgyal po man+da ra la bzhugs so//zhes grag go/yang shar phyogs kyi grong khyer/dz+wa ṣa swa mi ste nya'i rje zhes bya/sngon de ltaragrags/ba ren dra'i bye brag cig yi myo zer/der rgyal po drag po'i 'byor pa zhes bya ba gshin rje gshed po'i rig sngags grub ste/gdug pa can thaman/cad drag shul spyod pa'i sngags kyis bsad bskrad dbye mnan rengs pa sogs kyi tshar 4

bcad rmo slar gsos thi / lha pa te/yang nga/ga pa'i sa bskya pob / zhi can/thar lor gra rgyal yi mar+sādang bcas pa pa 'dzin pa she bo//'ad sa na rgyal yi mchod zhes / su rnga rig gi she//rnga thams cad grub pa zhig byung ste/paXyedzas bya ba ri/ga pa rdor pa shā // thams cad grub pa zhag byung/zhas ba/nga dang gro'i dardebacas ṭā pa 'dzin pa las grub nas/'phags pa bya bad lta kla nā lngasdokhams snye tu zhes pa kau/༵nga zer der ya gun/na dra de/da lta kla grong ka la pa 'ad ka 'in zar/ ra rgyal pa nā na dra ba klu dbang lha sgres bya she byung /des rgyal srad kyang bde bar gyi zhal/༷brgya snron te dzozhig gis ba ༵ na/rje dkyi rig sngags stsa 9 zhal mthang ba 'a dgortswazhag sa/gzhan ni med rja da ḍā 'ag 'a stsal bas myur du ༷gru~X rgas pa'i ba ra sdug bsngal med/mū ༷dbyabs kya rnam rdzu/ slar sgyu pa 'a sgom la bshe brngor du gnas nas/'thar zhabar stang dang bcas pa pa na pa grwa kha/ ba//yangabyang phyogs kha sto ha ri ha ra zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das lten rje lted kyi1chi ri nor 7'i ra tsho ke sterdetsho chi ge de grub pas/'a skar ༷rme yul she sa cad dbang du kyi lhod /grang bya ba la ye she 'a sa/rig pa lo sgom pa su she de spyad sna sbyad nas/gshi stang na : dang rigs pa' ga pa na par gyur ta//'i dag mar+sā pa ste/ sa rje gshe/da kya sngags rgyud ye she nag/rje sku thob ḍi mtha' yas pa zhag byung ngo //de ltar dus dang po la brgyal5sa brgya yam̐34rde// 'i ra tsho ze rgyas/rderde :)de rjes lodzodus gnyas pa spyad pa ba sna sa rdo grub pa / rjas la su skabargya tsam/

gyi bar du gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa rnams/don mgrub pa ni gcig kyang med/phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung mad/ral gri ro langs bcud len sogs lo'i sbyor bas 'grub pa dang /zhi sogasardephra mo thams cad zla ba drug gis mi 'gru/ba pa'i thabs med/sa 'ogs stengasogs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'ang mang du byung /gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur9ri yi ri rdo bye lbo pe/bar ma thob pa dang lhan cag khyam gag tu sngags bzlar yang btung/ ste/'a na dbang ma thob pa de'i lus de ma thag tu 'a pa'am/skams/pa'am/da' 'gro ba byung bas/sngags 'a pa po rnams gcag pu kho nar 'a ༵da/de' tshe lho phyogs su tshong dpon gya bu a ra dang /sa ra zhes bya ba gto/—saslob dpon gcig la gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur nod nas/thor sa kyi tshe bri sku'i mdun du sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas so//a ra zhes bya ba de log ṇinatsam song ba na/tshong khang du tshong gi bya ba byed 'phro la/lus yang zhing semasadaga' ba de'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa zhig byung /der 'chag sa thag ring ba zhig la phyin pas/chag ma len pa'i phyir du/chom rkun g.yo can mi bzhisdabazung /zhags pas skyug pa la sngags dran pa tsam gyis chad/lcags sgrogabartod pa'ang thang chu bzhan du nud skad de/der tshong khang yid la dran pas tshongakhang du sleb/lam khar gter ra byi mthong nas snying rjes chom po de rnams bosate/gter de las ci 'dod par byen skad/bu sa ra ni dgong ka zhin dgrag pa thogs te/phyugs rnams skor ba la song ngo //der rang go lus las sngagasakyisgra dang /'od zer byung ngo //ba 4 /yab pas tshe la ra ro//de thogs te

phyugs bdas pas phyugs kyi rwa las kyang me 'bar zhing / log ho nges pas khyim du sleb kar/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ cho ga'i lhag pa 'di dang 'o de lta bu gyis zhes zer ro/ /de ltar byas pas khong rang dang phyugs rnams rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i lus su gyur/ lo bcu gnyis su ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rig pa mang po bstan te/ mthar ri rab kyi rtse mor 'gro'o zhes zer gar song ma med do/ /gtam rgyud 'dis mtshon no/ /de yan chad du gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams skal med kyi sems can gcig la'ang 'chol bar 'byar ba med cing /skal ldan kho na la dar ba yin no/ /dus gsum pa gnod pa can gyi dus ni lo lnga brgya tsam mo zer yang nges pa med pa 'dra'o/ /gnod pa can gyi don ni/ skal ldan ched du bya ba'i gduwa bya rang yang ma yin mdo sngags ci rigs pa 'grub nus pa'i las shugs chen po yod pa rnams la'ang dar bas nus pa'i sgo nas sems can la gnod pa dang /yul dang dus ma yin par mngon spyod byas pas/ sgrub po rang sdi la'ang ga pa 'byung ba'i don yin/ dus kyi stobs kyis de 'dra'ang mang du byung zhes pa tsa5yin gyi/ skabs der yang skal ldan dngos grub thob pa'ang mang du byung nga/sems can gyi don rgya cher ma byas pa ni ma yin no/ /de dag kyang mtha' yasapazhig yod mod kyi/ gtam rgyud dpe tsam mtshon pa ni/ rgyal po zla ba sbas pa'i dus su/ yul o ḍi bi shar tshong dpon gyi bu rab tu byung ba sna tshogs 'gyungaganas zhes bya ba zhig sde sne rwad gsum la byang bar bslabs nas/ nags khro de kyi phug pa chig na bsgom zhing 'dug go /des mtshan cig phug pa'i phyir phyin —45—

pas rdo leb cig gi steng na 'od cher 'phro ba zhin 'dug go/de mngon rtagasasu bzung ste nangs par bltas pas/shing be kang kang zhes bya ba las byas pa'i ral gri zhig 'dug ste/de la ma reg pa zhag re bzhin lta bar song na dbyar gyi dus su de las sprin chad de/o ḍi bi shi'i yul du char chen po 'bab pa yangayang mthong nas shin tu ngo mtshar skyes pa la/rmi lam du 'di ni ri bo waṃ laganas pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig gi rtsed mo yin no//zer bas/rigasngags mkhan de blta 'dod par gyur te/ri nags de thams cad bskor zhingayun ring du gsol ba btab pas/lan cig brag de'u cig gi ngos tshe long ltaramanyam zhing mkhregs pa cig las sgo phye ste/der zhugs pas rig pa 'dzin pa gcig bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag byas/de'i mtshan ni/a nan ta bhā te 'od mtha' yas zer gsung /dpe la la na a nan ta bhak+ta zer ba'ang yod/de lagasol ba btab pas/des gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbangabaskur/phyag mtshan rdo rje zhig gtad/sna tshogs 'gyung gnas kyis kyang de thogs nas zla ba drug bsgoms pas/rdo rje las 'od 'bar ba lus la phogapas 'ja' lus su gyur/phyi rabs kyi sems can gyi don du de'i zhabs rjesayod/de dag dang dus mtshungs rung la/'phreng rgyud mkhan gzhig gis kyangagashin rje gshed kyi rigs sngags la bzlas bsgom la brtson pas tshe tona'aphreng rgyud 'phyo bzhin du 'phreng rgyud sprugs pas/sa g.yos shing 'phreng rgyud kyi rjes rdo la gsal bar byung /bla dwags kyi ming 'phreng ba mchog ces bya/yulabhu sha na'i ri la sku lus ma spangs pa da lta bzhugs zer bas mtshon te/dngos46

rgyud rgyal gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'gyung rgyas pa yid tshes ngo mtshar bzhugs/grub thob pa'ang tshes mang ngo / /gnod pa can gyi gtam yang/ yul go ri'i rgyal po snying po thig le'i blon po bram ze tsa na ka lta bu yin/ de'i gon na rje gshed kyi zhal mthong / mngon spyod kyi las kyis mi sum stong tsam ni bsad/stong phrag bcu tsam smyo bar byas/ dbye ba/ bskrad pa/ rengs pa/ dbangaponyams pa sogs kyi gnod pa'ang ches mang / phyogs kyi rgyal po'i srid bcu drugatsam stongs par byas/ de'i sdig pas dmyal bar skyes so/ /'i de 'jam dpalartsa rgyud las lung bstan/ ma 'ongs pa na gshin rje chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur b.rabashad do/ /'di'i gtam rgyud mtha' dag ma lte thas kyang/ dper mtshon pa la/yul ḍi lir kla kle'i rigs kyi rgyal po/ ha tshar a la zhes bya ba yod do/ /grongakhyer bcom rlag man chad rgyal po snying po thig le'i yul yin/ rgyal po de gnyis/'thabs te g.yul bshams pa'i skabs su/ bram ze de'i sngags kyis btab pa'i bya thib shig nam mkha' la phur te btang bas/ ḍi li'i dmag mi rnams kyis mgo la reg pa tsam du 'phur zhing / gshog pa'i rlung gi sgra 'brun sgra tsa5byung / dmag mi thams cad kyis nam mkha' la bltas/so/ /bya de thag ringapor mi snang bar song ba/ dmag mi phal pa rnams rnal mar 'dun kyang/ rgyal po dang dpa' bo'i rigs lnga brgya tsam mig nam mkha' la blta tshul gyis dran med du brgyal zhing myos/ de ka la lus pas snying po thig le'i dmag gis ḍi li'i yul mtha' dag blangs so/ /yang yul si ro zhi'i rgyal po ha ha rwadzadang /snying po thig le rtsod par gyur pa'i skabs shig yul der dus ston chen po zhig byung / bram ze tsa na ka slong mo bar brdzus te blta bar song ngo/ /la mo du bud —47—

med rgan mo zhig dang 'phrad pa/ de yang sngags 'chang ma yin par shes nas/bdag cag las tshogs sgrub pa'i grogs kyis shig byas nas/ de dang sdebs te song song ba las/ mthar dus ston byed sa na/ shing karko shi'i 'bras bu phungaposhin tu che bar 'dug nas/ mi rnams kyis ma tshor bar/ de la bram zes sngagasakyis btab ste bzhag mkha' 'gro mas kyang lta stangs kyis ma zhan no/ /de nasadaga' ston gyi skabs/ shing thog rgyal po dang blon po dang gtso bo phros go ladrangs/ rang rang so sos de nas zos so/ /thams cad kyi tha ma phyag tshang ba des za bar bsams te/ chu gris shing thog phyed mar gtubs pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas sum brgya tsam gyi mgrin pa dus gcig tu chad de mgo sa la lhung ngo / /de nas yul de yang snying po thig les blangs so/ /zhes grag go /de dgani mtshon pa ste/ gzhan rnams kyang de 'dra'i rigs so/ /yang de dag ni rjesasu/ yul ma la bar bram ze legs par grub byed ces bya ba byung/ des slob dpon sngags mkhan zhig la gshin rje gshed zhus te bsgoms pas/ rigasngags 'grub nas las phra mo rnams thogs pa med do/ /'on kyang las sna tshogs kyis yid 'byung ste/ yul ma rle'i so mtshams grong khyer ka'i na zhes bya ba dang nye ba'i brag phug gcig tu gnas bcas nas/ skye bo mang po lag sngagasakyi mthus phan 'dogs shing bsdad pas/ grong khyer ba de dag sngar mu stegasabyed kho na la dad pa las/ skabs der phal cher nang pa la dad par gyur to/ /de'i rgyal po rgyal phran cig yod pas kyang / yang yang blta bar 'ongs pa las/de dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig na/ rdo leb chen po 'dom gang sa du 'thug pa —48—

dkyus zheng du 'dom bco lnga tsam pa zhig yod pa/ gnod spyin stobs po tshe zhinal bka' bsgos te/ des blangs nas rang nyid sdod sa'i phug pa'i sgo 'gebasabyed byas so/ /rgyal po des nyi ma snga ma cig ye 'angs dus/ de med pa las de'i phyi nyin 'ongs pas/ de ltar 'dug pa mthong ste ya mchan skyes nas slob dpon de bla mar bkur ro/ /de nas rgyal po de yang stobs dang ldan par gyur nas/ soru ni sogs yul mang po la dbang byed pa zhig byung ngo / /der mu stegs kyi slob dpon so ma ā tsar+ya la sogs pa rnams phrag dog tu gyur nas gros byas/ yulaphyogs 'di kun tu sangs rgyas pa dar ba ni/ bram ze 'di la thug na 'di bsad par nus pa su yod byas pa la/ khas len pa su yang med de/ de ni rig sngags grub pa yin pas/ me chu mtsho ni dug sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pasasozhes zlog go /de nas phyi zhig na mu stegs pa'i dbul po lus chung zhing gosakhrus ba nyams chung chung 'dra ba gnyis zhig gis khas blangs te/ de gnyis la ljong mu stegs de rnams kyis gser 'bum rngan par steng bar khas blangs so/ /de nas de gnyis bram ze legs grub kyi sar song nas g.yog byed cing yod pa las/ ji zhig na bram zes de gnyis kyi bsam pa shes kyang ci yang miganod do bsam pas ci dgar bzhag bo /de yang sngon bram ze'i bla ma sngags mkhan des/ khrus la 'gro ba na mi skra'i tshangs skud sgo gong du btags te bzhag pa/bram ze legs grub kyi mgo la thogs pas khros te bcad nas bor/ de la blamade bag tsam ma mnyes pa'i dmod pa yod pas/ g.yog de gnyis kyis kyanga'atshang de rig ste skabs 'tshol zhing yod do/ /skabs der bus ze legs grub —49

sdis 'a gnyis po ye sa ye ru brdzangs mi da/so ma ldi sa khas su bur stegs 'ganas pa sked skyal zhag ru/snyes lte da bzhan sdo sna/sngi shegs kya da' gzha she ste'o cad zhag /sa 'a mo ze dasasha'//'aXpag 'angs/༵/pa lan par khu ca khra//bram daX 'a kyā tshangs skud da bzhag nas sa 'i par khrusaX' ske/g.yag pa gnyas kyas 'a skud 'a ta ral gra la dkras nas bram zaX bcad sto sgo do//da na de bsad zan snyam nas mgo khyer te/de gto/bros nas so ra 7 rwa ri dren rtse bye 7 rarna da da nyu ) 'ir gi rasang/shang 'a ze~Xtogs ta phyar 'a/mū//rge chadage kya 'a ma she 〉 rdi//bram za gas gruX ra mu ste zan gya da gsar gte / dbyag rnams shes da bas/du~Xmugs 'a/dga' dgaX ltar nga mtshar cha 'a sngi pa kyi tsho'i za tshos grub zi sngags grub ༷sa ma ༷ sta bsams pa/da na slaX ye rngi ༷mad ṭā byungaX pas/dalasadu snga ga snram kroX ba dang brtis ta/mag ba sto pa' 'a dasacan rnams dang skye bo mang po lta dmo nas/ye ri tsho bo ༅ 'a/darded rmyums ye ༷ mang te ltad ma 'a stan ༷ ye ye sna dar gar sngid rbong 'angs/dmathang ba da// sku stega' 'aX gaXs dang /n+d+rastod can lnga brga cam ye skyugs ta sha mu sna~X pa' na na ge dzi grang da yang mas chag ga /da 'a ye za da 'a/ra gaXgaye dzi sngar sald du ༷na ye she /da 'go tshe pa yab rte/ 'aXga'angs ta/gtan na rja gshad kya cha ga stang brgyad brgya pa yab / bus shang/slab/

ma gsum la cung zad bsha/da nas/ glegs bam brag la sbas te bzhag mi ringabar phug de nyid du mi snang par gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni mthob/thun mong gi rig 'dzin yin zer/ gnas de ni sgo rang la ste/ drag po wor ba zhes pa dur khrod shin tu bka' gnyan pa zhig da lta yang yod de/ kla klo rnams kyis 'gro mi nus gsung ngo / /yang dmangs rigs kyi slob dpon kam la karazhes bya ba gcig gis/ slob dpon dzā la ha ri zhes bya ba dge slonge sngags mkhan zhig mnyes par byas te/ gshin rje gshed zhus nas bsgoms pag lo'aga' zhig song ba na/ sngags 'gru/ba cing zhal yang mthong/ nub phyogs kyi yul bhā ra pā ṭa na zhes pa grong sde bcu gnyis yod pa zhig na/ bsod snyoms rgyu zhing nags na gnas par byed do/ /yul de dang po dad can mang po yod pa yin yang / bar der bram ze dang kla kle'i btsun pa dag gis su thob kyi tshuwa gyisa'ongs nas/ yul thams cad lta ba log par bsgyur/ der kam la kar samim yin mthu chen mo mang po rig mar bsgrubs nas yod pa/ mi'i bud med kyigazugs su bsgyur te de dag dang lhan cig grong khyer du phyin pa'i grong khyer gyi mi rnams 'tshogs te/ sangs rgyas pa 'di kun la bden pa cung zad kyang med/'di sngon tshangs par spyod pa yin par brdzu ba/ da bud med dang lhan cig grongadu rgyu'am zhes thams cad kyis thal brdabs byas/ ka ma la ka ra khros te/lhung bzed sa la brdabs pas sa g.yos mi bzad pa byung / grong sde bcu gnyis kyi mi phyugs khang khyim byung ba'i shul tsam yang med par sa 'og tu song/ deraganod pa ha cang tshes pa'i sdig pas/ slob dpon des dngos grub ni mthob/—51—

lo sum brgyar 'tsho zhing /phan gnod kyi nus pa gang la'ang thogs rdugs med/yul sa kar dang /bha kar gnyis kyi ri la gnas shing/'o nges spyod lha dngamanyam pa byung /bzhin rje gshed mkhan po tshe ring ba'i grags pa yang de nasabyung skad/gtam rgyud mtshon pa tsam mo//de dag ni spyir gzhin rje gshed kyi chos skor byung tshul dang/rig sngags 'grub tshul tsam yin srid mar naga'ajigs gsum gyi rgyud rnams de skabs mi yul na spyod pa cher med skad do//rgyud sde'ang gsang sngags phyi rgyud la brten pa kho na yin zhes grags mod/mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/bla med kyi tshul la brten pa'ang mang du yod paramangon no//de rjes bar skabs cig lo brgya tsam khro bo ston rje lted po'i rig sngags grub pa nyung ba'i skabs shig byung ngo //dus bzhi pa nges pa la spyod pa ni/de nas slob dpon chen po dpal chosakyi grags pa'i sku tshe'i stod tsam gyi dus shig na/slob dpon la li ta badz+ra byungango //slob dpon de 'byungs pa'i yul ni o ḍi bi sha yin/bod pa rnamasarigs bram ze yin zhes 'chad/dpal na lan dar song nas rig pa'i gnasalnga la mkhas par byas/sngags kyi theg pa yang mang du thes/slob dpon sngags/mkhan zhig la/dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang zhus/me tog 'jam dpalalaphog pas 'jam dpal nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgrubs pa yin/gsang mtshan lali ta badz+ra yin mtshan dngos 'jam dpal mtshon cha zhes bya/des 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas/lo nyi shu tsam na zhal gzigs shing/thun mongagodangos grub 'ga' re thob bo//skabs 'dir bod kyi blam rnams gsung༅pa

ltar na/slob dpon 'dis paṇ+ḍi ta sngags mkhan rnams la/'jam dpalamasno brjod las/rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/khro yi rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs//mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan//zhes gsung༅pa 'di rnams kyi lha sngags rgyud dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gang yin zhes drisakyang /'jam dpal gyi sku'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa ston te de'i nang tshan reyin gsung pa tsam las/'dzug btsugs su ston rgyu ma byung/khong rang goglama'am/paṇ+ḍita bgres po zhig la zhus pas/dpa' bo mkha' ga 'gro'i phyag na 'di dag la'ang rgyud re re yod par 'dug ste/da lta mi yul na med pas/de'i don du 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgrubs shig gsungs nas bsgrub pa yin zer ro//de nas slob dpon gyis bskyed rim brtan cing nus pa cung ra thob pa dang /dpal o rgyan gyi yul nas dregs pa 'dul ba'i rgyud spyan drongs shigapa'i lung bstan yang thob nas/rim gyis byang phyogs su bzhud na ga.o rgyan dang nye ba'i gnas kun tu mu stegs rnams dang nus pa 'gran pa las/gzhan thams cad las rgyal bar gyur kyang lan cig mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor ra ma zhig gis lta stangs byas pas/slob dpon yug cig dran med du bo gde sangs tsan/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/bco5ldan 'dasam rdo rje ro langs ma mi'i bud med kyi rnam par ma phro sum du byon te gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/slob dpon gyi rgyud la phyin ci ma log pa'i dbang gi ye shes skyes/gnad der zla ba phyed dang gsu5rdebasgoms pas/bskyed rdzogs kyi ye shes brtan cing drod thob nas/nags kyi

ma he gdug pa can bkug ste/ de la phyibs te zla ba drug tu smyon pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ de rjes dza la pa ṭa na dang / ta la pa ṭa na la sogs pa'i grong khyerarnams su rgyu zhing / bzhi mdor bzhugs te chang 'tshong ma rnams kyi chang thamasacad dus gag tu bkug ste gsol ba dang / yang de'i phyi nyin chang 'tshongamarnams kyi chang gi snod dag gser dngul dang / rin po tshe dang/ gzhan yangardzas sna tshogs kyis gang bas tshims par mdzad/ yang lan cig grong khyer gyi miphyugs rnams la khrag 'gug pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du snod chen po khrag gis khengs/ rdo rje tsar tsi kas zhal mngon sum du bstan/ de gsol bas stobs dpag tu med par gyur te/ glang po tshe ni soramogacig gis mnan/ shal ma li'i sdong po chen po yang phyag gcig gis sanasabaton/ grong khyer gyi mi phyugs thams cad shin tu rid par gyur to stams cad 'jigs shing skrag pa na/ de'i nangs par sngar bkug pa rnams slar pharaspos pas/ mi phyugs thams cad nyams stobs dang ldan par song/ rdorje tsaratsi ka'i sgrub thabs zhig kyang mdzad do/ /de dag la sogs pa rig pa'i 'julazhugs kyi 'gro don cung zad mdzad nas/ dpal o rgyan gyi gnas dharma ga lja chos kyi mdzod du byon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bka' bgros te/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud spyan drangs so/ /yang rgya gar gyi lo rgyus cig la/ smyon pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa yan chad yulaja ri khaṇ+ḍa ra yin la/ de nas rgyud spyan 'dren pa'i lung bstan byung ste/ o rgyan du bzhud ces kyang 'chad la/ bod kyi bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ la li tas o —54—

rgyan gyi sa mthar phebs tsa na/ zhabs la 'a sa rgyu ras byugs nas yod pa la/'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ nged kyi mgo rgyan khyed kyi rkang pa labyug pa zer nas/ sdigs mdzub byas pas/ slob dpon dran med du song/ de sangs tsa na skyabs gzhan med mgon gzhan med dgongs nas rdo rje ro langs ma la gsol ba btab zer ba dang / rgyud spyan 'dren pa na mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ zhag bdung du blo la gang zin pa khyer zer bas/ zhag bdun du bzung bsami phan snyam ste/ lha la gsol ba btab pas/ zhag bdun pa'i thorangs/naga'ajigs skor gsum gyi rgyud thugs la lhangs te shar/ ske tshang nas glegs bam blangs te blta sa pas kyang ma nor bar 'dug ces 'chad/ de lta na yang gongadakyus su bris pa ni/ 'phags yul rang du grags pa ltar yin zhing/ lo rgyusakyi yi ger yang bkod pa yin pas 'khrul ba med do/ /de nas nub phyogs kyi yul mo la tā na zhes pa na/ rgyal po na ra pad+ma zhes bya ba yod de/ gnas de na mu stegs byed dug gi rgyud la mkhas pa mang po dag yod pa las/ rgyal posabaskul te de dag dang nus pa 'gran pa las/ mu stegs de rnams kyis dug bre bore re dus gcig tu zos/ slob dpon gyis dug mi khur bcu btags te/ de'i tshad nyis 'gyur kyi myos byed la btab ste gsol yang gnod pa med/ ghi la zhesapa chang snyol ba'i snod rdza ma shin tu che ba cig gi ming yin de 'dra gnyis dngul chus gang ba gsol yang gnod pa med/ de ltar dug dang / dngur chu de zhags/bdun gyi ring la gsol bas/ sku bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dpa gtu med par gyur rte/ rgyal po'i pho brang yang phyag gcig gis bsgul bas/ thams cad —55—

skrag ste yo byad dpag tu med pa phul/ de thams cad dge slong dang phongs pa rnams kyis ce bder khyer/ de nas gan+ta ra'i ri la lo gcig tu ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la bzhugs/ de nas grong khyer hasti na pu rar byon/ den mu stegasabyed kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi rol pa'i sngags/mkhan gyi sde chen po chags te/ nus pa thob pa rang yang pho mo 'dres pa lnga brgya tsam yod skad/ der slob dpon byon te/ de rnams la phar sku lus ston cingatshig kyang gsungs la/ de dag gi tshur smra ba'am/ phyi rjes ge cod du byung na sku lus mi snang bar byed pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul bstan te/ mthar nyi ma phyed kyi dus zhig na/ de nas brtsams nam phyed kyi bar la dus btab ste/ khyed rangarnams bsgrims te bzlog pa gyis shig ngas kyang sngags gtong ro zhes mthu dusabatab pas nam phyed na sa g.yos/ skye bo gzhan la ni gnod pa med/ mu stegasapa'i sngags mkhan mthu chen thams cad sa 'og tu sdib ste gar song med par shi'o/ /de nas ma ga dhar byon te/ dpal na lan dar song ba na/ paṇ+ḍita rnams na re/ khyed kyis rgyud kyang spyan drangs/ nus pa yang thob ces zer na/nangs par nam langs pa tshun chod la/ dngos su mthong ba'i nus pa zhin ston cig zer ba la/ 'o na rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i 'khor zhig 'dir dgug gi byas/de la rgyal po seng ge lnga pa 'khor bcas ni/ yul go ra na yod de/ na lan da nas shar phyogs su mgyogs pa song yang zla phyed tsam 'gro dgos pa la/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi las sbyor mdzad pas/ rgyal po seng go lnga pa'i blon po mu tā ri pra dā na bya ba mu stegs la dad pa zhig yul ma ga dhar 'gro 'dod skyes—56—

nas nyi ma phyi phred kyi dus su yo byad mang po dang bcas shing 'khor dang bcas pa lam du zhugs pas zla ba phyed kyi lam chu tshod 'ga' zhig la bgrod nas/ namaphyed pa na dpal na lan da'i lcags ri'i nang du sleb/ dge 'dun gyi zhal ta pa la skad btang ste/ nam langs ma thag dge 'dun rnams la chos ston gsol/nor mang po phul/ phyin chad sangs rgyas pa byed par khas blangs pas/ slob dpon la thams cad yid ches shing ngo mtshar skyes so/ /de nas shar phyogs ba ren+t+ra'i bye brag ba ga la zhes bya ba cig yod/ de yang bha gal dang / ba galasoso yin par go dgos/ yul de na mtsho gcig la klu bi kri ḍa zhes bya ba/gdug rtsub che zhing / phyi pa dang kla kle'i grogs byed/ nang pa la shin tu gnod pa zhig yod do/ /mtsho'i mtha' rnams su sngags kyi srad bus bsgor nas/ deraspyin sreg mdzad pas klu 'khore dang bcas pa tshig mtsho yang theg bdun nasabaskams/ de'i shul du rdo ring wo po btsugs/ rdo ring go rtse mo la wotshadapal gyi sku gzugs cig byas so/ /skabs der yul ba ben dran he tsili zhesapa kla kle'i grong zhig yod/ gzhan kla klo med do de rnams stobs dang ldan para'agro ba dang rgyal khams thams cad phung bar byed pa'i ltas gzigs nas/ de dang nye bar spyin sreg kyang cher mdzad/ nyi ma gcig 'khrul 'khor bskor nas/ro langs me ldan zhes bya ba nyi ma khos pa la btad pas/ de ma thag he tsili'i kla kle'i grong thams cad tshig ste/ kla kle'i bla ma kā tsi dang / sa phyi ta thams cad shi de nas brtsams lo lnga brgya'i bar du ba ren+t+ra ra kla klo ye ma byung skad/ de dgani rgyud las gsungs pa'i bsam gtan dang / sbyin sreg dang / 'khrul 'khor—57—

gyi nus pa bstan pa yin gyi/slob dpon ṣ+ka de dag la ma ltos te/grub pa wo po brnyes i phyir/brgo pa tsa5gyis las thams cad mod la lnga yi/bo//da de ༷ ra ma yig:spro ra tshod rjas gā ga dha dang/'aXl dang/do de nasang na~Xye bzhugs zhes sems can gya ye nga gi dpo// she 'a ga a o du rgyalardepo an+t+ra bo dha bar ༷ de/thun mang she da she thab oṃ/ye shengargyal dang ldan pas dzhai ge ge ge zhes ge ge de ni de ta byan 'a/lam du ces bya ba lwa ba she dang yi snad pas ri nge 'a cag dziX/sa ༷ na/ra mu chas ka bya ༷ lashe 'a 'a/no da thun s+t+ri mtha kring 'ad 'a ( yan pa las sa dpan 'a cing nge rja (lgad kya ral she ra ༷ sa cing dang lnga na ༷ ston / 'jing kha du shes pa' tshong 'dzan mdzad pas/slab dpan nyad dang lhaX 'aXdu 'gra baX skye sdo 'a po dang bcas pa thams sa/rnyi wo snro la wog tshad gsa'/graX khyar gya srang kha dog po 'dra ba cag la na pa' ngang nas yud tsa5kyig la ra 'a pha rol tu snyeb dzo she da ya ye 'a/skre nas o ༅ du de rdzo ri tsho po/she da sa zhas she pa an+t+ra gu rna she gsaX 'i/'bar 'a mang pa daX bcas ta bsu ba la smu re/rgyal pas sla(/ skor kyis gya zhaXd bkru zhang bsku mnya mdzad 'a la/spyabs laXg tsho ༷rda//ga tha/sa sku 'a byad dgos pas lag pa bzha sprul ༷la/ga/ma rnyis slab dpan spre gzhabasabazha sprul bas 'a pas phyag bsdod/sla 1 bas te dzo ri sa brgyad sprul pas/rgyalakhapas shes drug ga bar du 'a /slab dpan gyas zhabs bcu drug sprul pas/rgyal pa na lha phyag bcu drug pa' bag chaXs brtas pas/bcu drug las lhag pa

sprul ma nus te/de nas slob dpon kyi zhabs rel rgyal pos phyag re resaskumanye byas so//de nas zhabs sum cu so gnyis sprulda/bas/de yang ma nus te/rgyal po nga rgyal chag skye bo rnams dad pa skyes so//de nas o rgyan du yang 'groba'i don rgya cher mdzad/rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis kyang /phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/dus de tsa na rdo rje slob dpon r+ṣa po 'di ni ༅ge gyi shosagrub nyams 'og tu chud/bskyed rim gyi grub pa la dbang 'byor ba yin/slob dpon lwa ba pa ni mchog gi dngos grub brnyes zin pa yid skad/o rgyan nasaphyir byon pa'i dus su/lwa ba pas ri mu dzo ga nyid nam mkhar ba stsokhes pagari gtan nas med pa'i thang yangs gcig la byon chog pa byung ba'i gtam rgyud yi ri yiriyod/phyas slob dpon 'ad yang slob dpon lwa ba pa dang rtogs pa mtham paragyur to//de nas byang phyogs kha che'i yul du bas de/sems ngo mang po'i don mdzad/yang lan cig tho gar gyi yul du kla kle'i dmag byung bas/dmagarnams chu klung pa klu'i byang phyogs su yod/slob dpon gyis lho phyogs nasa'akhur ba'i dum bu cig dang /chu snyim pa gang gis gtar ma mdzad de/gtserabur bzhengs bzhin du thal mo brdabs pas/kla klo'i dmag tshogs thams cad smyo ste/ri klungs med par rgyugs/rgyal po dang dmag dpon dang dpa' bo lnga brgya tsam khrag skyugs nas shi ste/re zhig kla klo rmeg med par byas sa//de dag la sogs pa gtso bor mngon spyod kyi las sdis 'gro don mdzad 'a sgo /gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang dgug bcud len gter gya dngos grub sogs kya sgo nas/sems can mang po la phan ba/gas te/mdzad pa nge mtshar can lnga

brgya'i bar du bstan skad/sku che'i mthar yul pus ka rar bzhugs nas/'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes so//slob dpon 'dis mtshan brjod la sogs pa 'jam dpal zhi ba'i rgyud 'ga' re dang /rgyud thams cad kyi spyi bo yin pa'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa tsi rigs gsungs/gzhan gshin rje gshed skorawagatogs ma gsungs kyang sngags kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo nas tshes che ba bla na med pa'i phyir/dkyil wor wo po'i rdo rje slob dpon wo pos zhes4zha gsol lo//'di dang po bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i dus/zla dgo slong yin zhes bod rnying rnams 'chad kyang /lo rgyus khungs ma la gsal ka med cing yin ni rung /phyis ni rnal 'byor pa'i tshul du bzhugs ces pas/skub ho bzhes(na rnal 'byor ba'i cha lugs can du byed dgos/bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i thugs dmabade mchog dkyil thang drang srong srin po ri na yod pa de na/ma he la phyi bas shingaling ga gyen bsgreng can bris 'dug rgya gar du bris pa'i thang kagazhan las khyo cherkams kla kle'i sde bcom pa'i bkod pa'i tshul du byas zhabs gnyis mnyam par brkyang zhing bzhengs pa/phyag thal mo brdeb pa/ling ga gyin ba spre/nga/skumadun du gtor ma'i maṇ+ḍal yod pa re yod sgri 'dug spyir mngon spyod kyi lasamang du bsgrubs pa rnams kyis tshe de la dngos grub 'grub pa dkon kyang/slob dpon 'di'i ma phro spyod kyi phrin las thams cad ni 'gro phan bla na med pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/mngon spyod dpag tu med pa mdzad na gamathar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes so//slob dpon rdze'i glo wasang ka ra de ba zhes bya bas/rdo rje mkha' 'grom 'grub ske srid pa gsu5rdepo60

mtha' dag mthong ba'i mngon shes byung /bram ze gser mdzes zhes bya bsaganod mdzes grub ste sa 'og gi dngos grub thob/a bhi ma na zhes pa dge slongazhig gis rdo rje rta mchog grub nas/rang snang du nam mkha' la spyod cing/gzhan snang du'ang lam gang la song mi shes par ci 'dod du yong ba cig byung /pra kā sha du ta zhes bya ba ral gcig ma la brten nas/gnod spyin mo grub/nam mkha' las nor gang 'dod blangs te mi rnams la ster ro//mi pha bshesaganyen zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa cig gis/'jam pa'i rdo rje grub nas phal cheralus mi snang zhing mkhas pa rnams kyi the tshom gcod pa'i phyir du res 'ga' lus snang zhing chos ston to//bram ze chos 'bangs zhes bya ba gdug sel ma grub ste/dug khur du longs ba za zhing chu la mi bying bar 'gro/rigs ha gyi rnawa'abyor pa tsa ka ru zhes pa klu'i gnas su ci 'dod par 'gro/ku ru ku snye grub/dmangs rigs dur dza ya zhes pas yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'grub ste/thig/lemachog ma sogs lha mo brgyad kyis g.yog byed/bha tra pā li ta zhes pa cig/gisardedapal he ru ka la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sna tshogs pa dag gis bskor zhing gshegs pa zhin yod do//de rnamasathams cad rnam smin gyi lus ni ma bzhag 'ja' lus su song /snga ma rnamasakyis thun mong gi dngos grub thob/phyi mas mchon grub pa'o//de dag gisachos bshad pa las 'phel ba ni med skad/yang slob dpon dza mā dzi par mtshano thogs pa cig bha ga lar byung /grong khyer sa hrir du chos kyi 'byung gnas zhesabya ba cig byung /grong khyer a dzo khyu ru budha gup+ta zhes pa byung ste/de rnams rnam6

smin gyi lus gnas ma gyur mod/lha mo bzhi grub cing las tshogs thogs pa che pe 0ri no ge mje / rte zur 9 rngo/ yigs tshodā pa rnon zar/gsum pa skya ban nas la ta badz+ra kya chas/rnams/darab ya/kyi mu rgya gar ba shaX lha rdo / go ༷//sa sa// shes she sheli ca kya brgyud ḍi sa sa 'a she kya dbang du sde na/sgru ༵na la spyo brdzu la/dge kya ༵ga she las/mtshan lte she sa dpan lashe 'aX ta/rgyud du ma man/dbye rengs kyiXsna pa las/tshwa5sti~X pa ṭīka (rdongs nas/da she da rjo ni cha dpon gyis ma bstan pas la 'a slab ma rnams da kyi mas par byung / ra slab dpon ga rna sa bsamasardeX/nus phyim zu ye she rgyas 'i shes pa ༷grung nus pa/cha lnga yi/yestoskyun pa/ ma ༵na gyi thab sdu chas cag dgas rjo snyug she 'a5du byan ye/chu na she dge rje ye da pa sa la ye ga ye 'gra ba ༷ste dkri/rdengaphrad/daX 'gra /ra/chas ye lta 'a 'tshawa༄rde 'gra byas pa ga khyaX sacang rnyaX dam zar/ mkha' da ma dzo 'a shas 'i tshal du khrid skar ba shes 'a dro btab sdig/das dur cig las rtangaX de 1 sa ༷sa/sprama' raXs kya mkhaX ༷sbyi //༷/skan gag la gtad da//spras na / bas rdzo phyagasayo' du khrad nas/rda rja 'i dro byog phug tu bsngal bas/༷sta5si she 'dasa' mdzad daX/ltan zi spyod zhal 'a cang spyan ga~X ba te / tsu rgya su~Xd/bi tshog mdzo 'gra ma sa ser thi bka' lte'/cig/ sordeglags 'a gya shegs pa' nang ye/gar gya thuX zi sar bzha dro than chad cag lang gsung ba ltar btan pas/nag pa skar gsum gya rgyud byung/

de yang dgra nag ni rdo rje 'chang khros pa lha'i bu'i bdud 'dul ba'i phyir dang /gdong drug ni phyag rdor khros pa gshin rje 'dul ba yin zhes dang / rdorje 'jigs byed ni 'jam dpal khros pa dbang phyug 'dul zhes dang / gsum karango bo rnal 'byor chen po yin par 'dra yang / 'jigs mdzad kri ya dang mthun te/ bris sku'i sgrub pa gtso bor ston/ gdong drug yo ga dang mthun te phyag rgya bzhi kha/ rgyas 'debs/ dgra nag rnal 'byo7ra chen po rang rkang bar dgo te/rgyud kyi bzhugs tshul ni de lha bur ma ces/sro der rgyud gzhan gnyis bris/bshu sa mdzad/ 'jigs mdzad glegs bam rang du bton nas bsnams pas/mchod rten gyi cong chen po rang sgra sgrag bya dang khyi rnams shar du zug ljon shingathams cad shar du rtse mo dud skad/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang rmi ltas sogs log ste/ phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas slob dpon ni ma mthong/ phom ldan 'dasa'ajigs mdzad kyi sku'i drung na glegs bam 'dug par mthong ste/ mkha' ri 'gro marnams kyis glegs bam blangs te song ngo / /der glegs bam spyan drangs kyangadon du mi 'gyu/ra bar 'dug snyam du dgongs nas/ slar yang o gyon du cung zad cig bzhugs/ rgyud thugs su chud par mdzad nas byon te/ phyis/thugs nasabaton te yi ger bris zhes 'chad do/ /ba ri lo tsā ba'i rjes lho/rnams ni 'di skad ces 'chad de/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas/ dzin na rje gshe/da nag po bsgoms pas nus pa cung zad grub nas/ lho phyogs kyi yul du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byas/ mu stegs gcig dang 'gran pas khong rang laslatshugs kyang / 'khor pho mo rnams ra lug tu gyur pa/ spyod pa sngas so snyamakha—63—

—sa rla 'ir gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam du lung bstan byung nas/ dpala.orgyan du phyin/ lung bstan dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor mdang mjalanas/ de'i khol po lo gsum byas te dka' ba spyad pa las/ khyod ci 'dod gsung/ 'o dod bya med de/ bdag khyed la gus pas bkur bsti byed pa lags zhes zhus/ de bzhin du lo drug dang dgu' mthar yang de dang 'dra/ lo bcu gnyis kyi mthar/khyod dngos grub ci 'dod gsung ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi 'galazhing / bdud dang mu stegs mod la tshar gcod pa'i thabs cig zhu byas pas/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur zhing rgyud rtog pa bdun pa gnang ngo / /rnal 'byor ma de'i mtshan ni bde ba spyan ldan zhes zer/ de nasartog bdun dar dkar po la ra'i 'o mas bris te bsnams/ mkha' 'gro tsharnams kyis snying khrag phyung ba snyam byed kyang / slob dpon rkang mgyogs grub pas rjes ma zin par rang gnas su sleb/ sngar gyi mu stegs de dag thams cad tshar bcad/ ces zer ro/ /'dir sgeg pa'i rdorje zer/ rol pa dang sgeg pa don gcig par bsams nas/ la li ta sgeg par bsgyur bar snang yang/ sleb dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi 'byung bas/ sgeg pa'i rdo rjer bsgyur ba mi legs shing / der ma zad la li ta rol pa la ge tsobor 'jug cing / sgeg pa'i skad dod gtso bor la sgyu'am/ bi la sgyu yin pa dang /rol pa'i don rtsed mo'am/ gang 'dod dang ci gar rang nyams su yod pa'i don yin/ sgeg pa ni cha byad spros pa bskye rta pa'i don yin pas tshig don rnyas kar nas cung zad mi 'dra'o/ /lī la dang / la li ta yang don cig mod kyi/ ming—64—

———'dogs tha dad du byung zhing / skyo ba'i lugs kyi lī la pa de yang/ nag po skoragasum gyi rgyud spyan 'dren pa po yin par 'dod pa'i phyir la li ta badz+ra nyid yid dgos pas/ lī la badz+ra zhes 'bod pa cung zad mi legs so/ /slob dpon 'di'i rjes su lo brgya lhag tsam gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor ha cang mang por mched pa med/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyisakyang ci rigs par gsungs shing / la li ta'i brgyud 'dzin dang / ye shesazhabs kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams gcig tu 'dres te shin du dar bar gyur to/ /de dag ni gtso bor nag po'i skor byung tshul yin la/ gzhin rje gshed dmar yi rgyud ni/ grub thob bi rū pas spyan drangs par kun tu grags na/ de la'ang rgyud le'u nyer gnyis par grags pa 'di ni bru rū pa kho nas spyan drangs par nges shing /sku gsung thugs rdo rje dmar po'i rgyud 'di ni/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra gyisakyang spyan drangs par mngon te/ rgyas bsdus cung zad ma gtogs nag po'i rgyud nyid 'don pa spos pa yin pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis kyangargyud 'di la brten nas bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad/ bod kyi brgyud pa 'dod lugs la/ birlu ḍom+bhi dpal 'dzin zer ba'ang yod pa ni/ gshed dmaralugs thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba'i dbang du byas par 'dug ya nga rdo rje 'chang ye shes mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin zer ba ni nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas pa yin/ don la bram ze dpal 'dzin de ni/ birlu to sdi'i brgyud pa mi 'dzin/ lali ta dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi brgyud 'dzin kho na yin pas/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i sgrub dkyil yang slob dpon de gnyis kyi dgongs 'dus —65—

yin pa'i phyir/ la li tas de spyan ma drangs na/ de las byung ba'i man ngag yin pa mi 'thad do snyam pa ni/ kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /rgyud de'i le'u dang po la brten nas/ birnyas sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i phyir/yongs su grags pa dang mthun par bi rū pas kyang spyan drangs par yang bya mod/rgyud gcig nyid grub thob du mas sbyan drangs pa mi 'gal lo/ khri5 thob bi rū pa yang rags rtsis su na slob dpon la li ta badz+ra dang dus mnyam la/ lograngs cung zad kyis snga ba tsam ni yin srid do/ /'dir birlu po'i rnamatharalorgyus sbyar bar bya ste/ gzhan du gsal lo/ /de ltar dmar na ga'i jigasagasum gyi rgyud thams cad/ bram ze dpal 'dzin la bka' babs te/ sngon gyi slob dpon la li ta dang / bar du sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / thamar slob dpon dpal 'dzin te/ 'di gsum la dkyil 'khor wo po'i rdorje slob dpon zhes grags shing / las dang po pa la bskyed rim kho na bsngags pa sogs bskyed rim phrin las dang bcas pa'i bka' babs yin/ zab gsal gnyis med lhun grub kyi dgongs pa sogs bka' babs dang dgongs pa yang gcig go /de la slob dpon dpal 'dzin ni rgyal po dharma pyala'i sku tshe'i mjug gi cha tsam la/ yul ma ga dhar bram ze'i rigs su 'khru spras/ chub bunasasgra tshad sogs rig pa du ma la mkhas par byas/ dpal o tan ta pu rir rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod gsum la'ang mkhas par mdzad nagamar me mdzad bzang po la lung thob tsam byas te/ dpal sde sogs ye shesazhabs kyi slob rgyud slob dpon 'ga' re bsten nas/ gsang 'dus dang gzhi myo —66—

rje gshed kyi dgongs pa thugs su chud de dpal gzhan rje gshed rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ye shes chen po la dbang / sems can gyi don mdzad par ba ched de/ nus pa nyams sad pa'i phyir nags tshal rnams su rgyu zhing gshegs/ bseru dang ma he dang stag rnams la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa tsam gyis shi lta stangasamadzad pa tsam gyis gsos/ yang ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis shing thog la sogasapa'i khu bcud lhung bzed du bsdus te gsol bas/ de dag rad rad por 'gyurazhing / se gol gtogs pa na sngar bzhin gsos par gyur to/ /de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud be da rbar byon pa na/ dge slong sde snod gsum pa chos smra ba rtsod pa'i khyu mchog/ga khril/yod pa des rtsod pas/ yul der mu stegs 'gribs so/ /der bram ze'i rigs kyi rgyal po ha sa de ba zhes bya ba log pa la mngon par zhen pas/ dge slong de'i mgo gcod pa'i grabs byed pa na/ slob ge zu/ 'di derabyon te/ 'jig rten la phan par byed pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin na/ chosardede 'dzin pa'i mgo gcod du rung ngam ma gcod cig ngas 'di la rin spyin no gsung / rgyal po na re/ 'o na mgo bos mgo bo bslub yin pag khyod nyid kyi mgo bo blang ngo zer/ slob dpon nyid kyi dbu bcad de rgyal po la byin/ dgoslong de thar bar byas so/ /de nas de dang nye ba na mchod sbyin gyi khang pa zhina'adug pa'i tsa na/ ma he'i mgo zhig 'dug pa blangs te ba nā na pag slob dpon ma he'i dbu can du gyur/ zla ba gsum du de ltar 'dug cing 'gro 'ongamadzad pa las/ de'i rjes su res ni stag dang / res bya ka pa ka dang / res rta la sogs pa nyin re sab 'cha/ dbu mi 'dra ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ skye bo rnamasaro—67—

mtshar du gyur cing / mu stegs pa mang po'ang sangs rgyas pa la bkod/ de nasalan cig rgyal po de lam du song bas/ slob dpon khyi'i dbu can du 'dun pa mthong / der zhe sdang gis khyi khyi zhes byas so/ /slob de3 gyis khyod nyid khyi'o zhes sdigs 'dzub bstan pas/ rgyal po nyid khyir gyur to/ de ye nas slab dpon gyi dbu sngon bzhin du rnal mar gyur/ phyogs der re shig mu stegs tshe na med par song / rgyal po na ra ba ti tsa la zhes pa cig gis kyang gtam de the se nasazhabs la bshud do/ /phyi nas de lta bu'i snyan pa'i grags/pas khyab pas yuladabus kyi rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ bi kra ma shī la'i sngags pa slob dpon mdzad/de skabs kyi rgyal po ma he pā la yin pa 'dra'o/ /der bstan ga bcas kyang mang du mdzad/ gdug pa can mang po btul ba dang / chang 'o mar bsgyur ba dang /dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du yod par gda'/ de nasadaben khang gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs/ tho rangs cig mchogagator rnams phyi rol tu skyel bar byon pas/ rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid tsheb cig sgo drung na 'dug de ni slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba yin/ de la phyagamadzad pas rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i rig sngags kyi lung stsal te mi snang bar gyur/nang du bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nub byang na/ rdorje dbyangs can ma dngos su bzhugs 'dug de nas mi ring bar slob dpon 'ja' lus su gshegs te/ thun mong tsa5ma yin mchog rang brnyes par grags so/ /yang zhal gzigs yin na ma gtogs/ ga ya dha ra'i bla ma dpal 'dzin dang 'di mi gcig par mngon pas de nas spyod pa ba la brgyud pa 'ded na/ bar—68—

der brgyud pa gcig gnyis dgos pa 'dra'o/ /slob dpon dpa la'i tshe na gyi rjes de nas kyang mi rabs gcig tsam song ba na/ slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi ta byon/ gtso bor gshin rje gshed dgra nag la grub pa brnyes pa yin/ de yangam ga dhar 'khrungs/ rigs tshong ba/ rten dge slong/ grub mtha' rnam rig pa/phar phyin dang / gsang 'dus dang / gshin rje gshed lamakhas/ lho phyogasa.ang dā gi ri zhes bya ba'i ri zhig la bzhugs nas/ lo bcu gnyis bsgoms/dang por sdug bsngal dang / 'jigs pa la sogs pa bar chad sna tshogs byungayang / stong nyid dang lha bsgoms pas zhi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gzhin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs/ de phyin chad phra ma rnams thogs pa med par grub/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa nyin re bzhin zhal gzigs shing / chos gsan par yang grags/gong bu dgug pa dang / rkang pa dgug pa dang / khrag dgug pa dang / myongadagug pa sogs la thogs pa med/ gtam rgyud dmigs gsal re re yang yod par 'dug bi kra ma shwe la'i sngags pa slob dpon yang mdzad/ rgyal po sha mupāla'i dus tsam yin par mngon/ der bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ de yan chad dge slong bsod snyoms pa'i spyod pa can yin/ de nas dgo slongagortags dang ni ldan bsod snyoms pa'i brtul bzhugs spangs te sngags kyi spyod pa can du gyur/ lan cig ma ga dha'i yul mtha' dur khrod cig tu tshogs 'khor rgya chen po mdzad par bzhed/ de'i dus na nub phyogs kar+ṇa'i yul na kla klo'i rgyawapo zhig yod/ de'i dmag dpon gcig 'khor rta ba dang / glang po pa lnga brgya tsam dang bcas dmag jag la 'ongs/ yul dang lha khang 'ga' zhig bcom ste —69—

log 'ongs pa dang /slob dpon 'khor bcas tshogs 'bor gyi yo byad du mdang bcas te byon pa phrad/de dag gis rol mo brdung gamatshon tsha4paga'ajoms par brtsams pa la/slob dpon 'a rgyas bum pa sa la brdabs pas skad cig la rlung nag byung mi rta glang po rnams bsgyel/mi nag po ral gri thogasapas brdeg pa'i snang ba shar/dmag dpon ni de nyid du khrag skyugs te shigazhan rnams la yang rims nad kyis btab ste/gcig ma gtogs yul du masleb skad/gzhan yang chos 'khor bi kra ma la rtsod pa byed pa'i mu stegs pa'i paṇ+ḍita brgyad kyi ngag mnan/byad ma byed pa bcu drug tsam sngags dngan sreg gis bsgral ba sogs kla klo dang mu stegs can thams cad shin tu skrag par mdzad do//mthar nags tshal dben pa zhig tu ga khril/pur bzhugs/dngosagrub chen po rnams kyang 'grub rung gi sgrub pa po zhig yin no//dus lnga pa cha shas la spyod pa'i dus ni mtsharma na(de dganas da rdzobar rdo/mkhas pa sgo drug gi dus tsam na ye shes lha'i las tshogs gzhan rnams dang /rdzas kyi dngos grub rnams mi 'grub pa ma yin yang /yun ring por sgrub dgosapa'am/dka' spyad chen pos bsgrub dgos pa las/gzhan thams/cad pasagashin rje gshed myur zhing /dmar nag sogs las kyang rdo rje lob gas mdzad myur bar byung bas/'jigs mdzad la brten nas ro 'angs dang/rdzasakyidangos grub 'grub pa dang /las bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa shin tu mang b.rabyung ngo //gshed skor bod du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mdzad pa po la li ta cob dang /a mo gha bar pa dang /li la badz+ra dang/zhi ba ye shes dang/'jawa0

dpal ye shes sogs kyang skabs der byung zhing / gzhan yang nus mthu can tshes mang ba byung ngo / /rtog pa bdun pa yang tshes ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rgyud 'gran zla med par mnga' gsol zhing / glegs bam tshar re 'bri ba la yangagaser srang bcu'i yon du chad byas skad/ de nas gzung lo brgya tsam rgya gar du mchog tu dar la/ bal bo'i yul du yang de dang mthun pa'i tshul gyas bar skabs der shin tu dar zhing phan stobs che'o/ /de rjes slob dpon a bha yā kara'i dus tsam na/ dgra nag dar ba yod/ 'jigs mdzad kyi chos skor rnamasabatsal rnyed tsam las med/ gdong drug gi rgyud ni zhar byung tsam ma gtogs de'i snga rol nas kyang ha cang dar ba ma byung ba 'dra'o/ /de rjes rgyal po gya na bzhi re ring la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i skor rnams dar bar byung/ rdzogs lo nyengagi nang gi de dang / sgrub thabs phra mo'i rigs ma gtogs/ na ga'ajigs skorarnams nub pa bzhin du song skad/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi chos skor nub pa nas/ yul dbus su kla klo zhugs pa 'dra ba cig byung skad pas/ kla klo lha rin gyi gnyen po mchog ni/ spyir khro rgyal ya mun ta ka dang / sgos su 'jam dpalardo rje 'jigs mdzad nyid mthar thug pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos 'di rnams bod kyi phyogs 'dir ji ltar dar ba yin snyam na/ spyir bod du dar tshul dang / brgyud pa so so'i rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dpal gzhin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs thor bu pa cung zad ni chos 'go dar ba dang dus mnyam du byung / sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang sgrub thabs mdzad par grags/ rab tu byung pa'i sde dar tsam na—71—

gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'gyur zhing /dbang bskur po gad pa man ngag lag len thams cad byung /gsang sngags bla med lugs kyi sgrub thabs phra mo yang mang tshad byon/rigs sngags grub pa yang mang du byung/de nas snga dar phyi dar gyi bar mtshams der/rig sngags 'chang gi dbang phyugasnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pas/gshin rje gshed kyi cho so skoramatha' yas par spel/drag sngags kyi mthu can shin tu mang bar byung/chosaskor rnams kyang /rgya gar/bal bo/kha che/li yul/rgya na gsogs nasaspyan drangs pa dang /khyad par du zhal mthong dang /nyams shar gyi cho so sna tshogs pa mtha' yas pa zhig go/dpal gdong drug ni rgyud sdom gsum pa 'di yang /snga dar gyi dus rgyal blon la gsangs te bsgyur ba45/bar skabs derabaskyur ba gang rung zhig yin par mngon/'di la phyis 'gyur gyi lotsā ba so so'i 'gyur byang mi 'dra ba bris pa 'dra 'dug ste/rang rang gi mos zhen gyis brisapar zad/'gyur khyad ni gcig kyang med/dpe rnying phal tsheb na 'gyur byangayang mi gda'/'di dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang /zla gsang pa thig/le dang/rdorje bdud rtsi'i rgyud rtsa ba da lta yongs khyab 'di rnams la 'gyur byang nges can med de/sngon rgyal blon la gsangs te bsgyur ba rnams/'gyur byang byas na bsgyur mkhan ngo shes nas/chad pa byung dogs ma bris pa yin/yang snga dar phyi dar gyi bar der/khrigs ka med pas 'gyur nges shes pa la yang 'gyur byangamed pa dang /bod rang nyid kyis brtsams pa la yang rgya gar ba'i mdzad byangadang /lo paṇa gyi 'gyur byang byas pa'i brtsam che(rgyud kyang mang du byung ba yin sho//

de lta na yang sdom gsum pa la ni snga 'gyur sogs kyi dbang bka' bshad bka' cher ma dar zhing / dmar nag 'gas gsum gyi chos skor gzhan rnams ni skabs der ma 'gyur ro/ /de rjes bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ bod yul dbus gtsang du dge 'dun gyi sde byung nas mi rabs gcig la nye ba na/ zhang co gru lo tsā ba shes rab blamabyung / 'di lo tsā ba leng 'brog gnyis dang dus mnyam yin/ 'o de'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang / 'jigs mdzad rtog bdun te rgyud gnyis dang/gzhin rje gshed 'byung ba dang / 'jigs mdzad zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs dang/gtor chog dang / li la badz+ra gyi lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rnams sngar ma 'gyur ba gzhi 'gyur mdzad/ dgra gdong ji 'gas gsum gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' yang byung zhing / lhag par dgra nag la rtsal du thon pa'i skan pa ka dang / sgrub bka' shin tu dar bar mdzad do/ /de las lo grangs bco lnga'am/ nyi shu tsatshagyi rjes su nag po tshul khrims rgyal bas/ nag po'i rgyud dang / sgrub thabasaphran bcas jo bo rje la zhus nas bsgyur/ phyis shwan ti bha dra la dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung 'grel sa rnams zhus nas gzha 'gyur byas 'dug nagatshodang dus mtshungs rung la lo tsā ba rong zom chos bzang gis/ paṇ+ḍi ta u pa yoshrīmi tra la zhus te/ nag 'jigs kyi rgyud gnyis dang / gzhung phran du mdang/rtog gsum rnams bsgyur ro/ /lo tsā ba de rnams kyis bsgyur ba ni/ 'gyurasngam la 'gyur bcos byas pa min/ rang rang gi blo'i rtsal gyis gzhi 'gyur mdzad pa'o/ /nag tsho dang / rom zom gyis bsgyur ba'i rjes de nag lo bco lnga nyi shu —73—

skor gyis 'a) ba la/gnyos lo tsā bas nag po skor gsum gyi chos bsgyurabashad mdzad 'dug dpal 'dzin gyis nag po'i skor sogs nag le rdogs kyi gzhung 'ga' la/gnyos kyis 'gyur byang mthong /rgyud gtas 'gyur tshamathongayang yod par ni snang ngo //de dang dus mtshungs rtsab la/klog skya lotswa ba shesarab brtsegs kyis kyang nag po'i rgyud nag tsho'i 'gyur la/'gyur mchan mdzad do//des bsgyur ba nas lo sum cu tsam 'gro ban/rwardo rje grags kyis naga'ajigs kyi rgyud gnyis bsgyur bar 'dug dgra nag nag tsho 'gyur la gto/ los 'gyur mchan mdzad/de la rwa los bcos pa yin/rtog 'dun ni zhanga'agyur dang mthun shas che bar 'dug pas/de la 'gyur bcos mdzad paragasal lo//de dang dus mtshungs par nag po'i rgyud la zangs kar gyi 'gyurachung dang /rtog bdun la bu rangs pa khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur byung ro//rwalo las dus bag tsam gyis 'bye ba la/paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra chung ba bod du phebs/de la skyo 'od 'od 'byung gis zhus te skyo lugs byung/a mo gha de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung chung sogs man ngag gi gzhung thor bu tsam gsar du bsgyur yod/rgyud gzhung che ba'i rigs la gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur chung gang yangam mdzad do//de dang dus mnyam par ba ri lo tsā bas paṇ+ḍita de nyid la zhus te rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi rgyud gzhung chos skor mang du bsgyur bar gragag 'asabha ro phyag sdum la yang zhus 'dug de las cung zad 'phye ba la/mal gyo lotsāb blo gros grags kyis bal bo ha du dkar po la nag 'jigs skor gsum zhus/nag po'i rgyud ni snga sor du klog skya la'ang zhus par sems/rtog bdun khyud po 4

chos brtson gyi 'gyur la mal los 'gyur chung mdzad do//mal lo'i dus de tsam na rgya gar na dgra nag dar rab yod/'jigs mdzad btsal rnyed lasardemed/bal yul na nag 'jigs gnyis kar dar ba yod 'dug de phyin chad nag 'jigs kyi rgyud la 'gyur bcos byed mkhan ma byung ba 'dra zhing/lo paṇa sdebs pa'i lugs srol dbang bshad man ngag gsar pa'ang ma byung bar snang ngo /kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir 'jigs mdzad kyi cho so skor snga phyi thams cad du dar rgyas che/dgra nag kyang sngon gsang sngags dar rgyas tshe ba'i skabag tsi rigasapar dar/gdong drug la rwa chen pos bshad pa mang ra pa mdzad pag yigasnabasdus don sogs yod/gzhan dbang bka' tsam las khug da pa dang/phagangag dar rgyas cher ma byung ngo //gdong drug gi rgyud la 'gyur yang gnalasamed/dgra nag la zhang nag tsho klog skya gu ru ba gnyan rwa 'gyur rnams mthongal/gnyas zangs kar sogs gzhan yang mang du yod par ni snang ngo //rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud la ni/co gru shes pos bla ma/gyi jo/rong zom/khu ston dngos grub/rwa lo/ba ri lotsā/mal lo/paṇ+ḍita sa rdzo shrī'i 'gyurate 'gyur brgyad yod ces sngon dus grags la/phyis skyi rong lo tsā ba shad bangagis/co gru rong zom rwa lo ba ri bzhi/sngar gyi brgyad la mi thob btsad po mune rā dza'i 'gyur dang /'gyur byang ma thebs pa yang gnyis mthong gsung bsa'ajigs mdzad kyi skor 'di la thams cad kyi sa su byas pa'i phyir 'gyur byed lo tsā ba tshes mang ba byung rigs su 'dug/zhang 'gyur la sngags btu tshig lhugapa dang /rwa 'gyur la tshigs bcad mar yod/'gyur cig la rgyud yongs

rdzogs tshigs bcad du byas pa'ang yod/gzhan dpe rnying yin yang 'gyur phan tshun 'dres pa ni mang du snang ngo //de nas phyis ni zhang ga storwa skyo mal te lugs lnga po de las rgyud pa la/nag 'jigs skor gsum ci rigs pa yod pa'i dbang du byas nas/so so'i lugs ma 'dres par 'dzen pa dang/de dgaphan tshun ci rigs par bsres te byed pa dang /brgyud pa ni de dag gang rbangagacig la ded nas/gang rnyed thams cad legs bsdus byed pa'am/rgya gzhungardegacig gi rjes su 'brangs nas lag len byed pa sogs nges med sna tshogs byung ba la/yi ge rtsom pa po de dang de'i lugs so zhes rab tu grags par gyur la/dag ma dag kyang sna tshogs su sna ri ngo //dmar po'i chos skor la/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i nang na lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs cig yod/de tsam ma gtogs/gong du smos pa'i lotsā ba de rnams kyi skabs su 'gyur ba med cing /mal lo 'das nas lo lnga bcu tsam song ba tsatshan/bla ma dpyal lotsā ba chos kyi dpal bzang pos/rdo rje gdan pa ni ska 'angaka la zhus/lha lnga'i dbang dang man ngag lag len cha tshang bar yod/byin rlabs shin tu che/birlu pa'i sgrub thabs che chung/gtor cho ge che chub/zhabrula'akhor 'phreng ba/dus 'khor lugs kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs bsgyur/rdzogasarim gyi 'khrid ni med/spros med 'grel pa dpyal los mdzad zer ba gcikayod de/phyis kyi kha 'phangs su ka snang /de dang dus mnyam rung las cung zad 'phyi bar/kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i slob ma/paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī las/bi hwa pa dang /dpal 'dzin gyis gzhung mang po rang 'gyur mdzad/dbang bka' yang bcu 6

gsum ma dang /lha lnga gnyis ka byung mod/phyis 'ga' zhig lha lnga khona'i zerab ni/rang gis ma mthong ba rgyu mtshan du bkod pa'o//rdzog༅rim gyi zhakhrid tshul ci rigs par yod kyang /spros med dang rnal 'byor bzhi rim ni de dusama'agyur ro//de'i rjes su lo nyi shu tsam song ba na/chan lo stob chos rje dpalagyis/bi rū pa dang dpal 'dzin dang /blo gros bzang po sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung mang du bsgyur/lugs gnyis ka'i dbang bka' dang lag len darargyas su mdzad/rdzogs rim ni/rim pa lnga'i dag sbyor tsa5gyi rdzogs rimamagatogs/'khrid tshul rgyas pa'i lag len ni med do//de las/cung zad 'du bar glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis/chag lo'i bla ma ra ben+da pa la yangathug khyad par du da rlan ā tsar+ya spyan drangs te birlu pa'i spros med/dpala'adzin gyi rnal 'byor bzhi rim sogs gzhung phran gsar pa mang du bsgyur zhing /rdzogs rim gyi man ngag 'khrid tshul khyad par can mtha' rgyas su byung/chagalugs kyi skor rnams sngar nas khong rang la bzhugs/'gyur bcos ni mamadzad do//de ltar na dpyal lo/dā na shi la/chan lo/slo bo lotswa bstobazhi po des gshe/da dmar gyi dbang man ngag lag len rnams mtha' rgyas su mdzad cing /thams cad byin rlabs kyi bka' dang ldan pa yin mod kyi/skyon rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud ni spyan ma drangs pa las/glo bo lo tsā ba sku 'das pa tsam gyi dus na/yar lungs lo tsā ba shud ko grags pa rgyal khamatshan gyis/skugasung thugs rdo rje gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu yod pa 'di bskyur/khong pa la dbang dang rgyud bshad gnyis kar bzhugs par 'dug de

dang dus mtshungs rung du shong blo brtan gyis kyang rgyud de bsgyur snyug sto stir shud ke cung zad legs so//'di la rgya des gyi 'grel pa ni mtshar/bod kyi yig sna rnying pa'ang sto med pa 'dra'o//spre rje lted dmar yi a wochos grags dpal bzang gi/slob dpon dharma kirti bar grags pa/ca spasporin po tshe'i dpal bzang phyag tu rgya dpe byung nas/mkhas mchoge bu lko na po snye/'e 'a phyag tu phul nas skugs pa yin yang bsgyur bar zhus/'a sdo/ra yang mdzad/'gyu/rabazang legs pa yin yang /rgya dpe de'i skabs shigan/ma dpe zhabrugasardepa las bsko/'a tshig/ gar pa rmi rta nag ba/skye ring mcho 4 yang zhabrugs pa'i rgyun de ka 'du / ga phyas rgya gar paṇ+ḍa ta nags kya na wo bod du byon dug rgyud rdele'u bcu dgu rdo shud sa zu thub/yid bzang rtse pas lngar bco༅wod mu she la rgyu~X 'da' dbang spyod khri ngag bangs ni rdekyan yod gda' na'ang / da bzang rtseb dang / mas khang lotswa bsogs bod kyi phyag wo pa'i zhes ske ho chad 'then pa la yengs nas/sangs/rgyan/mu ge bstan pa la phan pa'i cho so de dgazhu ba ma byung dī 'dug mig thob bla kho kya rgyud la'ang dbang tsam ma gtos de dang 'dra ba ga ka byuṣ+ṭha//phro kyangargyud le'u bcu dgu pa ni gsha/na rje gshe/da nag po'i rgyud dang /birlu pa'i gzhungardespru༈tes/rderderderde :/rdernams shes na/rgyud don phal cher go bar nus la/nyer sa pa rdze /rdzo don tsam zhal ge ge ge ge 4 thud dod da zlor snyug mod/'on kyang bla ma' zhal lung kho par/rnyi ge' 'go pa na wo ngo // //da spyon rje lted skor la brdi pa so so'i rim pa brjod na/dgra

gdong 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor thog mar bsgyur zhing /srol brtod mkhan zhang lugs par grags pa rnams lo rgyus 'di skad ces 'chad de/dkyila'akhor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon lha sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs de/'jawadapal zhi khro dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa lta bu yin/des maratshemadzad bzang po la gnang /'di dang la li ta chen po gnyis kyi lo rgyus 'khrulagazhi cung zad byung /de la ri ta badz+ra ram/mtshan gzhan lil badz+ra gyis zhus/'dis rgyud rdo rje 'chang zhal gzigs nus pa thogs pa med/dgra na gago rgyud kyi don 'grel du gshin rje gshed 'byung pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/le sdogasamadzad zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs kyang 'dis mdzad pa yin/zhang pa rnams slob dpon 'dis nag 'jigs skor gsum gyi rgyud rnams spyan drangs par 'dod mod/slob dpon 'di ni sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi yang slob tu zhang lugasapar rang 'dod pa bzhin du/don la'ang gnas par mthon pa gal li ta chungab rang yin zhing /rgyud spyan 'dren pa po ni la li ta cen po yin pas/slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs las kyang /mi rabs bzhi lnga tsam gyis snga bar byon no//zhes go bar bya'o//li la badz+ra de'i slob ma ni/so su ra ba yin te/zhakhrungs yul shar skrugasakā ma ru pa/rnal 'byordo ra chen po'i rgyud mtha' dag la mkhas/shing/gshin rje gshed la grub pa brnyes pa yin no//de'i slob mni gu ru sen pa yin/mdo rgyud kun la mkhas shing sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/de'i slob ma a pa lin pa yin te/'khrungs sa kha che ba yin/rkang mgyogs kyi gos grub brnyeg de'i 9

slob ma gu na ā ka ra bha dra yin/yul shar phyogs bha 'a spre ba/mkhas/pa lhan po sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa/de'i slob ma ni po/dbangagrags pa yin te/'khrungs yul dza gad dha da la ba/ra dha'i rgyal kha po'i blamaragyur/sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs zhal gzigs/tshe ba'i yon tan dpagatu med pa mnga' zer te/mkhas pa sgo drug gi nang tshan ngag dbang grags pa kayin nam sems/ye shes zhabs nas de'i bar thams cad rab go byung cha byad du bzhugs/de'i slob ma de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra yin te/paṇ+ḍita dkar po yin/yul ma ga dha ru gzungs/dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus sogs rgyud tha pas cad la mkhas/gshin rje gshed la nus pa thob/yul ra ra na klus dun pa can gnas pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa/skabs skabs lud nas grong khyer dang zhingalaganod pa cher 'byung ba zhig yod pa la/lta stangs mdzad de gnad la phab pas/klu de thul nas phyin chad mtsho lud pa'i gnod pa ma byung /bskam yang ma bskam/zhing la phan pa cig yod zer/yang brgyud yig 'ga' zhin na/'jam dbyangasaye shes zhabs dang mar me mdzad//rab 'gying rdorje bde spyin sen pa//mkha' lding zhabs dang yon tan 'byung gnas bzang //nga gdabang grags/pa lha 'byung zla ba dang //zer ba yod de/so su rab dang bde spyin zhabs gcig a ba li dang mkha' lding zhabs gcig pas/don la khyad med do//de ba ā karal zhang gis gsan te/de yang 'bring mtshams pa zhang co gru shes rab bla ma bya ba/'chims phu bka' phyogs pa bya ba'i sngags rnying ma pa'i sde la zhugs/mdosgyu sems gsum/mgon po beng ma dang /mdor mgon sogs kyang mkhyen/80

bo dong gi 'bal shākya rdo rje la yo ga yang bslabs/mtshan nyid kyi gzhung yangamang du mkhyen/gsang 'dus gsan par bzhed kyang /de tsan gsang sngagasardegasar ma shin tu bka' dogs pas/dpe 'dra g.yar ba las chos/bka' thobardepa ma byung nas/bal bor byon nas lo gnyis tsam sgra la sbyang gde nasargyagar ma ga dhar byon/jo bo de ba ā kar tsan+t+ra la gsang 'dus rdzogs paragasan/dus 'khe7ra yang ji rigs pa gsan/khyad par na ga'ajigs sgoragasum dgyes phyin par gsan cing /rtags mtshan dpag tu med par byung/byin rlabs kyi bka' babs/de'i nang nas kyang dgra nag nyid khyad du thon paragrags so//phyis bod du phebs pa'i a mo gha badz+ra ya/jo bo de ba u kara'islob ma paṇa chung cig yod/lo tsā ba dang de dus mched gro kha yin/de nasajobo de ba ā ka ra bod du spyan drangs/bal bod mtshams su jag pa byung ba la/pa'i tas sa gtor bas jag pa thams cad rengs/de rjes lo paṇa lhan cinatudabus gtsang du 'gro don cher mdzad nas/gzhong stag rtse phug mo cher spyan drangs te/chos mang du bsnyur/paṇ+ḍi ta bal yul du bskyal/de nas sngon gyi glam dang /mched po kun 'das te me bzhugs pas thugs shin tu skyo ste/dpyalabyang chub 'byung gnas de gzhom nu'i dus kyi bla ma yin/de dus khongamibazhugs kyang /de'i sras se rtsa rma ru spran drangs te/'jam dpal nam mkha' dri med la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/phyis paṇ+ḍi ta de ba rwadza la/mtshan brjod kyi chos skor sgrub rgyud dang bcas pa dang /a mo gha badz+ra wad du phebs pa la yang /rgyud kyi 'gyur bcos dang /'khrul 'khor gyi skor sogs man ngag8

'ga' re dang /o rgyan gyi slob dpon shes rab gsang ba zhes bya ba ska yo po'i thi por yang grags/lwa ba dmar po te du gragasa~Xdel/phyag rgya 'a po'i ga le dang /bka' srung re ma /dmag zor skor dang/rdzogasarim gyi man ngag zab mo mang du gsan/gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyila'akhor yang yang zhal gzigs/she zor rgyal sgro dang /legs po nag po bran du 'kho / pa/mthu stobs thags pa med/'ang mtshams/ru ri ljordegatsug lag khang du ma bzhengs/dbus gtsang khams gsum gya grwa ba tsā bzhi 'dus/'bring 'chas kyi zhang zhes bod kyi mi wo bzhi'i gya gcigatu:gan :sku ji)rde pa lhan rirdebagrang ba yang 'a nas byung / rabs bdun bar du thams cad rjesasu bde bar 'gro zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ pa bzhin/phyis gdung las chad pa lastod smad tsho du mar gyes kyang /thams cad la bdun brgyad kyi bar du sngags pa dang /dge ges ngo 'a can sha stag byon/'a 'a por grags pa bsod nams rgyal 'a gyas bzhi /lo tsā ba 'ad la stu si ji / snyan ba'i / da / ra5rdzogs par sdos/sku' sa ba 'a/sab bha dra/sto /rnyon tī/rat+na ke tu rnams yan pa las/phya ma gnyas//rde rgyud 'a she med/tsheb dgo'adun bzang ༷ la ༵ rjesang 'a grags/'a yab kya chos thams cad la shin tumakha~Xshang dam zhal bta/gsa'/yul lha sde brgyad snal mu de da tshal thegs/rdeyab dus thugs rngom mgro ne lha' gtsu~Xlag khang ga 'dangs pa tsam las mgrub pa la/'a ma/ḍi lha shes gtsug lag khang bya ba/rdor dbyingasadang /'jam dpal gya da—la 'khor rdi brta pa mtha' yas bzhugs pawo

mtshar rmad du byung pa'i lha khang bzhengs/gsang sngags kyi sde chen po tshugs/bla ma gnam kha'u pa sku mgo kyis kyang 'jam dpal zhi khro'i chos skor rnams gsan cing shin tu gus par mdzad do//lha rje sang po la sras lnga byon pa las/tsheshos tsang thang 'od po dang /chung shos rdo rje rtse mo gnyis mkhas grub ༅go/tugyur pa byon/gcen gyis khyung po grags seng dang /gcung gis/gsang phurazhang tshes dang /stod lung du rgya mar ba la gtug/sa te/mdo lugs ga kyang mkhas/par mkhyen pa yin pa 'dug de dag las gyes pa'i dge bshes sngags mkhan shin tu mang yang /'dir rgyas par 'bri mi lang /cog thas rin wo phrengab sogs na gsal bar yod/lha rje sang po'i sras gnyis pa skyi lod wo gyi sras zhar lo mya ngan med pa'i dpal yin/de'i dbon po zhang byangs lga wo yin te/rten sgos spyod/dge bsnyen shin tu sgri las che/zhung lotswa bo'isras dharma sirnyi nas brgyud pa ni zhang ban dpe ba'i phyogs yin la/zhang sgomaribar grags pa de yang 'di'i rgyud la byung /khyad par zhang rnal 'byor gzungasardezhes bya ba'i sras/zhang ston 'brug sgra rgyal masno yin/slob stod sgrub pa 'od dang /yab mes dngos grub rgyal mtshan dang /byang chub rin chen sogs/lagatug/sa/spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung dngos su byon/sgog thang gyi phra men wabatu'//nus mthu shin tu che/bstan pa srung bar mdzad nas/de dus rgyalardekhrims med pas bod sil bu yin yang /nyin mo lag rtags bstan pa dang /mtshan mo skad thos pas sus kyang 'da' mi nus/'bring 'tshams la lam rgya yang mdzad/lcen lung mkhar rnga'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/dgra gdong8

'jigs gsum gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' man ngag bka' thams cad shin tu dar bar mdzad/ yang zhang byang chub rin chen gyi slob ma shas tha rdorje dang / shes rab 'byung gnas sku mgo kyi slob ma zhang rin wo 'od zer ba yin/ 'dir mkhar rnga dgon gsar btab/ rten dge slong yin/ gzhan phan shin tu che/ yang zhang 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan gyi sras zhang rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs kyang chos kyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung tho/ /brgyud yig ni logs su yod do/ /da ni rwa lugs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa bshad de/ slob dpon chen po lalita badz+ra la/ a mo gha badz+ra chen pos thug gsung ste/ de ni dpal rdo rje 'jigasabyed chen po dang mi lab pa bzhin du bzhugs gsung / rgya gar du grags pa la li ta'i dngos slob kyi gsal kha rang med/ ma la ba'i yul du kla klo'i grong lnga stong tsam yod pa la/ grong bskrad pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pag yul do re rgyal po khros nas/ de thams cad rgya mtsho'i gling phran zhig tu bskrad par grags/ lalita mi yul na bzhugs pa'i dus kyi dngos slob yin na/ rgyal po de yang rgyal po brta ha ri yin par byed dgos/ phyis zhal gzigs yin na nges pa med/ rgya gar gyi gtam rgyud cig la/ rgyal po mahā pā la'i dus sā a mo gha chen po byung / des sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la 'grel chen byas zer ba yod ces bla ma gsung ste/de lta na yul ma la ba'i rgyal po de yang rā ma yudha yin par mngon no/ /gang ltar yang a mo gha chen po la ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal gyis gsan/ de la slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra bya bsags na/ slob dpon 'i de ni pha —84—

mas btags pa'i ming rā ma pā la/ slob gnyer byas pa'i ming a bhi dzuk+ta/rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shrī rak+ṣi ta/ gsang mtshan pad+ma badz+ra yin gsung ba 'dugayi ge rnying pa rnams na/ o rgyan pa yin gsung ba 'dug na'ang/ yiganorabargyud pa 'dra/ slob dpon 'di gzungs sa o ḍi bi sha ba yin/ oḍi ba orgyan par 'khrul ba yin nam snyam mo/ /slob dpon de gnyis kyis kyang/ rdorje 'jigs mdzad chen po zhal gzigs/ bla ma de la bla ma bha ro phyag sdum dang /me tsa ling pa gnyis kyis zhus/ bha ro phyag sdum la paṇ+ḍita 'jam pa'i dbyangasazer/ 'khrungs yul bal bo/ rigs bram ze/ dang po phyi pa yin/ rgyal po'i chad pa byung bas/ phyag g.yon sdum po yin/ rgya gar du byon nas mu stegs kyi lha drag po mang po bsgom bsgrub byas nas rgyal po 'dul bar bsams kyang /khong rang spyo bas sdug bsngal bar yod pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis bumachus bkrus pas smyo ba bsangs/ nang pa la mos te chos kyi sgor zhugs/ nagapo skor gsum la mkhas/ sgrub pa ring du mdzad pas/ dpal rdo rje lo sdogasamadzad zhal gzigs/ nus pa thogs med mnga'/ rwa los gzigs pa la yang/khong gi g.yog po dang / mtha' 'khobo rgyal phran cig rgyal po desadamag byed par brtsams/ 'khor dang nye du kun gyis bros pa drag zhus kyang/rgyal po kho nga la gus pa ba spyod du 'ong gsung / zhag shas cig su yang ma byung/de nas nyin cig rgyal po de 'khor bcas 'ongs/ 'bul ba chen po byagazhabs spyi bor blangs te/ slob dpon 'dis dbang dang dgug pa'i las 'grupapa'i rtags so/ /me tsa ling ba'ang bal bo ka yin/ dus de tsan bal lnga'i yo—85—
