'a dra ma rnams la bha ro byer bas/'i ming dpon 'di la'ang bha ro kho lod 'di gnyis gci pas/bha shes 'a nga tsam kyi ra brtabang ba'i5dngadangs di pa kar rak+ṣi 'dad pa na shan tu sbyi/ rden/she/rab 'a pa yon dngas dā paX ka ra ra ta/ri she rgyud 'jam 'gra ༷na shan tu rde~Xrde~X/rdedwags kya tsa li thugs rje chen pa/dge slong yin dgan rnyi me tsa ka shrī/me tsa nga par 'a/rten dge she/pratswa ra dzi ༷da /kan ka kau/dha~X'adi da~X /pad+ma cher rdes/ḍi/ she bstan nagalha pa sgyu no|༷nga mi bla da kya rgyud grags ba rdzul mahā/rdo ga la thams ga/rdepa yan par snang ste/zangs krir la tsā bas paṇ+ḍa ta 'a la zhus/na g.ya ga sprad 'grel womo bsgyur ba yan/khyad par jib wor lo sdom she dang /sngan rje lted la dzi' brnyes 'jam she 'gas de chu she gzags/nus mthu thags pa sa pa mnga' bye//blam tsurdo~Xta la rwa pha / 'olawo pos ye she/yang brgyud pa' lugs gag la/dze rta ri wo pha / 'gro ma/nag pa spyad pa dro/hā tsili/dha zhes/deb pa/ rdordzem / /a spyaXga'i'/sto ā ka ra ma ta/ khri la pa pa sa pa dang/yang do mkhaX 'gra tsho ma/ta l+la pa/nā ro ba/pradz+nyā rak+ta ta/shugs rje wo po zhes/pal/nā rab/tshan ka shrī/ka na ka shrī/di paX ka ra rak+ṣi ta zhes 'ded pal yod de/dedagar ra chi ji ri de bye①rder 7 rdo)rdekyang /dgra gdang 'gas she dang po/༵/ das nga 'bazhi /bang du go / byardzupar 'dug gzhan yang grub thab she sa ༷sdu ge cha pa 4'a ri sheg/bharaphyag sdum dang /thugs rje r+pā pa dī/ gnyas la/ba lotswa bas kyang

gtugs/mal los kyang phyag sdum la sgrol ma'i chos skor sogs zhugalorgyus de tsam ni/khungs dang ldan zhing nor 'khrul ye med pas bkod pa yin la/gshin rje gshed rwa lugs kyi bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar/rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis mdzad zer ba de na/la li ta man gyi bla ma rnams la lo rgyusanyag nyog mang po 'dug kyang /khungs dang mi ldan zhing yid brtan thub par mi 'dug pas 'dir ma bris la/rgya ston chen po yang gsung rab spyi lamakhas tshularang ma bstan 'dug na'ang /lam 'bras dang /gshed skor la mkhas shingaganas lugs gzigs pa/nus mthu brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam par 'dun pagardzun po che ga la mdzad/des na yi ge de rgya ston kyis ma mdzad par nges/khams phyogs kyi slob ma mi mkhas pa de 'dras brtsams par rmen no//blawabha ro phyag sdum dang /bla ma me tsa ling pa gnyis la/lo tshwa shes pa'i slob warang yang mang mod kyi/slob ma'i thu bo 'gran gyi do zla med pa ni/7rje btsun rā lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags pa'o//bla ma de ni la stod gnya' snam gyi yul de'i nang tshan snang yul zhes par 'khrungs/yab ni rwadakon mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba/sngags rnying ma ba'i rigs zhin yin/sa pa chung ngu'i skabs shig dpal lha mo re ma tī mngon su lnga du byon na gan bza' phu rungs kyi nang du bcug ste/spyir rgyal khams ches mang ba zhig bskor zhing yulagyi bkod pa gzigs/khyad par mdo khams lho byang stod smad thas༅cadabastan/zla ba gsum gyi bar du de ltar byung /nang mi rnams kyis bu stor b.rathag bcad/de nas dpal lha mos yab yum gnyis kyi khyim du bskyal ba na/8

zla ba gsum po de'i ring la lo gsum gyi lus skyed byung / lo rgyus rnams pond pas mi thams cad ngo mtshar che bar byed/ phyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus kyang/khams pa'i grwa rigs mang po 'dus pa la/ khyed kyi yul de ni 'di dang 'i de ltabu'i zhes ri klungs chu zhing grong gi bkod pa sogs phra zhing phra ba thams cad yul so so rang gi mi bas kyang zhib par gsung ba zhig yod/ de nas sku cher skyesanas/ re zhig khyim gyi 'tsho a dang / 'brog skyong ba sogs la'ang lo mngar song / de nas bar skabs su thugs la dad pa 'khrungs te chos grwa 'gar byon nas/ phar phyin dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos thor bu pa yang mang du gsan cing mkhyen la/ de skabs nas bla ma dang / mched grogs gong mthams/cad yo byad dang spyod lam dang gus pas mnyes par mdzad/ bar skabasasumanyam par 'jog pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / sgrol wa sogs lhag pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa yang mang du mdzad/ dgyes rdor dang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabasalugs kyang rags pa mkhyen/ de dag tu lo mang po song zhing/ bar skabs deragrogs dang nye du rnams kyis bskul nas/ 'bro jo bo pad+ma bya ba'i bu mo zhin kyangakhyim thab tu bzhes/ snang yul la sdud sgo re yang yod pa las/ mi ring pa cigan bud med des kyang mi dga' ltas te bor nas/ 'bro rje rtsad po'i bu wo ༅ mezer ba cig gi sar song / gnya' snam yul pa dang / de gag grosaubasha/mas/ yul pa rnams log ste dmag byas bkrong bar brtsams pa las rezhig mkhar la 'phras pas gnod ma thub/ de nas nyan tsho gnas rnying gyi 'dulab 'dzin pa/ rgya gar la gshe/gas par bzhed pa zhig yul der phebs pa dang —88—

mjal nas/khong gi phyag phyi la 'brangs/bal yul du byon/mthu zhu b.rabazhed de/me tsa ling pa dang /ba ro phyag sdum la nyi ma go 〉 /la chosasnobatags/thog ma nyid du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po'i dbang bskur zhugalag len bslabs te bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mdzad/lo gcig lhag tsam/na zhalardegazigs kyi mtshan ma byung /las rnams 'grub nges par 'dun na gabod du 'gro ba'i mi 'gal la lon bskur te/'bro rje rtsad po dang/snang yul ba'i yul pa rnams la zla ba gsum gyi mthu dus btab/drag po'i 'khor lo bskorabs zla ba gsum gyi nang du snang yul du rims nad sna ka mi 'dra ba mang po dus gcig tu byung /grong brgya tsam yod pa gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad stongs/rtsad po'i bu dang /bud med de gnyis la lkog bcu bzhi'i nam phyed cig 'urasgradang bcas te lcags kyi phur pa dngos su byung ste/dpral ba phuganas shi lo de kha'i khongs su rtsad po rang dang /g.yog pho mo drug cu tsam yang shirwa na gawa'i mthu ba log lta log tu grags/de nas rwa chen pos pu rangs su mnga' bdagartse lde la/chos bsgyur ba'i mthun rkyen zhur byon/gser sogs yo byad rmang po rang byung ste/slar yang bal yul du phebs/rin chen tshul/gyi gtsug lag khangadu dge slong mdzad/sngar gyi bla ma rnam gnyis dang /g.yin yang rgya bal gyi paṇa grub mang po bsten/slob dpon thugs rje chen po gsang sngags kyi bang mdzod yin pas/rtsa ba'i bla ma de la mdzad/bde mchog rtsa rgyud/sa skru zhi rnalawor ma kun spyod/he ru ka mngon byung /a bhi dha na/rdorje ga5 'gro sto'akhor lo sdom pa'i rgyud sa drug gzhan rje gshed dgra gdong rme jigs gsum/89

'jam dpal mtshan brjod/྅ yi smad lnga/nag po gzhud drug dkyil choge/bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/sgrub thabs don gsal dang/phag mo zhalardeganyis ma'i chos skor sogs rtsal du thon par sbyangs pa mdzad/mgon na gdangapar bu sogs gdams ngag phra mo mang po yang gsan/gtso/mo/rlud sbyor/sems 'jog gi sgom sogs zab don mang po'ang gsan/gsang sngags kyi rgyud zhor nyan du mdzad pa'ang mang po yod gsung /slar yang 'khor lo sdom pa dang /gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa bskyar ma'ang mang du mdzad/bal boralobaco lnga tsam bzhugs/skabs der bod la ma byon kyang/mnga' ris kyi rgyalardepo dbang phyug lde la gser slongs kyi pho nya btang ba la/gser mang du byung bsaphal cher bla ma rnams kyi zhabs tog mdzad cing /gdams ngag gi 'phro zhus/gser lhag ma mang du bsnams nas/rgya gar ma ga dhar byon/zla ba drug tsam/bzhugs/rdo rje gdan/bi kra ma shi la o tan ta pu ri rnams sumachod pa gyocher mdzad/smon lam btab/na lan da'i lha khang thams/cad la yang mchod pa mdzad/dge 'dun ni mi bzhugs/dkon rkun rnams(tshim par bya gamag dha'i mkhas pa rnams la chos 'brel re tsam gsan pa ni mang du yod par 'dugadogs gcod kyang mang du mdzad/'on kyang ma ga dhar mchod pa mdzad pa yī/thugs gnyer rang ma mdzad cis kyang grags te/yun ring ba rang ma bzhugs pa min pa slob gnyer ni mdzad par shes so//de nas dbyar cig pu rangs dang /yar rtser byon/rgyal po goganyis kyangadagyes pas chos 'khor re yang mdzad/de nas las stod la mar byon dus/90

sngar gyi dgra rnams lta ci smos/ phyogs gtogs tshun chad kyang stongs nas med pas bag zon dgos pa ni gcig kyang med/ mthu bo che de byung zhes thams cad 'jigs 'jigs byed/ rnyed bkur dang chos zhu mkhan tsam ma byung/ de nasadabus gtsang gi gzhung kun la phebs/ mthu chen gyi grags pa la brten nasaskubasod rgyas/ lha sa bsam yas gnyis su chos 'khor cung zad re yang mdzad/lo shes song yod par 'dug paṇ+ḍita spyan drangs na 'gro phan tshe bar dgongs te/mnga' ris nas de bar la phyag tu 'byor ba'i rdzas bzang rgu phar bsnams nas/bla ma rnams la tshogs 'khor dang 'bul ba cher mdzad/ dī paX ka ra rak+ṣi ta bod du spyan drangs/ grom pa man chad nas 'gro don 'ur lang ga dbus kyi lho byangathams cad dang / gnyal gyi bar du phebs/ chos thams cad gser chosasumadzad de/ rgyud so so'i rgyud mchod/ dbang yon/ tshogs 'bor rgyud yon sogs phar bzhag zhu rten rang la'ang / rdo rje 'jigs byed lag ser srang gang/gzhan rnams la gser zho re re bab kyang / zhu ba po mi thob pa tsam byung/ paṇ+ḍitas kyang bod du lo mang po ma bzhugs 'ga' zhig lo bdun/ kha cig lo lnga zer/ phar phebs dus gser srang stong phrag gcig phyag tu phul/ gla ba lasogs pa yo byad gzhan rtsis su ma btab/ yar lam la stod du'ang 'gro don cher byung / bal bo'i bar du skyel ma mdzad/ de rjes rwa lo zhi po sku bsod shin tu rgyas/ khams stong pu bo yan chad dbus gtsang rka nge po/ gnyal lor/lho brag tshun chod du lan mang du phebs/ bzhugs yul mthil ni g.yas dra chub mdar mdzad/ bla ma dī paX ka ra bal yul du phebs pa'i rjes su sku ma 'das kyi —91—

bar la/snga phyir 'bul chen lan sum cu so bdun bskyal/'bul ba re re'i steng du res tsa du zhes bya ba btsun pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa la/mchod ston yon bcas re dang /res ha du ste sngags pa nyis brgya tsam bsags pa latshogs 'khor ra yon bcas re mdzad/bla ma bha ro phyag sdum la gser srang lnga brgya phul/gzhan yang bka' drin che ba'i bla ma lnga tsam yod pa la'ang/gser srangardebargya lhag re phul/rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mchod pa'i thes la/gser srang bgyophrag re snga phyir lan mang po dang /bi kra ma shī la/o tan pu shin lan da rnams su nyi khri dang /brgyad stong pa/mtho rtogs rgyan dang brtsa༅pa'i 'a tswa ni nyan gyi thes dang /chung ba sdud pa 'chad pa'i thes sogs bstan pa nam gnasapar du rgyal blon la/zhing sa dang /lha 'bangs grong zhu ba sogs la/gserasrang brgya tsam nyis brgya tsam 'bul bar btang ba shin tu mang /bla mal gus/shing zhabs tog che ba'i tshad du bzhag pa yin/de dag ni sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i rgyu rnams gtso bor smos pa'i skabs yin no//'bras bu gtso bor gyur pa'i che ba la/lung bstan tso༅pa'i tsheb/chosagasungs pa'i che ba/byin rlabs nus mthu'i che ba/sku ba chod nams kyi tshe ba/mdzad pa phyag rgyas kyi che ba'o//dang po ni/sprul pa'i i rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang/u yo bodhi satwa sa chos snyen ra r+pā po bsam yas la/ma 'ongs pa na me'i gnod pa byungaba'i tshe/'jam dpal gyi sprul pa dge slong zhig gis gso bar 'gyur ro zhes9

lung bstan pa de ni/rje btsun rwa lo 'di yin/klu mes kyis zhig gsos cungazad mdzad pa nas/phyi ma'i bar du zhig gsos than thun byed pa mang du byungayang /me'i gnod pa gsos pa 'di kho na yin no//gnyis pa ni/gong du smos pa de rnams las/sngon bod du gsan pa dang /phyis rgya bal du yang zhor nyan tsam mdzad pa'i rigs rnams ye ma ga sdangs/gyobal gyi paṇa grub rnams kyi drung du nan tan nges tig rtsal 'don du mdzad pa rnams kho na gsungs/lhad med yid chos can byin rlabs dang ldan pa sha stagayin/dge bshes 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi gsungs nas/chos/cigaladage bshes rwa ba'i chos las zhe kha gshi/na pa med/rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams/'di skad gsung bya ba las rang bzo dang /bod kyi sra bsre gtan nas med pasaso//zhes gsungs/gsum pa ni/yi dam 'jam dpal khros pa dang mi lab pa bzhin/ bzhugs/rde'akhor lo bde mchog dang /rdo rje phag mo dang /'jam da pa la zhiba'i ya nga zhalagazigs/bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal snang can ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog nus la brtan pa thob/stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang/rdzogs rim gyi yeshes la mnga' brnyes/las kyi gshin rje dang /lang ka'i bdag po ga du 'khole/mgon po nag po lcam dral gyis kyang gsung bzhin bsgrub/dbangabaskur tshad la ye shes phebs shing snang ba bsgyur nus/bsam gtan gyi lasardebazhi yang grub/de lta bu'i rtags ni la stod phyogs su gong du smos pa ltarartags bstan pa dang /phyisang na lam yul gyi sri mnga' dang/byang phyir chos9

gsung ba'i skabs shig ngan lam nyu gu sna pa rnams kyis mthu yod med blta'o zer nas mdzo rta ded/ 'bul skyel ba bcom pa la/ rwa los grong bskrad pa'isbyor ba mdzad pas/ ngan lam 'bar po la sogs pa 'ga' zhig spyo nas garasong cha med/ zla ba gnyis gsum nas nyu gu sna'i yul pa dang/ dgo'adun rgyal sar sgang pa 'khrugs/ rgyal sar sgang pa'i rgyab tu klu mes tsho thams cad 'gril nas/ nyu gu sna pa grong nyis brgya tsam byang rgyab tu yul bud do/ /yangaskyogs 'dul 'dzin gyi slob brgyud/ skyogs dbang grags zhes bya ba dang po 'dul 'dzin yud tsam byas/ phyis dang tshugs can gyi gsang sngags par rlom pa cig gis/ rwa lo 'dra mchod rten chag ro yin zer nas bla ma la skur 'debasabyed cing / chos 'khor 'gegs pa 'byung / de la thugs khros te spyin sreg mdzad/zhag bdun nas skyogs dbang grags gzer thung btab nas 'das/ lotswa ba rgyus smon lam grags dang nang rgyas byung ba yang / zla ba drug tsam nas rgyus/losku 'das/ zangs kar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab gsang ba'i bdag po zhalartagazigs/ rnam sras bran du 'khol/ zhes grags shing nus mthudang ldan pa yin yang yin/ me tsa ling pa rje btsun gyis bod la spyan drangs dug khong gyi me tsaling pa r+sā po nying ro dbyar thang du spyan drangs/ chos 'khor mdzad pa so lta de dus legs lam du yod kyang / phyis rwa lo sku bsod rgyas pa la/ zangs karagyis phrag dog gi tshul gyis rwa los chos mkhas po mi shes zer brnyas pa yang mang du mdzad/ dang po paṇ+ḍi ta kho pas spyan drangs kyang / chos thams cad sprasabasgyur ba zhe tshe yin zhes 'phya smod mdzad kyin lha sa ra mo cher rwa lo'i chos —94—

'khor dgag pa sogs nang rgyas byung / de'i lo dus la zangs mkhar slo bur du bsnyung nas sku 'das/ gcung po dang nye gnas kyang de nas cang ma len pa shi'o//mar pa lo tsho jo sras dar ma mdo sde yang yin te/ rje btsun 'di lho brag stod smad du 'gro don mdzad pa'i skabs shig yon bdag shud ke bya ba cig gisagason ston la spyan drangs/ khong rang tshe dang sngar 'dris kyi yon mo chod yin pasadar ma mdo sde yang byon/ bla ma lo tsā ba las kyang bkur zor che ba tsam byed kyin 'dug skad/ rwa lo'i gsung gis/ chos mkhas na ni ngas kyang khyed ladagapa byin pas chog de min nged lto bal du phyin pa'i lotswa ba yin/ khyed bod ston tsam du ka gda' bas/ sa gcig tu khyed kyi 'gying thabs 'di rang bag min nam/ chos kyi gleng bslang byed dgos gsungs pas/ dar ma mdo sden re/ ngapha tshe rabs nas sangs rgya ba'i chos byed mkhan yin/ khyed rwa nag po bya ba nganasngags la blo gtod pa dang mi 'dra zer nas/ dngos su gshe zhing lta kal ba mdzad thegs song / de nas zla ba gcig tu nye tsam na dar ma mdo sde rnga mochushod kyi ltad mo'i sar rtas brdabs te skad cig la grongs/ 'di la dingasangagolo rgyus khyab che ba tsho na/ mar pa bzhugs pa'i dus su yin pa dang / mi larasapa rta gdong pa yin go ma chod byung ba sogs 'chad kyang / mar pa'i sngon la tshwa sde 'das pa min/ 'di skabs mar pa sku 'das nas lo shas song/ mi larasapa tho phyi na bzhugs pa med do/ /des na lo rgyus mang po de dag rdzun phalakasgrigs su shes par bya'o/ /yang 'brog mi jo sras in dra de/ dbus su nora'atshol la byon pa gtsang rong gi re dngul gyi chos sder/ rwa lo chen po dang 'dzom/—95—

chos kyi gleng bslang mdzad pa la/ de na re/ lo tsā ba dang / lotswa ba mi 'dra/bsgro gleng byed dgos med zer bas/ rwa lo thugs khros te/ lotsā ba dang / lotsā ba ka cis kyang mi 'dra/ gzod blta'o gsung / de nas zla ba gsum nasa'abrog mi jo sras khrag tu 'khru ba'i rims nad byung nas dbus su ka 'das/gcung po jo sras rdo rje yang phyis mi ring bar 'das zer/ yang bla ma lo tsub gtsang rong gi g.yung du chos 'khor zhig mdzad kyin yod/ der khams pa jo srasardo rje sra brtan bya ba rnying ma'i ma mo dang / phur ma la mkhas/ nus pa yod parayang 'dod/ gsar ma sogs mdo sngags gzhan yang ci rigs shes pa thig yod/ des 'dra men srang gang gi tshod tsam phul nas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhus pa la/ bla mas kyang snod brtag pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yin pa ltar mdzad nas/ gdong drug gi dbu nas bag tsam gsungs/ chos thun 'ga' zhig song ba na/ rgyud mchod mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla mas mgur wal/ khyod kyisagaser dang 'dra ba'i 'dra men phul/ /ngas 'jigs byed 'dra ba'i gtong drugabashad/ /ces gsungs pas kho ma mgu/ sang snga mor kho dos mas byed pa la/grwa ba rnams kyis gros btab kyang ma nyan par 'gro khar kha rdeg byas te/ rongagorwa rgan lo tsā la/ /'jigs byed dud 'gro'i mgo can nyan pa las/ /sman lungagi dpyal ston lo tsā la/ /rgyud dgyes pa rdorje zhu ba dga'/ zhes zer gyin song / de nyin chos gral la kho ma byung bas/ ci yin gsung ba na/ grwa ba rnams—kyis lo rgyus zhugs pas/ mil brnyas btub ste/ lha dzadi la brnyas sumibatub/ 'di la brtags ma bstan na mi rung gsung ste de ma thag spyin sreg —96— dzi

mdzad pas/khams pa de yang de'i nangs par tsam rang yin yod par 'dugasman lung du ma sleb pa la/lam du khrag skyugs nas shirwa lo chen pos sman lung gi dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje la phrin pa brdzangs te/ngas grub khyod kyisablo brkus 'dug khyod sbungs bskyed la sgur zhig gsungs pa gdapyalalothugs shin tu skrag nas/'bum gser ma gcig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po bsnams te dag 'tshangs la phebs pas rwa lo chen po'ang dgyes par byung /dpyal los rwa chen po la chos kyang mang du gsan/thugs/dmathang sku cig kyang dpyal la gnang yod par 'dug go/yang bal bor bla ma'i phebs skyel la byon pa'i skabs shig kyang/kri sna jobo dang /puṇ+ḍa jo bo la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la go nod cing/glama'i sku dgrar gyur ba mu stegs pa'i bla chen bzhi tsam mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis bsgral bar gdag grags sgo pa kha skad du/dar ma mdo sde la cho gos pa//rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum bsgral//zhes grags/dang po nas gzungasawarungs pa'i mi re re gnyis gnyis la bsad bskrad dbye rengs sogs kyis tshar bcad pa la rtsis btab med/lo tsā ba dang dge bshes chos 'khor mdzad pa thams cad/rwa lo chen po la dgongs pa zhu dgos pa yin par 'dugamayin gdug pa can tshar bcad pa ni/ngan lam nyu gu sna'i btsan bya ba sngon slob dpon pad+ma byon dus yib thub pa yin/dam 'og tu ma chud zer ba'i bdud btsan shin tu rdzu 'phrul che ba chos la gnag pa cig yod/nye skor der gsangasngags kyi sgrub pa dang chog grwa byed sa med/dge 'dun mchod na lo nyes gtong9

ba cig yod zer/nyu gu sna'i yul ba rnams kyis rwa lo la sdig gsog/byed pa yang des bskul ba yin/rwa lo wo po byang phyir bzhugs pa'i tshe/khobalabatsan des cung zad gnod pa byed pa byung bas/nub gcig gtor mtsheb cina'imadzad nas ༵gongs ṭā brtad/yi ri rgyun la zhag bdun la sgrub pa mdzad pagazhag lnga pa dgong tsag btsan gya gnas brag dang lha rten la thog smad dgubabs/brag chad lha rten gar song med/kho thul 'og tu a de shosasugazugs bstan/khorang yang mi bka/'a yul dang 'khora' ye she rang ༵nga ga zhar zlos nyu gu sna' btsan 'an du grags/phyan chad chosa~X gnod rtsa sna 'a kyang byed thub bo//yang sku smad kya dus shag yar lungs su lha btsun sngon mos spyan drangs te i ༷bor mdzad/de nas gnyal phyogs la this par bgo do//yaralashams bu' pre gci 'gram du bzhugs du/'a pos bzu ༵/na po phab dzhailabakag grwa ba gag kyang 'tha/gas nas sha ba la/bla btasungs gas/shams po dregs pa che mno'am//rwa rgyan lotsā rgas rmesko 'am//gsungs shing nus pa chung mno'am//rwa mtshone rtse mor 'a ri / ji//zhes gsung༅rde—ngagangs ri la brdungs stangs mdzad dgongs pa yun nga du brtad pas/dawathag brdung stangs je zla la dkar po gci shes thib/po 'ur/nam phyed kyi dus shigan/shams sdo kho rang khye'u gi 'kho po gag ga gzugs su byas 'a/rwa dus lta~Xzhunga'atshal zhang /bdag 'i 'khotshor rda 'a thogs pa stong phrag lnga na sne kyi gtugum song /da bla ma' grwa ba gcag sha ༷8 la grwa ba brgya dang brgyad — yus byed/

gser srang brgya dang brgyad kyang 'bul/bzod pa mdzad de rjes su bzung b.razhu zer/de ma thag yul yang 'jam por gyur to//dpon slob rnams kyis kyangazhag shas de kar bzhugs/zhag bdun gyi khongs su/yar lungs phu slad 'a nas/grwa ba byed pa brgya brgyad kyang byung /gser srang brgya rtsa brgyad phyagatu'ang 'byor bas/'dre 'di pa chad la btsan par 'dug gsung/de rjesaganyal du chos 'khor mdzad/de nas lho brag ban pa dang/gru shul dngalayag kun tu'ang phebs/klu bdud thog 'bar bya ba dang /mdzo mo spun lnga zeraba'i klu srin mo gdug pa can yod/lam la 'gro ba'i mi kun gyis kyang/phyagaphul mchod yar byed dgos/ma byas na cho 'phrul 'phral du rdzong/mtshan mosuyang sgyu 'phrul byed mi nus/mngon sum du mi khyer ba'ang mang po yong / de skabs kyang bag ma 'gro ba cig rta thog nas gar song med par sbas te lo gcig gnyis song /rwa lo chen pos phebs lam du de dang nye bar tsha phogs mdzad/khal ma rnams kho'i gnas kyi tshal gling dang ne thang la bces pag kho'i cho'aphrul gyis mdzo gcig shi bla ma thugs khros te mdzo sga bcag sbyin sreg gi yams shing la phul/klu bdud pho mo 'khor bcas de ma thag tshigo yod para'adug sngar sbas pa'i bud pho de gson po skyon med du rgo/des lo rgyusabashad/klu bdud kho lo tsā ba dpon slob kyig tsha phogs mdzad pa la'ang/ngal phyag mi 'tshal ba zer nas 'khu/phyugs btsos pas shin tu khro so te/mtshon cha 'phangs/de dud 'gro gcig la phog pa yin/sbyin sreg mdzad parabartsams pa na/kho bzhad gad byed 'phro la phyogs thams cad nas mun na gan 99

bun 'dra ba bstibs/ gang yang ma mthong ba cig la lung pa mes khengs nas de thams cad tshig de skabs mo rang yang skrag dngangs chen po byung ste/ de nasaganyid sad pa 'dra ba cig la gang yang mi 'dug zer/ de nas mi nga bar gnas de'i chu mig thams cad bskams par gda'/ de dag mtshon pa tsa5yin/chos la bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin mang po yang btul lo/ / gsum ( 〈dza〉 bzhi ) pa sku bsod nams kyis che ba la/ longs spyod dang zas nor char bzhin babs/ mi chen so sos zhabs tog byed pa la grangs med/chos yon rnams brtsis na yig 'bru re re la gser srang re re'i rtsis byung/ na bza' gsang 'a ma ma gtogs sku la snal ma mi 'khri/ de dus rgun 'brus shin tu dkon pa'i skabs yin yang / rgun 'brum bre lnga lnga'i rgun skyems kha tshe'i lugs nyin re bzhin du sbyor/ rgya bal gyi shing thog mang po mi rnyings pa'i thabasabyas te/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang / rgyal blon tshong dpon sogs kyis 'bul mkhan yangayang yong ste/ rgya gar gyi shing thog so ma la rgyun mi 'chad gsol du yod pa sogs/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi rjes su 'di bas bzhes thang che ba med paragrags/ dus rgyun gyi 'khor ra tshogs 'dus pa la/ chas nyan pa po brgya phrag du ma rgyun mi 'chad cing / sngags pa dpe 'grems brgyad brgya dang / btsun pa dpe 'grems stong nyis brgya re yang yang 'dus/ gsang sngags kyi chos grwa la'adi las che ba dus gsum khegs pa yin/ sngon chos dar ba'i skabs mdo pa dang sngags pa mi 'dra/ sngags chos la mchod pa dang yon chen po dgos pas/phal pa cig gis mi 'grub/ gzhan sngon dus sngags pa 'du 'tshog tshe shos rang—100—

mgos khug pa la yang /dus gcig/ la dpe 'grems bdun brgya 'as/lhagapam byung ngo /khyad par gyi 'khor tshogs ni/mi che ba jo bo rtsad po'i rigs ca dang /zhang sgra chen la sogs pa 'byor ldan kun dang /brang ti dab sgo phyugagrags dang /g.yu thog dar po la sogs pa sman pa chen po thams cad kyisakyang zhabs la gtugs/zhang tshes spong ba dang /'bre chen po dang /'ban dkon mchog rdo rje dang /rtag ba kha che la sogs pa spo nyid pa wo po lgesacad dang /zhang sang gha dang /gtsang thang 'od po dang /sgang rgyu dang /snuranyi ma dang /klun rdor po dang /rgya long chos grags dang /rtsangs yang dga'abar dang /rngog mdo sde dang /shong rdo rje rgyal man dang /skyu ra a skyasadang /ngo khro yon tshul la sogs pa gsar ma pa'i dge bshes thams cad dang /zur hor po dang /yang keng bla ma dang /byang chub 'bar la sogs pa rnying ma pa chen po rnams dang /ba reg lo tsā ba dang /dpyal lo la sogs pa lotsā ba mngapo ste/de dus kyi dge bshes dang mi chen phal tsher gyis zhabs la gtugs(sgo/mchod gnas gzhan lta zhog gsung rab gcig po phyag tu phebs pa la yang/mdo sde yongs rdzogs tshar drug cu dang /'bum cha nyis brgya lhag pa phyag tu byon pas mtshon/nor rdzas tha mal pa smos kyis ga la lang /slob ma mi chen rnamasakyi mtshan dang /so sos zhabs tog byas tshul rnams rgyas par rwa ye shes sengage'i gsungs las shes par bya'o//lnga pa mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi che ba ni/rgya bal du phyag rjes dgo rtsamadzad tshul gong du smos zin/bod kyi dbang du byas na/chos khor ba4yas surnga0

dang /rag sha'i sde 'khrugs byung ste/'kho 3 sa bar pa dang/grang khang thamasastucad mes tshig go/de rjes lo sum cu tsa5song yang/dkor bdag gto/ tshebs zhig gsos byed mkhan yang med/rba rag gzhung ma 'du pas pa gdagon gnas 'dzin mkhan med par/dkon gnyer re tsam ma gtogs stongs pa bzhi du gyur/de skabs rwa lo wo pos zhig gsos mdzad par dgos te/ba lam kla gi phul phebs pa'i skabs/dkar bdag dpe pe kar gyisardedakon gnyer la gzugs dngos su bstan te/sang gnangs 'dir 'jegasasuyo ba cig yong ba 'dug 'dir sdod pa'i dbang mi snyug zer nas bros pa dngos su mthong /su yod snyam tsa na/zhag gsum song nas rwa lo ho po phebs/mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas/dkon gnyer la khyod kyi dkor bdagagar song gsungs/de nas dkor bdag kyang bos/bka' bsgo dam bzhanamadzad/'ol ka'i shug nags wo po zhig bcad de/shing rnams gtsal po'i steng nas yar drangs/thag pas cung zad de 'dren pa ma gtog gnya gyen largyugs pa bzhin dka' tshegs ye ma byung /bsam kyi yas zhig gar che/lanasakhal 'bum phrag cig gi rtsis song /dbyar lo gsum la gyang ris tshun chod mthar phyin/rba rag sde pa gnyis la mthun par bsgrigs dam bzhag mang po mdzad nas/dge 'dun gyi sde sngar bzhin tshugs par mdzad do//g.yasarugatsang 'gram lha khang yang shin tu gogs shing zhig ral du gyur pa la/dbu rtsedang 'khyams thams cad la zhig gsos mdzad/nas khal khri tsho gcig go rtsisasong /de'i dge 'dun 'thor ba yang bsdu bar mdzad/sku tshe'i smad kyi dus 0

cig na/ g.yu me tog sbungs pas sna drangs pa'i g.yu byang kho na'i 'phreng ba spemoche zer ba mkhar thog so lnga pa cig gi dar cog gi rtse nas bzung na sa la 'khyil ba tsam zhig yod pa dang / gzhan yang zab yug dar yug go khrab/ stang rtse/mdzo rta sogs dpag tu med pa rnams ni/ ngur smrig bye mda'/ kyus thang /nyan tsho/ lcang ra/ shar skyang / re dngul sogs gtsang gi dge 'dun gyi sdernams dang / rgyal lha khang sogs dbus kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la/ so sorathes su sbyar nas chos 'chad pa'i thes dang / dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog lha khangagi mchod pa/ mtha' na mgron zan gyi bar du bstan pa nam gnas b.racharkyen du gnang / gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi sde so sor rten gsu5dang / spyi rdzasadang / phyag 'gyed kyi dngos po btang ba la grangs med/ de bzhin du 'bumabacu drug du marang yang brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/sku drung du rgya gar gyi a tsa ra paṇ+ḍi ta bgyod stong pa 'don mkhan brgyad redang /pū yi pa bsgom mkhan re ste/ mchod gnas rgya gar ba dgu re rtag de tu 'gas/bod kyi gsung rab la sher phyogs stong tshar dang / mdo sde brgya tshar lan mang du song / mtha' na tsha tsha rang yang 'bum phrag lo star gyis mdzad/ gson dgomadzad pa la rngog lo tsā ba'i chos 'khor la nas khal khri tsho gcig dang/ 'butshagyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba chen po bskyal/ de dang mnyam pa glang ri thang pa dang / btsan kha bo che dang / rgya 'dul 'jin rnams la yang mdzad/ rogamangon pa ba la sogs pa gzhan yang dge bshes ji snyed pa zhig la chos 'bor btsugs shing 'bul ba mang du mdzad do/ /bla ma lotsā ba rmedi sku tshe yang ring—103—

por bzhugs pa zhig ste/dpal me tsa ling pa spyan drangs pa'i dus na/dgungalo drug cu lhag tsam du phebs par gda'/de nas phrin las mgo rgyas pa yin/de rjes mi ring ba na/rngog lo r+ṣa po'i 'phrin las kyang mgo tshugs/rngogalosku 'das nas kyang rwa los lo nyi shu lhag par bzhugs/sku tshe'i smad lo mngapor gzhan la gshegs bzhud ma mdzad de/ne'u me tog ldan du bzhugs 'dugadagung lo brgya dang bcu bzhugs bya ba dang /brgya brgyad bzhugs bya ba chogasarde'achad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug kyang /lo rtsis nges gsal mi gsung ba cigayin pa 'dug pas/sgra ji bzhin bshad dka' na'ang /dgung lo brgya sgoracig bzhugs par nges/bsad pas tshe ring 'grub pa ni//rwa rgan lotsware khyad chos yin//gsungs skad/mthar bsnyung ba med par ye shes gong 'pho mdzad de sku 'das/dpon po lo tsā ba chos rab kyi dge 'dun gyi sde chen po nyi shu tsa5spyan drangs nas/sku ldad rgya chen po mdzad/zhag shas nas sku gdung du mngon pa cher ma byung /khru gang tsam yod zer/cung zad cig ston pa rin wo rdorjesazhi ba'i thab khung cig tu zhugs la phul/sgra dang 'od dang /me rtarge/go charasagazhi khengs pa byung /sku ldad kyi skal ba skyel ba la/ston pa rgyal ba zhes bya bas bal yul du phyin te gser srang brgya bshig pa'i mchod pa dang/gserasrang brgya'i 'dra min gyi rnyed pa phul lo//rgya gar bi kra mdang/rdorje gdan du de dang phyogs mtshungs pa byas par grags so//de ltar na rnamathar lo rgyus ra tsam mo//'dir ma 'dus pa rnams ye shes seng ges mdzad pa'i rnam thar dang /04

de'i lhan thabs gnyis las shes par bya'o/ /rnam thar gyi yi go rgyas pa gzhan zhig sngon dus byung zhes zer na'ang / deng sang med par mo ngon/ spyir yang sngon dus kyi lo tsā ba rnams la/ rnam thar khrigs chags ma chen mo'i rigs/khungasastedang ldan pa cher mi snang bas/ lo rgyus kyi ngo bo 'di tsam yang rgyas pa yin paramangon no/ /phyis kyi kha skad 'byam po la/ rwa lo dang gnyan lo nang rgyas byungazhes kun la grags pa ni mi bden te/ nag po'i rgyud nag tshos bsgyur ba laganyan gyis bcos/ de la rwa los bcos pas kyang ma tso no/ gnyan lo dang sngags pa nang rgyas byung ba de ni/ bla ma rdo lo tsā ba yin zhes skyo ba'i yig rnyingakhungs ma rnams las bshad/ de yang gnyan lo rdo lo gnyis bsdung khongasalartsod pa byung bas/ gnyan lo na re/ nangs par khyod kyi mgol phur ba rtsang༅seb cig bya yi/ zhes lon bskur bas/ rdo lo na re/ khyod dgag sngags 'drasaspos pa yin te 'ong / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po la su yis ho/ khyod rang zobs shig zer/ rdo 'o/sa/ brdung stangs byed yo yi dmachos skyongabaskul bas/ gnyan lo'i thugs kar lhog 'bur chen po byung ste/ cang ma len par grongs zer bar 'dug rdo lo tsā ba de phyis deng sang grags lto yang khatshede gyi slob ma yin/ chos rnam grangs mang po mi mkhyen/ rdorje 'o jigs byed kho na la chig/ 'dril mdzad/ yi dam gsang yang mi gsang/ gzhan la 'chad kyang mi 'chad/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa cig yod zer ba 'dug blun pa las kyang ches blun pa dag zhal bzhi pa dang las gshi/na la lha 'dras yod/ bya rog gdong can dang pu ṭa la lha 'dras yod/ phyag drug pa dang / gur zhal la lha —105—

'dras yod zer ba sa ni go rnyi ye ma zhes kyi pa'i gtam ༵rgo/shes sa thams cad khrel ba 'a gnas sa//༷'a rgong nga sto she/sngags mi chi / rdemakhan nang rgyas byung yang /ya dam lhon pa ga la yad/da na bad gi lag tu rgya gar gyi ral gri byung /cig shos kyi lag tu rgya nag gor la gri byungar nga skyob/1rdeganyi kra ka/nye khus/rderde ra tsho:sku re tshonas/zhi no 'i gnyas 'a kyang /nā kau rga ༷nig lag pon 'angab ye spu//'asa~Xn rab ༷kyi phyags thams go du ni / do rde~X ltar/ shas rdzo/ lha' re sngags ge ge de mu ge sngi dan la kun su de te tu khyab pa na/ ye da shas blo ma 'a /she mkhan she rges rje/ blangs she la/tshe ste / 'dim she lha la skul zhe/da ga la yad/'ad yang snan to du gab ga~Xsarde/'ad ma ga bas rnam sa 'a ma she dgu langs nga/'am5ga mā/rdergyal sa gangs 'dug ka ste phyaX ra// lo chen po de nyid kyi shedā na rab ni zi pa gi bye /rdzu btsun rwa la pa nyad phu gas al tsā ba ma pa rtsa pa gi/rdeb sogacig rta smra ba bzhi du sku 'khrungs/yab lo po yo(smi bum rngi ga dzo gag tu byo ba ḍi du snogs su chud/bla ma be yi las la tsā yang shan 9 she par rti ta yul rnya shrī du sbyangs/bla ma sa ḍi spyaldad grub ༄da bal bar bya na/༵ ta~Xshe dus kya stiralal bye slo/sdol phyad dang lnga dzi na mas zil skar sdum cha ge ged la 'a mkhas par gyur nga /dus (༈gar legs 'gyur dpa sa der bomaga~Xgs par hūṃ skyar mdzad pas shan tu rmi rta sa zu rnya shrī /she du bas/'gra dan cung zad mdzad gre 1 0 /6paṇ+ḍa ta sa snya bad du a dras/

dbu gtsang kun tu phebs/phar leg phebs dus gser srang sum brgya dusagacig tu phul/skyid grong gi bar du skyel mar phebag bla ma 'ang dgyes te/blam nyid kyis dam tshig rdor dril dus 'khor lugs dang /bstan skyong 'bumaphrag gsum pa'i brog zhu/brgyad stong pa'i po ti dang bcas pa gnang/yanga'aphyas rgya gar du phebs nas/paṇ+ḍita wā gī shwa ra gu rtol yang thug phag mosobadun ma la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bsgyur/nag po r+sā po'i a skru3 byung yang bskyur zhing dbang dang man ngag blangs/de skabs he ru ka mo ngon byung/phag mo mngon byung /mgon po ma rga byung ste/ma phro byung skor gsu5gyi thasnyad kyang byung /gsang sngags kyi lo tsā ba cig la bla ma 'di rang mkhas paragrags/de la sras gnyis mnga' ba las/gcen po ni rwa ye shes seng ge ste/de yang rwa lo chos rab kyi sku'i yon to thams cad par btab pa bzhin mnga' ba yin/rong khu lung gi se khyim zhes pa'i mkhar cig tu bzhugs/rwa nub pa bar grags/de'i sras ni rwa 'bum seng yin te/de yang bla mgong ma rnamasalamanga' ba'i chos thams cad thugs su chud pa cig byung /ye shes seng ge dang/'bum seng gis kyang rgya bal du khor tsam re gshegs shing /sgrubaḥs ther bu ba sogs chos sna cung zad re 'gyur mdzad/rwa lo ye shes seng godang/rwalo'abum seng du yang grags so//de las brgyud pa'i rigs kyi dbon sras brgyud pa'ang ci rigs phyis byung bar du yod par snang yang slob brgyud bzang/rigasabargyud grags chung ngo //rwa lo chos rab kyi sras chung ba ni/rwa sto seng ge yin te/des ne'ume0

tog ldan du bzhugs/de'i sras dkon mchog seng ge de'i sras shes tha rgyalamatshan yin te/de rnams kyang nus mthu dang ldan zhing /nag po skor gsu5lamakhas pa/'khor lo sdom pa/dus 'khor/phag mo'i chos skor sogs kyang ci rigs pa mnga' ba byung de dag rnams la rwa shar bar grags/rwa shes rab rgyalartamatshan pa'i rjes su/rwa lcags mkhar ba sogs brgyud pa mang du gyes/slob brgyud la ru mtshams kyi rgya dbang phyug grags pa/de'i sras rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/de khams su byon/rgyal thang me long steng du bzhugs/mi lhanadang /dmar khams kyi yul du'ang lan mang du phebs/mthu stobs shin tuche'o//de la khams su slob ma mang /khams pa lon tan 'bus bya bas dbusagatsang du'ang khong gi lugs dar bar byas/ma rdzo rten dkar po ba 4sa rgyasaskyabs sogs slob ma mang du byung /des lha btsun bsam yas pa cho gosalabashad nas da lta'i bar du dar/rje btsun 'bum seng la zur du byon pa'i srasablo gros seng ge nas brgyud/gdung rabs 'ga' re byon 'dug 'gro don tsheb rang ma byung ba 'dra/slob brgyud bu chen bza' la mang ba byung/thugs sras kyi gtso bo rong ba rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje yin/mdo sngags yis go dang/ha par dus 'khor la mkhas shing grub pa thob/de'i sras rje shes rab sengagodang /bla ma a ka ra gnyis kyang dus 'khotshor dang gshin rje gshed pa lamakhasardeshing /'jigs mdzad la brten nas nus pa'ang thob bo//rje sher seng nas brgyud pa la/mang mkhar lo tsā ba dang/blam dpalaldan seng ge bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/yang rje sher seng dang /bla ma a kar08

gnyis ka la/ skyid ston grags rgyal gyis zhus/ de la sangs rgyas kun 'dusakyi ngo bo kun mkhyen chen pos gsan/ seng rgyan pa dang / kun mkhyen chen polazhang ston rgya bor grags pa/ mkhas pa bsod nams grags kyis gsan/'dis 'jigs mdzad kyi chos rgya cher spel/ 'bri khung dpal 'dzin du gragasapa'ang 'di'i slob ma'o/ /yang rje sher seng la khor rang gyi dbon po rong pa rdorje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la dbon po bsod nams lhun grub kyis zhus/ de la'ang 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis zhus so/ /yang rwa 'bum seng gi slob ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa de gshin rje gshed dang dus 'khor la mkhas pa cig byung / de la ldongs ston shes rab dpal gyis gsher skor rnams zhus/ ldongs ston des mdo sngags kyi gzhudachen mang po mkhyen/ brgyud pa tha dad sna tshogs kyi chos sna bzhugs rgya tshe zhingathams cad la mkhas pa cig yin yang / nyams len rdo rje 'jigs byed rwalugs kho na gtso bor gton pas/ nus mthu yang chen po mnga'/ sku bsod tshebs bla chen 'phags pa dang / rgyal po go pe la'i bla mar song/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo'i skabs sogs 'ga' zhig tu/ snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos cung zad yod/ khong rang gi sgos kyi brgyud 'dzin rnams la ldongs lugasapa zer ba byung / bla chen 'phags pas kyang rwa lugs rtsal 'don mdzad de spelabs/ sngar dkar po rnam gsum gyi dus su mdzad pa'i mal lugs de ni bgal zha ba ltar gyur to/ /bar skabs su rwa lugs 'di bo dong 'jam ral du grags pa nam mkha' smon lam/ 'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka skyi rong lo tsā ba —109—

ngag dbang /she kyi dpal ba/grub wo ca she ge de rten zhe shes ge.idapal baX pa/sngags 'cha kun dga' zla rdo/slab she sbyi/rdege mu/ la 'a~Xye///da lta' bar preng ge ge/kha' la sa lugs kya nga sngon ra mu na 'phags spyi khog tsam bsha sgrub ༵/rdzu brgyud rim so so ba rnams kha ni//'dar yis tshul — khog tsam/bshad pa di/brgyud ma so rtse ge'/ lha/( brgyud ga 'jig tha par o/rde/rwa lugs 'a la dgra gdong ga kha ge ge ge zil dod dang zhes de ge mu rtse ge cha/bzhi : ) dbang / la da lta lebaramakau she/ro langs brgyad bskor te dkyal wor ba 'a dbang rgyun da tsho bar du rngu pa/tshod rda/tshe//rderde// 9si 0sro zur 〈 sna/skya lugs kya brgyud pa' dbang du byas na/la ta badz+ra dang/gsangaldan mdzad mkhan gyi sgeg pa'i rdo rje gcig pa ltar gyi spyod pa byed de/de ni ༈tre/ra pho ke phyo ge tsho ge ne je do ra tshor rje no ge tsho ge tshordem na mad/'an she slab rnyin sa to 'dan byad sar byan nas 'khang ribanas 'khotshor 'a zhing du pas phan gsungs/nya rnams zha~X du gso le / nasa'ajam dpal gya nga s+t+ri spur nas bto zer/slob dpon la ta de la womadapal po1mi ge ge cha zi tshod dod da ༈sa thug de yang grub pa thob par nye nas spyo pa sbyang/mu stegs kyi rgyal po ga glang po byung bas slob dpon gyis sdi/zam pa cigatumajal nas/she bzung stod nas bas slob dpon gyas lto'༈/bstan pas/rgyal pa dang /glang pa che gnyas/mu ge mar gas te/rkya 5 6 /pa'i sdig yasag phro du lhungs/de nas ltor ri pa'i bsan pa'i par gso~X nga go ye/babatab pas/slar gsos te nang pa rwaskyi pa la bkod/ ga rten lha la

phyag mi 'tshal//glang po byung yang lam mi bzur/khanas gsang sngags rgyal/po bzlos//rkang pa brag ri thogs med 'gro//zhes pa khong la ḍā ngo //de'i slob ma ni a mo gha badz+ra wo po yin/de ni bum pa nam mkha' la'ajog sprul pa'i sku zhal gzigs/rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgaco/krug brnyes skad do//de la slob ma bzhi ste/de ba ā ka ra tsan+t+ra dang/nag po ba dang/bi bya tsa spro dang /a mo gha badz+ra chung ba'o//dang po ni/zhung lotsā ba shes rab bla ma'i rtsaba'i bla ma de yin/mgos khug pa'i bla ma btsun mo ngo dang gag pa 'dra'o//'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes nas dpal gyi ri la bzhugs zer/gnyis pa ni/kā ma dra'i yul du mchog spyin byed mkhan gyi mu stegs rnamasastul sdigs 'dzub byas pas/dran med du brgyal/rgyal pos zhus nas slar gsos/rgyal po zhabs la gtugs/dmar mchode rnams phal cher bkag/lam la stag brdzus mdzad zhi gnyal du byon/bod du byon dus lo tsā ba med pa glos ni tshabasgyur/dbang dang man ngag than thun gsungs/a tsa ra zhabs dkar po can du grags so//gsum pa ni/jo bo rje'i tong po yin/gshin rje lted kyi nus pa sa pa/bod yul phal cher du byon/yar klungs kyi klu dgon par yun ringabazhugs/slar rgya gar la thegs pa de ka yin nam sems/skyo ba rnams blo des/'ja' lus brnyes/dpal gyi ri la bzhud zer/bzhi pa ni/slob dpon a tu la dā sa'i sras yin par yang 'chad/gang

ltar yang zhang shes rab bla ma rgya gar du bzhugs pa'i dus/slob gnyer gyi 'phros skyong ba'i gzhon nu gcig yod zer/phyis nus pa dang ldan pa'i paṇa wo du gyur/bod du phebs dus zhang lo shin tu bgres por gyur kyang chos gsan/spyir bod yul du 'gro don che/ba ri ba'i bla ma sku drin che shos rnya ga yin/dus mnyam gyi lotsā ba phal cher kyis gtugs/phar phyin dang tshwa ste rgyan sogs mdo chos kyang mang du gsungs/sngags chos gsang 'dus/dgyes rdor sogs dang /sgrub thabs phra mo'i rigs mang du gsungs shing/phyag rgya bzhi labarten pa'i rdzogs rim kyang mang du gsungs 'dug bod pa'i dge bshes dang sngags pa mang pos zhabs 'bring byas/stod lung gi phu'i la zhig la bzhud pa'i tshe/jag pa mang po byung ba la bod pa rnams ri la brdzes 'thab chas byed pa la/paṇ+ḍi tas sdig 'dzub mdzad pas jag par rnams rengs/'thab ma dgos paral thon/de nas bod kyi dzo gi rnams la nus pa mi 'dug pa gsung/'gro don cher mdzad nas rgya gar du bzhud/sku tshe'ang ring du bzhugs/ras chung bsakyang bla ma 'di la chos mang du zhus gda' ste/ras chung ba'i rnam thar na 'bre dgos nges shes pa 'di tsho ma bris par 'dug de lta bu'i bla ma a mo gha badz+ralabla ma skyos gsan pa yin te/khong gi yul/pa snam gyi nya tshan phug yin/dang po mngon pa dang /tshad ma dam dum mkhyen/rnying ma sgyu 'phruwa sogs legs po shes pa'i ban gzhon nor che ba cig yod/ming dngos cha mi 'tshal/bla dwag༅la skyo nag 'brom ston zer/kho nangs par sman 'dra nyo ba dang /gzhan don spyod cig kyang yod/grabs rnams grub sto nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/lung

ba'i mda' chen mo ma gi nas yar/shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i lus can/mdog nag pa/mgo dang rkang lag mang po yod pa/me dang dud pa'i dkyil na gzugs shin tu che ba cig yar yong gin na mi 'dug 'dar ma byung na rung ste bsasatsa na/khong rang gi rtsar tshang gis byung /skrag rang grags te gang gragaci gragal gnyid sad pas/gos thams cad rngul nag gis bangs 'dug der bsams pa/da de ring gi don de rang mi 'grub pa yin/de bas kod gzhan ci yong yangami shes te/dus brtsams zin pas/ma phyin na mi rung bsams/nam 'angasardem thog phyin/gra ma smu gu zer ba'i chu 'gram de'i cwa na/paṇ+ḍita dpon g.yoga'aga' zhig 'dug de mthong ba tsam gyis yid la dga' bde khyad par can yangaskyes/zil che ba zhig kyang 'dug de la mos nas nga da lta snyen ra nas yong bsa'adir bzhugs zhig bdag gi khyim du spyan 'dren pa lags ga byas/denas tshonga'adus 'gur mor phyin pas sman mang po'ang rnyed/don spyod de yang legs pa rang zhig byung /de la brten pa'i chang 'dren pa mang ste/nyi ma zer ba tsa mo thub yongs/de nas sngar log yong ngo byas pa dran te/'phro bzhan nas 'ongs pasamun tshab tshub la/paṇ+ḍi ta dpon slob rnams sngar kyi sa de na ka bzhugs 'dugasar sleb/nub mo de ka yar byon te khyim du spyan drangs/zhabs tog sna len bzang po byas/paṇ+ḍi ta dbus du phebs pa'i cha rkyen thams cad kyang derabasags/sngar lo tsā rab rib zhig mkhyen pa la slar rgya skad la sbyangs pa cheramadzad/paṇ+ḍita dbus su phebs pa'i phyag g.yog gi rkang len mdzad/shorachos kyang mang du thob/yar phebs nas bla ma rang gi thugs dam gyi mthil gang

yin pa de nga la zhu byas/ snyigs ma'i dus na 'di kho na byin rlabs che/ nge'i yi dam gyi snying po'ang 'di yin gsungs nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i thang sku bstan/ sngar rang gi rmi lam du byung ba der 'dun nas/ dga' grags nas te te brdungs/ dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ dkyil zhe bor gyi dkyil nas 'od dkar po'i gong bu snyim pa tsam cig byung / khyim thams cad 'od kyis gang nas/ skyo ston gyi dbu la thim/ bla mas ming 'od kyi 'byung dzinasasu btags/ der zla ba bzhi tsam bzhugs nas/ rdo rje rme zags byed kyi chosardeskor dpyis phyin pa zab rgyas su gnang / skyid grong tshun chad skyel mar phebs/der rta bzang po cig phul nas smon lam btab ste/ phyir lon yong khar/ dbu zhwa dang phyag 'khar gnang nas/ da sgrub pa gyis shig legs pa 'ong zhes lungabastan mdzad/ de nas chos rgyud gcig par dgongs te/ 'ardzi 'tshams kyi nangagi dge 'dun bzang po'i drung du byon/ sngar gyi rgyab rten du dgra gdong lo sdegasagasum gyi chos skor rdzogs par zhus so/ /de nas nya tshan du sgrub pa byed kyin yod tsam na/ rmi lam du bla ma phebs yod phyir shog zer ba cig byung/ phyir phyin tsa na zhing kha cig na bla ma a mo gha zhugs 'dug phyag phul tsan/ ga mkha'/ gyis sa la ri mo mdzad kyin/ 'dir khang pa gyis gsung 'od dkar po cigatugyur nas yal song / de nas mi ring pa cig na/ pha sbun cig yod pa des zhingade nyo'i zer byung ba la/ lung bstan dran nas zhing nyos dgon pa byag pa tshasanyi ma sde zer ba de yin/ lan cig der sgrub pa byas tsan/ lha'i bu gnyis kyisabum pa bdud rtsis gang bas khrus byas/ lag tu rdo rje gtad de/ ri ni ma he'i —114—

gzugs 'dra ba//de yi rtsa ru skyes pa ni/sku kye re sras po zhes bya ba/tod 'byung zhes ni grags/pa'i na/de la bka'adzin nga byin mas kyis/ting pamadapal gyi ni dngos grub thob//lha yi dbang pos btob yin//ba4sa pa'i don las ma 'gyur cig/zer sman chu lung du yang dben mdzad na skabasnyen sgrub lo bdun byas pas/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po zhal stogs te/ma sto zhal ba༈ cing rtsa sngags gsung ba dang /'khor las kyi ston rje bzlas pa byed pa gzigs/bar chad bzlog sku tshe ring/lung bstan dngamathun pa'i byin sas ཿnga /mthu stobs shin tu che/skyo rog phung ba dang/pa tshab bdos phung bar grags/mthu rtags kyi lo rgyus mang po yod 'dugana'ang bris pa mi 'dug lar gyi thugs ngang rgyud 'jam zhing bzang ba zhin yin par 'dug pas brag las la brtson par ma mdzad kyang /sdig gson pa rnamasardel rang shugs kyis rtags 'gyung ba yin par 'dug go/de la sras 'jam dpal dang pad+ma gnyis kha byung /yab kyi rjes zin/bu be lnga/rtsangs yang dag 'bar/sgang ri bo tsheb/ma snar khro meb/bsagasardegazhon nu/glan gnya' nam pa ste/de tha༅sa cad gshin rje gshed kyi cho melamakhas pa'o//glan ni 'o yug tu rnying tshab tsig la chos to thi yod tsan/nub cig rmi lam btags pas/rmi lam du skoms nas chu btsal ba ga bye ma'i chu rnyog ma can 'ba' zhig 'dug de nas la cig brgal bas phu shar bstan cig/na/chu zhim po cig 'dug pa 'thungs pas tshim pa cig rmi/sang slob dpon laspyod pas/slob dpon na re/khyod la nga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs paraḥg

bla ma skyo 'di grub thob cig yod par 'dug pas/khong can du song gsungagader byon nas dbang gdams ngag zhus bsgoms pas/nyams rtogs bzangazhing nus mthu che ba cig byung bar gda'/skyo 'jam dpal gyi sras ni jo sras/khams pa yin/des yab dang /khu bo dang /glan gnya' nam pa gsum cang ri la gtul/sa/mes po'i rjes zin par byung /de yan chad bka' rgyan/bsdams/pas/mes dbon de dag la rgyud shes shing nus pa thob pa'i slob tshamang po byungayang /de dag gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor gzhan la bshad pa mang po med/de nas dbus skyi smad gsang mda'i gnyan rin chen bstan pa zhes/bya ba/rten dkar po mtshan nyid kyang shes/yo ga dang gsang 'dus sogs sngags chosamang po rang shes pa zhig skyo khams pa'i lo rgyus thos pas/dad pa skya gnasadang por mjal du phyin/gshed skor gyi chos kyi snyan 'bul byas pa gangalosteng gi skeg che da res mi 'ong /sang phod tsam bya ga sda5sa/de res log phyi lode phyin pas lo mtshams byas yod gsung ma mjal te/snod brtags pa'angayin par 'dug de na lo gnyis lon nas phyin pas mjal/za 'og yug bzangapo cig phyag rten du phul/khyod sngar thag rings nas 'ong gad yang than ringadu 'gro bas bshad kyis gsung /sman chu lung du gtor ma cig mdzad/gtor ltas shin tu bzang ste/sman chu lung du bshad na bar chad cig yong bar 'dugakun ra gnas su 'gro gsung /der phebs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbangadang man ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang /rtog bdun gyi zhib bshad tshar gnyisamadzad/cha lag kun kyang rdzogs par gnang /de nas pa tsha po nyi ma ldeng phebs6

nas rgyab rten zhe dgu ma dang /dgra nag gdong drug sogs kyang gnang/'aralo gnyis bzhugs/yo byad thams cad kyang sprugs te phul/bshad pa gdams ngag thams cad kyang rdzogs par shes pa byung bla ma'i ga sdang nas/rdorje 'jigs byed 'di mi spags khud kyi gser phye yin/chos 'di bsgrubs na/btsal na nor rnyed/btul na dgra thul/sdig pa mi 'jigs/sangs rgyasamyur du thob/pha'i chos btub nas bu dang tsha bo yang tsha sogs mtha' med pa'i bar du chos kyi grul thub pa zhig yin/chos yin zer ba lal pha'i ringaladar dar nas/bu'i ring la shog rjes kyang med par 'gro//rdze de dngami'adra'o//byi khung du mdung las snyung bu gzo bya ba yin/khyod kyis kyang chos chen po mang po shes par 'dug ste/nga'i chos 'di kho nas phan thogs par 'ong/migasum las mang ba la dus gcig tu ma shod cig ces bka' rgya bkrol te gnang /bla ma 'dis kyang yi dam 'grub ste mthu stobs thogs pa med pa mnga'/dgung lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs/brgya brgyad kyi steng du/7bla chen chos rgyal 'phags pas kyang zhabs la btud/de'i sras po gnyan 'od srungs/de la'ang bla chen gyis chos gsan/de'i sras po gnyan chos/rgya lnga yin/de labu chen 'dzims pa rin she sogs bu chen brgyud pa dang /rigs brgyud kyangaganyan ston rdo rje grags kyi bar du mi rabs bzhi lnga tsam chos brgyud zin pa rang byung 'dug go/da ltar yang chos bka' mnum tsal yod cing/kho bos kyanga'akhu kyims so//brgyud yig logs su gsal/rwa lugs kyi 'og nas lugasardesrol 'di yang gdams ngag rgyas la bzang pa byin rlabs tsheb zhin go/

lugs 'di la skyo nyid 'a kyas rang lugs khro mo brgyad bskor gyi dkyil 'khor kho na yin/dgra gdong 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma gsum zhang lugs la bskrun ma'o////gshin rje gshed nag po skor gsum gnyes/lugs ni/rgya gar gyi brgyud pa phal cher gnyes lugs rang gi gsang 'dus dang 'dra ste/gnyen(kyis ba ling ā tsar+ya la gsan pa yin/rtsa ba la li ta la thug dgos pa gzhir bcas(kyang /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis man ngag kho na la brten pa'i phyir/dngos su brgyud pa'i 'go yang de nas 'dren/gnyos lo rdzo to grags/de'i sras rdo rje bla ma/de'i sras dpal le/de'i sras grags/pa dpal rnams kyi bar du mthu stobs shin tu che/de'i sras rgyal ba lha nang pa 'phrin las phyogs kun tu khyab/de'i dbon rigs sogs la'ang dar te/gnyos lugs rang du grags shing rgyal ba lha nang pa la mched grogs 'gar dam pa chos sdings pas zhus/khong gi 'bri khung gi spyi rim pa yun ring po mdzad/skutshe'i smad la/spo bor lha dgon btab nas gdul bya bskyangs pa gabaraskabs cig tu 'jigs mdzad 'gar lugs su grags shing /mdo khams ga lho stod du dar rgyas che ba byung zer/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi srol 'dzin bar ltasasu byung ba la/'gar ljongs rgya gsum grags che ste/'gar lugs ge nyes/lugs kyi nang tshan yin/ljo ngas dang rgya lugs rwa lugs gyi nangs no/khyesakyi spund pa rdo rje myu gu zer ba 'di na 'gar ni lho pa 'gar rdo rje snying po zer ba dang zhang lugs brgyud 'dzin la zhang ston rgya bo zhes sogs zer ba ni/chosargyus phyogs tsam yang med pa'i bab col lo//ba ri ba'i rjes 'brang rnams ni/8

la li ta la 'jam dpal grags pas zhus/ de yang rdo rje ma mkha' 'gromasadabang bskur zhing mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa yin/ de la 'jam dpalagrags pa chung bas zhus/ de yang yon tan snga ma dang 'dra/ de la 'jam dpalabashes gnyen gyis zhus/ de la a mo gha che bas zhus/ de la a mo gha chung bsazhus/ de la bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas zhus/ des g.yor dar grags la gnang/ de nas kyang brgyud pa gsum bzhi'i bar du byung bar 'dug ste/ yun ring du ni tshadar ro/ /lugs 'di la'ang dgra gdon gnyis la re re dang / rme rdze gas mdzad bcu gsum ma dang / gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan rnam snang la sog༅par bsgyur ba'i lha dgu ma dang / yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku can gyi ro'angasabargyad bskor te dkyil ge dur lnga yod do// //mal lugs su grags pa ni/ nag po skor gsum gyi nā ro pa'i man ngagarnams pha thing ba chen po la bzhugs/ de la klog skyas zhus/ de lam la losardezhus pa dang / yang slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag bal po ye rangaṣ+kapaṇ+ḍi ta ha du dkar po zhes bya ba/ ba ra in+d+ra ru rtse'i drung du mal los zhus besasu 'dug pha thing pa phyi ma la yang zhus ni zer/ gang ltar yang ma la losa'ajigs mdzad chen po dang / las mkhan smyon pa 'jigs byed la nus pa cungazad thon/ de la bla ma sa skya ba chen por zhus/ 'jigs byed sa lugs bya ba 'di la zer ba yin/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i ngag sgros kho na las bsre bslad ni chung/ naga'ajigs gnyis ka la dbang bka' bshad bka' yod/ bshad rlabs chung zhingaman ngag kyang mdor bsdus pa'o/ /drag po'i 'khrul 'khor la skyogs kyis—119—

btsal ba dang / 'khrul 'khor a ka ru nag po'i chu la 'dren pa sogs yod de/rgya bal paṇa chung 'dra'i ngag sgros dang lag len yin srid kyang / dgas nusagang yang med do/ /lugs 'di'i lung bka' tsi rigs dang / dbang mchonagazhan la brten pa'i dbang bka' ma nub tsam yod pa yang bdag gis 'khums/'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang chog 7 bla chen sa skya ba kun snying gisamadzes pa ste/ bar skabs su sa skya ba'i pho rus che bar bsgom pa sa tshig rdo tshigal song ba tsho sus kyang ma rnyed pa dpe rnying rang zhig khog bo'i lag tu 'byor bas ngo mtshar skyes so// lugs 'di la dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor dang/ 'jigasamadzad ro langs brgyad bskor kho na te/ gnyis po dbang rgyun nges ngo yin la/gdong drug ni de gnyis kyi 'dabs thebs pa tsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ bla med kyi lugs dmar nag 'jigs gsum dang 'brelaba'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ji tsam bod du 'gyur snyam na/ nag yi rgyud kyi 'grel pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba/ dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa nagatsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dka' 'grel rin chen 'phreng ba gzhon nu zlabs mdzad pa/ dpyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur te/ rgya 'grel rnawadag gnyis yod/ 'grel pa rin chen sgron ma zer ba/ slob dor+sha/ shwan ti pa lakha 'phangs pa 'di dang / sgrub thabs ku mud ta kha phye ba zhes/pa/ dgra nag bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs shwan ti pa la kha 'phangs pa 'di dang / gzhin rje gshed nag po'i 'bor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa/ slob dpon mi bskyod rdorjesamadzad zer ba ste/ nag po'i skor la gsum po 'di/ mnang lotswa ba go rub —120—

chas/ shes brtsams pa yin gyi/rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel ma yin la/ku mud khaphye ba ni/rgyud dang mi mthun pas legs po yang ma yin zhing/gzhan gnyis(tshig dang don legs par yod do//rgyud kyi 'grel pa mthong ba la5sgron nagapo pas mdzad zer ba 'di ni/skor ni ru bas bod skad du brtsams pa'am/khong gi slob ma zhig gi zin bris yin gyi/rgya dpe las bsgyur bar mi 'dugadon gyi cha ni/dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa'i rjes su phal cher 'brang pa bshad pa bzang po yod/tshig kyang rgyas par yang snang wo//dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdze/'gyur gyi rtsa ba nag tsho'i 'gyur yin/gnyos lo dang /zangs kar dang /klogaskya dang /rwa lo rnams kyis kyang 'gyur bcos re mdzad 'dug na gtso 'gyuradapal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa dang gzhung 'di dag la/la lar paṇ+ḍi ta tshe gyu pa yin zer ba dang /dā na kirti yin zer ba sogs paṇ+ḍi ta'i ming mi 'dra ba 'ga' re'adug cing /'gyur byang gcig pa la tshig rigs mi 'dra ba yang dum re snang ro//yang lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang /dkyil chog dang /zhabru 5 'khor gyi cho ga rnams gzhung gcig la tshang ba'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba la li ta chung ba'am/la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa paṇ+ḍita a mo gha dang /'kholo shesarab bla ma'i 'gyur yod/gzhung de rgyud kyi don 'grel du brtsams pa yin zhing/shin tu bzang ba zhig kyang snang ngo //slob dpon ka ma lar khri to5mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa jo bo rje dang /nag tshos bsgyur/spyir dgra nag bcu gsusardema'i sgrub thabs 'gyur tshad/slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi

rjes 'brang yin yang / sgos su ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i sgrub thabs 'i de zhabs lugasazangs ma rang yin no/ /slob dpon nyin byed grags pas mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mgos 'gyur cig kyang yod/ bzhi po de nges can yin la/ paṇ+ḍita rdo rje blo yis byas zer ba'i sgrub thabs dang / paṇ+ḍita ca tu bzapapos byas zer ba'i sgrub thabs te/ de gnyis yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs yin/yang dpal 'dzin gzhung la mdzad byang migacig pa re byas lhad cung zad rebacug 'gyur mi gcig pa'am/ 'dod tshukha thad da byas pa tsa5du zad do/ /de ltar na/ dpal 'dzin/ pad+ma srung ba/ la li ta chung ba/ nyin byed grags pa dzhaidakyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs rkang thub bzhi yod/ dpal 'dzin dang la li ta badz+ra chung bas mdzad pa ste/ dkyil chog gnyis yod par don la'agro yang / la li ta'i sgrub dkyil bstan bcang / gcig gi nang nas phye ba yin pas/ gzhung so sor bgrod du ma btub bo/ /gzhung phra mo'i skor la/ lha bcu gsum po re re'i sgrub thabs bcu gsukhodī pa ka ras mdzad pa dang / dgra nag lha lnga'i mngon rtogs shrī pa rje tas mdzad zer ba cig yod/ mdzad byang la yig nor cig byung ba 'dra/ da pa la 'asgo gyis mdzad pa'i dpa' gcig sgrub thabs yang dpa' gcig sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ yang ka tshal rak+ṣitas mdzad pa'i gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi chog steganyis/ gtsorkyang gi sgrub thabs nag po pas mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga mdzad byang med pa gcig chos sku'i snang ba'i cho ga zer ba'i mchod rten gyi cho ga ldog dang /—122—

gas khor gyi cho ga cib ma la ma rga prarnyo shi / 'a ba lto~Xzhi pratswa sgyi dz+nyā gomadzad byang med ༵ gcig de rnams pradz+nyā dz+nyā na 'a 'gyur yan/pratswa nyes na ni rgya gar zangs nga 'i ce graga~X pa skor sngi ru pa'i mashaṃ zhi no//ga lha la spyobang bu/yangamachod rten bsgrub pa cho ga la badz+ra gyas mdzad ra gi/bsrung 'khang sgrub 'a me mdzad rngazang tha /sa mdzad pa/gtso rkyang sgrub lha pag tha ye/sa sto ṣa ripy-i' she mdzad pa/gtso rkyang sgrub 'thabs ye byang ༷da dzi rdzogasagatso rkyang gi sgrub thabs las tshogos dang bcas pa rnga rti ta / nga gis mdzadang/ga rkya~X sgrub thabs bzhi tsho gos dang bcas pa paṇ+ḍa ta klu byang sa sab//pa she rnal 'byor ba pa de bā kar tsan+t+ra sa she ༵ ye da chog gcig 'a yad kyang bstan 'gyu/ra du sngar ma chug 'dug nag pa mchad chag/ galadape kha cig la/dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad/kha cig la kri sna pa rje tag mdzad :sku ྅nge 0ri9rices/༵dza thab/ she le 'dra tu 'a ba ga ba 5 ga' da' ye/ 'am shed/snyun pa she dan sne sto pa cag dang tsho///khas myo zhe/'a she ye dmaralayang rdzo bar shes kyi//ro sreg dang 'is sngir gya 'a saX/dhi/ sa ༷ra she cha kyi snga zi 'bri 'a chog mdzad byang med ba/ngab gtso rkyang gi sgrung//zhabar ༵ 'a ba 'a tshag mdzad byang mad dz+nyā dgra nag gtso rkyang ci sgrub thabs la ta chung bas tshar sko rte/dang/ na ba bcigardedes mdzad pa ga rnams byung /ba 'a'ab stan/ tsar+ya sa ༵dzad zer ba shebazang snying/ra ro//de dag las gzhan 'a rje gshed skrub dib yos 'gra bzang nga pos mdzad pa jo bo rje dang lo wo gyas bsgyur ba 'a bstan lngar

na skabs 'dir yod kyang /'di dgra nag gi chos skor ma yin/nag po zhalagacig phyag gnyis pa sgrub thabs kha 'thor ba'i sdebs yin/bskyed chogardesogs dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mthun shas che/yang gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs phyogs gcig pa zhes pa/jo bo rje dnganag tshos bsgyur ba 'di yang /dgra nag gi skor ma yin kha 'thor ba yin/bstod pa'i rgyud las phyung ba yin zer ba'i bstod pa 'di yang de dang mthun pa'i bstod pa yin gyi dgra nag gi ma yin no//sdom gsum pa gdong drug gi rgyud dang 'brel ba la ni/klu'i byang chub kyimatshan can paṇ+ḍi ta cig gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang /de bā kar tsan dra'i sgrub thabs yod/de gnyis kar nas las tshogs kyi rnam gzhag mun ne ba re ston/gdong drug la 'di gnyis ma gtogs dgongs 'grel gyi rgya gzhud yongasasu grags pa med do//gshin rje gshed dmar yi phyog༅la/rgyud kyi 'grelapa 'gyur ba ni med/thor bu'i skor la lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabagalhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/gtor chog chung ba/bdud rtsi byin rlab gzhabrulardelubor gyi gzhung che chung gnyis/'od gsal 'char ba'i dbang chog rdzogs ri5shin tu spros med de/brgyad po de la bi rū pa'i gzhung ba yo so/glo bo lotsā ba la bshad bka' stabs gcig tu byung /der ma 'dus pa'i birnya'i gtorachog che ba cig kyang dpyal lugs dang dā na shrī la'i lugs la 'dug sgrub thabs che chung dang /'khrul phro tshor che chung 'di rnams la dpyal chag/dā na shrī lagasum ga'i 'gyur yod/lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rang byin rlabs zhes pa slob 4

dpon gresa~XzaX pos 'a rdo/sha lo i rje dpal gyi ltir/sa 'a she 'ad rgyud she nyar gnyas pa' man 'a tu 'dus pas rnal ku sde ljongs gzha zu kho ci ༵ lnga kya shes da////nga'adal gra 'a sde/lha 'a/na rja nid dmar nag mu ༷da ༷thun rna pag bsagacag la la 'dzi pa 'a/'a tsho da ༷ri phags zhag she da// t+yādapal 'an she maXs rim skar she/'a rdo ༵rde ma rdzas gyi/she sgrub thabs/ye she 'ad dzin gyiXstiX bzha she/maṇ+ḍa5 rnyigam rdzo ye she spoX 'an gya cha ga dzī she man zu /ga rno / gzhung /lha ma 'ad 'chang ma 'asgrub thabs/tsar kā log khyi//ni tu byu snru/ thabs hūm̐ re ste/'a bcu 'a she khu sha lha dag gi bka' da ni tu byung/ zlog 'a 'dug spya na/dkyal ga༈ga nang nas bto she/kyin sa she sgrub thabs sags spyib snyi ye bu pa gzhan yang snang nga//nga me/ga pa shegardegya 'a she nas 'a 'i chub nga dzo mdzad pa 'a 'a/mdzad byang mang pa 'a yad/'ad gnyas ka ༄sa (ga bar lugasaX5na zhang/sheg/rnyika' khyur snang la/dā na shā la 'a tsor yang kyi bzang snying/3/nas sgrub thabs sbyi snang sding bas kyod 'di rje/sa slob dpon gas dang /lha lnga 'a pa' rnal stir sbyi 'a da shes da~Xn gas 'byu/nga gnas kyas mdzad pa dang /'a ba 'a de kha na nyan sa pa dan ca/a tsa byas mdzad pa rnams yod/skyon rje lted kyi lag ma rdzo dā na shī lasar rna 0sro rang tsho ba/ji/rderdemadzad pa dang /thar las bsgyur ba 'a gzhung ༅ gzhan yang ga snang nga // na

rje gshed dmar po'i las kyi 'phreng ba'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ slob dpon shes rab skyong gis mdzad pa/ dā na shī le'i rang 'gyur 'edi la/klu dang gnod sbyin mo dang 'byung po dang sha za'i sgrub thabs sna tsho gos 'dus pa/da lta sum cu so lnga yod/ so bdun yod par bshad pas gnyis le1ra ba'o/ /'di rgyud sna tshogs las bsdus pa'i man ngag yin pas/ gshed dmar khona'i chos skor yin rgyu tsam med do/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed wo po'i chos skor la/ gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni/ bshad pa shin tu cha chung ba mna' sel lta bur snang/ rdorje grub pas mdzad pa dang / so na shis mdzad ces pa gnyis ni 'gyur khyad tsamamagatogs ngo bo gcig yin zhing / rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba cig gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'ang yod/ slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa 'di ni/ lo tsā ba go ru ba chos shes byas pa yin/ 'grel pa phyi mde rnams gzhon nu zla ba las ni cung zad rgyas kyang / rgyud don gsal bar rtogs nus pa'i bshad pa mi snang ngo / /gzhung phran gyi skor la/ a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i bum dbangagodakyil chog yod/ zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs la li ta chung bas mdzad pa/ zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum kar ston pa'i sgrub thabs/sem/sa dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogi/sa dang bcas pa 'di la bod mang dag don yod rdo rjes mdzad zer kyang ma yin no/ /smo ma drug pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ skrub thabs shobha —126—

dras mdzad pa dang / dz+nyā na ka ra bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs khro bcu me mruda'akhor sngon du 'gro ba'i sgrub thabs/ li la badz+ra gyis mdzad par yang 'o dod pa ste/ gsum po 'di phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du grags pa de'i rigs kyi sgrub thabs yin/ phyi ma 'di la bod rnams ro langs brgyad skor yin zer ro/ /dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / a mo gha chung bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di gnyis dang / bong du smos pa'i sgron ma drug pa de gsum po gzhal yas khang med pa'i lugs yin/ sgrub thabs pad+ma rgyas pa ka ma'i/rak+ṣitas mdzad pa dang / rdo rje 'od zer be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa gde gnyisabacu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs yin zhing / dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yin yang rtogabadun gyi rtog pa dang po'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ dgra nag gi rim pa bkral ba yin no/ /de bzhin du phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal ye shes kyisamadzad pa/ bsdus pa rnam gsum gyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍita 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyisamadzad pa/ gtor chog bsdus pa la li tas mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gyi chog a molhas mdzad pa/ tshogs 'kho ra gyi cho ga shun ti pas mdzad pa/ drag ngo/ lasabadun dang / zhi ba las bdun gyi cho ga ste gnyis po de a mo gha badz+ra gyis mdzad pa yin/ 'di'i 'phrul 'khor rnams rtog gsum gyi lugs kho na rang min yang/rtog gsum dang mthun shas che/ a mo gha chung ba bod la byon pa de yin/ zhesabod rnams zer yang / gong du smos pa'i dpa' rkyang gi sgrub thabs mdzad pa po de dang mi gcig par mngon no/ /phyag mtshan gyi rnam dag ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa mal 'gyu1ra gzugarde—127—

gzhan yang bstod pa'i rnam grangs 'ga' zung dang bcas pa war ro/khyud 'di'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung yin zer ba/phyis byung ba gcig gnyis tsasagada' ste/bod du phyis brtsams pa kho nar zad do//de ltar na dmar naga'ajigs gsum la/gzhung rnam dag bod du 'gyur ba da dung gzhan yang yod srid mod kyang /bstan bces 'gyur ro 'tshal du chug pa dang /mchug kyangayongs su grags pa ni de tsam mo//gzhan yang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang na 'angayod pa sogs/gzhin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs kha 'thor ba/gzhung rnam dgakyang mang dag yod cing /gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud la 'grel pa gnyis yod pa rgya 'grel yin tshul du byas 'dug kyang /snga dar ram/phyi darasnga dus kyi zin bris zhig yin par mngon/dkyil chog gsar ma zhig yod/sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bzang po 'ga' re snang ste/bstan 'gyur du ni ma chugagode ltar na gshin rje gshed skor rgya gar nas bsgyur nges pa'i gzhung ni de tsam yin yang /de dag la brten pa'i bshad pa dang /man ban zab mo ni mtha' yas pa yod do////da ni 'di cung zad dpyad par bya ste/gshin rje gshed rwa lugs kyi cho so skoral/phyis bod yul 'di na rwa bod ces grags tshe bar snang tho//re zhig 'di'i dkar chag tshigs bcad ma ni 'di yin te/le'u bco bgyod kun gyi gzhi//rgyud kyi rgyal po ston pas gsungs//de yi grogs su rtog pa gsum//sngagasapa'i mtshon char gsungs pa yin//sgrub thabs dkyil chog dpal lo sgon gyis//mdzad pa waṃ la gtso bor bzug/'phrul snyen rags la byed budha shrī/khus8

di ge de de god dod dod das steng 'dra'i ma nang ga yod//ces nag po'i rgya gzhung dang /rgyud kyi spyi 〉sa khog don yin//yig sna lus kyi rnam shad yin//blama'i gsung bsdur phran tshegs rnams/ /ma go gegs sel gdams ngag yin//dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad gdams ngag la//gsal byed tsamakha gyi yi go byas//bha ro'i phyag len dpal 'dzin gsung //de brten dbang bskur gang tshal//yig sna bdud rtsi'i bum pa brtsams//chos bzhi char twad rtsi dang //mig sman sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud dang /sru da'akhor kha sbyor dbye ba dang /khisardesgrub 'khor lo phyi ma dang /rgyas gas/ bla mo'i bzhed pa dang/bla ma'i zhalabasdur gtor ma dang //sa 'og dgug pa'i gto/a dang//blam rnams kyi zhal bsdur dang //he ru ka yi rnam spyod dang/bar do bya bas sosabashad dang //glu yi rnam par bshad rnams dang//blam rnams kyi gsungardebazhin du//zin bris byas nas bla mal//gzigs par phul nas dag paragatso / sa//mnyes nas de tsug yin zhes gsung//char 'bebs lha dbangaklund gtong //sprul bzung gso dang mgond zhi/khu 'gan 'a༅sa dang rolangs bsgrub//'phags ma dzi gu li sgras thab/ga khrim bzhi la sogs/bsgrub pa dang //mig sman ril bu rkang mgyogs dang//mkha' oṃ thos pa bsgrub pa dang //sa 'og mkha' spyod mi snang dang//ral gcig puska sribs dang //lha dang klu yi bu mo dgug/man bkag ser zhuga'edi dag rnams/khyud kyi snyinga'adra bla ma'i gsung //bod kyi brnyes yi ger blte//bla ma o lagasapa phul//nor zhabrul byung na dngos grubar//lhag rdzo e grog ga 9

gsum zhus//rkang thag spangs nas lan gsum zhus///bla ma'i / zhal nasalegs zhes 'bod//nor 'khru/la mi 'dug lan gsum gsung//zhes nag po'i skor gyi bod yig rnams dang /bshad rgyud sdom gsum ldan pa yod//dka' ba'i khas bgrol yigasnabyas/kha bsdu༅kas5ba'i sgro me bya gtabang chon 'dud rtsi'i bumacobyas//zhes gdong drug gi bod yig dang /snying po rgyud mchog rtog bdun yod//las mkhan lko yi rtog pa yod//shrī bha dra yis mdzad pa'i//sgrub thabs lotsā ltob yod//don yod rdorjesamadzad pa yi//sgrub thabs dkyil chog/spyin sregayod//dī pa kar sa smi sreg/yod//rat+na a kar shwan ti yis//mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'dir lo yod//bha ro'i sgrub thabs rnam gsum yod/kha cig gsar 'gyur kha cig bco se//zhesarderdo rje 'jigs byed skor gyi rgya gzhung dang /rgyud gyi rgyal po rtog bdun la//nag 'grel mun pa'i mda' 'go brtsams//rkang 'grel phyogs mthong len la bco /bcud kyi thigs pasaphog par bsnun//gsod pa'i mardzo de snying las ga khas yi geratshabakod do//bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud yod//rmen rtogs mi5pa lnga yang yod//las bzhi'i sbyin sreg cho g.yod//dmar po ra 'a gzhu 'gongasapa yod//smin byed dkyil ma rdzo yig sna yod/khres lo jigs mdzad skor gyi bod yid rnams so//dpe 'ga' zhig tu/bsnyen sgrub las gshi/na sbrags ma yod/khes/0

'byung /tshig lhug par yang de bzhin 'byung tho//'jug/sa 'di dag rnamasani mi legs na'ang //ban chung rwa yi lugs su snang//'di rum 'dusayege'i tshogs//legs na'ang gzhan gyas sbyar ba yin//zhes so gos yod cing/nag po'i sgrub thabs dang /dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa gnyis/rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams la/rwa lo chen posabasdus don re yod pa/dkar chag tshigs bcad mar ma chug pa ni/sku 'da' khar mdzad pas yin/chos rab kyis yi ge ma mdzad/ye shes seng ges dgranag la mngon rtogs dang /dharma seng ges bum dbang gi cho ga'i yi go byagazhes pa dang /paṇ+ḍita zla ba phyed pa'i lugs yod kyang rtsis su mi mdzad ces pa dkar chag tshigs bcad ma'i 'grel pa/ga gong dpal gyi dgon par/rwasher rgyal gyis bris gsung ba na yod do//'on kyang rwa chos zag kyi nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yig sna dang /ye shes seng ge dang/'bum sengagis kyang de las cung zad spros pa'i yi ge snang bas/cho ser ba kyi yigasnagasar pa ma mdzad pa'ang min la/gong du 'khod pa'i yi ge de rnams dkarachag der/rwa lo wo po'i gsung yin tshul brjod mkhas par byung 'dun pagabar skabs kyi mkhas pa rnams dang /phyis kyi sa dge bo gsum sogs rdo rje 'jigs byed pa kun gyis/rwa lo'i gsung yin nges su bzung na ga' ga' zhig yig cha de dag la dgag pa gtong zhing /rwa lo 'gog thub par63rde pa'i nga rgyal byed/kha cig dad pa tsam gyis rjes su 'brang mod kyi/bstan yos de dag gi nang na/rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i gsungs rtsom yang ci rig pa yod

par snang zhing / phal cher gsung la slob ma rnams kyis zin bris su byas pa yin pas/ gsung rgyun yin pa'i phyir gsung zhes byas pa yin/ dmigasasudod pa la/ bsnyen sgrub las gshi/na sbrags ma zhes pa tshigs bcad ma de yin na/ tshig sbyor tshes mi mdzes pa yod pas lo tsā ba'i gsungs rtsom gal yin/yang bsnyen sgrub dgra srog dbang sdud bya ba lag len khrigs bkod la zer na/de ni rwa lo chen po'i gsung la/ zhang tshe spong bas zin bris sbyar ba yin paragrags pas mtshon/ bcud thig che ba yang rwa dharma seng ges mdzad pa dang /yang dgra nag gi yi ge cig na/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa man ta shrī'i bzhed pa bkod pasakyang gsal/ 'on kyang de dag na bla ma'i gsung bgros 'chugs pa yang cheramed la/ gsung rab spyi dgos dang 'gal ba'i nor ba yang cher med pas/dgag pa byed pa rnams ni mkhas 'dod kha thal ba tsam ma gtogs/ don thogatu song ba cang mi snang ngo / /mngon rtogs rim pa lnga dang bcu gsum mo khrod kyilachog ni/ rwa lo yab sras kyi gsung dngos reg zig cig yod pa dpe ha cangabaka' dam pas ma 'phel ba dang / phyi mo gcig po de yang bla ma de kon mchogaseng ge pa'i dus su mes tshig nas/ de'i dod du khong nyid kyis brtsams pa'am/bla ma sher rgyal bas mdzad pa yin/ gser pod dod du gser 'dra brtsams//zhes pa'i kha skad yod ces/ rwa ba'i bla ma rnams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/sngags 'chang tshul khrims rnam rgyal gyi gsung las thos so/ /de bzhin du dmarapo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yang / dbang sdud dang / dug srung bsdus pa de 'dirabagrong pa yin gyi/ dug srung rgyas pa 'di ni stod lung be+e ror grags pa/ rgya —132—

gar gyi grub thob be+e ro tsa na badz+ra zhes pa la/ rwa dharma seng ges gsan pa yin/'di'i lha sku mdog sngon po yin pas/ dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i thasnyad kyang mi thob bo /'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog chen mo 'di/ rwa lo ho po'i rtsom pa dngos yin na/ 'bum seng gi dkyil chog logs pa 'di mdzad midagos pa las/ de'i phyir yang de 'drar rig par bya'o/ dkar chag ni gosabacad ma de'i don gzhan rnams go sla/ de'i grogs su rtog pa gsum/ zhes pa da lta'i rtog gsum gyi gzhung rang yin/ dkar chag mdzad pa po rgyud du ba'e da pa yang des gsal/ des na ngor pa rnams rwa pod rwa lo'i gsung rtsom du hod bzhin du/ rwa ba rnams rtog gsum khas mi len zer pa ni/ rdorje'i jigs byed kyi yig skor de kho na ma gtogs/ rwa pod rdzogs par lan gcig tsam yangamabaklags shing / dkar chag tshang ba yang ma bltas pa'i skyon no/ /gal te mthongan ni/ 'di'i 'grel pa tshig lhug pa na yang / lte 'khrul 'kha ra gyi rtog pa/ dmordzas bdud rtsibaza' ba'i rtog pa/ las dang rgyud kyi grogs shes rtog pa gsurapo dngos su bgrangs 'dug kyang / rtog gsum yin pa ma shes pa 'i de ni/ mjos 'dod yon lnga bgrong ma shes pa'i dpe'am lag tu sgron me thogs nas me slong du 'gro ba dang 'dra'o/ /lus dang snying 'phro rdzo ba/yod/ khres pa ni/brnya shis mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gzhung dngos lus dang 'dra/ de'i gsalabyed kyi gzhung chung snying dang 'dra zhes pa'i don yin/ yig sna lus kyi rnatshabashad ces pa rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa'i khyi ka yin/ gzhan rgyud sde'i rnam bshad —133—

nas klu'i sdud ༷ yan kau/yig chung bcu 'i : yod pa ༵ ye she sgi'abe / ba nas klo ma/ kar 'a snyus ༵ 'a pa rta lnga go de /sngu yed klu rdzu she pa' rtika sdu yag chung nya bri rtsa lnga to'i/snyolkos mu ge ge rtse ge ge de sa yi ma / / ka' gyil so ka 'ar ma lang pa'i sa thabs kya ye ri~Xzhes/ge de mu la sogs sheX rnaXs tsho rwa pa 'kho/nag gi womo zhes pa cig sna nya shu rtsa ga kha tsam snad ༵ yob rdo mas pas dgra nag 'grel pa thug tu 'gro ba yod she ba / ge dngos su maX6 bzim 'i/cho ni ༈nga ma dag pa/zhe bro rnga ni hal nag pa shog/gsad pa man she she/she/saX/ ba shin tu spogayu choshekhar ma yi/ger ma bkong ces pas / /du pa zhal she ༷/ / ngo 'astu / 'aX.o/rdegakha rgyun she rwa ma ga rim sa snga ni/da dung ga rdzo nas ya dpa' lha dan ka 1 phyag ge'i gi kho pa na na/zhi/mngan/ rtags ram pa lnga /dpal ri ka 1 phyags zhan rgya goX/she/zhal rtse'/ phyag drug pa/zhal phyag rgya~Xdho/ rkyang rig mang na chi ༷ / shad spyin rtags/bcu chogardegasum ma' sgrub thabs rnams la zer ba /las ba na sreg chogani/drag po la dgra bgogs kun snyul zer ba'i yi ge tshe pa tsin yod/zhi bar tsho6/rde bri bye ra tsho ra tsho:sku/ ge sgo / deskol tha ga 'ang ba ga pyang thi/dbang drag ༵ṭāXyo~Xsngi5ba / tha dgalas gshi/'grel dang/bcud ༵sko khri /she sa/ser nasardeXr ge ge zhes cha pa'i brdzo dang /'gaci /ga na zung pa cig she nang na gī zing ma yan pa brjad bya sheg tu na yige spyi / she she spro'i tshal nga yong pa yad pas/de dag nges par rtags na ya / khag na zlas pa tshul/du yad pa

'a mgo mi rmongs par tsor ro//de ltar rwa 'cha du grags pa waṃ/rwa shar pa' lugs la dkar rngo༅ka )rdo rdo/cas pa yo~Xpa yan/nub dā rnams/la dkarachag sna cing bsdus pa' po ta gas chags mdzad kyang /na/ mthun nga /khyad bcos lhag po yang 'a po yod do/uṣ+ṭha ge'o min ngan skor 'a kyang /bzlas sngags sdigs kya sgo 'a/gsang 'dus la brten pa'ang yin mod de/༵na 'a : nge ba bza na gsang 'dus kya 'ad/de 'a cha 'i phyir gdong drug na/'gas byed kyang phyogs 'dra zhang 'brel ngo yan pa' ra/gsang 'dus dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gshed skor ma yin zer ba gad mo'i gnas yin no//'on kyang lha rnams zhal ga5/phyag gnyasapar byed pas/gsang 'dus kho na'i yang ma yin no//waṃ ṣ+ka kyi yig skor she she shelas kyang /slab dpan sprangs rgyas ye shes zhabs las gas pa/mkhas grub/ mang ༷ gtso rnga 'a yan par bshad/des rjo rgyud sde gang la sbyar yangahrūmod kya/kri bor gshan rje 'a skar gsum da~X'adaramatho zhe te/zha mu dbang gsum gya la/kha sbyo / da ba yi ri pa la bar go ཿngab 'a ṇa/ dang mngon spyod kya las zil tsho dge ge shes rtse ge mu rang gi la/pha rol po'i lhamiganod ṭā dang /bzlog pa sogs kya las kyas rang sa las sbyor das du 'gro ba 'a bar chad mang du 'byung ba la srung bzlog ༷ nges pa gal che ni las rol 'a gsang sde 'joms pa dang /byas pa gzhag pa dang /'dag 'ardegazhan gyas mnan pa 'don pa dang /yang bzlog la sogs pa'i~Xblo/du' dgos pa yin pas/gshi/na rje gshe/da kyi las tshogs rnams sgrub pa rgyab skyor

la gal che zhing /snyigs ma'i dus su sngags pa nang rgyas kho na 'byung ba'i phyir/srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams kyang legs par rtogs par bya'o//'di la rwa shar nub kyi man ngag dpe bum so so ba rnyas yod do//gzhan yang sgrub thabs thor bu ba 'ga' re yod/mgon nag la mchon sred kyi gzhung la mchan bu dang /man ngag gi yi ge gcig yod/dpal lha mo la srogordewi shegarde/ra bu'i spa༈zhung mchan bu dang bcas/pa dang /rme'u/ ban gi/yi she /lha mgon gyi skor la/tshu tshun dha ra'i cho ga sngar song/de'i ma rdzo bu dang /las mkhan te lo'i rtog pa dang /de'i man ngag yig chung dang /lha mgon gyi sgrub thabs kā la ka las mdzad pa/sgrub khog gi yig chung rnams/yod/'an/gshin la chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa dang /de'i gsal byed kyi yi godang /rdzo ngag gces pa brgyad dang /dmar po'i man ngag sbu gri reg gcod che ba dang/rgya ston phyogs la dmar po rigs gnyis kyi sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa re re dang /spru gri reg gcod chung ba dang /gzhan yang phyag mtshan gyi lasatshogs dang /'khor lo rnam gsum ma dang /yang bzlog go rman bkagasumardesogs man ngag thor bu mang po zhig yod de/de dag ni rwa lugs kyi skor ro//skyo lugs la ni/brten so rgyud bzhi la brten/bstan bcos la sgro ne madrug gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rgya gzhung bcu tsam rgyab brten du byed/rtog bdun la skyo wo po nyid kyi khyi ka dang /rtog gsum la ngag sgros kyi rtika dang/sgrub dkyil/sbyin sreg rab gnas sogs 'phral gyi chog rnams dang /man ngagal chog/ sgrigs nyams kyi zhal gdams zhes pa gcig gis sna drangs/pa'i/yig6

sna phra mo lnga bcu lhag rnom ye do//de dag tho she sa skya to/yi/ye she she la //ga bdun la mchan bu pre zhe thar ma gtags ga snardzudakyil she/'a par na snang /sdib she la nag ni de po/sheX rgya'i she lhor gnyas ba : sku/dkya~X spo dgra she she she/naga~X skar la sbyid la mchan bu rdzo ba si ni gra dang sa da/ //ban gshe/ mthang/ gasna she da da she 'a yad paX grags ge tshe she/'a shed yis sa tholaskyang rda rja rtsa mas ṭā ka mdzad/dasaXltar la 'dzi man snyen sags ga sna tha~Xbu ba yang mang du mdzad/gtsang 'a 'ad nga ri na che snan sgrub la~Xlkog zhing rdeman ngag khyad ༷ra can ge mu zhe mu/she zhang na rgyal mtshan sheshebartsams pa'i sgrub dkyil sbyi/spya dan sreg so yang mdzad/she gang pa du yang deb/brtsams pa' sgrub dkya~X zos sa ri 'a du yad/khyada~Xr du yang nga ba ā ka ༷ ni she ra che ra she gya 3zhung la/sil she sa sad rdegasum she da nga mtshar ba /she ༵she//la tsā ba ba lugs la rtag bdun ye ye she lamadzo she thar tsam dang /nag pa la rgyus dang /bsdus hā sags phra mo tsamarde64tharnga ri ga rnga pa rde/ze②/rde :rdon gyi 'breg yi ) tsho / sa/rdenag luga~X la/'a dang she 'dzo gya 'grel pa gā na pa la ba 9 /na bu dang /rgyud 'al gya bsdus dan yang yad/'al par ma gsal/rdeb khaskong /rgyud kyi yig sna rgyas rab dang bcas pa mtho ro//rdze'i lus kyi 'i ra lte rje / ge 7 ྅re de spre/rde ge tshor tshobargyud yag na/rda she ༷gra ma/bi ga ba dgaX pa ༷/naga~Xsnra/da pa/lwa ba pa/rgyal pa ha r+ṣa da ba/gaX ra badz+ra/slab dpan dpal na/

sto shrī/si wo ཿbkan ga shwarnyi rdo don ga po'i rgyud la ni tha/ stomal lugs sngi grags pa la /'dzinaXshe/gau⑫la gnas su/bla ma la tsā ba she che kho /༷na gya 'a ༷sna bcas pa things gī she pa'/she/ mi pa sil ge mu ge ge/gla ma lotsā ḍi rjodapa' phaX ngas pa' dgangs pa she dpan ༷ 'a ༵sa nga mi'ang ge mu ge zhe gyu tshes bcas mtsha/ spa btab sdo rder ba yad sdo par gu cisang 'drab she yad da /sa ri zu tsho/ kyi ༵ bu' yag sna bsdus she noXtrog dang/bsdusasbyi/sa sku/'a pa sgrub thabs rnams/ga pa dkyim/rtag/bsnga/ rdel/bla sa skya ba 'a zhi/rde' 'phro 'a /de la gsal byed nas sa dbang lha no/ par she pa sa snrod/gnyas kyi la gī mong du ldi wo gyas zhi byughomadzad da//'ad pa' lugs la slab dpan dza mā pas rgyud 'dami drangasagasung ngo //de dag gi so so'i yig cha rtsa ba rnams ji rma rnyed pa'i dbang du po7rde rdo nye/ ra tshor tsho rkyo sku/ ra rar de sna 3 ) /rdecad bri/snga ra lugs sa sa la ga di sprur dang ri ni gri/ba/skyobasdo / ra pa / stusrid ra gal rdzung ste bzhag go/'a ti brtse pa rtse rwa gdod dod ca she~X/ra pa//da pa gsum gya rgyal thabs bla na med/khra rgyal sdun rje lted pa' / rdo ldeg ske sku / sde la//྅sdus pa par 'dod rnams pa de ltar ying ches dngom/zhes/par rta ri zhe lted kya i thas skye gto la gi lo 9 / du i ngo mtshar can zhes pa 'aXd yang /tā ra nā thas sas bdag la la ma 3 8 // //zhus dag/ma ṅga la/

brgyu / 'dabs dang bkra shas sa bya ba bzhugs/cig smra 1 /rang bzhi 'od gsal chos dbyings spros kyi 'phrin//dkyil 'khor ra lhan ga skyes pa bde wo sku//gang la gang 'dul thabs ye la can//bla ma ni bzhi sa she sras she dzi la ge mu//rje lte dun sna rgyal ba nga bzhin rdo rje//bdud ba 'a' stabs 'phrag khra rgyal btan na dbyi/ sna rab rang ban rda 'a mkha' 'gro mar//phyag khri li gsol ba she rje'i na ga tha lto /brdes/ga pa' ye brgyud brnyes ye she//'ja' lus rda skur gas a ma gha//bzhi kau brgyud bas zigs pa sngo gnas was//she 4sbya soga~Xng ba /༵ga~Xmadzad spyo ge rnga / rngu / tshe ri rjod ༷ /dzo/ni stabs thags ma da me tsa nga ba 'a zhabs//sna pa'i dpal khra ba she rda rje grags//phyag rgyud ste 'i/sgra ye mkhas pa phre phyug sprugaziX/ dang//'i 'ji sngagasargyud bdag po ye shes seng rde//'i las/gra brnga'i rgyas/pa gsas ris rdesnra//phyag 'tshal /rnam par phu9/ ba she rje ra sno/ sbyil//she byings zhabs masno mkhar sngan pa/she/spras bral dzin kyigs rwa sengadhimatshan chos kyi//phyag 'amo khu bkra shis kha sdo/ /zab she rgyud 'an 0na lbos sang mtshan//chas bkra si kha nus mthu rwa 3 9 gyur mā//snyan brgyud gdams
