pa'i mnga' bdag sher seng ba/ /phyag 'tshal: /kun dga' seng ge mkhyen rtogs byin rlabs gter/ /chos kyi seng ge mngon spyod nus mthu'i bdag /dam pa'i rjes bzung 'jam dbyangs blo gros zhabs/ /phyag 'tshal: /byin rlabs brgyud ldan blo gros rgya mtsho dang / /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul khrims rnam rgyal zhabs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba las grol don grub legs/ /phyag 'tshal: /dus gsum sangs rgyas slob dpon tshul ston pa/ /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang / /'gro kun smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi/ /gshin rje gshed dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang man ngag gi brgyud pa'o/ /yang 'bum seng gi rjes la/ klog skya'i rigs 'khru/ngas mkhas pa dbang phyug grags/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang ldongs ston shes rab dpal/ /'phags pa'i mtshan 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la/ /phyag 'tshal: /mkhas btsun dam par grags pa'i rin rgyal ba/ /lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung dkon rgyal ba/ /mang thos mthar gson bag ston gzhon nu ba/ /phyag 'tshal pa /sdom brtson ri sngags ga tshul mas rgyal mtshan dang / /blo gros mchog gyur 'jam dbyangasaral gri'i mtshan/ /'dzam gling nyi ma ma gzhan las la 'khol/ /phyag 'tshal1:/rig gnas kun byang blo brtan bzhi pa dang / /mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug shākya mchog ldan zhabs/ /byams gling mkhas pa dpal ldan rna95 khrims la/ /phyag 'tshal: /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan grol mchog rje/ /rnam dag ye shes thugs mnga' rdo ring dbon/ /gdams pas rgyud grol lung rigs rgya —140—

mtsho'i zhabs//phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs gong bzhi bya/kun rtog gzung 'dzin bdud dpung gshin rje'i tshogs//don dam dbyings su gdod nas rtag bcom pa//chosakun rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes mchog khri/ rgyud gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs//dkyil 'khor mchog tu zab mo'i dbang bzhi bskur//rdo rje bzhi bdag sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs//dri ma rnam bzhi sbyong ba'i thabs mkhasakyis//dbang don rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlos/rnam dag ye shes semasadapa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs//rnam pa lam byed zhi khro sbags sgrub tshul//rnam gsum zhing sbyong bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi dang //rnal 'byor bzhi ldan bskyed rim mthar phyin shog/nang go rnal 'byor rdzeg༅pa'i rim pa las//rlung sde spras dhū tir bcings pa'i mi 'gyur bde//spros bral rnal 'byor gsum gyi rim pa las//zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku mchog thob par shog/de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis//bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams kun zhi zhing //mthun dirkyen dam chos bstan pa rgyas dzo dang //tshe 'ar rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog/ces gsol ba 'debs shing /nang mchod 'bul ba sogs la/kun la 'dud cesapa kun la mchod ces dang / lka phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul 'e1 bzhes su gsol//lkoX āXskyoX/zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas/ kun rtog bzung 'dzin ces pa man chad mi dgos so//brgyud pa'i gtso bo gong du smos pa gnyis po yin la/dbang bka' tsam gyi brgyud pa la/'jam ral (dze+e gyi rjes )la/ blo brtan gyis thug par byas kyang chog zer/rong pa rga lo/ rong ba sher seng / cha 1 4 / rwa gcig slob dpon dkon bzang /'jam ral

bar zhes/ded kyang chog la/rga lo lo mchog pa/ dpal ldan seng ge seng ge rgyal mtshan pa/zhung ston bsod nams grags/'bri khung dpal 'dzin/gnya' ston rdor grags/bla ma kun dga' seng ge man ra gong bzhi ded kyang chog yang khrom yon pa nas brgyud pa'ang yod/yang rwa lo yab sras kyi rjes sa rdo rje skyas/rdo rje ga brtan/mkhan po sher gzhon/das khor ba/chos mgon padzhairong ri lung phug pa'i bla ma lnga/g.yag sde ze dmar sangs rgyas ye shes dang /ye shes rin chen gnyis/jo gdan mkhan chen grags tshul kha ba dang /rgyal bzang ba gnyis/bla ma rgyal ba thugs rje/kun dga' seng ge ba man chad sngar bzhin ded kyang chog gzhan yang sngags 'chang gzungs pa nas brgyud pa dang /ldang pa/brag phug pa/chos/rje glam/byang seng ba/shar r+ṣa/ngor wo/kha char ba/paṇa r+ṣa chos rje man ra sngar bzhi byas kyang chog pa yod/ga༈ yang brgyud pa mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod de/gong dkyus su bsgrigs pa gnyis po dam sel sogs skyon dang bral ṣ+ka /dbang rgyud sand man ngag gsum ka 'joms pa/byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang bcas pa yin pa las/snga ma ni lhun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa yin no//'di'i lo mo gha ni/a mo gha badz+ra che ba yin la/me tsa ling pa ni bal bo thugs rje r+sā po ste/mtshan dngos dī paṃ kar rak+ṣi ta'o//rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje ni/rong pa rga lo yin la/ rin r+sā rgyal mawo snga ma de ni/gru gul khar sngon pa zer ro//(〈dze+e phyi ma bzhi thog pa yin/da kho rgyal brgya sto pa dang /ba gzhi gzhon tshul dang /tshul rgyal ba gnyisasnang thar pa yin/chos dbyings pa chos ba po shis ca dga' seng ge chos kyi seng gewo ma dbyangasablo gros/ blo rgyal ba/tshi khrims rnam rgyal/don grub pa rnams kyang rwa ban kho na'o//)de ltar na 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad wo po'i brgyud yig 'di yang 'ga' zhin gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /gcig zhus//ma ṅga le/oṃ swā sti/gang 'dul lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las kyis//mtha' 42

yas 'gro kun thar pa'i lam du 'dren/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje snyan rje tshul 'dzin pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rtsom chen dbus su sna tshogasapad nyi'i steng / khro brjid dpa' bo'i gar gyis dge gur rol/ /sgrub la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /rtsol mdzad 'bor lo'i mgon po'i: /'bar ba'i sku la gzi brjid mtha' yas 'chang / /sna tshogs mtshon che'i rlabs 'phreng 'khrigs pa'i phyag /nad gdon bgegs rnams zhabs kyis 'og tu gnod/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po'i: /lha dgu'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ /'pho med lhan skyes bde chen rtags kyis mtshan/ /'od gsal rnam pa kun ldan dkyil 'khor ra gtso/ /bco pa ldan 'jigs mdzad chen po'i: /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nang phyogs mtshams su/ /srid gsum dregs pa ma lus 'dul byed sku/ /sna tshogs dbyings dang mtshan ma'i dkyila'akhor pa/ /las kun thogs med 'grub pa'i: /ma mo gshin rje srin po 'dul ba'i sku/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms mdzad ro langs brgyad/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing du thogs med rdzu 'phrul 'byed/ /'jigs byed chen po rnams kyi: /rin chen las grub ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /gzhal med khang bzang sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' dag rgyas pa'i zhing / /ye shes dkyil 'khor chen i /sdang dang gdug can ma lus 'dul ba'i zhing / /bran dang pho nya mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi bsten/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas spangs pa'i dngos/ /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad kyi: /lta ngan 'jom byed sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /don dam mkhyen pa'i nyin phyed 'od brgya —143—

'bar//skyon bral 'dab ma 'bum ldan pad ma'i gdan//dkyil 'khor bzhi yi dge legs /mi phyed rdo rje sa gzhi rwa ba gur//bar chad bdud sde g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/rab 'bar me dpung 'phro ba'i gzi 'od can/khrung byed bka' yi 'khotshor lo'i /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun//gcig bsdus 'jam dpal 'khros pa'i dkyil 'khore du//rgya lnga ba'i 'phrin las kun 'dus dam tshig can//chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shisashog/rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang dar ba dang //bar chad bgegs kyi mtshan ma kun zhi nas//mchog dang thun mong ṭa dros grub kun stsol zhing //'gro don phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar pa'i mthus//bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan sham+bha lar//rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas//dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog/ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o//44

lkoX snya sti/ tseX( āXbisnrun ta krita hūX phaṭa kyis bsangs/ tseX( gi bhā was sbyangs/ tseX( āXhūX ha hoXhiXs byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid nga/ gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad oX da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX lkoX da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra phyeXbadz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ oX pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ gtor snod kyi phyogs bcur 'khode/ pad skor gyi mthar rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oX in+t+ra ya hruX ya ma yasgyiX wa ru ṇa wi/ ku be ra ya kṛ/ yī sha na ya ta/ asne ya a/ ni rta ya na/ wa ya we ya na/ pra rmi ṇa ye skyoX/ ba sun+ta ri ṇi ye phaṭa/ sarba dh+wa te smyoX ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/huX huX skyoX/ h+pha h+pha h+pha phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum lnga bdun gang rung ske ji bsngos/ tseX( da sha sogs sbyar ba'i ar+ghaX nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' po gdul dka' 'dul pa po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog /sa'i phyogs 'dir yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang /dpal mgon dam nga/chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod gtor bskang ba phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyis thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga'i bya ba la 'jug par 'tshal na zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ ga po spyi dang 'dra/ ya mun ta ka'am gong bzhin bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las —145—

gnas khang hū las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor 'o/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bhu yongs su gyur pa las/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ oṃ u hu rnams las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil zhes pa nas/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig o badz+ra ar+gha swāhā/ pu sde/ o badz+ra pukhre a hū nas/sha lta'i bar/o badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi nas a khaṃ grwahwa'i bar lan gsum brjod/ bkra shis dge legs 'phel/ gcig zhus/—146—

snying po bzhugs/na mo mañdzu badz+re khyuX bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrubs thabs/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab tu khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po sgrub par 'dod pas/dur khrod la sogs par dbugs bral gyi gdan la 'dug ste/'di skad do/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o//'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la//byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar//rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/khres rab —147—

snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems cad don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /de ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de dag ni mang nyung ji ltar rigs par bya zhing / de rjes rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyis rgyud sbyang ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ huX las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo rang dang mtshungs pas 'khyud pa/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang /ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can du gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oX badz+ra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa rnga ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su to khyo me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po khyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra yasmosarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taX shrī yaX/ ku ru huX ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa ༅/dzir bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa a/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing —148—

nyams/ / bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ / thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas/ skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa'i snying khar pad nyi la hūX nag po mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis/ bla ma mi bskyod pas gtso bo'i dbu rgyan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX na mo gu ru khyuX na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa maṇ+ḍal khyuX gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ / rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis drangs mdzad nas/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pa khror 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra lā su huX/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le traX/ oX badz+ra girti hriX oṃ badz+ra snu ti āX oṃ badz+ra ga pe hūX/oṃ badz+ra pukhre/ traX/ oṃ badz+ra ā 'o( ke hiX oṃ badz+ra ga rnye aX zhes phyag dang bcas pas mchod/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang / tshad med bzhi yang spyi dang mthun par brjod cing sgom/ de nyid byang chub kyi sems dang 'grel ba yang sgom par bshad la/bsdu na rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ma byas kyang chog go/oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā su bhā —149—

wa shu khyo3snya/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/lho ser/nub dmar/byang ljang /lte ba mthing nag la huX gis mtshan pa/de las 'od 'phros/rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla re dang bcas pa/phyi rol rdo rje'i mes gtams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig pa/ phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad khrag zhag 'khru/gas pa/steng keng rus kyi ka gdung gis phub pa/g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang /rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung zhing kyi g.ya' ba brgyad kyis bskor ba ste/de dag tu na ga ge sar la sogs pa shing chen po brgyad dang /brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong brgyad dang / gzhan yang zhing skyong ba brgyad dang / chu dang / me dang / klu dang /sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten rnams kyang brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa ma mo dang /srin po dang /sha za dang /gshin rje dang /ro langs la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing / ha he'i sgra dang / ku co brag cha dang bcas lhang lhang bor 'bod pa/mdung la bskyon pa dang /shing la dpyangs pa dang /mes tshig pa la sogs pa'i ro sna tshogs dang / keng rus dang / ro mgo med gar byed cing / rus pa dang / khrag dang /sha dang / klad pa 'thor ba dang /dum bus khebs pa dang / bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang 'khrug pa dang nga ro 'don pa/ 'byung po rnams kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pas yid bsgyur bar byed pa dang / dpa' bo dang rnal —150—

'byor ma dang sgrub pa po dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dam tshig gis spyod pa dang /'jigs pa med par thod rnga'i sgra dang bcas te gar byed pa dang /grub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dang / mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /gzhal med khang gi dbus su yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha dog can gyi steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/a las zla ba la dhīXlas ral gri dhīXs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gur gum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa ltar dmar ser/ phyag g.yas ral spi 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs khar ut+pal sngon po kha bye ba la gnas pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing mtshan dpe rdzogs pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra'i thor tshugs zur phud lnga dang bcas pas mdzes pa rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las bdun pa'i bdag po la gnas pa'i huX las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang rig ma khro bo la sogs pa spyan drangs/ 'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa de thams cad nyi ma la thim pas tsha zer 'bar ba dpag tshad 'bum du khyab par gyur/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis/ ā li kā li dang /sngags 'phreng rnams spyan drangs te bstims pas/ hūX nag po 'od zer lnga ldan du gyur/ de'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i thugs ye shes chen po phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thim pas/ hūX de nyid rdo rje chen po mthing nag rtse lnga ba rwa gdengs pa 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa —151—

la sogs pa dang / rdo rje phra mo mtha' yas pa spros/ sdang ba dang gdug pa rnams tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ zhing khams dag par byas/ de rnams dang 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med dho sna ṭā ḍā rdo dzhai /'ji /kā ༵rdo ༵ ༵do sna pyi shā tha'i rnyi sna dhi/ dhi kyā ltar ga/sna cing ngam za ba/ zhal dgu'i rtsa zhal mthing nag ma he nag po rab tu khros pa'i gdong / rwa sngo sangs shin tu rno zhing / rdo rje'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar bas phyogs thams cad gnon pa/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal gsum sngon po/dmar po/ser po ste shin tu khros pa/ rwa'i g.yon phyogs gyi zhal gsum dkar po/ dud kha/ nag ༵ / /'a/ga ༵ /ga~Xsna~X rdo/༵ ts+tsha~X sgi sdu sho ḍi / dzhai krā zhes drag tu / bzha 1 / ༵/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gser mdog yid tsam khro zhing 'dzum pa/ zur phud lnga ldan byis pa'i rgyan bzang pos spras pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum pa/spya/ dgra ༵gegs sgre / /nga ༵ sngu spya la ༷ rdo/ /rnam rdzu kau / ༵spra / ༵/bo~X gnyer bsdus pa'i 'gram nas 'bar ba'i smin ma 'khyog por bcus shing /༵ rnyi rdo snro~X ༵ shā /dzī gsum stag lta /'i smi /dzhai gdang /tu sma༈ dang / ba mag spu ༵//'ji/ rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal rnams mche ba rnon ngo/ bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa/ ljags —152—

'grin pa ba/ 'jigs pa chen po dus kyi rlung dang 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i mtsham rngam kyi sgra'i gad rgyangs kyis bdud sde'i snying 'gas pa/ lang tsho la bab pa sku lus che zhing rags pa'i yan lag dang nying lag sbom thung hrags shing 'khrang bag can/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ rab tu rgyas pa'i liṅga gyen du sgreng ba/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis/ 'phang mdung /ga a shing /chu gri/rdo rje rtse gcig pa/sta re/mdung ring /mda'/lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭāX ga 'khor lo/rdo rje rtse lnga pa/tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge'u chung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis/ mgo phub/ rkang pa/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rgyu ma/dril bu/ lag pa/ ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal gyi kha phor bdud rtsis gang ba/sdigs mdzub/ba dan rtse gsum pa/rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras rnams 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags rlon khrag 'dzag pa stod g.yogs su byas pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ gyad chen po'i stobs kyis srid pa gsum bskyod cing 'dar bar byed pas lhag par brjid pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas brgyad kyis/ mi/ ma he/ glang / bong bu/ rnga mong / khyi/ lugawa rnams dang / g.yon brgyad kyis/ bya rgod/'ug pa/ bya rog ne tso/ bong khra/ bya chen po/ ri skeg bzhad rnams gnon pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu/ tshangs pa/ dbang po/ khyab 'jug drag po sde bdud bzhi dang /gzhon nu gdong drug la sogs pa rnams kha bub tu bskyel nas mnan pa/ gcer bu shin tu gtum pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ mi —153—

mgo khrag 'dzag pa brgya phyed rgyu rlon la brgyus pa'i do shal dang / gdug pa'i sprul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / khrag dang zhag dang / thal chen gyis spras pa/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spro ba/ 'jig dus kyi me ltar drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten gsum pos lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūX nag po/ mig tu khyodakar po sa'i snying po/ rna bar dzi sngon po phyag na rdo rje/ sna la khaX ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la gaX dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug dpral bar skaX ljang khu sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar saX dkar po kun tu bzang ngo// spyi bor oX dkar po sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āXdamar po gsung rdo rje/thugs kar hūX sngon po thugs rdo rje rnams su gyur/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer mkha' dbyings thams cad du son pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaXzhes spyan drangs/rma badz+ra pur+sha āXskyoX/de bzhin du/ si pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ni wi rkye/ zhes sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan de ba'i na gshegs ༄pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas//rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi tiñtsa hūX/su ra ta stuX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma thams —154—

cad sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra aṅga sha dzaX oṃ badz+ra pā sha huX/ oṃ badz+ra spro ṭa baX/ oṃ badz+ra lha ṇ+ḍi hoX rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya gnas gsum tu gtugs la/ hiXsgyiXlan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bhe ra wa rū pa badz+ra āXhūX/ de bzhin du/ shag/ ga rnye/ ra sa/ sparnye/ oṃ badz+ra bhe ra wa dharma dha tu badzi āXskyoX/ oṃ badz+ra lwa phye huX/ sogs gong bzhi dang / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ bsnams par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dges pa'i gar gyis rol bar mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol tu gsol/ /hoXchags pa med cing chags pa mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ hūX/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gzhan rje gshed po ni/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ 'byud rgya dang bcas pas bde ba sgom par mos la/ oṃ āXhuX/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes brjod do/ /nang mchod 'dus byas la/ oṃ āXde krita huX phaṭa/ zhes pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX las mi mgo'i skyed bu —155—

gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang du dbus su na las mi'i sha ya yig gis mtshan pa/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha skyes mtshan pa/lhor ku las khyi'i sha mas mtshan pa/nub tu da las rta'i sha mes mtshan pa/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ dbus gyi steng du shu las byang sems hūX gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor bi las dri chen dzas mtshan pa/ lho nub tu mu las dri chu sas mtshan pa/nub byang du maX las klad pa dos mtshan pa/ byang shar du ra las rak+ta rus mtshan pa/rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/rlung g.yos/me sbar/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge bcu dang bcas pa zhu/ spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte bar zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ shar du gti mug gzhan rje gshed/lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed/ nub tu 'dod chags gzhin rje gshed/ byang du phrag dog gzhin rje gshed rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje lam nas yum rnams kyi pad+ma ra babs pas/ yab yum bcu rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas/ rdzas rnams la thim pas/ kha dog dang / dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho sdiXgayon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te lce thog tu bzhag la 'bru gsum brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta snyu da na badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ de nas man ngag ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/sngags bzlas par bya ste/oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ya me do sa ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya spu ya/ ya slo ru ni rā ma ya huX phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ —156—

hiXṣiXbi kri tā na na huX phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oX ya mun+ta ka huX phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de 'od du zhu/ gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim/rang gi zhal phyag rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du zhugs/slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis par 'gyur/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar skyoX/ mig tu snyiX/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaX/ lte la gaX dpral la skaX/ lte bar saX rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ lag len ltar gtor ma bshams la/ nang mchod byin brlabs kyi skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdor bsdu na/ mdun du dkyil snyen ra gyi 'khor lo skad cig tsam gyis gsal btab cing gtor ma phul bas chog la/rgyas pa la spro na/swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar paX las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ maX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dus mtha'i sprin dang / zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid du gyur/ mig tu k+ṣi dkar po/ zhes pa nas/chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ sngags gsum ka'am snying po'i mthar/ sarba birtswan sha chun mā ra ya i dam bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi —157—

huX phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra lā phya huX/ sogs kyis mchod snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod phul/ gzugs la sgra sogs drug po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong rnams ༈ 'bul/gsum pa phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las/ khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/phyogs skyong thams cad bkug par gyur/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ hūX in+d+ra a dī naX sarba duXri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/nub byang du rlung lha/ dbus kyi g.yas su tshangs pa/g.yon du sa'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi 'khor gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/rgyas pa la spro na/ zhal phyag sogs rdzogs par bskyed do/ /slar yang rang gi snying ga nas/ khro bo phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ in+d+ra a dī rna sarba du giX badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ grub pa'i dngul chu'i bcud kyis reg pa na/ khams rnams gser du 'gyur ba ji ltar bar/ /rdo rje phur bus reg pa tsam gyis kyang / /phyogs skyong 'khor bcas gshin rje gshed du gyur/ /thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ma he'i gdong ba can/ gcer bu liṅga gyen du —158—

bsgreng ba/dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/rang rang gi bzhon pa'i steng du g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṇi/ nas/ rgyas btab par gyur/ gyi bar gong ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes pa nas/ chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ in+t+ra ya hiX ya ma ya sgyiX wa ru ṇa ya wi/ ku be ra ya kri/ yī shā na ya ta/asne ye a/ ni ri rkye na/ wa ya we na/ pra rmi ye hūX/ ba sun+ta ra ṇa ye phaṭa/ sarba bhu te lcoXha ha hi hi hūX huX h+pha skṛ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/zhes lan gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa gang rigs kyis phul la/ oX da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra khyuX zhes sbyar la/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ hruXsgyiX'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'phrin las bcol/ gtor ma bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la 'bul te/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /slar yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad la dmigs la/ mchod pa bsdus pa zhig byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs rnams dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang / de'i gtong grogs mdzad cing / bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang / yig ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ra pa —159—

dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ o khyed kyis sems can don kun gru/dzad/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ o badz+ra ste ra wa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra mu o kā la rū pa sa pā ri wā ra ca sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis kyi drigs su bcad pa mang du brjod do/ /ces pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs snying po 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so dgu pa la nye bar sbyar ba'o// //dge legs su gyur cig /(〈dza〉 waṃ mtshan brjod bsdus pa ni/ gshegs snying rigs 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba che/ /rdor dbyings gnas lugs ye shes rnam lnga'i bdag /dgongs yid ro mnyam ngang nas skyabs su bsten/ /glo bur sgrib kun myur nas dag gyur cig /'di 'bum phrag dad mos kyis bton na gnas lugs la rang 'tsham gyi bag chags nyams myong re yod snang bas/ ma tis so/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bla ma dbyer med la/ /gus pas skyabs gsol 'dir bsags rab dkar mthus/ /sham+bha la ru rigs ldan sras gyur te/ /bstan 'gro yongs la rlabs chen phan thogs shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so// //)—160—

brgyad skor gyi cho ga bzhugs/oX snya sti/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas kun/ /gcig bsdus bla ma dam pa la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag bgyi'o/ /gang khyod sku bzhi'i rgyal srid la gnas te/ /yid can mtha' dag gdod ma'i rang rtsal las/ /dbang bzhi'i rgyal thabs bye ba'i rang gnas su/ /mngon par dbang bskur byed pos skyong gyur cig /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid don dam pa'i/ /gtor zhing blugs pa'i nges gsang rin po che/ /thabs mchog byis pa'i 'jug pa dang sbyar bas//skal bzang 'dod 'jo'i ngo mtshar rmad byung spel//'di la sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa'i cho gdangos gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi las rim/ rjes dam tshig gi tshogs pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la/ sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ dkyi' 'khor nyer bsdu'i bya ba rnams so/ /dang po la sa brtag pa sogs spyi dang mthun la/ 'dir ngag 'don dang 'brel ba tsam brjod na/ gtor ma sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ yi ge bcu pa tshar gsum brjod/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gyur/ gtor ma/ya mun+ta kas bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/skye rna āXhuX ha rdo ste hiXs byin gyis brlabs/skye( in+d+ra ya hiX zhes pa nas h+pha h+pha phaṭa —161—

phaṭa sruhwa'i bar/ lan gsum kyis phyogs skyong dang 'byung po spyi la phul/ a kā ro lan gsum mam bdun gyis gzhi bdag sogs la phul nas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khore don du khyed kyis stsole/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyir dor/ yang dkyil 'khor 'dri bar 'gyur ba'i sa gzhir dri bzang gi thig le'am tshom bu bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum brkyang ba sa la reg ste/ tshom bu/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor nas 'thon pa/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX badzi bha wa a bhi ski nyu skyoX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar dang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'khru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi swe de yī ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pu byaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /—162—

pham par byas te dkyil 'a9(ra 'dri/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis gnang ba zhus pas gnang ba byin par mos/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod la/ oṃ pri thi lbi badz+ra mu zhes tshom bu nas gshegs su gsol la/ nam mkha'i khams su bzhugs par mos/ oṃ bhu kha/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/hu la hūṃ/sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan mang du brjod cing yungs kar brdeg de nas slob dpon gyis sa gzhir 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bzlas pa'i bar du sgrub thabs bzhin sgom/ ma sdo/sa phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yis//'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya//sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byo / na 'tshal//dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stso'///ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/de nas mchod pa bshams te byin gyis brlabs/ ar+gha nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon pos dkyil 'khor 'dri bar mdzod/ /ces brjod/ rdo rje stsog tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ hu badz+ra u la zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg rang gi mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yas bskor dang g.yon bskor du bltas pas bgegs rnams bsregs par gyur/rkang mthil hu las rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/ rdo rje'i 'gros bo'i pa ༵gh+ri~X sa/hu/ lus 1 ḍi / ༵ sa ༵ chi sa ༵ ༵ shi/ /༵ gega~X kyi ༵//༵ dhi/ rdo —163—

la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes 'ges par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jigs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /rol mo dang bcas pa'i hiXsgyiXsogs drag tu bzlas la bgegs bskrad do//phur bu bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hūX las byung ba'i khro bo bgegs mthar byed rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ gha gha/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba du giX phaṭa/ gī la ya/ gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX huX huX/ badz+ra gī la/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pā ya ti/sarba du kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ ces dbus su bgegs kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/oX badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ces tho bas brdung /phur bu'i khro bo las 'od zer 'phros te/ bgegs kyi lhag ma thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ ces srung ste nub dang po sa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa la lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro dang / lhag gnas dngos so/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang /sa'i lha mo'i mchod gtor dang /gzhan dpal gtor lnga dang /bum pa'i gtor ma dang /mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang / dri bzang dang tshom bu'i rgyu la sogs pa yo byad thams cad tshang bar byas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ ya mun+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oX āXhuX ha ho hruXs byin gyis brlabs/mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags sam/ tseX( in+d+ra ya sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bskang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa —164—

mtha' dag mnyes par bya ba dang /ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams theg pa mchog gi bde ba la 'jog pa'i don du/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ (〈khyu〉rtse bsgrub cing mchod pa dang /)bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang /slob ma bzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i tshogs rnams kyis bar chad srung ba dang /'phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub cing dngos 'grub kyi stongs grogs dam pa mdzad du gsol/nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung bo'i tshogs rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyir dor/hruXsgyiXdang bgegs mthar byed kyi gzungs bzlas la bgegs bskrad/ yang gnas dang yo byad bsangs sbyangs/ gnas khang stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyi rnam par brgyan pa/ phyi rol bsrung ba'i 'khor los yongs su bskor ba'i nang du/a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oX āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa dbang sgyur ba'i rnam rig gi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang / smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu las grub pa/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams nam mkha'i gtos thams —165—

cad yongs su gang ba/ srid pa ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gha swāhā/ pu du/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye ā hūṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai we rkye/ shasta ā:hū/ oṃ badz+ra snyarnye ra ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis rol mo byin dbab/ bar 'dir zhu 'bul sogs byed na spyi dang 'dra/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la/ sa lha sta gon dang / dkyil 'khor sta gon dang / bum pa sta gon dang / slob ma sta gon te bzhi las/dang po ni/gong du bstan pa'i sa'i lha mo las bslang ba de nyid dang 'dra ba las/sa lha ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i skabs/ nam mkha' nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa zhes 'don pa spo/ mjug tu mchod pa'i mthar/ sa'i lha mo slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la thim/ zhes brjod/ tsho( badzi bha wa hū/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi lha tilga zhes brjod/gnyis pa ni/dkyil 'khor gyis sa gzhi gi bzang gis byugs/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang / gzhan phyag mtshan gyi gnas dang / grwa bzhir zlum po chung ba re bya/ de rnams kyi steng du me tog gi tshom bu re bkod la/mthar ma rdzo gtor gyis bskor/de rnams bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la/ zhes pa nas/ hūṃ hū hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su pa las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhu las 'khor lo bhu gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/de'i steng du pha gu ser po la dra ba dang / dra phyed 'phyang ba steng la mda' yab mchod rten gyi rnam pas mdzes pa/ pu shu'i khor yug la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sgreng ba/—166—

nang gi lha rnam shar dkar/ lto ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres pa/dbus su dkyil 'khor zlum po/de'i nang re'u mig dgur gyur pa'i dbus su/mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig pa/ phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad khrag zhag 'khru/ga pa/ steng keng rus kyi ka gdung gis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang / sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs rnams kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang / gdugs kyis mtshan pa/ 'khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /gzhal med khang gi dbus su/mi ro mgo dang rkang lag bral ba'i steng du/ ya las rlung gi nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hu las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hu gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin/ zhes pa nas/ blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ re'u mig brgyad la/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor ru lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang ba/shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ tan ra gyi lha snam la g.yas su gri gug dang / 'phang mdung dang / gshun shing / g.yon du chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa/lcags kyu rnams so/ /lho'i lha snam la g.yas su dgra sta dang / mda' dang / kha ṭā —167—

ga /g.yon du dbyug to dang / 'khor lo dang / zhags pa rnams so/ /nub kyi lha snam la g.yas su rdo rje dang / rnge'u chung dang / phub/ g.yon du gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung ras rnams so/ /byang gi lha snam la g.yas su sdigs mdzub dang / ba dan rtse gsum pa dang / glang lpags/ g.yon du tho ba dang / mdung dang / me thabs rnams so/ /sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir nyi ma'i gdan la lha yig nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ ro langs nag po gshin rje'i lus can gri gug dang / thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ ka ha ka ha/ ha la ha la zhes ljags brkyangs shing bzhad pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX hruXsgyiXs bgegs bskrad/ dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par bstim/ sa chog byas na/nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha yang skabs 'dir bstim par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX sogs nas/sha lta'i bar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyi mchod pas kyang chog la/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na 'di skad ces sbyar te/'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mi zad a rgyu'i rgyun chen po/ /phyi nang gsang ba rab sbyar ba/ /'bul gyis 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra hai ra —168—

wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/de bzhin du sbyar te/mi zad a rgyu'i rgyun chen po zhes pa'i dod du/rdo rje chu gtsang khrus kyi rgyun/ /zhes dang / ar+gha gyi gnas su/ pu du kho 'dod pa spos/de bzhin du/rdo rje me tog khang par brtsegs/ /oṃ badz+ra ste ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra puṅge ā hū/ rdo rje bdug spos sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ /dhu pe/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang bsal gtams/ /ā lo ke rdo rje gdung sel dri zhim tshogs/ /ga rnye/rdo rje bza' bca' rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /nai wi tre/rdo rje rol mo'i sgra brgya pa/ /sha rte/ badz+ra lha rje ra ṇi ta/ zhes rol chen bya/gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' zag med bde ba'i reg bya dang ldan pa mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blos sbyang phyir 'bul//bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog/oṃ badz+ra ste ra wa: badz+ra wasta ye ā hū/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya swāhā/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling g.yin dag/'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang ste/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /tsakra rat+na pū dzi te ā spru/de bawo du sbyar te/nor bu rin chen/ma ṇi rat+na/btsun mo rin chen/bsti rat+na/khyim bdag rin chen/ mahā ta rat+na/ glang po rin chen/ hasti rat+na/ rta mchog rin chen/ a shwa rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen/ kha sga rat+na/ gzugs mdzes kyis ni rab bkang ste/ /rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te ā hu/sgra snyan/sha p+ta/dri zhim/ga rnye/ro mchogar sa/ reg bde/ sparnye/ chos khams bde bas/ dharma dh+wa tu pū dzi te ā skyo/ rgyal ba —169—

lnga dag thod pa'i cod paṇa dang / /rigs drug rang bzhin rus pa'i phyag rgya drug /byang phyogs rnam dag phyag mtshan tshogs rnams kyis/ /ye shes kun la mchod cing brgyan par bgyi/ /sarba a laṅka ra/ sprul chun tshangs pa chen po'i mchod phyir thogs/ /ā li kā li rnam dag mgo bo'i 'phreng / /gti mug chen po glang chen lpags pa'i gos/ /rdo rje gsum dngos phyag rgyas mnyes gyur cig/tri badz+ra mu dra/dngos grub chen po brgyad dang dbang phyug brgyad/ /nyer spyad gyur las srid zhi gnon phyir dang / /zhe sdang gshin rje bsgral ba'i dam tshig che/ /bcu drug cha rnams dag pas mnyes gyur cig /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis bsas te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas smos te/'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/yig ge bcu pa'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtso bo dang / lan gcig gis re'u mig brgyad na gnas pa'i mtshan ma'i lha dang / rtsa sngags tshar gcig gis lha rnams kyi mtshan ma rnams dang / ya mun+ta ka lan brgyad kyis ro langs brgyad la 'bul/ ya ma rā dza dang / ya mun+ta ka'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas mtshan ma'i lha rnams la yang 'bul/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i zhal du/ oṃ hi tsa muṇ+ḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ dus kyi mtshan mo tsa muṇ+ḍa re zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul shwe(/ /glu( ā spyo/ skye( i rnye ye swāhā/ skye( ā hu/ de bzhin du/ ya ma ya wā dmi ṇa ya/ ku be rā ya/ yī sha nā ya/ asna ye/ ne ri t+ya/ wa ya we/ prad+ma ṇa ya/ 8( bā su dha ri ṇi swāhā/oṃ ā hū/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā hu/ gzhan yang / gnod sbyin srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ spyo byed/ rjod byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong /pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā hu/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam —170—

rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/de nas bstod pa ni/ huX/ mi'u thung sgeg po sprin gyi mdog /'od zer bye ba 'phro ba bzhengs/ /mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal/ /gnyis med spyor ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyings chen po/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ khros shing rab khros cher 'khrugs pa/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed la 'dud/ /yan lag dgu yi chos ston zhal/ /stong nyid bcu drug zhabs kyis rol/ /byang chub phyogs chos so bzhi'i phyag /sgrib bral gcer bu khyod phyag 'tshal/ khams gsum dbang phyug ma he'i zhal/ /bden gnyis rwa yi phyogs kun gnon/ khro chags khrag 'dzag srin po'i zhal/ /rab zhi gzhon nu'i zhal la 'dud/ /'gyur med gzigs phyir byis pa'i brgyan/ /mngon byang zur phud lnga yi thod/ /kun tu dus gsum gzigs pa'i zhal/ /ljags bskyod rdo rje'i ngag la 'dud/ /srid pa gsum 'joms gar gyis rol/ /zhi ba'i mtha' gnon dbus skyes 'bar/ /hūX phaṭa sgra yis ma rungs skrag /gsus 'phyang gtum po'i sku la 'dud/ /thod pa'i cod paṇa ye shes lnga//mgo 'phreng rdo rje yi ge'i dngos//rnam lnga'i rigs kyi phyag rgya can/ /sbrul chun tshangs phyir thogs la 'dud/ /ma rig gcod phyir gri gug ste/ /bi dha pa las rnam rtog gcod/ /dran pa nyams 'joms gas shing 'phyar/ /chu gris srid pa gcod la 'dud/ /sgo gsum nyes sel ka na ya/ /sta ris bag chags sra ba gcod/ /lta ngan 'bigs pa'i mdung rang po/ /mda' chen rmongs —171—

mthar byed la 'dud/ /dbang gi lcags kyu cher 'bar zhing / /dbyug tos las kyi sgrib pa 'joms/ kha ṭā byang chub sems rang bzhin/ /'khor lo shes sgrib gcod la 'dud//ro mnyam ye shes rdo rje gsor//tho bas ser sna phye mar brlag/dngos grub brgyad ster ral gri phyar/ /cang te'u mchog sgra sgrog la 'dud/ khrag chen thod pa'i dam tshig skyong / /sgrib kun bcad pa'i rab byung mgo/bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal phub/ /rkang pa'i mchog gnas stsol la 'dud/ /dngos kun ye shes zhags pas 'ching / /'jig rten gsum rgyal gzhu thabs can/ /stong nyid sor rtog rgyu ma ste/ /shes rab dril bu 'khrol la 'dud/ /'phrin las kun 'grub lag pa gdengs/ /bdag med dur khrod bor ba'i ras/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i gsal shing dang / /'od gsal me thab 'bar la 'dud/ /thod tshal snying brtse bdud rtsis brlan/ /bdud la cher sdigs 'dzub mo bsgreng / /sku gsum ro gcig rtse gsum 'phang / /sgyu 'phrul rlung ras 'phyar la 'dud/ /bde chen ling ga rgyas pa'i tshul/ /gti mug glang chen lpags rlon gyon/ /brkyang bskum gar gyi gar chen pos/ /lha chen bgegs bcas gnon la 'dud/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljags 'dril zhal nas ha ha bzhad/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos grub brgyad po stsol ba dang / /gdon dang nad kun 'joms mdzad cing / /sdang ba thams cad 'dul pa po/ /ro langs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi ge rnams la yang dag byung / /sna tshogs mtshon cha'i dra ba dkrigs/ /mtshan ma'i lha rnams thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba rnam shes brgyad dag pa/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i —172—

skur ston cing / /sgrub la dngos grub kun stsol ba/ /'khor bcas de la'ang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos gzhal med khang / /bka' yi 'khor los bdud bzhi 'joms/ /rnam das rten gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje go 'phang la/ /bde ba'i lam gyis 'god par ye lkog /ces pa'o/ /gtor ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor 'a 'bul te/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hu las byung ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'khru/ba sgo rwag /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa dpal nag po chen po lcam dral sogs ye shes kyis spyan dang ldan pa'i chos skyong rnams la gtor chog ltar phul/ gsum pa phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul ba dang / bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la 'bul ba ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin yin pa las mthar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ zhes pa nas/ tse( khyod kyis sems can/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ tse( dza ya dza ya/ sogs dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam btab/spos dang bcas pas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rigs sngags rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje'i yid kyi dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang / /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs dang / /dngos grub dam pa rtsol bar mdzod/ /ces dang lan gsum/ ar+gha/ la sogs pas mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes sogs dang / dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ —173—

badz+ra sna la zhes dang /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas nam mkhar bteg slar yang mchod bstod snga ma bzhi byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs la bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa dang / nangs par dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa dang / bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa stsol du gsol/hiXsgyiXlan gsum gyis bsrung la byas bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par mtshan ma btab/ snying po lnga sogs bum rdzas rnams bcug de yang lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na legs kyang bsdu na rnam rgyal dang / las bum kyisacho ga bum pa bca' lugs spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/chu 'phyang ba/lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa le ru ṭa ma ṭa/ oṃ ta ste pa ste mahā rta zhe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya huX/ /oṃ kalpa prak+ṣi huX/ zhes pa rnams tshar gsum gsum brjod do/mgul chings dang /chu dang /bum rdzas dang /kha brgyan rnams kyi sngags so//rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa/ zhes pa nas/ blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du lha yongs su gyur pa las/nas/bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/gyi bar lha sta gon bzhin no//las bum gyi nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig —174—

phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong ba can/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i skur gyur/de thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ mig tu k+ṣi/zhes pa nas/ lte bar saX dkar po/ spyi bor oX/ zhes pa nas/ spyi bor 'khyil ba las/gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang / ro langs brgyad la rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ oX badz+ra/ nas/ gaṇ+ḍi ho/ zhes pa'i bar bya/ bar 'dir rtsa sngags dang / nye snying ci rigs dang / hiXsgyiX brgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba/ las bum pa la dmigs nas nye snying brgya rtsa brgyad du bzla'o/ /mjug tu thams cad la thun mong du/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa bzla/ slar yang / ar+ghaX/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ hruXsgyiX'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ gzugs sgra la sogs dang / dur khrod rgyan gyis/ sogs dang / phung po 'byung ba rnam dag cing / /bsdu ba zhi dang bde chen dngos/ /las kun sgrub pa'i lha rnams te/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byore ba/ sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ āXhūX/ zhes dung gi chu phul/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i ye shes pa rnams gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chur gyur/ las thams cad pa'i lha la bar ho bsrung bar gsol ba btab/ las bum gyi chus bum pa la bskor bar bya/ las bum gyi lha mi bzhu bar bzhugs pa don yod rdo rjes bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa la slob dpon gyis/rjes su gnang ba'i 'khor bzhi po/ /rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan/ /theg pa chen po'i blo chen la/ /bde gshegs yang dag cho ga gsungs/ /sngags kyi dngos grub —175—

don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yi/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung / /'jig rten pha rol dor gnyer na/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu 'byung / /de bas 'jig rten 'das sgrub phyir/ khyod kyis brtan pa'i yid bgyis shig /ces brjod la don bshad/ 'dir sngags kyi lam gyi sangs rgyas sgrubs pa la/chos bzhi tshang dgos pa yin te/ go tra ste bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rigs brgyud ma nyams pa dang ldan pa dgos/ spu ṭā ste slob ma rdo rje theg pa'i zhing du byas pa dgos/ shudha ste sngags kyi theg pa la dad pa che ba dgos/ pradz+nyā ste zab mo go ba'i shes rab che ba dgos so/ /zhes go bar byas la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hu gis 'od zer gyis slob ma drangs nas/ khar zhugs shing gsang gnas su gti mug gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis par gyur pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mang po spyan drangs te/ kha nas zhugs shing slob ma la thim par bsam la/ lte ba nas 'thon pa de/ mdun du 'dug nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o//gus pas thal mo sbyar la/ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid dam tshig rim pa dang / /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsole/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum po ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /lan gsum rjes zlos bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i rgyud bzang por bya ba'i phyir/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga —176—

ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam pa med pa brnyes/ khri/kya seng ges sogs mchog gis/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde / /shin tu mi bzad cher bcom nas/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug brtags nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don bshad/ de nas sems bskyed dang sdom pa spyin pa'i rjes zlos bya zhing / dkon ma/chog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor batsha/gas/ /zhes pa nas/sangs rgyas 'grub par lha steg /gi bar du lan gsum brjod/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpang por byas la/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ / byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / zhes pa nas/ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma gro/la ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum bzlas so/ /slob dpon gyi dbang mi bskur na/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa mi sgyin no/ /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg cing / o dkar po/ ā dmar po/ hū sngon po las 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje yi ge gsum dang bcas dmigs la/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas kyis mchod par bya'o/ /so shing sbyin pa ni/ ba byung dri bzang dang bcas pas gru bzhir byugs pa'i steng du/ so shing sor bcu gnyis pa ma gas shing srog chags kyis ma zos pa'i rtse mor me tog dang bcas pa/ hū las byung zhing / lan bdun bzlas pa/ slob ma thal mo sbyar ba'i lag tu spyin zhing / e rna badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na a my-i ta hu phaṭa/ zhes pa bgegs sbyangs la/rtse mos —177

so drud nas kha shar du phyogs pas/ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes brjod cing dor/ rtse mo shar lto nub byang 'og tu bstan na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag mkha' spyod sa 'og gi dngos grub thob par lung bstan to/ /baX las byung zhing / lan bdun bzlas pa'i dri chu/ oX sdiXbi shudha dharma sarba pā paX ni stsa phya lha( dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa na ya huX/ zhes bzlas pa'i khyor chu byin la lan gsum mthung du gzhug go /de nas/ hūX las ku sha che chung gnyis huX/ lan bdun bzlas te stan dang sngas kyi dod du/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇaX/zhes bzlas shing sbyin par bya'o/ / bsrung skud dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum sgril la/ hūX las byung ba'i mdud pa gsum ldan/ hiXsgyiXlan bdun bzlas pa dpung par bcing la/ oṃ bzhi mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba na swāhā/zhes brjod do//chos spund pa ni/'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung ngam yang na 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma sa /sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur legs na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /gong 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod pa mchog 'ji dwa /blo gros shin du mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg —178—

pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni 'gro bas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing don spyod do/ /rmi lam brtag cing ༅ na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smros/ /zhes gdams la rmi lam bzang pan gyi khyad par cung zad bshad do/ /de nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo / /'di la snyan gsan dbab pa yan chad sngon la byas te/ de rjes bum pa dang slob ma'i sta gon byas/ mchod bstod nam mkhar 'degs pa rnams skabs 'dir byas kyang rung bas gang bde bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ni/nangs par snga bar langs nas/tshon sna lnga'i steng du srad bu kha dog sna lnga bzhag gtor ma dang mchod pa cha tshang bshams/thig tshon sna lnga gral sgrigs su bshams kyang rung /dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod kyang rung ste/bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ thig tsho ni sngon po'i gnas su/ ya las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog sngon po/ dkar po'i gnas su spu las gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po/ thig tshon ser po'i gnas su ma las ser sna gzhin rje gshed sku mdog ser po/ thig tshon dmar po'i gnas su me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/thig tshon ljang khu'i gnas su da las phrag dog gshin rje gshed sku mdog ljang khu/thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong ba can/gcer bu ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing / dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par ā thugs gar spyo/rang gi snying ga nas —179—

'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX pukhre sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ a bhi khri thu skom maX/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa gong gzhin bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho sdiXl na gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXbadz+ra lha ka huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXdzi na dzika huX phaṭa/ oX āXrat+na dhika huX phaṭa/ oṃ āX.a ro le ka huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXpradz+nyā lha ka hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags tshan lnga re re bzhin/ a kwa ro/ btags pas gtor ma phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog pa'i mchog /zhe sdang rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje: /thugs kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i:khyab bdag chags pa chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal//phrag dog rdo rje'i:/gdin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ sngags tshan lnga po de dag bdun nam nyer cig tsam gang rmes bzla/ khro bo rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ oṃ di bhaṇ+ḍa tho aX ku sha dzaXdzaX nam —180—

mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi thig skud dang rdul tshon byung ba thig tshon dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/thig skud brkyangs shing sgrim ste/ oṃ ā rgyo n+ya a nut+pa ta sarba dharma pa ra spa ra a nu pra bi gisarba dharma a dun+ta a nu pra bidhi kyisarba dharma/ skyo/ zhes bzla/ hū ཾ zhes slob ma la gtad la/ tse( badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra ma ti kra ma skyo/ zhes brjod bzhin du dang por nam mkha' dang / de nas sa la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du thig chen brgyad gdab ste/ g.yas bskor du byed pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes su las thig kyang zhib mor gdab par bya ste/ rtsa thig nang du lha rnams cha chen gcig bzhag la/ de nang zlum thig rim pa gsum/nang le tshe dgu dang bcas pa gdab/rta babs sgo tshad gsum pa dang /gcig pa ji ltar bde bar bya ste/ me ri'i phyi rol tu dur khrod 'dri ba'am rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du bris kyang rung bas/ de'i thig kyang gdab par bya'o/ /de nas rdul tshon rnams hi hi zhes pa dang / rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas cher sbar la/ oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hū/ zhes rdul tshon mnye bar bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ tse( badz+ra be ga a kra ma ho / / zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs pa la/ hi hi zhes sgo'i rtsa thig phyi/ chos dbyings ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /sems can khams rnams rab sgrol byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gnas pa'o(/ /zhes brjod de dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa na 'dri/ tshon 'gyed pa rdzogs nas/ thig tshon gyi lhag ma la mchod bstod bsdus pa re byas nas/ oṃ ā hū mu zhes ye shes pa gshe/gas/ dza hu ba hoyis dam tshig pa rang la thim/lhag chad kyi nyes pa spang ba'i don du/dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje gsor zhing yig brgya mang du bzla/ bum pa 'bul tshul spyi dang mthun no/ / bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/mchod pa dang sa rgyan gnam brgyan sogs tshang bar bshams/'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang 'dzom par byas la/chog la 'jug ste/sngon 'gro gtor ma/gnas yo byin —181—

brlabs/ zhu 'bul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ nang mchod byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas/tshogs zhing nas brtsams bzlas pa'i mthar/ rang gi thugs kar bsdu/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed mngon rtogs rdzogs par sgom/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las chos 'byung gru gsum/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dam tshig pa bskyed pa lha sta gon gyi skabasadang 'dra/ gtso 'kho(ra thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣ-i/ zhes pa nas/ phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ gyi bar yang bum bskyed kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha' nas sta gon gyi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bske/ra ba tso'o badz+ra sa mā dzaX khyiXsgyiXlan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bsgrad/ slar yang khyiXsgyiXlan gsum gyis gur gyi sgo phye la nang du spyan drangs/ yang gsum gyis mtshams bcing ba'o tsoṭībadz+ra lwa su hūṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ tsho( ku sha sogs kyis/ dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bstim/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa'i don du sngags gsum ci rigs pa dang / yig brgya lan dgu bzla'o/ /de nas slar yang mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa byed pa nas brtsams/gtor chog rdzogs kyi bar sta gon dang 'dra/ phyi rol gtor ma gtor bar spro na/ lag len ni spyi dang mthun la/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas par bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las/ zhes pa nas/ bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣ-i/ nas 'phrin bcol gyi bar phyogs skyong gi gtor chog sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs kyi bkra shis dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/—182—

sogs smon lam btab/ tse( hru bi shu khyu sdo/ sogs kyis mchod yon 'gro phyogs su sgrengs/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol/ gshe/gas gsol rnams byas la gtor ma bzhi mdo sogs su bskyal/ rtsa sngags dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis mtsham/sa bcad nang du 'jug go /'di la dkyil chog rnying par bshad cing deng sang phal cher lag len la byed pa ltar/ drug cu rtsa bzhi nang gtor gyi lugs bzhin du byed pa yang spyir mi legs pa ma yin yang phyi rol gtor ma la 'di tsam gyis chog cing / nang gi gtor ma'i skabs/ phyogs skyong gi gtor chos grun mong ma yin pa de yang byed dgos pas/ lag len phra mo 'di'i rigs kyang ma 'khrugs par bya'o/ /bar 'dir 'grub na/ sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor los dkyil 'khor mchod pa yang gal che'o/ /lnga rnga/ ni/ phyi rol gtor ma'i rjes thogs nyid la/ sgo dbye ba dang me tog 'bul ba byas nas dbang len pa'ang yod la mtha' gcig tu bcos pa'ang ma yin pas ci bder bya'o/ /de yang 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul 'a /ro langs ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes sogs nas/ skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsole// /ga sdo/na rje sgro le ba'i grong khyer du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ ā kha lī ra hū/ga rdong g.yogs bcing la/ u dum wa ra maṇ+ḍa ra/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang ma li ka /ka ni ka yi 'phreng ba 'di/ /legs par mnos la bus bzung zhig /ces me tog bzung / e( ya mun+ta ka hu phaṭa/ kyis bum chus bsangs/ tse( ā skyo/ gis bdud rtsi myangs/ bu tshu1da sdo/ yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /des bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes dri lan bya/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gnas par gyur/ o sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pā da yā mi/—183—

snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra te sa ma ya stuX ho sirnyi badz+ra yā tha su khaX/ rdo rje spyi bor gtugs la/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /nga yis rdo rje ye shes byin/ /de yis sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di ni ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smra na nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan gsang bar byos/ /shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam/oṃ na maXte huX/na mo mi hūX/ na mo na ma huX/ zhes gnas gsum du thal mo sbyar ro/ /glu( badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be ro/ ya huX/ zhes pas sgo phye/rgyas par spro na phyogs bzhi nas phyag lnga 'tshal ba'ang bya'o//de nas/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun par bya/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyeng pa/ra bru /tī/khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar me ba ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ /snying gar gtugs te/gshin rje gshed dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhug par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ /yang spyi bor bzhag la/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems bar 'gyur ro/ /dung gi chu'am/rnam rgyar bum pa'i chu nas cung zad 'thung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dgru/ tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /'thung zhig rdo rje bdud rtse'i chu/ / oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta ud ka ṭhaXṭhaXṭhaX yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas bzung sde bu khyong kyi/ /gshin rje gshed po nga yin gyis/ /nga yis ji lngar bka' stsal pa/—184—

khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la brnyas par min/ /de bzhin mos par ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal gshin rje gshed bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum/chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa'o/ /rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i rkang 'og tu ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su me rlung gi rang bzhin yi ge dzhai ljang khu/ sum mdor ra las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ snying khar la las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mgrin par ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ mgo bor ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam nag po ha yig 5 /sa mtshan pa/ snying ga'i dbus su 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog gser btso ma lta bur ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bzhugs par gyur/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis/ ba dan bskyod/ dzhai bskul te me 'od 'bar ba/sum mdo'i me dang 'dres/snying ga'i sa bsregs/mgrin pa'i chu bskol zhing lud pa snying ga'i sa la thim/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus thams cad gang / lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/rang gi ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs te thim/hru snri 'i mthar/ a bhe sha ya/ sta bhā ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya —185—

tsa la ya huX āXha dzhaiXzhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te ye shes phab/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/gyis brtan par byas/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gshin rje gshed po'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil snyen ra 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin ye|ga /ces gsol ba btab/ oṃ pra tismo badz+ra ho/ zhes me tog dor/ pra ti gro hā stuX i maX satwa mahā ba la/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ/ dpral bar raX/snying khar hūX/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu mahā maṇ+ḍal pra bhe sha ya phaṭa/ces gdong g.yogs bkrol/he badz+ra pā shu/zhes pas blta bar bskul/ dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ ji ltar rdo rje chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /ces lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du/ rin po che'i khri dang / pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas gnas par gyur/ hruXsgyiX lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ dkyil 'khor ra gyis gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang —186—

gi lha bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza ar+ghaṃ nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis shis pa brjod cing mchod par byas/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ tsartsi ka la sogs pa yum bzhi po rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba thogs te/yal 'dab kyis bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun blangs te/ dbang bskur tshul du mdzad/ mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs rkya dang bcas/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin du shis pa brjod par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /des nas deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /deng bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams mi mthun pa'i phyogs —187—

thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas/shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ya man+ta ka bzla bzhin las bum gyi chus dbang rdzas dang / slob ma rnams la bsangs gtor bya/ chu dbang gi don du/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka hūX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/yum mā ma gī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying gar dhīXlas 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ mut+pa ra dzaX sogs/ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btang pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi tiñtsa skyoX/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams la rang gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes so/ /dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi —188—

khiñtsa ha stoX/ su ra ta stuX/ a haX/ zhes gsung bzhin du bdag nyid la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ chu'i dbang la phyi nang gnyis yod pa las phyi'i dbang ngo / /dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung /bdag nyid zhal du bcug /thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong pa can phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/gcer bu ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing /dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūX/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas babs te/ bdag nyid la dbang bskur zhing gnyis su med par thim/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/phyi rol tu rang gi stan la 'khod/ de ni nang dbang ngo //pur+sha nas/ni wi rkye'i bar gyis mchod/de ltar na chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon nus pa mthu can du gyur/ zhe sdang gzhin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /de kho nas rig pa'i dbang ga ska rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ de la cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i —189—
