dbu brgyan gnyis ka e las rin po che a gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ zhes dang / yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ zhes dang / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ zhes dang / zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du/ zhes dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi cod pan dbang / / rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab sgrub phyir/ /cod pan mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ /oṃ la ma pa ta hu/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi tiñtsa skyo/ zhes dang /rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ zhes dang / dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed: /deng bdag: /yon tan rdo rjer: /zhes dang / yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ser sna gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po/zhes dang /de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon dus byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon nus pa mthu can du gyur/ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /rdo rje'i dbang la/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka dzi las pad+ma dzi gis: 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang / yum gos dkar mo dmar mo: 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer:rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /chu / ༵/'od sdo ༵sna ༵ rdo rmi rdo/bu/ ༵ sna/ ༵ tshos hūṃ ga ༵nga nywa snro / mi /dro a ri ldan /bhi/ —190—

mi phyed: / deng bdag5 /gsung gi rdo rjer: /me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod chags gnyen rje gshed sku mdog dmar po: de ltar na/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'od dpag med kyi 'dod chags lten rje gshed kyi/ zhes 'don pa spo/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaX las ral gri khaX gis: don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ ral gri dang /yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bu/chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrog pa/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i/ /dril bu'i dbang ni bla na med/ /tseXrtso sarba ta thā ga ta shasta pa da lbā dharma dh+wa tu a bhi lta dzi ñtsa spruX/dpal ldan 'phrin las rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed: /deng bdag: /'phrin las rdo rjer: /mkhar babs pa/ da las ral gri das mtshan pa yongs phrag dog gshin rje gshed sku mdog ljang khu: de ltar na dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po: bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes don yod grub pa'i2 phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas:zhes 'don pa spo/ming gi dbang ni/bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu/ bhuX las 'khor lo bhuX gyis mtshan pa yongs su: rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang : yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo: rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ /oX badz+ra satwa stuX a bhi khri khwa ni khruX/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kyai dpal 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gde/gas —191—

pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /mi phyed /deng bdag: /sku yi rdo rjer: /yum gyi mkhar babs pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po/de ltar na ming gi dbang thob/gti mug dgagazugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon nus pa mthu (〈dzaX〉 can ) du gyur/gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu: yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo: thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo/ lag pa dang snying gar gtad pas/rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhugs par gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi skyoX/ de ltar na brtul bzhugs kyi dbang bskur ba thos pas/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i rang bzhin dang / phung po lnga'i chos nyid dang / rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga mtha' dag don dam mnyam nyid chen po gcig gi ngo bor mngon du byas so/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ kye ho khyod kyi 'phrin las ni/ /bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ dkyil 'khe/ra gyi shar phyogs su khrus kyi —192—

khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i dbus su khrus stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par gyur/steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par yongs su bskor bar gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang nyid zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar skyo/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas babs te/ bdag nyid la dbang bskur zhing gnyis su med par thim/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/phyi rol tu rang gi stan la 'khod/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo/'di ste sangs rgyas thams can kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /ces lag tu gtad par bsam/ de nyid lan gsum du gsol zhing snying gar gtad/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i gtso/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hu/ a las byung ba'i dril bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ khres rab dbyings —193—

kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /lan gsum gyis dkrol te/ kha nang du phyogs pas dku g.yon pa bsten/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis sred 'gal byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog/srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur//oṃ badz+ra lha rnye ā shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje dril bu rab sgrub phyir/ /bu yi yang dag gus par bzung / /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje bzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya che/ /byin gyis brlabs la snying po bzla/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'chang cher por gsal ba'i pang du/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus yang dag par 'khyud pa/ thugs rgyud bde bas yongs su khyab par gyur/rdo rje che dang dril bu che//zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyi longs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod pa gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su brjod/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes dam tshig gsum bzung / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /slobadz+ra u da ka sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar na/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus kyi —194—

nang thams cad gang / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ pukhye sogs kyisamachod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye snya hā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas/ de nyid gsum brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas ma yin pa gnyis de kho na nyid du mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dag pa ni/shar gyi sgo dang /yang dag spong ba bzhi dag pa ni lho'i dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dag pa ni nub kyi dang /dad pa la sogs par dbang po lnga dag pa ni byang gi sgo'o//rdo rje lta bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba'i phyir rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'o/ /'jigs tshogs la lta ba'i ri rtse mo mthon po nyi shu 'joms pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu'o//rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par dag pa ni/zur bzhi dang logs bzhi'o//lha rnams ni phung po lnga dang / 'byung ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid dang /dngos grub brgyad dang /yon tan brgyad dang /dbang phyug brgyad dang /lam yan lag brgyad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid rnams dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi'i bdag nyid do/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / bsrung ba dang / phyir bzlog dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / slob ma gzhug pa dang / rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni slob dpon gyi las bya ba'i rim pa yin no/ /gzhan yang gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gsung rab yan lag dgu rnam par dag pa'i zhal/byang chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'i phyag /stong pa nyid bcu —195—

drug dag pa'i zhabs/ zhe sdang rnam par dag pa khro bo'i sku/ gti mug rnam par dag pa ma he'i zhal/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa liṅga rgyas/ nga rgyal rnam par dag pa lha rnams zhabs kyis mnan pa/ phrag dog rnam par dag pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /mtha' rten rnams las dang por rjes gnang gi rim pa rnams ni lugs ma'am/tsa ka li la sogs pa'i sku gzugs sam me tog spyi bor bzhag la/nyin re bzhin yang thun bzhi sa /'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang / / ldan pas mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub 'dod phyir yid ma sgrubs/ /sku'i rjes gnang ngo //dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung / zhal nas 'thon/rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying gar huX gi mthar 'khod par gyur/ sngags gsum po lan gsum gsum bzla/ bcom ldan bdag la stsa44 lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ 'phreng ba'am/ me tog spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gri gug che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi gri gug dam pa ni/ /rmongs pa'i mgo bo bcad phyir bzung / /zhes gri gug bzung /dngos dang dngos med rnams rtog gi /mgo bo'i pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /thod pa bzung ste thugs kyis rjes gnang ngo / /rdo rje thod dbyug dbyug pa'i sgras/ /bdud rnams gshin rje 'dar zhing bskyel/ khams gsum ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /dpa' bo'i mtshan ma 'di bzung zhig /dbyug pa bzung ste/ gshin rje dam la 'dogs pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /sdug pa'i gdong du bltas na ni/ /bltas par 'gyur ba'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas kun la phul na —196—

ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi byin 'gyur/ /bud med kun gyis yongs bskor te/ /kun nas brtse ba'i bde ba de//sangs rgyas kun/skad cig:/dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams byed pa gang yin de/ /sangs rgyas: /skad cig: /lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya/ /de phyir gshin rdze 'joms pa yi/ /brtul zhugs rnam pa kun tu spyod/ /phal cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni/ /brtul zhugs med na mi 'grub pas//gzhan rje 'dzoms pa'i brtul zhugs ni//legs spyod mchog gi dngos grub sgrubs/ /brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang ngo //pra las byung ba'i mig thur gyis ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal bar gyur/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal bo yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hi tra/ mig thur gyi rjes gnang ngo / /a chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med//rgyu dang las las yang dag byung //rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /'dir ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /me long gi rjes gnang ngo / /o badz+ra he tu mu/ o badz+ra bha ṣa ra/o badz+ra lha rnye ā o badz+ra dharmā sdi rnams kyis/ 'khor lo/dung /dril bu/po ti rnams gtad par mos/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos —197—

kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su gang bar gyis/ /chos spyod pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de rka du/rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /sprul spyod gyi rjes gnang ngo / /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par bgyi/ /dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ngo / /sna tshogs rdo rje sbyin par mos la/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar byed/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab bskor bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dbang gi las ni yang dag brtsams/ /bsad pa'i sems kyis drag po ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /las bsnya rjesaganang ngo / khaX las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi rang bzhin du gyur/sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung oṃ badz+ra khas hūṃ/ ral gri'i rjes gnang ngo / /hoXlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ mda' ga tshure rjes gnang ngo / /bsgral bar bya ba'i yul lnga ni/ /'khrul 'khor dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sman gyis kyang ni bya ba ste//de ltar thabs rnams sna tshogs kyis//bsad bskrad dbye mnan rengs rmugs dang / /tshar gcod rjes gzung las mdzod cig /drag pho rjes gnang ngo / /de nas lung bsnya ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /skyon rje gshed po de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las —198—

bton/ /kyai dpal rnye mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su snur bhu wa su/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'ji/ la dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni/'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de//de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o//oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hu phaṭa/ / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par bsngags/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / khyed la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /gzengs bstod pa ni/ de ring khyod bdag legs par brnyed/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/gsang sngags mnyam med sems las byung / /sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong ba yi ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /byang chub sems mchog rmad byung brnyed/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rjer da gyur to/ /de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil —199—

'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsole// /'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bcing / yang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod gtor la bsrung / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ dga' ba'i sgras/sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/rdo rje'i lam nas byung pa'i byang chub kyi sems lce thog tu bzhag btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub phyir/ /bu khyod de ltar shes kyis kye/ /yid la byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig hrīXsgyiX'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod myang / ā ho mahā su khaX/ byang chub kyi sems kyis lus gang / rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i rnam par rtog pa nub ste/ yang dag pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yog phye/de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /sngags bzlas pa dang rlung sgom pa la dbang / longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs so/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍa 'a/ phul la/ gong bzhin gsol ba btab/ gdong g.yogs bcing / 'khru gsum gyis bsrung /bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed chen por gyur pa la/ rig ma rdo rje ro langs mar byin gyis brlabs te gtad/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bstan byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam —200sgro

pa myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral mi bya'o/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad gyi/ /rigs pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /des kyang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa gsal bar byas te/ rang byung nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gal te cho ga bstan na ni/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad mar ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañdza mok+ṣa ho/ yab kyi gsang gnas hu las rdo rje sngon po hu gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkhar ā las pad+ma dmar po ze'u 'bru la a gis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog gi dga' ba bzhi mngon du gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs phye/rnal 'byor pa yis byang chub sems/ /ji srid 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal 'gyur bas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' khams rdo rje'i kun spyod dang / /reg bcas kyi ni rmad byung che/ /dga' ba skyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa'o/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brtan par gyis/ /pad ma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yi/ /lte bas mnan pa'i gnas dag tu//rdo rje skyil krung dag gis sems//nor bu'i nang du gnas lta bas//ye shes —201—

skye ba gang yin te/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes bya ste/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla gcig zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang / chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa'i don tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong bzhin gsol ba btab/de ltar yang / byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ / nam mkha' dang ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po'o / / /zhes gsung ste/chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa/ gdod nas grub pa'i zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ so sor rang gis rig par byas pa ni/ bzhi pa don dam pa'i dbang ngo / /brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi sgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid mi shes na/ /de kho na nyid sgom pa min/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes na/ /de ni sgom par rab tu bsgrags/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab sgom pa la dbang / ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams —202—

cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ gtang rang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don nam ma yin yang rung ste/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /mi bskyod rdo rje deng bdag sgrubs/ / dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog / dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyis rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyis ni bdag sgrub mdzod/ khren tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag sgrub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog khres rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yi mgon bdag la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung / /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal —203—

bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs/ bden stobs brjod do/ /drug pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ cho ga phal cher bdag 'jug gi skabs dang 'don pa spos pas chog la/ lag len phal cher ni mthong bas shes par 'gyur zhing / sngags rnams la yang bces na par gyis/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ mngon rtogs bzhin lha ngo ston dgos pa las/ gzhal yas khang dang lha rnams kyi bskyed chog rnams dor la/ rnam par rgyas par zugad do/ /de bzhin du/ slob ma'i dbang gi gsol btab song ma thag gi bgegs bskrad la cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang /drag pos sbyang ba rnams spyi dang mthun par byed/de rjes til gyis sbyang ba dang /las bum gyi chus dri ma sbyang ba sogs kyang byed/ lag len bsdus pa la/ ྅/sa ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan gshin rje gshed/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba ste/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'bar ba yis/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyu/ra/ /zhes pa'i mthar drag rol bya zhing yungs dkar gtor bas bgegs bskrad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ zhes pa phal cher/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka zhes 'don pa spo/ dbang bzhi pa la mig dar bcing bkrol byed pa phyis kyi lag len tsam yin mod kyang ji ltar bde bar bya'o/ /bdun pa dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bya ba la/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel ma byed pa sogs kyis nyi ma snga ma carnams la mchod bstod gsol gdab/ bzod gsol/ mchod mgron 'ga' zhig gshegs su gsol ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang rten la brtan bzhugs bya ba dang / smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol dang 'brel ba'i nyer bsdu la ni/dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bor te/rdul tshon chu bor —204—

spyan 'dren pa'i cho ga rnams bsnan dgos so/ /de yang mchod pa bshams shing /rnying pa rnams kha gso/ byin rlabs bsdus pa gong bzhin bya/ ar+gha nas/ shabha'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang /dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ dbang phyug dam pa phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba thams cad byang chub la yang dag par gzhug pa dang / sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can zhi bas mi 'dul ba rnams/ drag po'i 'phrin las/ kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin rnam par dkar ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/sems can thams cad kyi bdud dang nyon mongs rtsa ba dang dri mar bcas pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gzhom par mdzad du gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang theg pa bde ba dang / lam bde ba dang / 'jug pa bde bas thob pa mdzad du gsol/ ji srid go 'phang mchog de nyid ma thob pa'i bar du yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa —205—

la sogs pas gsol ba yang nas yang du gdab par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod pa mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun gtso bos bzod mdzod rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs/ mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa'am/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsa'/ lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang stso'i// /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas ba/zhegs badz+ra mu /zhes gtor mgron nam ye shes pa gshegs/ a kā ro / re sngags bzla zhing / chos nyid kyi don bsam zhing / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs/ smon lam dang / bkra shis kyi mtha' rten no/ /rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa dang / phur bu dbyung ba dang / khung bu 'gengs pa sogs spyi dang mthun no//'dir smras pa/zab yangs rnams pa (〈rjo〉 chos rnams ) kun gyi de bzhin nyid//tha snyad spros pa'i yul las 'das mod kyang //cho ga'i spyor ba brda' thabs sna tshogs kyis//rang bzhin lhan skyes mtshon 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin 'gyur med la/ /mtha' yas 'gro 'di rtag tu gnas mod kyang / /ji srid tshogs gnyis spyor bas ma sbyangs pa/ /de srid mngon du 'gyur ba med 'di ci/ /de lta mod kyi sangs rgyas ye shes ni/ /gdod nas rnam dag yon tan kun ldan pa/ /dbang bzhi'i rgyud kyis dri ma rab sbyangs te/ /'phrin las 'od brgya phyogs mthar 'phro gyur cig /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rwa ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa dang mthun pa —206—

ni/don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so dgu nye ba la/ nags rgyal gyi dben nas dpal jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o//dge legs 'phel/gcig zhug/ (〈khyu〉'di bzhengs dge bas rgyal bstan phyogs mthar rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan sbyin bdag nyer 'tshe zhi/ /bdag gzhan 'gro kun ngan 'gro'i 'jigs dang bral/ /'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dus kyi 'khor lo bla ma dbyer med la/ /gus pas skyabs gsol 'dir bsags rab dkar mthus/ /sham+bha la ru rigs ldan sras gyur te/ /bstan 'gro yongs la rlabs chen phan thogs shog /ces pa'ang ma tis so/ /bsod nams bsags dges bdag sogs 'gro/ /'di phyi kun tu yang dag gi /chos mthun kho nas legs 'tsho zhing / /rkyen ngan gang gis bsgyur med sgo(ga /ces pa'ang ma tis so/ /bkra shis/)—207—

cho ga 'don pa bsgyur lugs yang dag pa'o /oṃ snyu sti/ na mo gu ra we/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sngar bshad zin pa las/ lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor la 'don pa spo ba'i tshul ni/ sa chog gi skabs/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom zhes pa la/ bcu gsum ma nyid kyi sgrub thabs kyi gzhung srong ba yin/ slob mas gsol btab kyi skabs/ dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs bstod pa'i rjes la/dbang chog rgan po dri med chu rgyun na/ gsang 'dus nas bshad pa'i phyogs bzhi gsol 'debs go rim dkrugs pa'i tshul gyis yod kyang / lag len du shar la sogs pa phyogs bzhi nas rim pas/gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /skyon rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ khyab bdag chags pa chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod/ thams cad kyi thun mong du/ sangs —208—

rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /zhes sogs sbrel lo/ /lus ngag sems la sogs kyi skabs/ dkyus bzhin song ba'i rjes la/ nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rin chen 'dzin/ pad+ma 'dzin/ ral gri 'dzin/ sogs 'don pa spo/ phur gdab skabs ni/ dkyil chog rgan po na ral gri gshin rje gshed bskyed kyang / dkyus nyid legs pas the tshom mi bya'o/ /sta gon gyi skabs sa lha yan chad 'dra/ lha sta gon gyi skabs/ thig chen brgyad skam thig tu btab na'ang rung / gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi che ba cig bya/ lha bcu gnyis gzhan rnams kyi gnas su de las nyis 'gyur gyi chung ba'i zlum po re byed/ lha snam gyi phyag mtshan nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / ro langs bzhi dang / thod pa bzhi'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le chung ngu re bkod nas/ de rnams kyi steng du tshom bu yang che chung de ka'i rim pa bya/ gzhan shoms 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hū las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi re mig tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ rkang pa gsum gar byed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hū las rdo rje rtse dgu pa hū gis myo/tshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/slar 'dus shing thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das da pal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin zhes pa nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hu nag po 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i sku la 'phyud pa'i nas/ mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /re mig brgyad la/ shar du spu las 'khor lo smyes mtshan pa nas/ byang shar du go ri bskyed —209—

pa'i skabs kyi pad+ma 'dzin pa zhes pa'i rjes la/ sgo bzhir sgo skyong bzhi rnams 'khod pa ni/ shar phyogs su ya las tho pa nas/ bzhi po rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ces sogs nas/ bde ba'i lam gyi 'god par sgo(ga /ces pa'i bar du 'dra ba las/ nang mchod kyi skabs/ gtso bo'i rjes su/ rma badz+ra be+e ta li hū phaṭa/ o ā hū/ oṃ dzi ni dzika hu phaṭa/ o ā hu/ de bzhin du/ rat+na lha ka a ro lika pradz+nyā lha ka mo ha ra tī/ dī ṣa ra ti/rā ga ra tī/ badz+ra ra tī/ mud ga ra lha ka daṇ+ḍa lha ka pad+ma lha ka kha dha lha ka ces pa rnams la'ang sbyar/ re mig gi mtshan ma lhag ma la 'bul ba man chad 'dra/ gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor pa/ gnyis pa chos skyong ye shes pa ji ltar 'os pa/ gsum pa phyogs skyong / bzhi pa phyogs skyong chos kyi rgyal po rnams la 'bul ba yin/ de dag las smon lam gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs snying po dang /dkyil chog tu bshad pa bzhin no/ /de nas hri sgyi lan gsum gyis srung ba'i bar/ snyan gsan phab cing / dkyil 'bor nam mkhar 'degs pa'i bar yang 'dra'o/ /bum pa sta gon gyi skabs/ spyir bcu gsum ma ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim pa rgyas shos yin pas/ bum pa yang cung zad rgyas pa tsam 'grub na legs mod kyi/ lag tu longs pa dka' bas/ bum pa gnyis la bsdu na/ lta krar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ shar du skye las 'khor lo nas/khrag gis gang ba bzhi po rnams kyang 'khorwa da nga/ra gyur/ gyi bar mngal dkyil gyi skabs bzhin/ las bum la bgegs mthar byed kyis kyang legs la/ lha dang grangs mnyam gyi bum pa yod na/ byang sgo'i bum pas las bum gyi go chod par 'dod kyang lag len dkyil chog bzhin byed pa las/gtso bo phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can bgegs mthar byed kyi ngo bo yin pas/ lko ā bisnrun+ta krita hu phaṭa swāhā/ gtso bor bzla bzhin nye snying yang bzla ni bzla'o/ /'khor gyi bstod thung la/ yan —210—

lag bcu gnyis rab 'gags shing / /sa ni bcu gnyis dag pa'i dngos/ /bde gshegs yab yum 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces spos pa tsam yin/ gzhan khyad par med do/ /thig tshod byin rlabs kyi skabs su/ ya las zhe sdang gzhan rje gshed nag po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dkar po'i gnas su/ khyo las gti mug gshin rje gshed/ dkar po dkar nag dmar ba sogs/ ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed/ ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal sogs/ me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po/ dmar nag dkar ba'i sogs/ da las phrag dog gzhan rje gshed ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i sogs/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa/ stag spags dang / mgo phreng dang /rus pa dang /sprul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogasaspel/mi 'dra ba'i khyad par de tsam yin/dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs/gtso bo'i gnas su/mi ro'i steng du pad nyi la ral gri 'bri/ 'di nges can yin/ cal col gyi kha la ma rgyug cig re mig brgyad la mi mgo sogs kyi steng du/shar du zla ba la 'khor lo/ lhor nyi ma la nor bu/nub tu nyi ma 'od bral te dmar po la pad dmar/ byang du rlung dkyil te nag po zla gam la rgya gram 'bri/ mtshams bzhir zla gdan rim pas 'khor lo/ rdo rje pad+ma sku tul bris kyang legs/ yang gri gug kho na bris kyang rung ngo //sgo bzhir nyi gdan la tho ba dang /be con dang / pad dmar dang / ral gri'o/ /phyi'i grwa ba'i ra ro langs —21/—

kyi gzugs bzhi'am/ tshon spungs nag po re byas kyang rung tsam yin/ de rnams kyi mdun nam rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir zla gdan la thod pa 'bri/gzhan lha snam gyi phyag mtshan sogs la khyad par med do/ /dbus kyi gzhi gru chod khrag mtsho 'di la zlum skor rim pa gnyis yod pas/ zlum skor phyi ma la thod skam gyi 'phreng ba/ nang ma la gdung zlum bya/ re mig gi nang la khrag mtsho'i ri mo byed mkhan yod kyang mi legs/ des na gzhi nag por byed na gdung sngon po dang / gzhi sngon por byed na gdung nag por bya'o/ /dkyil chog rgan po nas dngos gzhi'i thog mar slar yang bum pa sgrub par 'dod/dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul la bdag mdun tha dad dang / mdun bskyed sgrub tshul dkyus ma zhig byed par 'dugaphyis 'ga' zhig dgra nag gi dkyil mchog dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dgongs par byas te/bdag mdun tha mi dad kho nar mdzad do//'on kyang 'di ltar bya ste/sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams/'khor bcu gnyis po dang yum yang rang nyid la thim/ zhes pa'i bar du bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bsrangs te bsgom/ skabs 'dir bdag bskyed kho na yin/ de nas spro na bgegs sbyang ba dang /sdig pa sbyong ba dang /khrus gsol rnams bya/bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hu las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/zhes pa nas/rkang pa gsum gar byed pa'o//dbus kyi gdan pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hū las byung ba'i ral gri hu gis mtshan pa 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'bar ba'o/ /nye snying dang / snying po dang / rtsa sngags lan bdun bdun brjod/shar du slo las 'khor lo skyes mtshan pa/ oṃ dzi na dzika hu phaṭa/ ltor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa/ oṃ rat+na lha ka hu phaṭa/ nub tu me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa/ oṃ a ro lika hū phaṭa/ byang du da las rgya gram da yig ā+o ཾ ༵ rnyi ༈dho hu//kau sbyi pyi sdu ༵ rdo/ rje dī yis ༵ dhi kau/ dhi rnyi/ sti ༵ / —212—

du do las pad+ma dos mtshan pa/ rā ga ra ti/ byang shar du ru las ut+pal rus mtshan pa/ badz+ra ra ti/ yang na byang du ral gri/ mtshams bzhir gri gug go khar sgor ya las tho ba yas mtshan pa/ mu dha ra dhika lho sgor tsa las dbyug pa tsas mtshan pa/daṇ+ḍa lha ka nub sgor me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa/ pad+ma lha ka byang sgor ra las ral gri ras mtshan pa/ oX kha dha lha ka hūX phaṭa/ lan gsum/ grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra las byung ba'i thod khrag bzhi/ ṇa yo ni ras mtshan pa/ oṃ āXhūX/ lan bcu gnyis/ de nas nye snying lan gsum dang / sdiXsgyiXlan gsum dang / rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis mtshan ma gzhan rnams byin gyis bsas/de nyid la ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sogs kyis bstod do//mtshan ma spyi la dmigs nas/snying po dang /rdor sems kyi yig brgya yang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor mdun bskyed 'ba' zhig gi tshul du sgrub pa'o//de nas sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal dgu/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug rgyan dang mtshon cha thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzi 'od 'bar ba can/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang / yon tan 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba nyid mdun gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus kyi gdan la bzhugs/ dbus kyi lha'i mtshan ma dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ oṃ a sa me/ tri sa me/ mahā sa ma ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ rang gi pang du rang rigs kyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gnas pa las/de nyid mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/oṃ shā n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las baX las gri gug baX gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro mo'i dbang phyug rdo rje ro langs ma'i skur gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas —213—

mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje nas/ srog dag pa'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ gzhal med khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa'i nang du/ lha so so'i gdan gyi gnas la thig le bcu bdun du gyur/ de rnams lha so so'i sa bon du gyur/ ces pa nas/ bzhi po rnams kyang 'a rgod par gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhi/ oṃ sdiXsgyiXnas/dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang nyid kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas zhugs te gnyis su med par thim/bde stong gnyis su med pa sku gsum nas/ shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang gnyis su med par 'dres ste 'khod par gyur/ de bzhin du thams cad la sbyar te/ lho'i re mig tu pad nyi'i gdan la/ mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang gnyis su med par 'dres te 'khod par gyur nas/ byang sgor pad nyi la/ mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang gnyis su med par 'dres te 'khod par gyur gyis bar brjod/ oṃ āXhūṃ/ lan bzhi nas/ gdan re re la thod pa bzhi'i phyag rgya dang dbyer med du 'dres te 'khod par gyur/mkha' nang gi gzhal med khang dur khrod srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spros/bcom ldan 'das nas/sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad/snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma ma lus pa sbyangs/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / bdud bzhi dbyings su dag par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi rang snang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang /dur khrod srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la gnyis su med par thim pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ 'dir gzhal yas khang dang /dur khrod dang /srung 'khor la dag spyor gyi spras spros mang po mi dgos so/ /lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣ-i las nas/don yod grub —214—

pas dbu brgyan gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sogs/ sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren pa man chad/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul phyi rol gtor ma rnams la'ang mi 'dra ba med mod/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin gter mdzod na/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes spyan 'dren skabs/ tshigs bcad la/ drag po'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral ba'i phyir/ /zhes 'don te/shin tu skabs su ma bab bo/ zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs na/ye shes pa la spyan 'dren tshigs bcad dang /mchod 'phreng sogs yod kyang /de ni rang dang mdun te sku'i rngar pa gnyis bsgoms pas/ mi legs pa min la/ rgyun gyi nyams len dang mchog sgrub sogs gang byung thams cad du drag po'i las zhes pa kho na 'don pa yang 'brel med do/ /des na 'di pa'i lugs kyi bdag bskyed la/ tshigs bcad de 'dra ye mi dgos/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs dang /khyad par sta gon spyan 'dren la/ de ltar byed na'ang mi 'gal lo/ /'di ltar 'don par bya ste/ hū/'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /srin po'i gzugs su sku sprul pa//gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i khro rgyal gshe/gas su gsol/ /tshur byon tshur byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol//rnam pa kun ldan khro bo'i sku/ /bskal pa sreg pa'i 'khor ra lo che/ /bdud sde'i dkyil ga bor kun 'joms pa/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad gshegs su gsol/ /ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrug /rdo rje mtshon cha'i bu yug 'khrug /pho nya drag gtum glog ltar 'khyug /drag shul mi bzad gshe/gas su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /mkha' dbyings gang ba'i lha mos mchod/ /rgyal sras kun gyi zhabs 'bring bcas/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug 'dir gshegs gsol/ /ces —215—

rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gyer na rung /bzhugs gsol gyi skabs kyang /sho lo ka dang po gnyis dang tha ma la bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur na legs par 'ong / dkyil chog rnying pa 'ga' re na 'di 'dra'i rigs bris shing / la lar da lta lag len yang byed kyin 'dug pas/ skabs re byas kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ nges pa dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /bstod pa'i skabs/ 'khor gyi bstod pa bsdu na sgrub thabs bzhin byas kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par na/ 'khore lo'i dbang phyug rnal 'byore ma/ /rgyal ba thams cad skyed mdzad yum/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad ma/ /rdo rje ro langs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zla ba nya 'dra'i gzi brjid can/ /stong pa'i chos las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /gti mug rgya mtsho skems mdzad pa//rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'bar ba gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje dbang bskur 'phongs pa sel/ /phra ma rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /gtso bo rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /nyi ma stong dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /sems can 'dod chags gnas la 'jog /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brtson 'grus chen po pha rol gnon/ /ljang sngon 'od zer bye ba 'gyed/ /sna tshogs las kyi rnam par 'phrul/ /phrag dog rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i byams pa yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir tsa muṇ+ḍi/ khrag chen btung bas kun tu dgyes/ /gti mug dga' ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug dgyes byed yum/ /gshin rje 'joms ma drag mo'i sku/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i rigs//zhe sdang dga' ma la phyag 'tshal/ /srid gsum gnas kyi ngag tshig rnams/ /lha mo khyod kyi mthu las byung //dga' zhing rjes su yi rang tshul//'dod chags dga' ma la phyag 'tshal/ /btang snyoms nyon mongs med rang bzhin/ /zhu ba dgug pa ye —216—

shes che/ /go rī bsam mi khyab pa'i mthu/ /rdo rje dga' ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gshed byed byad ma kun 'joms pa/ /mtha' dag 'gugs pa'i las la brtson/ /yon tan rnam par rgyas pa yi/ /rdo rje tho ba phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhan gyis mi thub stobs po che//lha dang lha min skrag par mdzad//lta ba ngan pa'i mu stegs 'joms//rdo rje dbyug pa phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji srid 'khor bar rtag gnas kyang / /nyon mongs dri mas ma gos par/ /thabs kyis 'gro kun 'dul pa po/ /rdo rje chu skyes phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bye ba stong gi bgegs rnams kyang / /gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas byer/ /bde chen bdud rtsi stsol ba po/ /rdo rje ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal//sna tshogs mchod pa'i khyad par las/ /rgyal ba thams cad rab mnyes byed//bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus 'joms/ /thod pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod//mtshan ma rnam pa sna tshogs ni/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs kyi gtso/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes gzhal med khang pa ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /shin tu rnam dag dbang bsgyur ba'i//de nyid rang bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod//mi shes mun 'joms nyi ma'i gdan/ /nyes pas ma gos pad+ma rgyas/ /bdud bzhi 'joms byed srung ba yi/ /'khor lor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar//'khor bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dur khrod gnas pa thams cad la'ang //gus pa'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /da lta nyid du thob par shog /ces pas bstod par bya'o/ /bdag 'jug gi thog ma'i gsol 'debs la/ e —217—

ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /e ma ho khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa/ /ro langs ma yis mgrin 'byud pa'i/ /zhes lhag por snon/dkyil chog rgan po na/ phyi 'jug gi skabs 'dir go rim mi gcig pa 'ga' re yod na'ang / legs pa kho nar yang mi snang bas/ lha dgu'i dkyil mchog sngar sbyar ba bzhin du bya'o/ /mi legs pa ji lta bu snyam na/ dri ba dri lan gyis snod brtags nas sems bskyed de/ de'i rjes su de nyid gsang ba gdams dgos pa las/ gsang gdams sems bskyed dri lan zhes rim pa go zlog pa ni/ shin tu mi legs pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes dbab pa'i skabs/ rang skad cig gis 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i rkang 'og tu zhes 'don pa spo/ rig pa'i dbang lnga las chu dbang gi nang dbang skabs/ ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las/ zhe sdang skyon rje gshed/ sku mdog mthing nag nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra ser gyen du brjes pa/ stag lpags dang / rus pa dang / mgo 'phreng dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar lko sogs dang sbrel/ de bzhin du cod pan la/ ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ser sna gzhan rje gshed ser go ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang —218—

pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i nas/ bzhugs pa ce'i bar snga ma bzhin/rdo rje'i dbang gi skabs/ me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod chags gshi/na rje gshe/da dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis 'dra/ g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang nor bu (〈j-i〉 rtse 'dzin pa/) khro bo'i nas/ bzhugs pa sna ( /dril bu'i dbang gi skabs/ da las ral gri das mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ phrag dog gshi/na rje ba/ned ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i: lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi ral gri dang 'khe(ra 'e rna g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan 'dra/ ming dbang gi skabs su/ snye las 'kho(ra 'e1 snyes mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po/dkar nag dmar ba'i: g.yas gnyis kyis 'kho ra lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad ma (〈dze+e〉 rtse 'dzin pa/) khro bo'i nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /lha'i de nyid brjod pa'i skabs/ lha rnams ni/ phung po lnga dang / 'byung ba bzhi dang / nyon mongs pa bzhi rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi rang bzhin no/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang sogs sbrel/ de tsam ma gtogs cho ga lhag ma rnams la khyad par med do/ /de bzhin du slob ma la dbang bskur ba la yang khyad par med de/ dkyil chog rgan po nas bshad pa'i spros pa zar zur mang po de rnams nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ci ste spros pa la dga' bas byed na/so so'i thad du ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas 'grub mod kyi/ spros pa la las ni/ chu gtsang la rnyog ma/ blang ba'i dpe dang ma/chungs pa'ang 'byung nyen yod do/ /de bas na dbang chog rgan po dri med snang bar grags pa dang / sgrub krabs yid bzhin gter mdzod 'di dag rtsa ba rwa dkon mchog seng ges mdzad rigs su gda' na/3nga / de —219—

la'ang phyis spros pa'i lhad mang po dang bcos byed mkhan byung bar mngon te/ dpe du ma bsags na tshig sna ring thung yang sna tshogs snang ngo / /sgrub dkyil de gnyis rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i gsung ma yin pa la yin par 'khrul bas/yi ge de gnyis rang ches nyog pa'i steng du/lhan thabs 'dzag 'dzog du ma bsnan pa'i rang bzo la gzhan la med pa'i khyad bcos dang / zab khyad yin no snyam ma go bo sbos pa yang bag re snang ba snying re rje/'dir ni rwa 'bum seng gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rwa lugs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur cho ga rnams la yang mkhas par bya dgos so/ /zhes pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i cho ga'i khyad par phye ba 'di yang / don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //bkra shis/ zhus dag /—220—

gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od zer zhes bya ba bsdo / gas//oṃ spru sti/na mo badz+ra ā tsa sde ya/ gang zhig mtha' gnyis la gnas gshin rje'i tshogs//gnyis med ye shes stobs kyis rab brjes pas/ /lhan skyes ye shes mchog gi rgyal thabs mkhan/ /bla ma gzhin rje gshed po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin bcu gsum 'khor lo'i bdag /rim gnyis lam gyis dri ma sbyangs pa las/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i gnas mchog thob pa'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bdag gis bshad par 'dod/ /grub pa rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis/ /bshad gang tshig don rtogs dka' bas//'dir 'bad go bla'i phyir 'bab zhig/gzhan du rnyed sogs 'dod pas min/ /'dir bris sku bkram zhing / mchod gtor lag len bzhin bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rol mo'i sgra dang cas te/rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la/ rang skad cig gis sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gyur/oṃ nga ni nga hūX/ gro hā gro hā huX/gro hā pā ya/ gro hā pā ya hūX/ a na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ liṅgā rā dza hūX phaṭa/ hiXsgyiX yi ge bcu bzhi pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces btags/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i khros bos bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur/ pho nya rnamasarang la thim/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya cas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes brjod do/ /rang gi snying ga'i ya yig las/ lha mo bzhi spros/ bla ma ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i gshin rje gshed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/—221—

mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ lha mo bzhi rang la thim/ mchod pa mchod byed mchod yul rnams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dben pa'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa sprul/ phyag dang bskor ba byas par bsam oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ca naX ka ro mi/ hiXsgyiX sh+ka gcig brjod/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa sprul/ mchod rdzas rnams/ hruXsgyiXs bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha hūX nas/ shasta'i bar gyi sngags dang / phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaX/ sarba dharmā nan/ ā byi nu yin tu ta/stong nyid kyi don bsgom/gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'bul/ /zhabasarnams nye bar bsil bar mdzod/ /hiXṣiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pra wa ra sa t+pa ra pra tismo swāhā/ de bzhi du/zhabs bsil gnas su/'thor thung 'di/ sku dang phyag ni bsil bar mdzod/ /khyoXgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri te huX khaX/ de bzhi du/ zhal bsil 'di/ zhal rnams nye bar bsil bar mdzod/ /hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i pad+ma 'di/ /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyan(la 'bus/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma kā ma ye stuX/lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dmar pa'i bdug spos 'di/ /bla ma rdzogs: /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oXbadz+ra ga pe huX/ chudang thang lasaskyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/༄/bla ma rdzogs: /'gro ba'i don du /badz+ra pur+sha traX/ 'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa'i/ /snang gsal 'di/bla ma rdzogs: /'gro ba'i don: /badz+ra ā lo ke dhīX lhan cig skyes dang sbyar byung ba'i/ /dri mchog 'di/ badz+ra ga rnye a/ 'byung ba tshe las rgyur byas pa'i/ /zhal —222—

zas 'di/ badz+ra ni we te/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs//rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong sgra/ /bla ma sogs/ badz+ra shasta ā hū/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang go /reg bya dag ni 'dod yon lnga/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /rin chen ri dang dpag bsam shing / /bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bkang nas/ /blam sogs/ lko sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa the ste skye ha/ lha mo rnams snying ga'i ya yig la thim/ bsdus pa la mos pas mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams ma brjod kyang rung ngo / /de nas sdig sgrib sbyangs shing nyams chags bskang ba'i don du rdo rje sems dpa' yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub tu bzlas/ thal mo sbyar zhing don dran bzhin pas/ lus ngag yid kyis sdig bgyis dang / /bgyid du brtsal dang yi rang dang / /sgyu ma sgyu ma la sogs bzhin/ /thugs rje can rnams mdun du bsha/gas/ /sngon byas ma lus bshags nas ni/ /phyin chad de la mi 'jug cing / /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /mi dge kun las ldog par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas de sras 'phags rnams dang / /srid pa mthar phyin dam pa'i chos/ /skyabs kyi dam pa de gsum la/ /de nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rnam rtog rgya yis rab bcings shing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa kun/ /bsgral phyir bde gshegs nyid thob pa/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed jo/ /bde gshe/gas sras bcas 'phags skye bo/ /kun gyi dge ba kun bsdus la/ /sel med rab tu yi rang zhing / /legs so zhes kyang bsngags nga/ra bgyi/ /dus sum bde gshe/gas sras bcas kun/ /gshe/gas shing gshe/gas dang gshe/gas 'gyu/ra ba'i/ /spyin sogs lam gyi rang bzhin gang / /ci yod stobs kyis yang dag rten/ /yon tan rgya mtsho —223—

ldan rnams la/ /bdag nyid bdag gis 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /so sor nang 'khor spyod du bzhes/ /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas bar du/ /de srid mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub shing la gzigs rnams la/ /theg chen bdud rtsi rab bshad par//'gro ba'i yab tu gyur rnams la//snyen ra lo bskor bar gsol bar 'tshal/ /lus ngag yid kyi dge ba gang / /bgyis pa ma lus kun bsdus nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi bde chen nyid/ /thob pa'i rjes su mthun gyur cig /badz+ra muX/yid kyis dran pas gshegs su gsol/bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khor bar lhung ba'i sems can rnams snying re rje/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa dang /chos rnams stong pa nyid yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa snying re rje/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don rtogs par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i don bsgom ste/ oX hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa rka3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam shes kyi rang bzhin/ gzhi dang 'bras bu'i sgo gsum gyi ngo bo/oX dkar po/ āXdamar po/ huX sngon po rnams/ hoXdamar skya gnyis kyi nang du chud pa nam mkhar gnas/ de las a chad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'kho 3 / huX chad pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang / lte ba mthing ga la huX gis mtshan pa/ huX las rdo rje dang 'od zer phyogs bcur spros pas/ /rwa ba gur me ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ o so/ /skabs 'dir dur khrod bskyed na'ang rung ngo / /de nas gur gyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan/ saX las rdo rje saX dang bcas par gyur/ de las kun tu bzang po rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang dang mtshungs par gyur/ 'bru lnga —224—

gnyis nga zhig chad de/ kun bzang gi zhal du zhugs/ snyoms 'jug rjes chags kyis 'od tu zhu ba las/ chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum rtse mo 'thur du phyogs pa/ 'phel kha gyen du phyogs pa'o/ /de'i dbus su dur khrod r+ṣa po brgyad kyi bskor ba'i nang du/ pa chad pa las sna tshogs pad+ma/ ge sar gyi kha ljang khu las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar bhu las 'khor lo ser po bhu gyis mtshan pa las/ gti mug gzhin rje gshed yab yum du gyur/ 'khru lnga las rang 'dra ba'i yi ge chad/zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyis 'od du zhu ba las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i steng du mchod pa'i lha modang bcas pa/ rtsig pa'i steng du gser gyi ske rags la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bā ku li'i 'phreng ba dang / steng du kra ma shirnya'i pu shus bskor pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i mdun du ka rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rta babs bzhi dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor dang / ri dwags dang gdugs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ 'dod snam gyi phyi rol pha gu ser po rtsig pa) lcags chung gis bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo bas gzhi la lha'i gdan sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ phyi nang gnyis rdo rje'i thog phub dang bcas pa ste pad+ma'i dbyibs can gyi re mig dgu pa'o/ /phyi nang thams —225—

cad dwangs shing 'od gsal ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ dbus kyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba dang / nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang / sgo bzhin nyi ma'i gdan/ shar gyi rwa dbus ma'i steng du/ phyi nang grwa bzhin zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /'dir kha cig thod pa bzhi la pad+ma'i gdan dang / dbus su ma he dngagashin rje'i gdan yang bzhed do/ /'on kyang dbus su skabs 'dir nyi gdan bskyed pa de mngon byang lnga pa'i tshe zla gdan du bsgyur/ 'bras bu'i skabs nyi ma gshin rje ma he dang bcas par bsgyur pa zhang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de dag ni rten bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i yig 'bru lnga las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar zhugs/ mtshan bzang po rnams kyi nus pa spyan drangs te/ gtso bo'i gdan la 'khod/ a ā/ i zhi/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e mai/ tse( au/ a a phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ā li phrag gnyis kyis mtshan pa/slar yang 'bru lnga las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba rnga sgra'i rgyal po'i thugs ka nas/ dpe byad bzang po'i nus pa rnams spyan drangs/ sngar gyi zla ba'i steng du 'khod/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa lha phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba kā li phrag gnyis kyis mtshan par gyur/ de gnyis kyi dbus su/ ra dmar po dang bcas pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be dha ka ro ni/ ra las 'od 'phros/zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa zhu zhing 'dres pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so//oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta u pa dā ya mi/ de lta bu'i nyi zla 'dres pa la hu dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ hu las sna tshogs rdo —226—

rje'i lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa/ byab grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ badz+ra at+pa ko3haX/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas rang snang gi rig ma la 'byud pa/ rol ba'i khro bo chen po rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lhan skyes bde bas rgyud gang ba/ zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta tha a haX/ de dag ni dang po'i rnal 'byor ro/ /thugs ka'i huX gi 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa/ lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ thugasaka'i 'od kyis rigs drug gi sems can thams cad bkug ste mkha' nang gi dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang thams cad bskur bar gyur/ rigs drug gi sgrib pa dag ste/ skye mched drug byang chub sems dpa' drug tu gyur pa rnams/ k+ṣi dzi khaX gaX kaX saX/mkha' nang nas phyir spros te rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/nam mkhar gnas pa'i yig 'bru lnga rnams skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos/ yab yum lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ 'od zer gyi thig le mtshams bzhir spros te/ dza sa do ru rnams su gyur/ de —227—

rnams las gri gug bzhi/dza sa do rus mtshan pa/de rnams tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhir gyur te/ kyai/ rje btsun thugs rjes khros bzhengs la/ /gnas gsum kun gyi gti mug spongs//gtso bo bdud rnams kun las rgyal//rje btsun khros pa'i thugs kyis bzhengs/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong gnas ci/ /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams bzhengs/ /kyai/ khyod ni stong dmigs ci ste bzhugs/ /'jig rten byang chub rang bzhin mgron/ /ces bskul te lha mo bzhi yang thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid ya las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yas mawo par gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje gshin rje gshed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na pad+ma dmar po/phyag mdun ma gnyis kyi gri gug dang /thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje phag mo rang dang 'dra ba la 'byud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas nyi ma'i gdan la/ ma he nag po dregs shing 'bros pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ gzhin rje pho mo phan tshun mgo bo dang rkang pa bsnol thabs su mnan zhing brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal rnams dang bcas pa/ rus rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ klu mtha' —228—

yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung rgyan/ dung skyong ser po phyag gdub/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul rgyan/stobs kyi rgyu ljang khus do shal/ nor rgyas bu dkar dmar gyi ske rags/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /nag po chos dbyings mi 'gyur ba/ /zhal gsum nyi zla sgra gcan dag /dus gsum khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan/ /skye shi gcod mdzad mche ba gtsigs/ /thugs rje 'dren mdzad skra ser 'khyil/ /thod skam rigs lnga rnam dag pa/ /phyin drug phyag drug rim pa bzhin/ /mi phyed pa dang nyon mongs gcod/ /chos 'khor skyon gyis ma gos dang / /sdig pa gcod dang bde ba skyong / /gti mug glang lpags sems byung gi /mgo 'phreng khams drug dag pa'i rgyan/ /ma rig ma he gzung 'dzin gyi/ /gshin rje khyo shug zhabs kyis mnan/ /thabs shes zung 'jug yum dang sbyor/ /tshogs brgyad dag pa'i sbrul rgyan dang / /bsam pa rdzogs byed rin chen rgyan/ /me dpung ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /skabs 'dir zhang lugs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig seng ge'i pags pas stod g.yog dang / dga' bo sngon pos skra bcings/pu tsu sha dang /nor rgyas kyi ske rags zhes bzhed cing /sbrul gyi mgul gyon mi mdzad do//de bzhi du yum rang snang tsam dang / rdo rje ro langs ma rnam pa yab dang 'dra bar mdzad pa yang yod do//'di dag kyang lugs tha dad cing man ngag dang ldan pa'i phyir mi rung ba ma yin no//de nas/ oX dharma dha tu swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ spyo bya'o//de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro//yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ las byung ba'i nor bus mtshan pa/ bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las paX tsho —229—

las byung ba'i pad+ma ā las byung ba'i ze'u 'khrus mtshan pa/ rtsa sbubs gaX gyis bkag pa/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhel du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ yab yum lha rmas par zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems yum gyi mkhar babs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ thig le de nyid cha bcu bdun du gyur/ de rnams ya nya ma me da ya tsa ni ra dza sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra rnams su gyur/ de dag kyang phyag mtshan bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas par gyur/ phyag mtshan rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ sdiXsgyiX gos/ mkha' nang gi zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus/ bdag nyid la thim pas mthu stobs dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzika swāhā/ gti mug rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus/ shar gyi rwa la 'khod pa ni/ sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/oṃ rat+na lha ka swāhā/ ser sna rdo rje/ nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam nyid ye shes la bkod/ lho'i rwa la 'khod pa ni/sku mdog ser po/ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gnyisan rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/o.a ro lika swāhā/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ zhe sdang / sor rtog ye shes la bkod/ nub kyi rwa la 'khod pa ni/ dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis —230—

g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ oX pradz+nyā dhika swāhā/ phrag dog rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog sbyangs/ bya sgrub ye shes la bkod/ byang gi rwa la 'khode pa ni/ sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/oX ri ra dhika swāhā/ rdo rje tho ba/ ma dad pa/ dad pa'i stobs/ shar sgor/ sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i/tho ba dang ral gri/rin po che dang pad+ma/oX daṇ+ḍa dha ka swāhā/rdo rje be con/ le lo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ lto sgor/ dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i/ be con dang ral gri/ 'khor lo pad+ma/ lkoX pad+ma lha ka swāhā/ blo pad+ma bto/na rje'i dgra/ brjed ngas/ dran pa'i/ nub sgor/ dmar po sogs gong 'dod chags rdo rje dang 'dra/ oṃ khat+pa dhika swāhā/ ral gri gzhin rje'i dgra/rdo rje ral gri/ rnam g.yengs dang shes 'chal/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gyi/ byang sgor/ ljang khu phrag dog rdo rje dang 'dra/ oX mo hā rā tī swāhā/ tsartsi ka brnabs sems/ byams pa tshad med/ tshematshams kyi grwar/dkar mo sogs/gti mug rdo rje dang 'dra/lkoX dī ṣa rā tī swāhā/ phag mo/rnam par 'tshe ba sbyangs snying rje la/ bden bral du/ sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ oṃ ra ga rā tī swāhā/ dbyangs can ma/mi dga' ba/ dga' ba tshad med/ rlung mtshams su/ dmar mo sogs/'dod chags rdo rje dang 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra rā tī swāhā/ mdzode ldan ma/ gnod sems la sogs pa/ btang snyoms/dbang ldan gyi grwar/ljang khu sogs/phrag dog rdo rje dang 'dra/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin —231—

pa ste/ khro bo brgyad rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'byud cing / lha mo bzhi rang snang gi thabs dang sbyor ba'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / skya ser gyen du 'khyil zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ lha mo rnams bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyi 'gying zhing / nu 'bur rgyas pa/zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ khro bo rnams sma ra dang smin ma 'bar zhing / nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ kun kyang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa'o/ /grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs su/ tsartsi ka skems shing khros pa/ zla gdan zla 'od/ phag mo dang go ri sbom thung / phag mo phag zhal can/ dbyangs can ma chags pa'i nyams can du bshad cing / bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad rol pa'i khro bo khro mor bzhed/ spyir gtso 'khor thams cad cher khros pa yin la/ nang tshan du ltos pa'i rigs dang mthun pa'i nyams 'gyur byar rung zhing / bsnyen pa'i skabs su/ rol ba'i khro bor byas na/bar chad mi ldang zhing / bkra shis pa'i don yin zhes gsung ngo //yang gong bzhin sbyar te/ skye( āXhūX/lan bzhi/ thod pa bzhi/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chong/ khams rnams kyi dri ma sbyangs/pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ de dag ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ram shin tu rnal 'byor ro//dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi rig tu k+ṇi dang 'khor lo las/ sa'i snying po gti mug rdo rje dang 'dra ba la/ rna bar dzi dang rdo rje las/ phyag na rdo rje zhe sdang rdo rje dang 'dra ba/snar khaX dang rin po che las/ nam mkha'i snying po ser sna rdo rje dang 'dra ba/ lcer gaX dang pad+ma las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'dod chags rdo rje dang 'dra ba/ skra mtshams su skaX dang ral gri las/ sgrib pa rnam sel phrag dog rdo rje dang 'dra ba/—232—

brang zer saX dang rdo rje las/ kun tu bzang po rgyu rdo rje 'a4 dang 'dra ba/ 'on kyang thams cad zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhi drag phyed ma'i nyams dang / rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /'di'i kun tu bzang po dpal 'dzin gyis lte ba bkod par pond pa spyi dang mthun no/ /thugs kar hūX las thugs rdo rje/zhe sdang rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar rdo rje la huX nag po/ mgrin par āXlas gsung rdo rje 'dod chags rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar pad+ma la āXdamar po/ dpral par oX las sku rdo rje gti mug rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo la oX dkar po/ de rnams las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su mnyes shing 'gugs par byed pa'i lha mod pag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la thim/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa bo te/haX/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta lha ka badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa the ke3haX/ skye( sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3ny-i / gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ya/ de las lha mo bzhi dang mchod pa'i lha mod pag tu med pa sprul/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod cing / bdag la dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mornams kyi gtso mo tsartsi ka la sogs pa bzhis/ bkra shis glu dbyangs dang rol mor cas bzhi pas/ oX badzir bha wa ā bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes gsung bzhin bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid —233—

kyis dbu brgyan pa'i rig bdag rnams cung zad zhi ba/ zla ba la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /slar yang snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i thugs kar thim/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra dpag tu med pa te sprul/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu gsum gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX ye shes pa rnams rdo rje'i gur gyi steng du bzhugs shing / lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsam yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis sgo ba bzhi bskul/ rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros/ rdo rje gur gyi sgo phye/ ye shes pa rnams khyams kyi steng du spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams bskrad de/ gur gyi sgo bcings par gyur/ sprul pa rnams snying gar thim/ hruXsgyiX ni gcig brjod/ thugs ka nas mchod rdzas thog pa'i lha mornams sprul/ hiXsnriX lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod pa rnams bsangs shing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di//ye shes 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul//zhabs rnams nye bar bsil bar mdzod//hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pra wa ra sa t+ta ra pra titsā swāhā/ dri zhim rnams dang ldan pa yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di//ye shes:/phyag rnams:/hiXsgyiX'i mthar/oṃ badz+ra ni ri te hūX khaX/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil bde/ /ye shes: /zhal rnams: /ar+ghaX/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ kha dog dbyibs legs pad+ma 'di/ /ye shes: /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma kā ma ye stuX/ tshigs cad 'di rnams ma brjod kyang rung ngo / /lha mo rnams thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ sgo ba bzhi'i thugs kar phog—234—

thugs rgyud bskul te/dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyi las mdzad par bsam oṃ mut+pa ra dzaX oṃ daṇ+ḍa nyu/ oṃ pad+ma hūṃ/ oṃ khat+pa ho/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems mchod pa'i lha snang gyur pa rnams yum gyi ba sbu'i bu ga nas spre/sa/ mchod pa rnams gong tshogs zhing gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ tshigs bcad rnams bor bas 'grub bo/ /kye kye gshin rje gshed nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /bdag gis khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /bdag po yis ni gar mdzad pas/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og g.yo/ /nag po khro bo nyid kyis 'jigs//gar mdzad khyod ni 'jigs pa che//nag po mi thung gshin rje'i dgra/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can mas zhus pa/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /dhīXmyiX'i gsang sngags gar byed khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'brul ba spongs//rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo khyod//gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3snya/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod//gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs//ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag/mi 'jigs sangs rgyas khyod la 'dud/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod myas rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gtso bo'i 'dod shas chosa'abyung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /'a las kya rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang je zhin sku/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab —235—

mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ lha mo rnams snying gar thim/ nang mchod hiXsgyiX'i bsangs/ ā ka ros sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs ba lta bu/ mchog ma la ba dan dang / chang zung la yaX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du/ mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang du/ dbus su ya las byang sems/ shar du spu las dri chen/ lto ru ma las dri chu/ nub tu tshe las rak+ta/byang du da las klad pa/ de'i steng du/ dbus su na las mi'i sha shar du go las ba lang gi sha lho ru ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las glang po che'i sha byang du ha las rta'i sha de rnams kyi steng du huX las rdo rje dkar po huX gis mashaṃ pa/ de las mtho gang tsam gyis dpag par zla ba la oX/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i huX las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ hūX/ skyon dang drim sbyangs/ āX kha dog dmar po zhu zhing ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oX/kha dog dang / dri dang / nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa gyen du 'phyur ba oX dang zla ba la phog pas/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa/ zla ba oX yig dang bcas pa la thim/ zla ba oṃ yig rdo rje bcas pa yang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu ste/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu gyur pas thams cad gang bar gyur/ hūX āXtso tshe/ zhes brgya rtsa'am/nyer gcig la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa —236—

brgyud kyi bla ma rnams rigs kyi bdag po'i ngo bor bzhugs par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hū las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi gsol bar gyur/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /dī pa ka ra rol pa'i rdo rje dang //snyu ra badz+ra sha na badz+ra dang / /a wa li na gu ṇa bha dra dang / /ngag dbang grags pa lha 'byung sbas pa dang / /don yon rdo rje shes rab bla ma dang / /dge 'dun bzang po gtsang 'od rdo rje rtse/ /gti mug rdo rje rdo rje gsang ba dang / /rdo rje 'od zer 'dzim chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gangs khrod pa dang ma ti paṇa chen dang / /lo tsā shāka bzang chen po ka drug pa/ /ngag dbang grags pa tshul mchog rnam rgyal mtshan/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dngos/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /tse( ā khru zhes brjod/ dbang mchog dbang gong ma brgyud pa 'ga' zhig ltar na/rdzo lo shes rab bla ma'i rjes su/ dz+nyā na gar+bha bsod nams shes rab dang / /bsod nams bkra shis ma zo jo thub dang / /gcen po gtsang 'od gcung po rdo rje rtse/ /de man chad gong bzhin/ yang na/ tse( ā hu/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du/ i da a mṛ ta mahā snya da hū/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ la li ta badz+ra/ bde spyin gang ba/ se na pa bde ldan/ mkha' lding zhabs can/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang grags pa/de ba a ka ra tsan+t+ra/a mo gha badz+ra/ co gru shes rab bla ma/ sras dge 'dun bzang po/ gtsang dang 'od po/ rdorje rtse mo/ zhabrul zhig rdo rje yang rtse/ sngags 'chang rgyal po/ byang chub rin chen/ glal ston mched gnyis/ 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan/ zhang sgom zhig po/ mkhas grub rin rgyal/ rin chen 'od zer/ blo gros mtshungs med/ byang chub seng ge tshul —237—

khrims rgyal mcho'i/ grags pa mtha' yas/ ngag dbang grags pa/ tshul khrims mchog grub/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyi zhal du i daX a mṛ ta mahā snya da guX 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'phreng sngags so so'i 'gora.oṃ dang / mjug tu i daX sogs sbyar bas 'bul/ spro na chos skyong dang / phyogs skyong sogs la'ang 'bul/ rang gis myangs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a spo ta snyu da na badz+ra swa gawa at+pa ko3haX/ de dag ni rnal 'byor r+ṣa po'o/ /de nas phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ste/ 'di dag yid kyis bsam pa las ngag tu brjod mi dgos so/ /de yang / snying ga'i 'od kyis phyogs bcur khyab/ snod la reg gzhal yas/ bcud la reg ltar byas te/ de rnams bsdus te gur la thim/ de chos 'byung / gzhal yas/ 'khor/ gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs/ ye shes sems dpa'/ rdo rje/ ya rnams la rim bzhin bsdu/ de zhu thig le sngon po rgya sran gyi tshad tsam gyi nang du/ gur/ chos 'byung /rten dang brten pa/ skye mched/ sku gsung thugs/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa skad cig la rdzogs par bskyed/ de'i gtso bo'i thugs ka'i ya'i 'od kyis/ thig le nang gi lha rnams gsal btab/thig le'i phyir 'phros/rdo rje dang /ye shes sems dpa' dang / gtso bo/ 'khor/ rten/ gur la sogs pa gsal btab la blta'o/ /de ni chung 0 r+ṣa po la brtags pa'o/ /phyi nas thig le'i nang gi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi ya shin tu phra ba la blta ste/ chen po la gnas nas chung ngur brtags pa'o/ /de gnyis res 'jog la brtan pa thob nas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung bas/ thig le nang gi lha rnams kyi spro bsdus sems can gyi don la blo sbyang ngo / /de'i tshe rgod na phyi nas rim gyis bsdu zhing / byings na nang nas rim gyis spro'o/ /yang rgod na rang wo po laganas —238—
