pas/ chung ja'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin/ byings na rang chung ngu la gnas pas/ chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin to/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ dung 'phreng la sogs pa'i bgrang 'phreng bsangs sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa zla bar gyur pa'i steng du/ bgrang 'phreng ril bu re re bzhin me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur/ sgyiXsgyiX brjod cing bdud rtsi lnga byugs la/ slar yang hiXsgyiXbargya rtsa tsam bzlas la/ de dag zhu ba las/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i 'phreng bar gyur/ bgrang 'phreng de nyid rang gi gnas bzhir gtugs te/ sngar gyi rdo rje gsum dang / steng sna'i thad kyi lus kyi dbus su/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la ya yig mtha' skor du yi ge bcu bzhis bskor ba/ de yang / ya dam rgya/ hūX las rgya/ āXchos rgya/ oX phyag chen gyi ngo bor mos la/ hiXsgyiXsogs bzlas pas/ sngags 'khru las khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe snod bcud thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te dbugs nang du yong ba dang lhan cig snying ga'i sa bon sngags bcas la thim/ bgrang 'phreng 'khru re re bzhin nas bgrang ba'i tshe/ 'dod chags rdo rje'i sku gnyis pa re re bzhin chad nas/ snying gar thim par bsam la/ sngags bzla'o/ /oX hiXsgyiXwaṃ kri tā na na hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa spru hā/ snying po'o//oX āXya badz+ra dhika huX phaṭa/ oX āXslo dzi na dzika hūX phaṭa/ rma āXm rat+na lha ka hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXtshe a ro le ka huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXd pradz+nyā dhika huX phaṭa/ ya mut+pa ra lhakats+tsha da rnyidhika ni pad+ma lha ka rā khat+na lha ka dza mo ha rā tī sa dre ṣa rā tī/ do ra ga rā —239—

tī/ du badz+ra rā tī/ skye( āXṇa hūX phaṭa/ tso r+sha āXsku1 hūX phaṭa/ skye(sna/༷༷ni hūX phaṭa/ tseX( āXr hūX phaṭa/ 'phreng ba'i sngags so/ /yang yi ge bstobadun pa bzla bar 'dod na/ snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rin po che zur brgyad pa/ rtse mo dbus ma la ya/ rtse mo brgyad kyi nang gi phyogs la/ shar nas g.yas skor gyi rim pa bzhin du/ spu dza ma sa me do da ru rnams dang / phyi ngos brgyad la/ ya ṇa stso yo ni ni ra ra rnams lha so so'i kha dog dang mthun par bkod la/ oX ya slo ma me da ya smo ni ra dza sa do ru ṇa yo nī ra hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla ba'am yang na/ snyibar rin po che rtse dgu pa/zur bzhi phyi dang zur bzhi nang du bstan par bsam/ rtse mo dbus ma la ya/ nang ma rnams la g.yas skor kyi slo ma me da/ phyi'i zur rnams kyi g.yas g.yon dang rtse mo ste bcu gnyis rnams kyi lho'i dbus nas brtsams te/ rā dza sa do ru ṇa ro nī ra ya stso ni/ zhes pa rnams bkod de/oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do sa ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya spyo ya/ ya spu rwa/ ni rā ma ya huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba dang / yi ge bcu bdun gyi dod du/ lha bcu bdun 'god pa dang / 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'i tshe/ rlung phyir 'gro ba na/ yi ge de rnams dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ thod pa'i nang du gnas pas/ 'od 'phros/ gti mug dag par bsam/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i rin po che la 'khod/ gnas pa'i tshe/ de las de 'dra ba gnyis pa zhig chad nas/ gsang gnas su sleb par bsam/ de gnyis las kyang 'od zer spros te/sdig sgrib sbyang ba sogs bya'o/ /de dag ni/ nang gi bzlas pa ste/ lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa yin zhing / bzlas pa'i man ngag ces mngon rtogs kyi dkyus su ma bcug par/ logs su mdzad pa de'o/ /bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa bdag nyid la thim/ thun tha ma la/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khore lo yang bdag nyid la skad cig gis thim/ zhes brjod/ thun snga ma rnams la —240—

ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo las phye ba'i/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya babyed par mos/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ lus dub na gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len bya/ sgom pas yid skyo na/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bstod byas par bsam zhing / dbyangs blangs la re zhig ci bder gnas so/ /gal te gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma bsdus par/ ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhagarang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis shar sgor phyin par mos te/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas/ rjes chags kyi sngags gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin byas la/ mkha' nang du byang chub kyi sems cha bcu bzhin gyur pa/ ye shes pa'i phyogs skyong bcu bzhir gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas bhuX spros pas/gzhal yas khang khong du chud pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu par gyur/ sdiXsgyiX ni gcig brjod pas/ phyogs skyong rnams mkha' nang nas phyir spros nas/ rtsibs rnams la 'khrod/ snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ 'jig rten pa'i phyogs skyong rnams bkug hrīXsgyiX'i mthar/ 'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad aX ku sha dzaX phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod/ yang hiXsgyiX'i mthar 'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ gī la ya/ gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ dernams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad byang / ye shes kyi phyogs skyong rnams kyang thim pas ro gcig tu gyur pas/ 'od du zhu/ slar yang gzhin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su bzhengs pa ni/ shar du hiXdang rdo rje las/ brgya byin dkar po mig stong dang ldan pa la/sha tsi mas 'byud pa/ glang po che la gnas pa/ lho ru sgyiXdang be con las/ gzhin rje nag po la/ 'chi bdag mas 'byud pa/—241

ma he la gnas pa/nub tu bi dang sbrul zhags las/ chu lha dkar po la/ chu bdag mas 'khyud pa/ chu srin la gnas pa/ byang du kri dang rin chen dbyug pa las/gnod sbyin ser po la/ nor 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ rta dkar po la gnas pa/byang shar du ta dang rtse gsum las/ dbang ldan thal dkar la/ u mas 'phyud pa/khyu mchog la gnas pa/ shar lhor a dang bgrang 'phreng las/me lha dmar po la/bsreg byed mas 'khyud pa/ ra la gnas pa/ lho nub tu na dang ral gri las/ srin po kham pa la/ srin mos 'khyud pa/ rol ngas la gnas pa/ nub byang du na dang ba dan las/ rlung lha dung ljang la/ g.yo byed mas 'khyud pa/ sha ba la gnas pa/steng gi rtsibs kyi rtsa bar/ hūX dang ut+pal las/ zla ba dkar po la/bsil byed mas 'byud pa/ ngang skya bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ rtsibs kyi dbus su/ huX dang pad+ma las/ nyi ma dmar po la/ 'od ldan mas 'phyud pa/ rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ rtse mor phaṭa dang sna tshogs pad+ma las/tshangs pa ser po la/ tshangs mas 'byud pa/ ngur pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ 'og rtsibs kyi rtsa bar/ phaṭa dang bum pa las/ sa bdag nag po la/ sa'i lha mo ser mos 'phyud pa/ phag pa la gnas pa/ rtsibs kyi dbus su/snyu dang ral gri las/ thags bzang ris dmar po la/ lha min mos 'byud pa/dar gyi 'bol stan la gnas pa/ rtse mor hā dang mtshon cha las/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i 'byung po sna tshogs pa dpal mol sogs pa/ rang rang gi lha mos 'phyud pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas par gyur/ dkar po rnams gti mug rdo rje lta bu/ ser po rnams ser sna rdo rje lta bu/dmar po rnams 'dod chags rdo rje —242—

lta bu/ rlung lha phrag dog rdo rje lta bu/ sngon po rnams zhe sdang rdo rje lta bu/ thams cad kyang g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o//'di ni bskyed chog 'bring bo'i dbang du byas pa ste/ rgyas par na/thor mar mkha' nang du/ye shes pa'i phyogs skyong bskyed/ 'jig rten pa'i phyogs skyong rnams bkug ste/zhal phyag rnams spyi dang mthun par bskyed/phur gdab kyi rjes su cho ga gsum bskyed kyi sngar bzhin bskyed de/ 'on kyang phyag mtshan gyi khyad par ni/ g.yas dang po rang rang gi bskyed gzhi'i phyag mtshan 'dzin par bya'o/ /de la ye shes kyi phyogs skyong gshin rje gshed rigs lnga dang 'dra/ 'jig rten rang brgyud pa'i phyogs skyong yang spyi dang mthun/ phyi ma 'di de gnyis 'dres pa ste ngo bo ye shes pa la phyag g.yas dang po'i mtshan ma 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'o/ /gang ltar ming skye mched dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs gong bzhin bya/ snying ga'i sa bon gyis spyan drangs pa'i lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzir bha wa a bhi 'khri nyu huX/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / drim dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zhe sdang rdo rjes dbu rgyan/ gong tshogs zhing skabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa nas bzung ste/ rol mo 'bul ba'i bar du bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te/ gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la/ bla ma la yang gtor ma 'bul bar mdzad pas de ltar na/oṃ āXhūX/ rdo rje 'a myong gi sogs gong nang mchod kyi skabs bzhin/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med du 'chad pa'i phyir/ 'di sgos su ma byas kyang chog go /oṃ āXhūX/ oṃ khyiXskyingaXwi kri tā na na spyiX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ i daX ya mi ta mahā snya da skyoX/ ba li ta ji ji/ ji hi ji hi/ de bzhin du lha tshogs kyi sngags thams cad la sbyar la/ gtso bo la lan bdun dang / 'bor rnams la lan re'am lan gsum gyis 'bul/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'di phyogs skyong ma bskyed gong du phul na —243—

legs par mthong ngo / /phyogs skyong 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje sbu gus drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hiX ya ma ya sgyiX ba ru na ya bi/ ku be ra ya kri/ yī sha na ya ta/ asna ye a/ ni rte ye na/ wa ya be na/ tsan+d+ra ya huX/ arka ya huX/ brad+ma ṇi phaṭa/ bā sun+ta ra ya phaṭa/ be ma tsi tra ye snyu/ sarba bhu te spyo hā/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ huX hūX hūX/ phe pho phe phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum sogs ci rigs pas 'bul/ bar 'dir 'grub na/ 'di nyid kyi sgos kyi chos skyong yang yin zhing / ma gshin shin tu 'brel che ba'i phyir/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo la yang gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma 'bul lo/ /de dag gi rjes su/gzugs sgra la sogs drug pa ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol tu gsol/bsnams par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol tu gsol/ /ho chags pa med cing chags par mdzode/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ hūX/ dur khrod kyi ni legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bur la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa//dud kha mun can khyod la 'dud//bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bco lnga'i tshogs la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs—244—

spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol//dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs//dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzode/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'gru/ba mdzode/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod cing /gtor mgron rnams mi dmigs par mos/bsang chu'i nye reg byas la/ o ni ri te hū kha/ zhes brjod/ 'di yang phyi rol gtor ma'i tshul du phyogs skyong la sgo phyi'am/khang steng sogs su 'bul ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/nang gtor kho na'i dbang du byas na nye reg 'di mi dgos so/ /slar yang rang nyid dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su song ste/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo la dmigs te/ o badz+ra pukhre ā hū/dhu pe/ ā lo keg rnye/ne we tu/sha lta ā hu/dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs kyis bstod/gtso bo'i sngags kyis nang mchod 'bul/ rang nyid dam ye dbyer med kyi nga rgyal gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal du bsdu ba'am/ yig rnying phal che ba'i lugs ltar na/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i rjes la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ ā hu mu/ zhes pas ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor ra mdun gyi nam mkhar gshe/gas/ yang oṃ ā hu mu/ zhes pas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin bsdus la 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag skad cig gis phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis langs te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang //gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa//de dag thams cad —245—

bzod par gsol/ /mgon dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /thugs rje can du bdag byin gyis rlobs/ /theg pa che las mi nyams shing / /slar yang bdag la phan mdzad par/ /nges par yang dag gyur nas kyang / /mgon po rigs dang sras bcas rnams/ /ci bde bar ni gshe/gas su gsol/ /oṃ ā hū/ zhes rang bzhin gyi gnas su skad gas su gsol/ dpal ldan gshin rje gshed po yi/ /sgom thabs thob pa'i dge ba yis/ /ye shes bde ldan rang gyur nas/ /'gro rnams kun rig sa thob sgo(ga /ces dge ba bsngos/thun mtshams kyi bya ba la ci bde bar 'jug par bya'o//yang gtor ma'i cho ga rgyas 'bring gnyis mi lcogs na/ sngar bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ gzhin rje gshed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza ar+gha nas/ shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs rnams la/ gong bzhin sngags kyis phul/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dza thams cad kyi skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su gyur/ zhes pa'am/ yang na sku mdog gzhon pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba la/ phyag mtshan spyi dang mthun par bskyed/tso rna in+d+ra ya/ sogs kyis 'bul ba man chad gong bzhin bya/lugs 'di ltar na/dam ye so sor phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu 'gro ba dang / nye reg byas nas/ nang du 'ong ba sogs mi dgos so/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar 'dod na/ lha bcu gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal bskyed la/ mchod gtor tshogs rdzas rnams bshams te/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mod pag tu med pa sprul/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bkang nas/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhi phul/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang —246—

nas/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhum pa med pa byas te 'bul/ /oX āXtsakra rat+na pū rdzi te huX/ 'di nyid 'phro pa spos te/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon sna lnga yang 'bul/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto tshe bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan dang ldan/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa gos bzang dag gis brgyan/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma dang / /dri ngad ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /sogs dang /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog nas 'byung ba ltar/ bstod pas bstod/tshogs phud gtor ma la sbran te/ gong bzhin gtor chog gis phul/ de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dren cing len pa dang / longs spyod pa dang / lhag ma'i gtor ma'i bar spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang thun mtshams spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dang /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams go bla zhing spyi dang mthun pa dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir 'dir ma spros so/ /gzhan rje gshed nag po rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di nyid la 'chad tshul lugs ji snyed cig snang na yang / zhung lugs nyid man ngag che zhing / byin rlabs che bar mngon no/ kha ba can 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa shas che bas kyang / rdo rje 'jigs mdzad dang / gshin rje gshed dmar po sogs la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pa mang zhing / zhung co gru lotsā ba de nyid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di nyid la rtsal tu bton te/ mkhas par sbyongs pa dang / nyams bzhes su mdzad pa sha stag go /'dir smras nga// srid gsum nyon mongs gshin rje kun 'joms pa/ /bla med bla ma khams gsum dbang phyug ma chog /rim gnyis lam gyi sgrub par byed pa'i thabs//dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas 'dir gsal byas/ /'di las dge ba gang thob pas/ /mtha' dag srid gsum 'gro ba —247—

gshin rje gshed lha bstogasum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer 'gas bskul ba dang / bdag nyid kyang lam 'di la lhag par mos pas nye bar sbyar ba ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du sgrub pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/

cho ga bde chen 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ snya sti/ gang zhig lhan cig skyes dga' 'khor lo'i mgon/ /ye shes rang snang bcu gsum dkyil 'khor tshul/ /de la dngos kun gnyis med tshul btud nas/ /dbang bzhi'i cho ga mdo tsam gsal bar bya/ /'di la slob dpon gyi las/ slob ma gzhug pa/ rjes kyi bya ba ste gsum las/ dang po la sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa/ dkyil 'khor dngos kyi bya ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po la/ brtag dang blang dang sbyang ba dang / /byin rlabs dang ni bzung dang bsrung / /de la lha 'gros bka' bsgo dang / /stang stabs phur bu yang dag bsrung / /zhes pa ni sdom mo/ /dang po brtag pa ni g.yin du shes so/ /gnyis pa bslang pa ni mchod gtor bshams te/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rol mo'i brda' sbyar te/ rang skad cig gis gzhan rje gshed du gyur/ hūX bzhi pa dang hiXsgyiXbarjod pas bgegs rnams bskrad/ tseX( gha gha sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis phur bu gcig btab la/ gtor ma dang po sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong la gtor ma phul/ gnyis pa dpung bzang nas 'byung ba'i phyogs skyong la gtor ma phul/ gsum pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ a kā ros gzhi bdag la phul/ sa phyogs 'di rnams bdag la ci bde bar gnang bar mdzod cig ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams la/hiXsgyiXs bsangs/ a kā ros sbyangs/pad zla'i gdan la/rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i baX yig dang bum pa las/ sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser —249—

mo/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lte ba'i thad kar 'dzin pa/sa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/hruXsgyiX'i mthar/ bhu mi de bi ṭu ki hūX dzaX zhes 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas ye shes kyi sa lha bkug ste gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ hruXrnyingaX'i mthar/ bhu mi de bi pra wa ra sa t+pa ra swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaX/ pu duX/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rig lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX badzir bha wa a ghi khri thu/ hūX zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbu brgyan/ mchod yon gnyis dang 'brel ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo rnams sngar gyi rigs bsgres te dbul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum dang / sa ni 'gro ba kun gyi rten yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med/ /de bas bdag la brdzun ni yong min pas/ /brtan ma 'dir ni bdag gis dpang mdzod cig /oX e waX bhu mi de bi i dam a mṛ ta mahā snya dā skyoX/ zhes nang mchod phul/ rig pa 'dzin pa ci bde bar spyod cig ces gsung bar bsam/ pra tiX khyu zhes mchog sbyin g.yas pa sa la reg pas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ snying gar reg ste/ dam tshig pa rang la thim gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ oX ru ru slu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ne sarba arba sa dha ne swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / dri bzang gi chus byugs/ sbyang ba'i byugs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag ni 'dir nye bar mi mkho —250—

bas ma spros so/ /bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu snying gar 'khyud rgyas bzung la/bdag nyid 'og min du gnas par gyur/ a ka ros snod bca stong par sbyangs/ yaX raX baX laX las 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ oṃ su khaX/ri rab rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa tu/ de'i phyag zhabs rnams dang /ba sbu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ des ri rab kyi phyed nub par gyur cing / rnam snang yang ri rab la thim/ ri rab kyi steng du/ hūX laX huX las 'od 'phros/ sa phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me di ni badzir bha wa badz+ra ban+ta huX/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa sa la reg par bya'o/ /sngar dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms na rang gi snying gar bsdu/spyod lam cung zad bya zhing ngal bso'o zhes gsung ngo / /lnga pa bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i ya yig las lha mo bzhi spros zhes pa nas/bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs yongs rdzogs sgrub thabs bzhin sgom mo/ /drug pa bsrung ba la sngon 'gro ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyogs bzhir gnas pa'i gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa bzhis/ rang rang dang slob dpon gyi bar du mchod pa dang nang mchod bshams/ phyogs bzhi'i slob dpon rnams kyis lhan cig tu mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams bya ste/de yang /snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ zhes pa nas/ sha lta āXhūX gi bar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod/kye kye gshin rje gshed nag po nas/gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ mngon rtogs ltar nang mchod byin gyis bsas/ oṃ āXhūX/ dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon chen po dang / zhe sdang rdo rje dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhal du i daX a mṛ ta mahā su dā huX/ zhes nang mchod phul/ de nas rdo rje —251—

dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ shar mas/ de bzhin ga tha/gas pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho mas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /nub mas/ zhi ba'i chos ni kun dang ldan/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /byang mas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsum gyis gsol ba btab/nga/ngos gzhi la drug gi dang po rdo rje'i lta bas bsrung ba ni/rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ hruXsgyi'i mthar/ u tiṣ+ṭha mahā maṇ+ḍal u pa ta yaX/ zhes pa lan gsum mo//sa bzung gi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal ba'i mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras dbus su hūX dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūX/ oṃ badz+ra dri ḍi ma ṭa/rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon skor du bltas nas huX zhes brjod pas/ bgegs rnams bcom par bsam/ g.yas su skor bas mig gi 'od zer rnams rdo rje'i rwa bar gyur/ gnyis pa 'gros kyi bsrung ba ni/rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang du gyur/oṃ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maX/zhes lan bzhi brjod cing / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas bzhir reg go /rkang mthil du a las sna tshogs rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zhes pa glur blangs shing /rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu —252—

dkrol 'gying ba dang bcas pas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rkang stabs zhig bya'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba dang sa gzhir gyur/ bdag nyid zhe sdang gshin rje gshed du gyur/ hruXsgyiX'i mthar/ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maX/ gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ rkang mthil du a las sna tshogs rdo rje/ huX glur blangs shing / phyogs bzhir hūX bzhis gzhi bca'i rkang stabs 'cha' zhing / drag po'i 'gros gyis bskor bas/ rdo rje rwa ba me dpung drag tu 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/gsum pa bka' bsgo bas bsrung ba ni/ ral gri bsangs sbyangs/ muX las byung ba'i 'jam dpal gyi ngo bo ral grir gyur/ de nyid 'debs tshul du bya zhing / hūX/ lus dang ngag sems la gnas pa'i/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /bdag ni dpal ldan ral gri 'dzin/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ /lus gsum las byung bcad par bya/ /ci ste bdag tshig las 'das gang / /'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /zhes lan gsum drag rol dang bcas pa'i brjod do//bzhi pa stang stabs kyis bsrung ba ni/g.yon brkyang ba dang mthun pa'i stabs//sa ga'i 'dug stangs g.yas brkyang dang / /zlum por gnas dang rkang gcig dang / /rus sbal stang stabs bdun par bshad/ /ces pa ltar 'grub na bya'o/ /lnga pa phur btab kyis bsrung ba ni/ phur pa lnga la/hruXsgyiX'i mthar gī la ya huX phaṭa/lan gsum gsum bzlas la/byang dang byang shar gyi bgegs thams cad bkug ste brtsegs pas gnas par gyur/ hiXsgyiX'i mthar/bgegs thams cad aX gu sha dzaX a kar+ṣa ya hru/ bgegs kyi snying gar btab par bsam la/ khyiXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ gha gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba ྅zhi ṇa phaṭa/gī la ya/ gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX huX hūX/ badz+ra gī la/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigha nan/ kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX huX phaṭa/ ces byang shar du phur bus —253—

bto/ de bawo/ shar dang shar lho'i zhes sogs kyi shar lhor phur bus bto/ lho dang lho nub kyi zhes sogs lho nub tu phur bus btab/ nub dang nub byang gi zhes sogs brjod/nub byang du phur bus btab/ steng 'og gi bgegs sogs kyi mthar dbus su phur bu btab/ hu zhes g.yon du bskor bas/ bgegs phran ram mda'i tshul du 'ongs pa rnams/ phur bu'i stod smad nas spros pa'i khro bo'i tshogs dang mtshon bya'i (〈dze+e〉 cha'i )tshogs kyis bcom par gyur/ yang hū zhes g.yas su bskor bas/rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur du gyur/ drug pa yang dag par bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas a chad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ hū chad pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye ba la hu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ slar yang rdo rje'i rwa gur gyi phyi nas bskor bas bgegs thams cad kyi mi tshugs par gyur/ de dag ni sa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon nam lhag par gnas pa ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba can te/ de yang bzlas pa yan chad kyi mngon rtogs sgrub thabs ltar rgyas par bsgoms pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/gzhal yas khang mi sgom par/rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bskyed chog rdzogs par byas la/skyed mched byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar du bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas/ zhes pa nas/ skad cig gis bar gyi zhes pas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa sgom na bsdu la/ bsdus pa'i tshe na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la zhes sogs brjod mi dgos so/ /lhag gnas dngos la/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas/ dkyil 'kho ra gyi lha lhag gnas/ dbang gi bum pa lhag gnas/gus ldan gyi slob ma lhag gnas so//dang po ni/sa bslang ba'i skabs dang cho ga 'dra'o//'on kyang gnyis kar bya dgos te/ snga ma ni sa bslang ba'i don yin la/ 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bris te bdud gzhom pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni lha rnams dang thod pa'i gnas su dri bzang —254—

gi thig le bya ste/ rang rang gi sngags bzlos bzhin pas rigs lnga'i gnas su gru bzhi pa dang / gzhan rnams su zlum por bya'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du rang rang gi sngags kyis me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ da lta'i lag len ltar na/ las thig gi bya ba rdzogs par byas la tshom bu dgod do/ /der mchod pa bshams la/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing / bsangs sbyangs/ pa las pad+ma dang ra las nyi zla'i steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed ces pa nas/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba rdzogs kyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin bya'o/ /ye shes pa dgug gzhug song ba'i skabs su/snying ga'i hu gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/ sa chog gi dkyil 'kho7ra badz+ra sa mā dzamachod yon dang nyer spyod lnga'i sngags mchod tsam 'bul/ o badz+ra mu dha ra dza zhes dgug gzhug sogs bya/ de nas mchod bstod bya ba ni khyad par ro/ /bstod pa'i mthar lha so so la dmigs te bzlas pa yang cung zad byas la/sang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la zhugs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba yang yang btab/ gsum pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bkod/ las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bkod/gal te lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ las bum logs su bya mi dgos so/ /de dag gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snying po lnga/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ chu gtsang mas legs par bkang / bcud ldan gyi shing gis kha brgyan dang /mgul bcing dkar pos dkris/ dung chos dang gzung thag rdo rje 'dus byas la/ bsangs sbyangs/ pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bhu/ bhu las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul bcing dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang —255—

bcud thams cad kyi yongs su gang ba lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus/ bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan la 'khor/ lkoX dzi na dzi ka sogs nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod/ phyi'i mtshams bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/phrag dog rdo rje'i skabs byang gi rwa dbus ma dang / las bum gyi nang du pad nyi la 'khod/ ces dang / shar sgor zhes sogs kyi dod du/ shar du zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ lha sta gon la yang 'di ltar bskyed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /skye mched byin brlabs/ dbang bskur/ ye shes pa spyan drang pa sogs sgrub thabs ltar bya/ yang na/ mig gnyis su dzaXdzaXgayon du nyi ma dang g.yas su zla ba'i steng du huX las rdo rje/ lte ba la di bha dri ni aX gu sha dzaX zhes pa'i sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ hiXsgyiX'i mthar di bha sbyar ba'i rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas shing rdzi ma bskyod pas/ ye shes 'khor lo bkug ste/ skad cig gis bstim par bsams kyang rung ngo / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba yang mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun byung bas/ bum pa khengs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing / hiXsgyiXci nus bzlas la/phreng ba'i sngags yang ci rigs bzla/ las bum gyi phrag dog rdo rje la dmigs te yang hiXsgyiXbazla/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gnyis su med par sbyor bas 'od du zhu/bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs nas/ oX āXhūX/ zhes brjod cing / nub byang gi gdan la bzhag go /yang na rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gtso bo bskyed —256—

pa dang las bum gyi gtso bo lhan cig tu bskyed kyang rung ngo / /lhag par gnas pa'i rjes kyi bya ba ni/mgrin par hri las pad+ma dmar po mdun gyi 'dab ma lcer gyur pa'i hu las rdo rjer gyur/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs shing / spos snod thogs pas/ mgon po zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba bdag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don byed pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po byang chub brtan gnas dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan snga rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yis/ /gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ji ltar nus par nyer spyod pas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /slob ma dang bcas bdag la ni/ /thugs rjes nyer bar dgongs nas ni/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor la bcug nas/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma btang zhing / dpa' bo'i ston mo'am tshogs kyis 'khor lo la longs spyad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'dod don gsol ba btab ste/yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / skye( badz+ra u tilga zhes rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar btega.ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ dur khrod brgyan gyi sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor —257—

gyi 'khor lo rnams sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor rin po che'i spar kha'i nang du bzhugs/ snying pos rgya gram du bcings shing rgyas btab par gyur/hru sgyi lan gsum tsam bzlas so/ /smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod de/ slob dpon bya ba lhag par gnas pa gsum rdzogs so/ /bzhi pa ni mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gus pas bshud de gnas pa la/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /skyes bu 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes brjod cing don spund do//de nas slob mas/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsole/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag gis kyang gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen te/ /dpa' bos byang chub zhing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med —258—

brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzang chen po stobs chen bcoms/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rab rtogs nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'da'/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don bshad/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi cho ga mdo lugs nas 'gyung ba ltar rgyas par sbyin pa'am/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes pa lan gsum gyis so/ /slob ma bsangs sbyangs/rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnyems pas 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/mgrin par ā dmar po/snying gar hū sngon po/slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gnas gsum du srin lag gis thig le bya zhing / 'bru gsum brjod pa lugs 'byung lugs bzlog bya/glu( badz+ra pukhre ā hu/skye( badz+ra dhu pe ā hūṃ/glu( badz+ra a 'e1 ke ā spyi/tso( badz+ra ga rnye ā hū/zhes mchod/ rgyas par spro na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa re re'i mthar mchod pa 'bul bar mdzad pa bzhin spro na yang bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te bde ba ldan par gyur pas nye bar gnas par byos shig so shing sor stso gnyis pa hisgyibarjod cing bdud rtsis bsangs la thal mo'i bar du sbyin/ dngos grub gyi ltas la dmod bor ba'i tshul gyis oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes pas dor/ oṃ hi bi 〈’snye dharmā sarba pā pa ni tsa a phya shwa dha ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hū/ zhes pas khyor chu byin/ ku sha che chung gnyis hi sgyi sa bsangs la sbyin/ bsrung skud dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum sgril du byas pa/—259—

bsangs sbyangs/ hū las byung ba'i srad bur bskyed/sdi sgyi 'i mthar badz+ra shiñtsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mi/ zhes mdud pa gsum ldan du byas la/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas dang /byis pa'i mgul du btags so/ /de nas/ theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/khyed rnams de ring dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig/'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma sa /sngon du sdig pa bgyis pa gang / /de kun zad par 'gyur ba yang / /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'grub/ /gang gi spyod mchog 'di la ni/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /yod dang med las rnam 'das shing / /zab mo rtog ge thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mi rtog gnas med pa/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa kun gyis ma spros pa/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu —260—

byung / /las dang bya ba sogs ldan bral/ /bden pa gnyis la rnam gnas pa'i/ /theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di yi/ /tshul la gnas pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing don spund do/ /ku sha'i gdan la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi nyal zhing rmi lam rtogs shig ces rmi lam gyi don cung zad cig bshad do/ /de ltar na slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rdzogs so/ /sta gon gyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams skabs 'dir byas kyang rung ngo / /gsum pa dkyil 'khor dngos kyi bya ba'am dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bya ba dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thig tshon sgrub pa/ thig gdab pa/ tshon dgye pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar gyi dkyus de nyid la yin na bdag bskyed bsgom mi dgos shing phyi de'i nyin par yin na/ sta gon gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar gyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa de sgom/ tshon sna lnga la rin po che sna lnga brdar la/kha dog gi rim pa dang mthun par ya slo ma med rnams bris/ rang mdog dang mthun pa'i thig skud gsar pa rnams kyang steng du bzhag bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig tshon sngon po ya las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma gī sngon mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thig tshon dkar po spu las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thig tshon ser po ma las rin chen 'gyung gnas ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thig tshon dmar po me las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thig tshon ljang khu da las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum dam tshig —261—

sgrol ma ljang khu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /skye mched dang / sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ mig byin gyis rlabs pa nas/ dgug gzhug gi bar bum bskyed bsdus pa bzhin byas la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs gsang 'dus nas 'byung ba'i de nyid lnga pas bstod/ ya slo ma me da oṃ āXskyoX/ zhes nang mchod phul/ lha sku rnams zhu ba las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ de rnams zhu ba las/ ya slo ma me da yig rnams su gyur/ de rnams zhu ba las/ thig tshon lnga lngar gyur/ bdag nyid gtso bo zhe sdang rdo rje dang / sgrub grogs gti mug rdo rje'am phrag dog rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ thig sna bsgril zhing drangs la/ oṃ a rgyo n+ya a nu ga ta/ sarba spyi mi pa ra spa ra na/ a nu pra bri ṭa/ sarba dharma aru skye/ a nu pra bri ṭa/ sarba dharma hūX/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ āXhuX/ zhes bdud rtsi phyugs la snod gtsang mar bzhag go /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin bzhin pas/ rma badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūX/ zhes tshon rnams mtheb srin gyis mnye'o/ /gnyis pa la ye shes kyi thigs gdab pa dang / las thig gdab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pas/ slob ma bden bral du gnas pa la/ dzaXdzaXzhes thig sna blangs te gtad la/ slob ma slob dpon gyi rgyab nas bskor te song la/ shar du gnas pas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sna tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ thig gi sgras nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes shing 'gro don la bskul bar gyur/ces brjod cing thig nam mkhar btab ste rim pa de nyid kyis ye shes kyi thig thams cad btab ste/—262—

slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub/ /slob dpon byang bltas slob ma lho/ /gnyis ka nub la shar ngos gdab/ /gnyis ka byang bltas slob dpon lho/ /slob mas bskor la nub bltas byang / /slob dpon nub bltas slob ma shar/ /slob dpo na lha min slob ma rlung / /slob dpon bden bral nas 'byung lta/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa las thig gdab pa ni/logs su shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa sor bzhi tsam bris shing / phur khung bgang / de nas slob ma rnams kyis ci bder bri ste/ rtsig pa sgrel la tshon bkra brtag /legs par bris zin pa na/ mtshan ma rnams dgod/ rgyan rnams dang / mchod gtor rnams bshams te/ de dag rgyas par bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yi ge dang phyag len las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/mtshan ma lhar bskyed pa/ sgo dbye ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ me tog dor ba/ lhag chad bskang ba ste lnga las/dang po ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bgegs sbyangs pa dang / khrus gsol spyi dang mthun par bya/bsangs sbyangs/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su gyur pa las/ bsrung 'khor ra gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ dbus kyi mtshan ma bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje nas/ bzhugs pa'o /de bzhin du sbyar te/ shar gyi rwa'i dbus kyi mtshan ma gti mug rdo rje dkar sogs dang /shar sgo'i mtshan ma tho ba rdo rje sogs/ shar lho'i tsar tsi ka sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i mtshan ma thod pa bzhir gyur/ zhes so/ /'di yig rnying phal cher na mi snang bas ma byas kyang dgag bya chung tsam yin srid na'ang sgo dbye'i sngon du 'di nges par thob cing / gcung rdo rje rtse mos dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar bkod pa yin pas yid ches pas gnas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ hi sgyi 'i mthar/ skye( badz+ra gi khyu/ ṭa ya/ sa ma ya/ pra be sha ya skyo/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi rang bye bar gyur/ ces rdo —263—

rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas re re'am shar nas lan bzhi brjod kyang rung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wa stsit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+ta naX ka ro mi/zhes g.yon gyi thal mo snying gar gtad pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul du byed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs par mos la/shar gyi lha snam la gnas par bsam ste/ oX pra tisnro badz+ra ho/ me tog gtso bo'i thugs kar babs/ oX pra ti grohātwaX i maX satwa mahā ba la/ zhes mgo la bcing ngo / /lnga pa ni/ mig gnyis su dzaXdzaX zhes pa nas/ hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ di sta'i sngags brjod pa'i bar gong bzhin/ mig gi 'od zer gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhag chad thams cad kha bskang bar gyur/ rdo rje snying gar gtad cing dril bu dkrol la/ dkyil 'khor la mig g.yo ba med par lta zhing yi ge brgya pa lan gsum du brjod do/ /gnyis pa la/sgrub pa dngos dang /mchod bstod dang /bzlas pa ste gsum las/dang po la/nam mkha'i lha dbang ba dang / dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab cing / sgrub pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/rang gi snying ga nas tho ba gzhin rje gshed la sogs pa sgo ba bzhi spros/ lhag gnas kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i yi ge rgya bkrol/ rin po che'i kha sbyor kha phye bar gyur/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'jom mdzad lha/ /sngon gnas ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ lkoX āXhūX a/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbus kyi mtshan ma la thim/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ slo dzi na dzika swāhā/ oṃ āXhūX a/ zhes pa nas/ tso( āXr huX skye( āXhuX a lha bcu gnyis thod pa bzhi dang —264—

bcas pa yang rang rang gi mtshan ma la thim/oṃ āXhūX a/gzhal med khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa yang bris pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas/gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri/mtshams bzhir gri gug bzhi'am/ shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho nub tu rdo rje/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du ut+pal/ shar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor be con/ nub sgor pad+ma 'bar ba/ byang sgor ral gri 'bar ba/grwa bzhir thod pa bzhi dang bcas par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ rang skad cig gis zhe sdang rdo rje sems dpa' gsum brtsegs dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la gnas par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon las rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa sprul te/ zhes pa nas/ thob pa'i rjes su mthun gyur cig ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te tshogs bsags/bdag tu 'dzin pas/ zhes pa nas/ phyi nang grwa bzhir zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i nas/ sbyan drangs te/ shar gyi lha snam la rang gi gdan la 'khode/ a ā nas/ oṃ dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX gi bar dang /mig tu k+ṣi dang / 'khor lo nas/ pū dza badz+ra sbi bhā wa at+pa ko3haX gi bar mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ lha rnams kyi zhes par/ rang gi zhes dang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ zhes dang / snying ga nas lha mo bzhi spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ zhes dang / yang thugs ka'i 'od kyi sno la sgo ba bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs nas/ bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /yab kyi gsang ba/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/—265—

tshur 'dus/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshi/na rje gshed nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ dzi na nas/shar gyi rwa'i steng gi 'khor lo la thim pa nas/sku mdog dkar po sogs/ de bzhin du/ lho'i rwa'i steng gi rin po che la thim pa nas/ sku mdog ser po sogs/nub kyi pad+ma/byang gi ral gri/shar sgor tho ba/lho sgor be con/nub sgor pad+ma/ byang sgor ral gri/ me mtshams gyi grwar 'khor lo/ bden bral du rdo rje/ rlung mtshams su pad+ma/ dbang ldan gyi grwar utu la thim pa nas/ ljang khu sogs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod/rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir zla gdan la gnas pa'i thod pa rnams la thim/ dkyil 'kho(ra gyi lha thams cad kyi nas/ skyil krung gi bzhugs pa ca'i bar yang mngon rtogs bzhin no//slar yang snying ga zhes pa nas/sprul pa rnams snying gar thim/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshe/gas su gsol/ /ma lus sems can sogs kyang bya/ hi sgyi lan gcig brjod pa nas/ khat+pa ho'i bar kyang mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /skabs 'dir yang mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba mngon rtogs ltar byed pa bshad pa'ang yod mod kyi mchod pa lan gnyis mi dgos par/ mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'am/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gang rung cig gi chog go /lag len 'ga' zhig la/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'bor rdzogs par bsgoms nas/slar bsdus te/ mdun bskyed spro ba sogs byed mod kyi/ gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang / 'di nyid kyi bla ma gong ma sus kyang ma bshad pas/ de ni lugs gzhan kho na ste/ 'dir bsre bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong du 4nad pa ltar mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba'i mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum pos kyang drang la/ bla ma snga ma rnams kyi yi ge ltar na/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ lho dong —266—

pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūX las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod rdzas bsam mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan mang du brjod/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /hiXsgyi:'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra sge swāhā/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni//ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na//de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol//sdiXsgyiX'i mthar/pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/'jig rten khams rnams dpag med na/ /bdug spos ji snyed mchis pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /dhu pe/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ me tog puṅge snang gsal/ ā lo ke dri chab/ ga rnye/ zhal zas/ ne we rkye/ rol mo/shasta/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ waX las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' chos kyi dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos//mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la//mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na//bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /hiXsgyiX'i mthar/ badz+ra wasta ye pra ca swāhā/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /rdul yab sbrang yab bsil yab dang / /'khyams dang skyed mos tshal dag dang / /gzim cha dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babs dang ni bla re dang / /bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs dang / /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ sogs gong bzhi/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par —267—

che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid du 'ong / /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog/ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams dang / /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /rin chen ri dang dpag bsam shing / /lda ldi rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs sogs/ /phye ske/sa bcu'i 'jig rten khams bkang nas/ dkyil 'khore sogs/ sgrub thabs nas bshad pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi skabs ltar rgyal srid sna bdun dang bum pa yang phul la/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /nas/ at+pa ko3ha gi bar dang / hu/dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs dang /kye kye gnyen rje gshed nas/ gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs kyi/ /bar dang /gti mug rdo rje nas/ at+pa ko3ha gi bar gyis bstod/ nang mchod lhag po yod na/ sgrub thabs bzhin byin rlabs rgyas par bya/ gzhan du na/ tse( ā skyo/ lan gsum brjod nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang nas/ at+pa ko3ha gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin phul/ yab kyi gsang ba zhes pa nas/ bhu gyis bkag pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad yab yum rjes chags snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen pos dgyes par gyur/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3ha/gsum pa ni/ dngos grub blang ba'i don du bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ cung zad bzlas pa byas la/ rang gi phyag rgya bzhi nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi gnas bzhi la phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul de rnams kyi gnas bzhi nas 'od zer byung ba rang la thim pas/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la/ snying po gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags 'phreng thams cad ci 'grub bzla'o//de nas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/'di la sngar dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i tshe/khyams —268—

kyi pad+ma'i thad la phyogs skyong rnams kyi tshom bu bkod yod na/ skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul ba nang gtor gyi tshul du byed pa yin la/ de ltar na mngon rtogs nas byung ba ltar las/ gtso bo'i dam ye 'byed pa dang slar bsdu ba sogs mi dgos la/ nye reg bya ba yan chad kyi gtor ma'i bya ba rdzogs pa yin no/ /'on kyang 'di ltar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oX āXhūX/ hiXsgyiXso gas kyi mngon rtogs ltar phul la/ gzugs sgra la sogs dang / dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo/ /bar 'dir nang gi chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu sgrub pa po'i stan gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang /shar dang dbang ldan gyi bar dang / nub dang rlung mtshams kyi bar du gsum gsum ste/ maṇ+ḍal bcu bzhi tshom bu dang bcas pa bya/ de tsam ma grub na/ steng 'og gi tshom bu dbus su bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gcig bya/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'ang nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am bsdu na/ stong pa'i ngang las/a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ lkoX āXhūX/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhuX/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas/zhe sdang rdo rjes dbu brgyan gyi bar bya/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas kyi nas/ phaṭa grwahwa'i bar bya/ oX dā sha di ka lo ka pa la sa pā ri wa re khyuX ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ de bzhin du/pur+sha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ hruXsgyiX'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /nas/ yig brgya'i bar yang mngon rtogs bzhin/ oX hri bi shudha/ sogs kyi mchod yon 'gro phyogs su bsgrengs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ sems —269—

can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad 'gyur ba'i/ /lam der myur du 'gro bar shog /oṃ u : thu/zhes pas gtor mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma bzhi mdo'am/ dur khrod dam gtsang sar bskyal/ snying po drag tu bzla zhing / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas mtshams bcad/slob dpon gyis rting mnan te nang du 'ongs la/sgo nang du nye reg bya'o/ /skabs 'dir sgo dbye ba dang /me tog 'bul ba sogs ni lugs 'di la mi bzhed pa mngon no/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ste/mchod bstod yan chad sngon 'gro'i bya ba rnams sngar grub zin pa yin pas/skabs 'dir mi dgos la/tshogs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa nas/ lhag ma'i gtor ma'i bar bya'o/ /de nas 'grub na/skabs 'dir sreg blugs kyis kyang mnyes pas bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa 'ba' zhig yin na ni/de dag gi mthar sdom bzung lan gsum byas la/rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o//'di ni sgrub pa dang /bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma sogs rang don du dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang 'brel ba yin no/ /gsum pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par mos la/ slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar rdzogs par blang ngo / /rang gi gnas bzhi nas khro bo bzhi spros/ dkyil 'khor ba'i gnas bzhir thim pas/ slob ma 'jug par gsol ba btab par bsam/ tshur 'phros/rang la thim pas snang ba thob par bsam/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bsdus pa zhin byas la/dril stabs dang bcas pas/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag grub/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes —270—

pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyi ni bdag grub mdzod/ khren tu rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i/ /bden pa 'di yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /las dang bya ba sogs dang bral/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sdig med mthong ba shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba med na/ dkyil 'khor la gnang ba zhu ba nas 'di'i bar mi dgos par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug pa la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dngos gnyis las/ dang po la/ phyi 'jug dang 'brel ba'i bya ba/ nang 'jug dang 'brel ba'i bya ba/gnyis ka dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste gsum las/dang po la/ gdong g.yogs pa dang sdom pa bzung / /tshig gis sbyang dang me tog gtad/ /gsol btab sems bskyed gsang ba bsgrags/ /phyi 'jug dngos te rnam pa brgyad/ /dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug lha sgyi dang las bum gyis bsangs —271—

pa'i mig dar gyis gdong g.yogs nas/ oṃ mut+pa ra dza nas/ho'i bar brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ sta gon ltar rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū rnams bkod/ skabs 'dir yang slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bzhed pa bzhin spro na bya/ de nas thal mo spyor bzhin pas/ slob dpon gyi rjes zlos su bya ste/ ji tsam dus nas gzung nas su/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su mchis kyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gi byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad cing / /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sgyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du —272—

bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma byung ba dbyugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan las 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis bzung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ bla mas/ sgo drung gnas pa khyod su yin/ zhes 'dri/slob mas/ bdag ni skal pa bzang po lags/ zhes lan btab/ yang / khyod ci la dga'/zhes 'dri/bdag skal ba bzang po la dga'/ lags so/ /zhes brjod/bzhi pa ni/u du wa ra man+da ra/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang ma li ka /kaṇi ka'i 'phreng ba ni/ /legs par nod la bus zungs shig /oṃ ā hū/ zhes me tog gi 'phreng ba'am chun po sbyin/lnga pa ni/phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bla ma slob dpon mgon rjes su/ /'bad pa chen pos dbang gi don/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ drug pa ni/ lus longs spyod dkon mchog dang sems can la blos btang du gas ka de nas/ snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar gas nas la/ o sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ nas brjod du gzhug cing / su ra te sa mā sta ho sirnyi badz+ra ya tha su kha gis brtan par bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/—273—

ma dad pa rnams la yang ma rung ngo / /zhes gdams so/ /brgyad pa ni/ lag tu rdo rje gtad de 'khrid tshul bya zhing / skyed na yi ra dza/ zhes khrid nas/ glu( āXhuX/ zhes pas nang du gzhug go /dngos su dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du 'khrid pa'am/ yol ba bsal/ de bzhin sgo ba gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar yang 'bru gsum btags pas/ sgo bzhi nas bcug par mos su bcugaslar yang phyag byas par mos/ te 'bru gsum brjod du gzhug go /gnyis pa nang 'jug dang 'brel ba'i bya ba la/ yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu/sngar rgyud sde spyi'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba yin la/ 'dir gshin rje gshed rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba'i don te/ sdom bzung lan gnyis bya bar bzhed pa'ang yod mod kyi phal cher nas ma bshad cing / rig pas kyang mi dgos la/ phyi 'jug gi skabs ma byas na/ 'dir byed pa dang / phyi 'jug gi skabs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar rgyun bshags byed pa thun mong gi sdom bzung dang / 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom bzung yang byed par snang ba 'di ni gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang yang mthun zhing / shin tu'ang legs pas/ de ltar yang bya'o/ /'on kyang dkyus kyi phyag len ltar na/ gsang bar gdams shing dam tshig sbyin/ /bka' bsgo gsol btab ye shes dbab/ /zhes pa ltar lnga las/ dang po ni/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhug la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs su zhugs te/ de bas na bdag gis khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par byas pa ste/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig las 'da' ru mi rung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar gsas la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' nyid//khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral —274—

te gshe/gas/ /glu sna badz+ra satwa huX/ glu( āXhūX/ gis bsngags pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ dmyal ba'i chu 'dis khyod la ni/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub kyang / /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaXgasum pa ni/ de ring phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas ci smras pa'i bya ba de khyod gyis bya dgos so/khyod kyi nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs pa dus phyis nas dmyal bar lhung ba gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa ni/phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par gyur cig ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ lnga pa ni/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba zhig byed du gzhug cing / slob ma rnams sngar lta gon bzhin rdo rje sems dpar gsal gdab/ ma yengs par dar cig de nyid la sems 'jog tu bcug rkang mthil nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu mchog ma la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ gsang ba nas lte ba'i bar raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum mdung gis mtshan pa/ de nas snying ga'i bar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ spyi bor baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa rnams gsal btab la/ slob dpon rdor dril dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya las/ mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pa/ slob ma'i snying gar reg cing spyi bor phus btab ba las/ lhaXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/zhes brjod/slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rlung gi ba dan bskyod/me'i dkyil 'khor drag tu 'bar bas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu tsha ba'i gdung bas —275—

bsregs/ spyi bo'i chu skol zhing lud pa snying ga'i sa la thim pas/ bde bas rgyud gang / rlangs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pas/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim par gyur par bsam la rol mo sgra bsgrags shing / rdzas kyi bdug pas bdug hrī sgyi'i mthar/ a be sha ya/ sta bha ya/ ra ra ra/tsa la ya/tsa la ya hū a ha dzhai/zhes brjod/spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/zhes brtan par bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ 'dod lha ngos bzung kha dog 'dri/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol dang blta bar bskul/ /lha ngo ston pa lnga pa yin/ /dang po ni/ rigs kyi lha la me tog phog par gyur cig snyam pas dmod bor du gzhug slob dpon gyis/ 'di ltar bdag gi slob ma 'di/ /dkyil 'khor du ni legs bcug pas/ /lha ni gang gi skal ldan zhing / /dngos grub gang gi skal yod pa/ /de ni de la 'bab par shog /ces dang / pra titsā badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod du gzhug la me tog gtor/pra ti gro hā stu i ma satwa mahā ba la/zhes pas me tog slob ma'i mgo la bcing / gnyis pa ni/ bar snang gi kha dog bris la/ las kyi dngos grub so sor lung bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mig gnyis su oṃ ser po 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni nan tan mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong ba yang / /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa khyo/zhes mig ras bsal/ bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun/ khyod la mngon sum phyogs par 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyong / /sngags rnams la yang brtson —276—

par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ lnga pa ni/ gtso bo nas thod pa bzhi'i bar rgyas par lha ngo bstan/bdag 'jug gi skabs ni dkyil 'khor mthong bar mos pa tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la bum dbang dang / mchog dbang gnyis las/ dang po la/dbang dngos dang / mtha' rten gnyis so/ /dang po la dbang dngos la/ slob ma'i dbang dang /slob dpon gyi dbang gnyid/ las/ dang po la/ bum chu/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming / rig spyor/brtul zhugs so/ /'di rnams la gzhan gyi lag len dang mthun par dbang rdzas dang slob ma sogs rim gyis bskyed chog byas na'ang rung mod gyi/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar na/ dbang rdzas bskyed pa dang / dbang lha dgug pa dang / dbang bskur ba gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ bum pa gcig tu bum chu rnams bsdus/bum pa dang / dbu rgyan dang /rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / yang rdor dril rnams gral du sgrigs la/ sgos mchod cig bshams/bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/rnam rgyal bum pa spu las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po sogs dang / dbu rgyan ma las rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/rdo rje me las 'od dpag med sogs/ dril bu da las don yod grub pa sogs/slar yang rdo rje dang dril bu ya las mi bskyod pa sngon po sogs/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar thig tshon byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin no/ /skye mched dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs rnams sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las/ rigs lnga yab yum rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza na dha ra dza/ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ ar+gha nas/shak+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ ya slo ma me da oṃ ā spyi/ zhes nang mchod phul/rnam par snang mdzad yab —277—

yum dgyes pa chen pos zhu ba las byung ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ dbu rgyan du/ 'od dpag med yab yum/rdo rjer/ don yon grub pa yab yum/ dril bur/ mi bskyod pa yab yum/rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang dbang gi lha rnams kyis shis pa brjod pas me tog gi char bab par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs slo ka gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa la/ cod pan gyi dbang dang / rig spyor brtul zhugs so/ /dang po la/ bum pa/ dbu rgyan/rdo rje/dril bu/ming ste lnga las/dang po ni/slob ma bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las me tog gang phog gi lha'am/ spu las 'khor lo skyes mtshan pa las gti mug rdo rje sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis/ g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing /khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can du gyur/ mig tu k+ṣa dkar po/ rna bar dzi sngon po/ sna la kha ser po/ lce la ga dmar po/ dpral bar ska ljang khu/ lte bar sa sngon po/ snying gar hu sngon po/mgrin par ā dmar po/ dpral ba oṃ dkar po rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur/—278—

slob dpon dang / dkyil 'khor dang / dbang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bar mos ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ke ta sa ma ya shrī ye spyiX/ oṃ badzir bha wa a bhi khiñtsa skyoX/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po dang / gti mug dag slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/lus thams cad rnam snang gi rdul phra rab kyis gang /me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / rnam snang gi go 'phang mngon du byas par gyur/ de nyid la mchod par mos te/ pur+sha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod de/ chu'i dbang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las ser sna rdo rje sku mdog ser po nas/pad+ma 'dzin pa/phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis nas/yongs su rdzogs pa rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can du gyur/ mig tu k+ṣ-i nas/ oṃ dkar po/slob dpon nas/ dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod pan dbang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir/ /cod pan mchog gis dbang bskur bas/ /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi tiñtsa maX/oṃ badz+ra a bhi blto khruX/zhes dbu rgyan skon/dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas/tshor ba'i phung po dang / nga rgyal rnam par dag slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyi sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spru'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang / mnyam —279—

pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du byas par gyur/ sngar bzhin mchod/ de ltar de gnyis kyi 'og ma gsum la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ gti mug rdo rje ma gtogs pa gzhan 'di rnams la/ zla ba'i gdan zhes pa'i dod du/ nyi ma'i gdan zhes sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'dod chags rdo rje sku mdog dmar po nas/'khor lo dang rin po che'i bar dang /phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis nas/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdo rje lag tu gtad la/sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang //de ring khyod la sbyin par bya//'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung / /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūX/lkoX badz+ra a bhi ṣi4 skyoX/ rdo rje'i 'du shes kyi phung po dang / 'dod chags/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par/ 'od dpag med kyi rdul/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / 'od dpag med kyi/ bzhi pa ni/ da las ral gri das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog rdo rje sku mdog ljang khu nas/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ phyag 'og ma nas/ don grub kyi dbu rgyan/ dbang bskur bar gyur/ dril bu lag par gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i/ sogs gong gi tshigs bcad 'don pa bsgyur la/ skye( badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi khi ྅ mi maX/ skye( badz+ra a bhi rdzis huX/ dril bu'i/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang / phrag dog don yod grub pa'i rnam par/ don yod grub pa'i rdul/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes dang / don yod grub pa'i/lnga pa ni/ ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las/ zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ phyag 'og ma nas/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan/ dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdor dril bsnol te 'dzin pa spyi bo'i steng du dkrol —280—

zhing /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo bar/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/oX badz+ra satwa stuX/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang ba'i ming gdags/ming gi rnam shes kyi phung po dang /zhe sdang /mi bskyod pa'i rnam par/mi bskyod pa'i rdul/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang / mi bskyod pa'i/ gong bzhi mchod de rig pa'i dbang lnga'o/ /'di dag ni phyag len 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa ste/ rgyas pa la spro na/ lnga char la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes pa bstim pa rnams mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / re re bzhin dbang lha spyan 'dren pa dang /cod pan man chad la yang chu dbang bskur zhing / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang slob ma la bstim pa rnams mdzad do/ /phyag len bsdus pa ltar na/ slob ma me tog gang 'phog gi lha'am gtso bor bskyed la / chu dbang sngar bzhin bskur nas/ dbang lhag ma rnams la/ slob ma ting nge 'dzin 'pho ba mi dgos par snga ma'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pa la/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /chu dang rdo rje ma gtogs pa la tshigs bcad kyang bor ba ste/ 'di la slob ma las mchod pa'ang mi mdzad de/ dkyus ni gcung rdo rje rtse mo'i gsung ltar bkod pa yin la/ yig rnying phal mo cher gshin rje gshed rigs lnga rnams slob ma'i ba skru'i khung bur bstim par mdzad pa'ang yod pa/de ltar yang rung bas ci bder bya'o/ /gnyis pa rig sbyor brtul zhugs kyi dbang la/rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig sbyin pa ste gsum las/dang po ni/slob ma gtso bo'i nga rgyal byed du gzhug cing /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/huX las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur/ de nyid slob ma'i lag par sbyin la/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo —281—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ twa ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hūX/ lag pa g.yas su ma las nyi ma bsam la/ rdo rje gsor zhing / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /ces brjod du gzhug gnyis pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i rngang las a las byung ba'i dril bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur/ de slob ma la gtad de/'di ༷de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ a ka ro mu khaX/ sarba dharma naX/ a du nu tra sno twa ta/ dril bu dkrol zhing / dku g.yon pa rten du gzhug srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dge/ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra lha rnye a/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /gsum pa ni/ slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i nas/bzhugs pa'o/ /rang snang gi yum ro langs ma la 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ khren tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs//dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed//'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /mkhas mchog bzhugs par gyur gyi bar/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan —282—

mi 'da' byed par nus/ khres rab pha rol phyin pa thob/ /bsod nams byin rlabs kyis bsgrub pa/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /zhes brjod cing don bshad do/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba ni/gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur//zhes slob dpon gyis brjod cing dam tshig bsgrags pa na/ slob mas/ gtso bo ji ltar bka' stsa'/ pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum kyis bzung 7/phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsole// /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khordo ra la/slob ma bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzazhes sngags rgya lan bdun bya/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mkha' dbyings thams cad til gyi gang bu ltar gang bar gyur/ rol mo'i sgra wo po bsgrags shing /dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/phun sum tshogs pa sogs glo ka gsum dang /rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams sogs nas/ lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog gi bar du bya/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam pa can du gyur/ji ltar bltams pa nas/khiñtsa hu gi chu dbang /sangs rgyas kun gyi nas/hū gi bar gyis/ cod pan/shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin du/ /rdo rje dril bu rab bsgrub phyir//bu yis yang dag gus par bzung / khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi khri zhe spro smyo ༵༵ rdo dhi / dhi /༵ ༵/ ༵/ ༵dre/ mi / rjo hu/ rdo sa ༵ rdo~X bskuX/ —283—

ral gri bsangs sbyangs/ my-i las byung ba'i shes rab kyi ral grir gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa//las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung / /oṃ badz+ra khat+pa a bhi khiñtsa skyo/ pra las byung ba'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin mig thur du gyur/ slob ma'i mig la byab tshul du bya zhing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa la hū hi/ a las byung ba'i me long / gtad la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med//rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos//'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes brjod/ a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med//nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes dang /ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ oṃ badz+ra ra ga ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig /me long la/rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan 'a4 bar byas te bstan la/rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med//sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin te/ /bu khyod gyis ni snying la zhugs/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems kyang 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod/oṃ badz+ra he tu ma/rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du/ma las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga ra/ lag pa g.yas su/ sha las byung ba'i dung / oṃ —284—

badz+ra gar+bhe a/ lag pa g.yon du dril bu/ a zhes pas 'phang du rgyud kyi po ti bzhag deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa//brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten du/ /skyob pa rnams kyis ge bor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis//gsang sngags spyod pa thabs kyi tshul/ /'jig rten 'dir ni rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / khyed la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod cing don spyod/ slob ma rigs lnga'i 'khor los bsgyur bar mos pa la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin du gtad de/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba//chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ chos kyi zhes pa'i gnas su/ khro bo'i 'khor lo/ nor bu'i 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ las kyi 'khor lo/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas de kho na nyid bshad pa ni/ mnyam pa nyid phyir grub bzhi ste/ /nye bar bzhag dang yang dag spong / /rdzu 'phrul rkang dang dbang po ni/ /go rim bzhin du sgo bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni rta babs te/ /ting 'dzin bzhi ni kha khyer yin/ /de brten bzungs kyi rang bzhin no/ /'gro kun 'dul phyir phyogs sgo nas/ /rlung gi bskyod phyir dril sgra sgrog /byang chub yan lag rnam dag phyir/ /dra ba dra phyed la sogs spras/ /rnam thar brgyad ldan ka ba ste/ /rgyan bkod bkra ba mdzes pa ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs skong phyir/ /sna tshogs las kyi mthar thug phyir/ /pho brang sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar/ /theg chen 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir/ /rdo —285—

rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /sems can sems rnams grol bya'i phyir/ /mtshon rnams ye shes lnga yin no//dam pa'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir//byang chub sems gang ka pā la/ /bdug pa me tog mar me dang / /bsho/sa dang phyug pa la sogs pa/ /sgra brnyan byang chub yan lag dang / /dga' dang chos zas lus bde yin/ /ngo tsha khrel yod sdom pa yis/ /bde bskyed dbyangs dang gar sogs yin/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs phyir gzhal yas khang / /snying po len phyir dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes dang / dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /stobs rnams dag pa'i sgo gnas bzhi/ /byams sogs tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi/ /tsartsi ka sogs lha mo bzhi/ khren tu rnam dag la sogs lnga/ /zhe sdang gshin sgra la sogs pa'o/ /'khor ba ma chags pad+ma ste/ /nyi zla byang chub sems myu gu/ /gso dang smin par byed pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing don spyod do/ /de dag ni slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'o/ /gsum pa la/lung bstan/dbyugs dbyung /gzengs bstod/bya ba bsgrub par khas blang ba rnams las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon sprul sku shākya thub pa'i rnam par gyur te/ des lung bstan par mos la/ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kyai gshin rje mthar byed 'di zhes bya ba bhu ru snur wa sā/ gnyis pa ni/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir//mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur bas//sdig pa kun las nges grol nas//de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas//bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yon min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi bzod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir//srid pas —286—
