sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spangs mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya ste/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs te/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar bzung / /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ dam tshig gi chos skor ci rigs pa bshad cing bsrung bar gdams pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob mas/ gces bos ji ltar bka' sdi ngo pa pa/ /sogs lan gsum brjod do/ /dbang de rnams bskur bas/ rang don du dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba la dbang / gzhan don du dbang bskur dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du gyur/ gnyis ka'i don du las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub pa por gyur pa yin no/ /gal te rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par 'dod pas/ dbang gong ma don du gnyer ba rnams la mchog dbang bskur dgos shing / de yang nub cig po de nyid la bya bar 'dod na/ lung bstan sogs mtha' rten rnams kyis sngon du bya'o/ /de la gnyis las/ gsang dbang ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma slob dpon la phul bar mos te/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag med kyang / /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad/ /sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / khyod ni 'jig rten rjes —287—

'jug phyir/ /'jig rten bya ba ston pa mdzad/ /chu zla lta bur bzung du med/ /chos rnams kun la gnas pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing rmongs mi mnga'/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ /spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ khyod ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul zhing / /sna tshogs nyid la snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod la/ kyai/ yangs pa'i sbyan ldan drang zhing lcug la rol ba tshul bzhin mdzod/ /rnam dag ye shes chu des 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig pa khrus/ /byams pa'i gzugs mnga' bdag nyid che dang lhan cig brtsen mdzod la//thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin dag pa'i chus des bdag la dbang bskur cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod pa che/ /dbang bskur rab tu rmad byung ba//lha yi bde ba bzang po myong / /rgyal ba'i ro yis byang chub thob/ /ces gnang ba byin/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings la/ stong pa'i ngang las/slob dpon bcom ldan 'das gzhin rje gshed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin nas/dbus na bzhugs pa ca'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rig ma de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo'am ro langs ma rnam pa yab dang mtshungs pa las/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa chags pa'i nyams can du gyur/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa spro na/ mngon rtogs bzhi bya/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor lkoX dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/snying gar huX sngon po mi bskyod pa/ nye bar swa ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ gsang bar āXdamar po snang ba mtha' yas/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu don yod grub —288—

pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba nas/ bkag pa'o/ /oṃ sarba nas/ ko3haX/ sbyor mtshams nas bde ba'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar du zhu/ rdo rje dang pad+ma las blangs te slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag par mos/ btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod de ltar shes kyis kye/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig/hiXsgyiX'i mthar oX āXskyoX/ btags pas nang mchod sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra gu phya a bhi khri3 hūX/ zhes brjod/ byang chub kyi sems 'thungs pas bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar bsam ste/ a ho mahā su khaX/zhes brjod du gzhug thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas de mgrin pa nas brgyud de/ lus thams cad gang bas/ rnam smin tha mal gyi lus ngag rnam par dag ste/ gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi ngo bor mos su bcug he badz+ra pa shu/ zhes pas mig dar bkrol/ gsang ba'i dbang 'di thob pas/ lam rtsa rlung sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ slar yang shes rab ye shes bzhi pa dang bcas pa zhu bar 'dod pas/ gser sogs rin po che sna bdun dang / rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyis zhing khams thams cad bkang ste phul bar mos la/ phyag sngon du 'gro ba'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ slar yang bstod pa 'dis bstod de/ khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ /'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa'i//dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang / /skye mched rnams la mi brten zhing / /phyin ci log las rnam grol ba/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med/ /thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal —289—

lo//ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing //spros med gos pa med pa ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa'i rjes su/ gnyis med bde ba chen po'i sku/ /blo chen slob dpon khyod drin gyis/ /bde ba chen po gnyis med ni/ /rang gi sems kyis myang bar 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas sngar bzhin sgo ba bzhi'i sngags kyis mig dar 'ching du gzhug go /mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma mig yangs lang tshor ldan pa/ rig mar gtad par bsam zhing / slob ma dang / rig ma lag g.yon gyi srin lag sgrel bar gnas pa la/de nyid slob dpon gyi lag g.yon pa'i bzung ste/lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bkod la/ 'di skad ces/ rig ma mtshan mchog yon tan kun ldan ma/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis legs par spras pa mo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi skyed byed yum/ /bu khyod la ni nga yis gtad kyis longs/ /chos rnams thams cad gnyis med pa/ /gnyis kyi dngos pos mtshon par bya/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar bral bar mi bya'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /de nas rig ma des/nus sam dpa' bo rdo rje can/ /bha ga'i pad+ma ra nga nam/ /bshang gci zas su bza' nus sam/ /rang byung nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun gyi bdag po ste/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /rdo rje dbyings kyi pad+mo la/ /yang dag khyod kyis spyod nus sam/ /zhes dris pa la/ bha gar 'o byed lha mo kye/ khu kra rak+ta rkang dang ldan/ /bshang gci zas su bza' nus so/ /rang byung khyed kyi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun gyi bskyed pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma —290—

dpal ldan gzhin rje nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/tog /gsang ba chen po'i pho brang ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis rtag par/ /bdag kyang longs spyod byed par 'tshal//zhes lan gdab/stong pa'i ngang las/slob ma gtso bo zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang / rig ma phag mor gyur/ rgyas par spro na/mngon rtogs bzhin gsal btab/ gong bzhin mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang rjes chags kyi sngags brjod/ thabs shes rjes su 'jug pa snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba brtsam pa las/ 'khyud pa dang tsum+bha la sogs pas thob pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes/ zhe sdang gi rnam rtog so gnyis 'gags pa snang ba dang / /rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dus byas pa las/mchog dga'i ye shes/'dod chags rnam rtog bzhi bcu 'gags pa mched pa dang bsrub pa'i spyor ba las/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams rang gi lus la nye bar bcug ste/gzhir gnas kyi byang sems dang 'dres pa/rjes chags kyi mes zhu nas/gsang ba'i 'khor lor phyin pa ni/ khyad dga'i ye shes/ gti mug rnam rtog bdun 'gags pa/ snang ba thob pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems/rtsa 'phrang ba'i gnas su son pa/ gnyis shor gnyis gnas kyi skad cig ni/ lhan cig skye dgu'i ye shes 'od gsal ba'o/ /slar hu gi sbyor bas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi thob par mos su bcug sngar gyi sngags kyis mig dar bkrol/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang 'di thob pas/ lam bde stong sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i bde ba de nyid rang bzhin stong gsal/ smra brjod kyi yul las 'das pa/ snang ba ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ phyi snang stong dbyer med/ nang rig stong dbyer med/ 'bras bu bzhi pa'i ye shes yan lag bdun ldan dang mtshungs pa 'di ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ ji skad du/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus 291sto

pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi sgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid mi shes na/ /de kho na nyid sgom pa min/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes na/ /de ni sgom par rab tu sgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha sku/ bde ba/mi rtog pa gsum rtse gcig tu gyis la mnyam pa zhog cig ces brjod la sgom du gzhug de ni dbang bzhi pa ste gnyug ma'i don sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /mchog dbang 'di dag logs su bskur ba yin na yang skabs 'dir dbang gi mtha' rten rnams gong bzhin du bya'o/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang mthun pas shes so/ /gsum pa drag po dbang bdun la/ bsdus pa dang / rgyas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bum dbang gi mtha' 'am/ rjes gnang dkyus rnams song mtshams su/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gshin rje gshed nag dbang bskur ltar/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug kun 'dzin cing / /las rnams bla med kun bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang gi mchog/dbang bskur rab tu rmad byung ba/ /brtul zhugs chen po khyod kyis ni/ /bdag la bka' drin rab tu stsole/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas slob ma gcer bu skra bzhag pa'am/ yang na chas gos nag por bsgyur la/ral gri'i rjes gnang sngar bzhin bya ste dang po'o/ /gri gug gtad la/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang //gsod pa gsod pa ma yin te//dam tshig la sdang bsad pa yin/ /sems can gnod byed bsad par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig la sdang dgra chen po/ /do mthon khyod kyis bsad par byos/ /zhes drag po'i las kyi rjes gnang ste gnyis pa'o//thod khrag lag tu gtad la/khams gsum kun gyi khrag chen po/ /ma rungs snying nas drangs byos la/ khrag chen —292—

khyod kyis btung bar gyis/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug bla na med/ /lko sā ma ya pi wa hu/ be con gtad la/ rdo rje slob dpon brnyas byed dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / mi gang sngags dang rgyud dag gi /sbyor ba la ni 'phya byed pa/ /nan tan bskyed de bsad pa'am/ /yang na gnas nas spo bar bya/ /zhes pa ste gsum pa'o/ /shā ma ru dang dril bu tshangs skud rnams gtad la/ shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor pa/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du bsdud/ /pradz+nyā u pa ya gro hā hū a/ bzhi pa'o/ /bde gegatsa/gas mya ngan 'das kun kyang / /zhi ba'i mtha' las blang pa dang / /sna tshogs don rnams bya ba'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma lus 'du bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod de lnga pa'o/ /zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang mi ro'i gdan sbyin la/ zhing chen g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /ba chen gsar ba'i gdan la 'dug /spyod pa'i mchog ni kun gyis te/ /srid pa'i dam pa thob par byos/ /mahā sa mā ya/ a dhi pa ti stu/ zhes brjod de drug pa'o/ /drag po'i dmigs pa byed du bcug la/ 'di la mi bya ci yang med//de bzhin mi bza' ba yang med/ /rtag tu mi bsam pa yang med/ /smra bar mi bya cung zad med/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug 'dzin phyir dang / /las kyi mthar thug spyad pa'i phyir/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ces brjod de bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ gcen gtsang 'od kyis mdzad pa'i yig rnying rnams dang / lag len mthong ba brgyud pa las shes dgos shing 'di la shin tu bka' rgya dam par mdzad do/ /de'i phyir rgyas par mi 'bri la/ don gyi sdom tsam brjod na/ bdag bskyed 'gyer nyag rnal 'byor bzhi ldan sgom/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rwa khrag mtsho chos 'byung mthing / /nang du 'das pa'i lha dang phyi ru ni/ /ma —293—

gshin bcu drug bskyed cing spyan 'dren bya/ /phyi rol phyogs skyong rnams kyi'ang maṇ+ḍal bshams/ /mchod bstod bzlas pa cung zad byas nas ni/ /liṅga 'gug 'dren bsgral chog mchod gtor 'bul/ /ting 'dzin sgo nas drag po'i dbang bdun blangs/ /slob mas gsol btab sdom pa bzung ba la/ /sku bskyed spyan drangs sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag /sku las sku spros gdug pa tshar bcad bsam/ /drag po'i phreng gtad sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ /sngags 'byu bstim zhing drag po'i bzlas dmigs 'bogs/ /ral gri gri thod dbyug zhags rjes gnang sbyin/ /phyag mtshan bstim zhing mtshon bya'i sprin spro ba/ /de dag sku gsung thugs kyi dbang du bzhed/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / kha lnga bdud rtsi chang rnams yon tan dbang / /rgya gram rjes gnang 'phrin las spyi yi dbang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha bskul nas/ /liṅga dgug gzhug 'das dang 'jig rten pa/ /bsrung ba bsod nams bzhi yi kha spyor dbye/ /thun dang mtshon bya phur bus btab pas sgral/ /rnam shes spar zhing sha khrag gtor mar 'bul/ /lha dang dam tshig bsre ba drag po'i dbang / /ro gdan glang lpags stag lpags mgo 'phreng dang / /cod pan sbrul rgyan phur bu phyag mtshan drug/mas bkod phyag rgya chen po'i dbang zhes bzhed/ /drag po'i dbang bdun rgyas pa'i rim pa'o de ltar dbang gi rim pa de rnams la/slob ma'i dbang tsam las mi bskur na/de'i mthar sgom bzlas kyi lung tsam sbyin par bya'o/ /bum dbang tsam bskur zhing drag po'i las sgrub par 'dod nas/ de'i dbang don du gnyer na/ drag po'i dbang bsdus pa ni rjes gnang gi mthar sbyin la/ dbang rgyas pa ni nyi ma g.yin la sbyin no/ /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod pa rnams la ni/ mchog dbang yang sbyin te/sgos su gsol ba 'debs pa med na/ bum dbang tsam bskur ba dang / bsnyen pa ma song ba la drag po'i dbang rgyas pa mi byed par bzhed do/ /gang ltar na yang slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba rdzogs pa na/ 'grub na zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya zhing / slob ma'i srin lag g.yas pa/ slob dpon gyi g.yon —294—

pas bzung ste/ slob ma'i lus la bskor nas dgang blugs lan gsum tsam 'bul ba dang / me tog la sogs pa bsreg rdzas rnams kyang slob mas slob dpon la bstabs shing slob ma'i ming nas smos shing 'bul/ mthar smon lam dang bkra shis mang du byed/ de nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa gsar du mug mas shing / gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba byas/ oṃ khyed kyi nas/ nam mkhar gshe/gas kyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ yang mchod pa kha gsos la/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/gang yang bdag blo nas/sa thob tre(ga gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/yi ge brgya ba mang du bzlas la/ o ā hu mu/ zhes pas/ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/chos thams cad stong par mos bzhin du/rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ a ka ro'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ lha mtshan rnams thur mas blang /gzhan rnams rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rnga yab kyis dbang ldan nas bsdus la/ sna tshogs rnga 'i rol mo dang 'phan gdugs sogs kyis spyan drangs te/ skye te gi li gi li hu dza zhes pas chu bo chen por dor ro/ /de nas nang du 'ongs la rdo rje skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu rnams sngar btab pa'i rim pas phyungs shing / oṃ ru ru sbu ru sogs kyis phur bu dang phur stan 'o mas bkru/ mthar dga'aston dang bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /gang thugs 'jam pa'i dpal gyi rang bzhin las/ /bdud dang gshi/na rje'i tshogs la mthar byed sku/ /gsung dbyangs sngags kyis sa gsum 'khrul pa sel bcu gsum sa yi rang bzhin 'khor lo'i mgon/ /de nyid sgrub la smin byed dbang gi tshul/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba 'di/ /rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyis blang bya ste/ /bde chen tshul la nges pa'i tshig tu gsungs/ /dri ma kun spyong dga' bzhi'i tshul/ /snying po'i rang 'gros dbang bzhi'i lam/ /'di yis 'jig rten ma lus par/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen rgyal gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed —295—

nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'od 'bar zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la dpal jo mo nang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis/ dge legs 'phel/co gru rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / zhang rin chen 'o de zer dang / 'dzin pa rin she dang / kun mkhyen sang gha bha dra sogs kyi yig cha rnams la'ang 'dris par byas/ gtso bor gcung rdo rje rtse mo'i bshad 'bum che chung dang dkyil chog rnams dang sbyar te la li ta'i gzhung dang ci 'byor byas pa'o// //gcig zhus dag /

zhang 'u/gas bzhu/gas/ dpal ldan gshin rje gshed po dang / /bla ma mchog la gus bshud nas/ /rgyud rgyal le'u bco brgyad pa'i/ /dgongs don rdzogs rim bri bar bya/ /'dir dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la gzhol ba/ rdzogs rim gyi skal ba can dag cig mchog gi bsnyen pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ slob dpon de wā ka ra tsan+t+ra sa mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi pa bzhin shes dgos pa las/ 'di la 'khrid tshul gyi yi ge bod kyis sbyar ba med pa'i phyir/grags chung bas/bla ma'i man ngag dang / gong ma'i mchan bu rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs te/cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya'o/ /'di la sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar thig le'i rnal 'byor ram/dkyil 'khor gyi lha rags pa la'ang rung ste/ cha shas la sems ma yengs par 'jog pa ni/ so sor sdud pa'o/ /cung zad sems zin pa na/ lha'i gsal snang rags pa rdzogs pa la sems 'dzin pa ni/ bsam gtan yan lag lnga'i dang po rtog pa'o/ /lha sku phra mo la zhib mor sems 'dzin pa ni/ dpyod pa'o/ /de las sems dga' snang skye ba ni/ dga' ba dang / lus la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skye ba ni/ bde ba'o/ /lha sku'i gsal snang rang shar ba na/ sems rtog med du gnas pa ni/ rtse gcig pa'i yan lag go /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom pa mi lcogs na/ rnal 'byor bzhi pa bsdus pa las 'byung ba'i rim pa de nyid la sems bzung —297—

bas chog go /de nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ byang chub kyi sems mu tig dmar po lta bu mkha' nang du spros pa la sems bzung / rlung yang drag tu dgag go /yang nor bu'i nang du bhu yig gsal btab la/ thur sel gyen du drangs te/ mkha' nang gi thig le bhu yig gi steng du zil pa bzhin chags pa la sems bzung srog rtsol lo/ /de las rtags lnga 'char ba ni 'dzin pa'o/ /yang byang chub kyi sems nor bu'i bu ga nas phyir spros te/ rin po che zur brgyad pa'i rnam pa can du gyur te/yab yum gyi rtsa sgor phyed phyed chud pa la sems bzung de la cung zad brtan na/ rin po che de nyid kyi phyed phyed kyi 'od zer gyis yab yum so so'i sku gang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros te/ 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa spro zhing yang bsdu ba'o/ /de bzhin du rin po che'i gnas su/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gzhan rnams bsgoms pa'i dbye bas/dmigs pa de nyid rnam pa mang por 'gyur ro/ /yang sangs rgyas rnams zhal du bcug ste/ snying gar byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ sbyor mtshams nas 'khor lo la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par phyis spros pa/yang slar bsdus te sbyor mtshams su gnas pa la sems bzung la/ 'khor lo'i spro bsdu sku sangs rgyas rjes dran dang / pad+ma'i spro bsdu gsum chos rjes dran dang /rdo rje'i spro bsdu thugs rdo rje rjes dran dang / ral gri la sogs pa'i spro bsdu rigs rjes dran dang / lha bcu gsum gyi rnam pa spro ba ni khro bo rjes dran dang /bde ba bsgom pa ni dam tshig rjes dran te drug go /rjes dran gyi yan lag go /yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs zhal du bcug snying gar zla ba'i steng du thig ler gyur/—298—

sbyor mtshams kyi thig le yang yar drangs te/ snying ga'i thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid spro bsdu bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag go /de dag ni/ dang po'i rnal 'byor ro//de nas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs yin na bsdu zhing /de ltar min na/gzhal yas khang dang / gtso bo skad cig gis rdzogs par bskyed la/ yan lag lhag ma rnams rdzogs par bya/ snying gar nyi dkyil la hu bsgom ste/ so sor rtog pa'i yan lag go /de las 'od spros te/ snang ba thob pa'i yan lag go /de las srid pa gsum spros te mched pa'o/ /tshur bsdus te sems tsam du bsgom pa ni/ don gyi phyogs gcig pa'o/ /de bzhi ni sngags la dmigs pa'o/ /'od zer tshur bsdus pa'i hu la gsal stong gnyis su med par 'jog pa ni/ sems la dmigs pa'o//slar yang 'od 'phros pa thob pa/de las don byas pa mched pa/hu las mi bskyod par gyur pa ni mthong lam gyi don no/ /lus rdo rje skye mched la dpyad pa'o/ /dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pa/ /zhes sogs dang / lus dang ngag dang sems dmigs na/ /sogs brjod cing stong nyid bsgom pa ni/ ngag rdo rje'i skye mched la dpyad pa'o/ /thur sel gyen du bskyod pas/ sbyor mtshams kyi dra dbu ma'i lam brgyud sna rtser sleb/ rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar nyi ma la hu gis mtshan par gyur te/sna bug g.yas kyi lam nas spros te/g.yon nas bsdus/snying ga'i hu la thim pa ni/sems rdo rje'i skye mched la dpyad pa'o//gnas gsum du rdo rje gsum bkod nas/mngon rtogs bzhin nga rgyal bzung /de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad lha mo bzhi'i rnam par bsdus te/ thig le dmar po'i rnam par gyur/ so sor zhu ste yab kyi nor bur dkar po/ yum gyi sna rtser —299—

dmar po/ sbyor mtshams su dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa la sems drag tu gtad/ sgo gsum car gyi skye mched la dpyad pa'o/ /yang rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom ste/ mngon rtogs bzhin nga rgyal bzung nas/ mkha' nang nas mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba sogs mngon rtogs bzhin byed pa ni rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /de dag ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar lam rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob nas/sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bris te/ rig ma dang bcas pas spros bcas kyi spyod pa byed pa ni/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs so/ /'di la rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de la cung zad brtan pa thob nas/ phyi dkyil la sogs pa spangs te/ 'od gsal du ldang 'jug kho na sbyangs te/ phyi rol kyi rkyen las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgyas mtshams sbyar te/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe chos thams cad bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes dang / rjes thob kyi tshe/ ye shes de'i snang ba ma 'gags pa snang grags thams cad lha skur 'char ba la yang yang bslab/ spyod lam thams cad kyang de nyid kyi rang bzhin du shes par byed pa ni mgon po kun tu dpyod pa'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /'di dag ni 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dang /lam 'gros shin tu mthun zhing / rgyud gyi rgyal po 'di nyid las/ le'u lnga par mkha' gsang byin rlabs gsungs pa sogs dang / le'u bdun par khrag dgug pa dang / khu ba dgug pa gsungs pa sogs kyi nges don dang / gzhan yang le'u bdun pa dang / bco lnga pa dang / bco brgyad pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i tshig mang po la/nges don gyi bshad pa sna tshogs pas grub pa'i don de wa ā ka ra tsan+t+ra'i gzhung gis gsal bar mdzad pa mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis thugs nyams su —300—

bzhes pa'o/ /slob dpon lha'i 'byung gnas zla ba de nyid dang / zhang lotsā ba shes rab bla mas bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bzang po 'di dag la/mkhas par grags pa kha cig kyang rgyu mtshan med par mthing slad byed mod kyi brag cha lta bur shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ mchog gyur man ngag dam pa rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i gzhung mchog dang / /la li tas mdzad byung ba'i gzhung 'di sngon byon mkhas dang grub la tshad mar grags/ /gzigs rgya che ba'i bar skabs mkhas 'ga' dpal 'dzin gzhung dang mi mthun pas na the tshom gnas zhes smra//da lta kun gyis shes pa lta zhog ming yang ma thos kho bo 'ba' zhig chos 'di thos pa'i skal ba bzang por gyur/ /la li ta'i gzhung dang / dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung la/mi 'dra ba than thun yod du chug kyang / bde mchog pū nag ltar srol ka tha dad yin pas/bsre ba dang dgag pa gnyis ka mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge'o/ /zhus dag /—301—

dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo gu ru budha bodhi sa te khyo: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyilag bor gyi sgrub thabs bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo gang zhin nyin byed 'bum phrag brgya yi gzi 'od 'bar zhing 'khrug ldan pa//srid gsum las rgyala'achi bdag sder bcas thal bar brlag mdzad dbyug pa dang //kun rtog thod pa bdud bzhi sgral ba'i khrag can phyag gi bgyon du ste/ /'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i skur ston khyod kyis bdag cag 'jigs pa med par mdzod/ /grub pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /bi rā pa zhabs rjes 'brangs te/ /gshin rje gshed dpal sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis bshad/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas pa'ang //'di yi mchog tu dgyes gyur te//'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang //bgegs rnams rab tu nyams par mdzod/ /'dir sgrub po dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor gyi yan lag rnams tshogs par byas nas/ skyabs su 'gro bdang sems bskyed pa ci nus su bsgom mo/ /de nas/ rang skad cig gis skyon rje gshed dmar po dpa' bo cig par gyur/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūX dmar po yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/oṃ ya mun+ta ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ ya mun+ta ka tī no pa tiṣ+ṭha zhes sogs dang / ya mun+ta ka mā me muñtsa ya mun+ta ka bha wa mahā samāya satwa āX zhes 'don pa spos la yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ mjug tu/ bdag dang lha dang nyes —302—

ltung thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud//gshin rje gshed dmar bdag grub mdzod/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad bya zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang skad cig gis gzhan rje gshed dmar du gsal ba'i snying gar aX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa/de'i nang du nyi ma la hūX dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bla ma la phyag bya/ de nas/ oX na mo rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wāramaṇ+ḍal khyuX bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /zhes dkyil 'khor la phyag byas/ oX hruXsgyiXha/ zhes pas mchod yon/ oX huX huX phaṭa/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ lkoX ku ma ra ru pi ṇi dzaXdzaX zhes pas me tog oṃ rdisaXha hiphaṭa/ zhes pas sa dug spos/ oṃ di sta lo tsa na bi kri tā na na mahā aṭa sna ha sa na din di lta ya swāhā/ zhes pas mar me/ oX bi kri tā na na du : ༷ satwa da ma ka gaXgaXgaX zhes—303—

pas dri mchog dang / oṃ badz+ra nai we rkye āXhuX swāhā/ zhes zhal zas te nyer spyod dang / oX dra pa badz+re ṇi hūX/ gis gzugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ shasta badz+re ṇi huX/ gis sgra/ oṃ ga rnye badz+re ṇi huX/ gis dri/ oṃ rā sa badz+re ṇi spyiX/gis ro//oṃ spar+sha badzi ṇi hūX/ gis reg bya/ oṃ dharma dha tu badzi ṇi hūX/ gis chos khams rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod/ de nas rgyun bshags ni/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig /sogs sam/ yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//sogs yan lag 'dun pa gur nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la//bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi//dam pa'i chos ni kun ston pa'i//sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs sdo/ ga the sol/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ tseX( badz+ra muX zhes gshegs/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/oṃ su bhā wa shurnyaXsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam mo//snying ga'i huX gi 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ oṃ yo ga bi shudha sarba dharmaXyo ga bi shurnyo3haX/ rang sems lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ lha'i rnam pa/ yang snying kha'i nyi ma dbyug pa dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang hūX la thim/zhabs kyu khog pa la/de mgo bo la/de zla tshes la/de yang nā da la/nā da yang stong pa nyid du thim/ stong pa'i ngang las smon lam gyi dbang gis/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab gru —304—

bzhi bang rim bzhi pa lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de las 'od 'phros skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba rnams grub par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhuX las gzhal yas khang pa ni/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs dang ni ka ba brgyad//rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin//dkar ser dmar ljang sngo bas mdzes/ /gzhan yang 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ pha gu/ shar bu/ dra phyed mda' yab rnams dang ldan pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang bum pa dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'o/ /lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ mtshams rnams su zla ba'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de zhu ba las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mar+sā pa'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad gzhin rje mthar byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ huX la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad skad cig gis grub pa ni/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po dpa' bo nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung po 'bar ba la/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'byud pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po la/ yum tsar tsi ka nag mos 'byud pa/lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po la/yum phag mo ser mos 'khyud 3༷5

pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la/ yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la/ yum go ri ljang mos 'byud pa/ dpa' bo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal cung zad gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pas rgya cher bzhad pa/sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo oṃ pa ser pos mtshan pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa bdud mtha' dag khrag sa gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ma he'i steng du gshin rje sngon po dbyug pa dang zhags pa thogs pa rnam par rdzi bar mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang /stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa bdud dang gshin rje ma lus pa skrag par mdzad cing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang lngan pa// yum thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yab dang 'dra ba las/ gcer bu mi mgo skam po'i do shal can dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas yab la 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ khar lhor mu men gser chab kyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ lho nub tu gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ nub byang du byi dra'i bum pa siglas gang ba/byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba/ thams cad kyang thod pa bdud —306—

rtsis gang bas kha brgyan pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo sgro pa ser bos mawo pa/ de'i nang du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX dmar po/ yum gyi mkha' āXlas pad+ma dmar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las rdo rje sngon po snyoms pa zhugs pas bde bas rgyud gang / tsho( sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ shes rab kyi lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa rang la kha phyogs pa'i lte bar hiXdamar po/ lha mo dang bdag nyid kyi spyi bo'i haX yig las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i re kha dkar po pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ba rnyiXyig gi rtse mor 'bab par gyur/snying khar huX sngon po/mgrin par āXdamar po/spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyi sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum du thim pas rdo rje gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ huX las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX a bhi khri nyu hwa/ maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa//sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyi dbu brgyan/ slar yang huX gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaX.oṃ badz+ra pulpe āXhūX/zhes sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes dgug gzhug bcing —307—

mnyes byas/ snying ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ hūṃ la thim/ 'dir 'phreng ba byin brlab ni/ 'phreng ba gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang ye shes pa spyan 'dren dbang bskur rnams byas la/ hriXsgyi0༷ 'ga' zung bzlas de zhu ba las khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i 'phreng bar gyur par bsam/ byin wos kyi don du/khyoXsgyiX 'phreng ba bskor cig bzla'o//de nas thugs ka'i nyi ma huX gi tha mar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar bsam lasngagaXs baXzla ste/ tsho'o heXsgyiXwi kri ta na na hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ces pa ni snying po'i sngags so//glu lha klo k+ṣa ye ka rā grit+na grit+na huX hūṃ phaṭa/nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so//oṃ mahā yak+ṣa sen a dhi pa ta ye/ mahā du ra dan+ta da ma ka ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ bi dra pa ya bi dra pa ya huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dī ṣa ra tāX nu da nu da tru ṭa tru ṭa hūX dzaswāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /oṃ mo hwa n+ta krita hūX phaṭa/ o pi shu nān+ta krita huX phaṭa/ oṃ ragā na ta kri ta hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ir rtsi zhi kri ta huX phaṭa/ dpa 'bo bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ mo hā ra tī huX dzaX a pi shu na rī tī hūX dzaX oṃ rā ga mi tā huX dzaX oṃ ir rtsi ra tī hūṃ dzaXdapa' mo bzhi'i sngags so/ /de nas spron skabs 'dir/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pa dang /nang mchod dang /a ye/ zhes sogs kyi bstod pa rnams/'og maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i skabs ltar bya'o//snying kha'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang bcud thams cad lha tshogs su gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang lha rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' dang / de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dang / de yang nā da'i bar du thim/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings la mnyam par gzhag—308—

slar yang stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsam la/dag pa 'di rnams yid kyi dran par bya'o//de yang dmar ba nyid ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa brlag pa'i don no/ /spyan gsum ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta byung ba'i dus gsum gyi phyir ro/ /phyag gnyis ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rtog pa 'joms pa'o/ /shes rab la 'byud pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje tha mi dad pa'i sbyor bas so/ /klu brgyad ni rnam par shes pa brgyad mtshon pa'o/ /mgo bo brgya phyed kyi 'phreng ba ni/ ye ge lnga bcu'i spyor bas so/ /g.yon na thod pa ni ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i ros yongasasu gang ba'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yas na dbyug pa ni/ phung po dang /nyon mongs pa dang / lha'i bu dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa'i rang bzhin can no/ /g.yon brkyang gi gom stabs ni khams gsum rnam par gnon pa'o/ /lha mo'i phyag g.yon pa'i thod par bdud bzhi'i khrag ni ro dang bcud len du ma kun nas myang ba'i phyir ro/ /g.yas pa rdo rje'i gri gug ni dngosapo dang dngos med kyi rnam rtog gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /gdug pa snyul phyir khro lo gzugs nyid do/ /gsus pa che ba ni mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyasapa'i phyir ro/ /ngos bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam gyi bden pa bzhi rab tu ston pa'i phyir ro/ /sgo bzhi ni/ bdud bzhi kun nas skrag pa'i phyir ro/ /zur bzhi ni/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rab tu rdzogasapa'i phyir ro/ /ka ba brgyad ni/ rmi lam lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang /—309—

sprul pa lta bu dang / brag cha lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig/ rgyu lta bu dang / me long nang gi gzu gas brnyan lta bu dang / chu'i zla ba lta bu ste/ brgyad kyi rang bzhin las/ nam mkha' lhar dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i nyon mongs pa 'jomasapa'i phyir sgo/nang gi rtog pa rab tu 'joms pas dra ba phyed pa'o//rta babs bzhi ni/ sbyin pa dang / snyan par smrab dang /don spyod pa dang /do myo/ mthun pa nyid dang /yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don no/ /zhes so/ /'di rnams tshig tu brjod dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang ngo / /de nas snang ba thams cad lha skur bltas la dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o / / /gal te maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal legs par 'dus byas la/༵ sa/hūṃ dhi badz+ra sgri sbyi dzhai /zhes ༵ dā~X hūṃ rdo/rma/ ༵ re rnyi ༵༵ / thug/sdu ti thi ༵spra /gi ta//༵dzi ༵ u hu lhi swahā//go sdu /bu/sngu kau / ༵ sbyi rdo ༵ hūṃ dzhai ༵ sdi rnyi tsar tsi kā a ling ga ta kan+ta rā ya oṃ ā hū phaṭa swāhā/ shar du dang / oṃ pi shu na ya mā ri ye badz+ra wa ra sdi a li gi ta ca rā ya ur hu phaṭa swāhā/ lho phyogs su dang / oṃ rā ga ༵ lja ya ༵ rjo rdo ༵༵ sna ri ༵ ༵ sna ta ta sna ka kan+ta nā ༵ dhi hu pha rdo rdo /hā//byang du /nga /༵ / rnga rdo rdo ri / hūṃ ༵ ༵ u hu pha sna rno khro/bde ༵ ༵/ //nga /me~X ༵ hūṃ ༵/ snya sna ༵ si sbyi rdorlo/dbang ldan du ste /spri//snyeg gi ༵ dī/rnams dī kod / zu/ ༵ lgi rnyi nga sna / smu ༵ ༵ s+tha ༵rde—310—

'khor rnams phyung ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gzhin rje gshed zhes pa nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /yi bar gong bzhin bskyed la/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro snyasmade bzhin du pu duX dang /yang oX badz+ra purmye āXhūX/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ne be rkye/ oX badz+ra shasta āXhūX/ zhes pa'am/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar sbyar ba'o//gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phul kyang rung bas gang 'dod pa blang ngo //spro na 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang ste/ /bla ma gzhin rje gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /zhes sogs 'don pa spos te/ rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ so so'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ 65 ye kye kye gzhin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ khyod kyis gar gyis sa steng dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa khro ba'i yid//gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags//sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste//rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis bshud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hiXsgyiX'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul ba sel/ /thugs rjes khros pa'i rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin chen —311—

rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal//'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ khyab bdag chags pa chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tsha4// /zhes bstod/ skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa sogs kyang spro na bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong spyan 'dren pa nas/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar skabs 'dir bya/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces dngos grub blangs/de nas yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod/oṃ mu swāhā/dkyil 'khore pa rnams rang gi snying khar thim/zhes smon lam dang /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'ang brjod par bya'o//'di'i maṇ+ḍal cho ga rang lugs ni 'di yin la/ dam ye rgyas gdab sogs bskyed chog spros pa byed pa'ang yod do//gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/zas bzang dgu sha chang nya sha sogs kyis sbags pa la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ yaX las rlung / raX las me/ ru ru ru las mi mgo'i chiskyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i hūX las thod pa dum bu gsum pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir/ na go ku da ha las/ mi dang ba glang khyi dang rta mchog glang po che rnams kyi sha dbus dang mtshams bzhir/ mu bi ra shu ma rnams las/ dri chu dri chen rak+ta byang sems rkang mar rnams su gyur/ de'i steng du oṃ las zla ba/ de la gnas pa'i huX las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/—312—

rlud g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing dbyug pas lan gsum du dkrugs pas/zla ba rdo rje dbyug pa dang bcas pa yang 'od du zhu nas dngul chu'i rnam par lta ja/ra sdo/ra/tseX( zhes/ lag pa ga sku(na pa bstan/ ni/༷༷zhes g.yas pa bstan/rdo rteXzhes/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan/ hūX zhes 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya ste 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya bstan/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsibakug ste 'dres/dzaXhuX baX hoX'adud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ces byin gyis brlabs/rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaXgong ltar mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugasapar gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo ljags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros snying po'i mthar/ huX sarba du niX in+ta a dī na zu pa ri bā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX phyogs skyong rnams bkug ste phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/shar du dbang po ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nye dbang nag po mkha' lding la zhon pa 'khor lo/ dung dbyug pa/ pad+ma rnams 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/nub tu chu lha dkar po sbrul la zhon pa sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod spyin ser po gter la gnas pa lī dza pū ra dang ne'i le 'dzin pa/ tshogs bdag dkar po byi ba la zhon pa glang po'i gdong can 'phreng ba dgra sta la du la phug rnams 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha di dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngon po ro langs la zhon pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu ri dwags la zhon pa rlung ras 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du 'byung po dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum dang —313—

thod pa 'dzin pa go ri la 'byud pa/steng du zla ba dkar po rta la gnas pa ku mu da 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyi drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa zhal bzhi spyi blugs mchopo spyin dbyug pa bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas shing bum pa 'dzin pa dang / thag bzang ris sngon po shing rta la gnas pa ral gri dang sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa'o/ /'dir bī rū pa'i gzhung kho na ltar na nye dbang dang tshogs bdag ma bskyed kyang rung bar mtho no/ /de dag gi 'khor du srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi bskor bar gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas phur bu thogs pa'i khro bo rnams spros te phyogs skyong rnams phur bus btab/snying po'i mthar/ hū sarba du ni in+ta ā dī na sa pa ri wā ra gī la ya hu phaṭa swāhā/ phur bus btab pa'i rkyen gyis thams cad 'od gsal du bcug nas/stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis skyon rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ bsdus par na tso btab med kyang rung ngo //phyogs skyong kho na la gtor ma 'bul na/ dbus su tshangs pa/ de'i mdun du zla ba/ rgyab tu nyi ma/ g.yas su nor 'dzin ma/ g.yon du thag bzang ris rnams bskyed pa khyad par ro/ /zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed pa mi lcogs na ming tsam brjod do/ /gang ltar yang / de thams cad kyi dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā snying khar hu/ thams cad kyang bsgrub pa po'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad par bsam/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ o rak+ta mu ku ṭu ya/ rak+ta dza ṭa ya/ rak+ta mu ji ya/ rak+ta dzo lta ༵ ā/ sna ghā dzā/ ༵bha/ ༵ dhi rnyi hūṃ dhi zlo ༵/ nā ༵/dba~X dho dho gro hā rū/ spya ༵/ —314—

'uX ha ra ha ra tsi shu rma rā na/ ni ba ra ya/ ni ba ra ya/ tru sa ya tru sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/tshin+da tshin+da/ dhin+ta dhin+ta/nā sha ya nā sha ya/sho khri ya sho khri ya/tshe da tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ skyoX hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ mo ha ya mā ri ye skyoXphaṭa swāhā/ zhes sogs/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa dpa' bo bzhi la rang sngags dang /oṃ ma sme ma smi bigha te huX/ badz+ra tsartsi ka ha ra ha ra bhu sproX mā rā ya mā rā ya bigha nāX dzaXlkoX sto ne su sto ṇi badz+ra mā ma gī bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sa lhar/ ha ra ha ra bigha nāX dzaX.oṃ ma sme ma smi/ a klo khyu ṇi badz+ra sa ra spyo sti/ da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ka spa ka spa/skyon dhu na/ huX bigha nāX dzaX zhig sdi ra badz+ra karti ka gha gha huX/ rak+ta sho ṇi ta pri ye go rī ya bigha nāX dzaX zhes pas lha mo bzhi la 'bul/ oṃ ir+sā ya na maXsdiX ya ma ya na maXsgyiX pā zad kyi nā ya na maXwi/ ku be rā ya na maXkṛ/ i shā nā ya na maXta/ asna ye na maX.aX ni ṛ te na maXn/ bā ya be na maXn/ tsan+t+ra ya na maXhūX/ arka ya na maXhuX/ pra h+ma ne na maXphaṭa/ba su dha rī ni yi na maXphaṭa/be+e ma tsi tri na maXsnya/sarba bhu te lcoXn maXhā/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ huX huX huX/ phe phe phe swāhā/ zhes pas phyogs skyong bcul 'bul/ de nas tshogs zhing skabs ltar/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod kyis mchod/hruXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ āXhūX/ btags la nang mchod 'bul/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod pas bstod/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bco lnga'i tshogs la bstod/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /wo sogs 'dod don gsol ba gagade nas yig brgya bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byore pa dang nyams pa dang / /gangayang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyid pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de yang mgon —315—

pos bzod par ma sgo//ha ha he he ho ho hū ཾ hu/oṃ khyod kyis smos can don kun mdzad//rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang //slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol//oṃ badz+ra mu zhes gshegs su gsol/dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul bar 'dod na/'theb kyu drug cu rtsa bzhi bya/sngags sbrel ba kha drug bcu tshan bzhis 'bul/'dra drug tshan re re'i mthar mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btang rnams bya'o//gzhan yang nyal ba dang /ldang ba dang /khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang /ji ltar longs spyod pa thams cad thog mar bla ma gshin rje gshed la 'bul bal sogs pas/myin mtshan khor yug tu rnal 'byor la mi gad la bar brtson pas gnas na myur du las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa dang /lo bstoganyis tsam gyis ni 'byung po thams cad kyis mngag gzhug byed cing /grub pa chen po bgyod la sogs pa 'grub par the tshom med do//zhes pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis nges pa'o//'dir smras pa/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub kyis//mi bsrun bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'thag byed cing //ma rig 'chi bdag drung nas 'byin 'dod pas//srid gsum rgyal thabs 'di la nan tan byos//'jam dpal khros pa'i sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di//sdom brtson bshes gnyen mang pos bskur ba'i ngor//'khrul med lung rigs man ngag ji bzhin du//rnal 'byor spyod pas rgyal po'i kha bdu bris//bcom ldan 'das gzhin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/'dud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/stan cig pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas mgrin gcig tu bskul ba'i ngor/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer drug pa lasmras pa'o//slar rang lo so gcig pa'i mthar shin tu dag par byas so//gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud gzhung dang //man ngag ma nor snab yi//phyi rabs mkhas pa tshes nyung zhing //deng sang yod na snang 36
gzhung lta bas ngal/ /thams cad shes pa 'ga' tsam srid/ /ces pa'ang smras pa yin no// //dgolegs 'phel/ bkra shis/

dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsal bar bstan pa bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshon rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug gsal bar bstan pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i las can rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'dus gsal go bde ba/ /gzhan laphan pa'i bsam pas 'dir 'chad kyi/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis dge bar mdzod/ /de la sa'i cho galhag par gnas pa/dngos gzhi'i cho ga rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/sngon 'gro gtor ma la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ las kyi rdo rjes sngon 'gro gtor ma'i zhu 'bul bya/ a mṛ tas bsang / su bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas dang g.yon dngaganyis ka rim gyis bstan la/ tsho( āXhuX zhes brjod/ te stoXzhes bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / huX zhes 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang /gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri lha ra khyiX sarba k+ṣitra pā le smyaX sarba bhā mi pa ti sa pa ri wā re khyuX sarba bhā te smyoX oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin du༄/ pu duX zhes sbyar chu gnyis 'bul/ oṃ da she di ka sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa bco brgyad kyis 'bul/ de nas oṃ da sha di ka sogs kyi mthar/ pulpe nas —318—

shasta'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ kun grub shog gi bar brjod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don gyi phyir/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs par bzhengs te/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i bsrung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig hiXsgyiXdrag tu bzla zhing / rdo rje gsor/ rol r+ṣa dang 4sa te gtor ma gtsang sar btang ngo / /gnas yo byin rlabs kyi don du zhu 'bul byas la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis/ mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ huX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas/rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung / byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag re/da kyi bde bas tshim par byed pa/ tho bo kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bzang zhing rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/oX badz+ra arnyaX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pu duX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pulpe āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āXhūX/ oX —319—

badz+ra ā lo ke āXhūX/ oX badz+ra ga rnye āXhū ཾ ༷/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi te āXhūX/ oX badz+ra sha lta āXhuX/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ skye tshe badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX/ lan gsum brjod/ rol wo dang gos/ oṃ badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba brnya spu tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ na da saX bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ sa rnyo ṣa ni/ hūX hūX huX/ho ho ho/ a khaX swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ zhu 'bul ni/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal bshams/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bkye/ /phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /phyag gsum btsal la gral du 'khod/ /ces pa ltar yin pa las/ gzhan rnams lag len mthong ba nyid kyis shes shing / gsol gdab ni/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas la/nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed/ zhes pa nas/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don no/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs yongs su rdzogs par sgom mo/ /sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su/ dri bzang gi thig le la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oX rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX huX phaṭa snyusmalag pa g.yas pa sa la reg rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX tshom bu'i steng du baX yig tu gyur pa 'khod/ baX las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 320—

pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lto ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor nas thon pa/ bdag la mngon du phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ oX pri shrī de swe sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā na maX zhes mchod yon phul nas/ eXkhro shrī de lī zhes pa la/ puspro sogs btags te nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar/ huX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha hoXhruX oX pri shrī de waṃ sa pa ri wā ra khyuX zhes pa la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la//lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /bcom par byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /lko ni gsum brjod/dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces brjod cing gnang ba thob par bsam/ pri shrī'i mtshan sngags la ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis btags pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/lha sta gon ni/ oX āXhūX/ lan gsum gsum gyis/gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang / gzhan 'khor bzhi dang bum pa'i gnas rnams su zlum po re bya'o//lha rnams la so so'i rang sngags lan gsum gsum dang / bum pa bzhi la 'bru gsum lan gsum gsum gyis tshom bu bkod la/ mtha' bskor du lha grangs las mi nyung ba'i mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len ltar bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tsho gos pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan/ oX—321—

sdiXsgyiXsogs/ o de ṣa ra tī sogs/ oX mo rnyan spo ta nas/ ir rtsi ra tī hūX dzaX dbusakyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed zhes pa nas/ gangabs kha brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ dzaXhūX baX hoX'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/rdo rje'i sa gzhi zhes pa nas/ grwahwa'i bar/sa lha'i skabs ltar mtshams bcing / gong bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/rgyas par na/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar ram/ bsdus par na/ phyi mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/nang mchod/bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byas la/gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyang sgrub thabs bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas/ khro/ rnge1 zhes pa nas/phyogs skyong rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i bar yang sgrub thabs ltar ro//de nas spos snod dang 4sa pa'i rdor dril thogs te/ gshin rje gshed rdor bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni bri bar 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams//bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen r+sha bdag /gshin rje gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro bas spyad phyir bri bar bgyid//rang bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /tshogs —322—

pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas pa mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba thob par yang bsam/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/oṃ badz+ra spru’tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'brugasum gyis nang ma rdzo phul/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /spa pa nas/ dkyila'akhor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /lko bstod/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir bzhugs la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i bar chad bsrung zhing / slad nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa dang /sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas grwahwas mtshams bcing ngo / /bum pa sta gon ni/ de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa drug gam gnyis/ kha dog dkar po'i bsgyur/ ras bzang po'i mgrin pa dkri/ hru ༷༷sgyiX bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug thams cad lamatshan ma ni/ pad nyi laganas pa'i dbyug pa 'od zer 'phro ba kho na 'god do/ /de rnams chu gtsang mas bgang / bum rdzas sum cu rtsa lnga blug shing bzang po'i yal gas kha brgyan/ stegs bu gang yang rung ba la/ g.yas su dbang gi bum pa lnga po lnga tshom dang / g.yon du las bum bkod/ mdun du mchod pa dang / gtso bum gyi steng du/ dung chos spos chus gang ba dang gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bkod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du paX las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ khag yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcing pa/dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis—323—

yongs su gang ba'i/ bum pa rnams kyi nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de yang dbus su/ ya las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ dpa' bo nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung po 'bar ba la yum rdo rje ro langs ma dang dmar mos 'byud pa/ shar du smyelas gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po la yum tsartsi kā nag mos 'byud pa/ lho ru ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po la yum phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ byang du las bum gyi nang du da las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum go rī ljang mos 'khrud pa/ dpa' bo nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mtshams bzhir pad zla la/shar lhor mu men nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /bum pa gnyis las med na/rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma'i gdan re re dbus su ya la sogs gong dang 'dra ba bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la nas/ kha brgyan pa sho /zhes brjod/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar lkoX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/rdo rje 'dzin pa nas/ dzaXhuX baX hoX'i bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhi/ gzungs thag nas bzubārang gi snying ga nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa rnams gang bar gyur/ so so'i sngags brgya rtsa re dang / hiXsgyiX lhag par mang bar bzla'o/ /las bum la hiXsgyiX gang 'os dang / hūX bdun bzlas la/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/zhes pa'ang lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzla/mchod pa byin rlabs —324—

gong bzhin/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la da lnga dus sdo/ba ma lus pa rgyu nyam du gse(la/ces gsol ba btab/las bum gyi chu ku shas blangs te/ bum pa rnams la bskor zhing / gnas dang yo byad sogs la gtor/ ji srid dkyil 'kho/ragyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzod ༵༵ pa tshi dī shā dhi mar kau ༵/༵ snro ༵sna ༵༵ rmi /nang gi / rnam ༵ ༵ḍi ༵ kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu/ bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces pa'o/ /slob ma sta gon dbang chog chen mor lta'o/ /gsum pa la dkyil 'kho 3 bri ba dang / sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba gsum las/dang po ni/ras bal gyi srad bu kha dog sna lnga brkyang la/ mchod pa bshams/'bru zhesda nga ye kau dho lted/ sngon rdo/ da /dzhai rdo rnyi ༵ ༵ dhi/ ༵ga skyon rnyi dhi rdo ṭā/rdo ga/ sa dhi sna sna chi sdo /hā tā/ hūṃ spu ḍi / ༵ sa phra/ / dog dhi sna ༵ gshe/da ljang khu/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa'o/ /dpral bar tse(/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/zhe~X sdi ༈ḍi / rlo/ sdo~X nga gi / rdo~X sdi rdo ༵ dhi lti je/ rnam ༵ rdo glu ༵/dī dhikhi ྅ mi rdo hub lha lto ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni —325—

mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum//gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod//rnam pa snang mdzad dag pa che//rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che//rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog/ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo//rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab//rdorje nam mkha' dri ma med//rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med//rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che//mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin//'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes//rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo//don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa//dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud lngar gyur/ mig gnyis su dzaXlas byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/mig 'bras huX du gyur/'bar ba'i lta stangs dang bcas pas brdzim bsdeb cing / oṃ di rteXchisko a du sha dzaX de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs rnamasaspyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ oṃ āXpra ca de ṣa kwa la a ri swa tsakra snyu tra na ya huX/ de bzhin du dre ṣa'i gnas su/ mo ha dpa/ pu shu nā dang / rā ga dang / ir rtsi zhes pa rnams bcug la lan gsum gsum bzlas pas gsol ba btab ste/ las kyi rdo rje phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal bzung ba dang lhan cig thig skud sgril bzhin du/ o.a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmya pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra bri ni/ sarba dharmu ud+man+ta/ a nu pra khrug sarba dharmā huX/ zhes ci nus su brjod do/ /de nas dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag ste/ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ khyoXsgyiXbazlas te bgrung ba bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhi dris byugs/ me tog sil ma bkram/ nam mkha'i dbyings su dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo —326—

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas thig sna phyogs gcig lte ba'i thad du bzung nas/ slob dpon bden bral du gnas nas/ dbang ldan du phyogs pa dang / slob ma dbang ldan nas bden bral du phyogs pas gnas pa las/ rje cho rje ne rjeb zhes gnyis kas brjod bzhin du thig sna gtod cing len/ de nas slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas/ o ā badz+ra sa mā ya mū tra ma ti kra ma hū/ sems can don la khyod rnams kyi/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces dang por nam mkha' dang / de nas sa la gdab bo/ /rim pa de nyid kyis thig chen brgyad po gdab pa yin te/ de yang / nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po/ /g.yas bskor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab//me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas//rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig gdab/ / gnyis sdeb dang po slob dpon dang //phyi ma slob ma'i gnas su shes//de dag la/ thig chen brgyad ni/ re re bzhin nam mkha' la lan gsum dang / sa la lan gsum gdab/ de nas thig skud de nyid kyis las thig gdab par bya ba yin la/ de yang 'di ltar/ dbus su mtshan ma legs btab nas/ /shar nub tshangs 'ig drang por btab/ /zlum bskor gsum gyis nya ru 'gyur/ /nya steng tshangs thig gnyis pa btab/ /lho dang byang du zlum por bskor/ /bya rjes steng nas zur thig btab/ /zur thig steng nas bya rjes bzhi/ /de la phyi yi thig bzhi btab/ /logs gtub gsum gyi bya rog rjes/ /mnan pas cha chen bcu drug 'gyur/ /phyi ru cha chen re re bsnan/ /dang po gnyis pa bdun pa dang / /dgu pa rnams ni bzhi bzhir bgo /gsum pa'i nang du cha phran gcig /bzhi pa rang sar bzhag par bya//lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab//drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab//brgyad pa'i dbus su cha phran gcig /tshangs thig zur 'ig ma gtogs pa/ /de rnams skam thig gdab par bya/ /dbus su phur bu btsugs nas ni/ /bzhi lnga bcu pa'i thig steng dang / /bcu nang cha chung phyed tsam bskor/ /—327—

'dab thig lag len bzhin du gdab/ /bcu gcig rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig go /bcu bdun pa ni mda' yaba'i ga /rtsa ba'i thig las phyi rol tu/ /zur nas ngos su thig lnga pas//dang po gnyis ni gsum par reg/de gnyis cha chung gnyis kyis sbrel//gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams/ /brgyad pa'i thig la reg pa gdab/ /rtsa ba'i phyi nas gnyis pa'i thig /bcu bzhi pa yi bar du'o//de nas ngos su bzhi pa'i bar//steng du bco lnga pa la reg /bco lnga rtse nas rtse ru smyo//nang du bstogasum la reg pa'i// ngos su rim pas thig bzhi ni/ /dang po bcu drug pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bcudrug pa/ /gzhan gsum bcu bdun pa la reg /tshangs dang nyer gcig 'dzom pa nas/ /cha chen gcig gis bskore ba ni/ /g.yas g.yon logs su bzhi par reg/bcu dgu bzhi pa 'dzom sa nas//snga ma'i sne nas bcu 'dun bar/ /cha chung gnyis kyis bskor bar bya/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /bco brgyad la sogs 'ig bzhi ni/ /dgu pa nas bzung glang rgyab par/ /rtse mo cha chung gsum du sgrel/ /de 'og bgyod pa cha chung gcig /nyer gnyis pa dang nyer gsum pa/ /brgyad pa nas bzung bskor thig bar//nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa nas ni bdun pa'i bar//nyer brgyad lnga nas lnga pa'i bar/ /de 'og lnga pa cha chung gcig /nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa'i 'ig nas bcad par bya//de 'og drug pa'o nyer gnyis dang //nyer gsum brgyad pa sbrel ba yin/de'i 'og bdun pa'i thig du bcad/ /nyer brgyad pa yis phyi ngos su/ /gnyis pas 'ig las mthon pa yi/ /cha chung bzhi pa byin gyis phra//rtse mo ral gri'i dbyibs su bya//brang ngos cha chung gnyis kyi tshad//nyer gnyis pa dang gnyis 'dzom par/ /cha chung brgyad kyi thig skud sgyi/bcu bdun pa yi thig nas ni//dbus rwa'i thig la reg pas bskor/ / de yi phyi rol cha chung gcig /bskor te rwa'i nang thig go/nyer gnyis nyer gsum bar gyis ni/ /bzhi pa'i steng nas cha chung dgus/ /sngar bzhin bskor ba phyi thig go /thig skud nyis stab byas nas ni/ /dbus kyi phur bu la bskon te/ /rta babs mda' yab rtse mo'i tshad/ /dbang ldan —328—

mtshams nas g.yas su bskor/khyams su 'gyur zhing phyi nas slar//cha chen gcig dang cha chen phyed/ /slar yang cha chen gcig gis bskor/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du mos/ /de nas skam thig rnams dbye bar bya'o/ /'di la dur khrod 'bri srol ni med la/ ka ma la rak+ṣi tas nag po la 4zhad pa ltar 'dir yang byas na legs par ni 'gyur ro/ /de nas skam pa'i phyag rgyas dbus kyi phur bu phyung / ye shes pa lag gi rdo rje la thim par yid kyis mos/ thig skud la mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la gtsang sar ba theg go /de nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/mig gnyis la hi las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hu las khro bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ khro bo'i lta bas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgo'i gegs thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o| /zhes sgo'i rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /rdul tshon sna lnga lag len bzhin po gams la/ ya snye ma me da rnams bris/ gong gi thig skud brkyang zhing sgril ba'i sngags dor la thig skud kyi gnas su rdul tsho ni zhes 'don pa spos/ rdul chon mtheb srin gyis mnye bzhin du/ o badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma khru zhes lan bdun bdun gyis byin brlabs/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chags pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig gyi gyihizhes bzlas shing sbar ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ tse( badz+ra be ga a kra ma ho zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs lka slobadapon gyis/ dang por phur khung bgang bar bya ste/dril bu bkrol zhing skur sten la/dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pas bgang / de nas/ 'di ni cho se dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin —329—

gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'a zhes ra lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ / zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol la/ mthar g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/dbang ldan gyi mtshams su sgo tshad gcig gi bar du rtsig par rim pa lnga bri bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis ci bde bar tshon dgye bar bya ste/ pad+ma'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams la/ nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan ji lta bu'i dbyug pa re bris la/ mtha' me 'od 'bar ba'i nang rigs dang mthun pa'i kha dog shas che ba las spyir 'od zer sna lnga 'phro bar bri bar bya'o/ /mu khyud gzhi dmar po la rdo rje sngon po'i 'phreng ba bri/ mthar dkyil 'khor bris zin pa na/ tshon gyi lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa nam mkha'i lha'i thugs kar gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bzhag go /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' kun tu dri bzang gis byugs/ me tog sil ma sogs mchod rdzas dang gyon thams cad bkram/rnam rgyal bum pa gtso bo'i gnas su bzhag par mos nas shar sgo'i g.yas su bzhag bum pa gzhan bzhi phyogs bzhin bkod/ las bum dbang ldan mtshams su bzhag go /mchod pa'i bum pa dang / gos zung dang /lha re re lamachod rdzas bcu las mi nyung ba rnams so sor bshams la/ tso ( badz+ra spa ra ṇa kha/ zhes yang yang brjod do/ /gzhan yang yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya ste/ de rnams lag len mthong ba tsam gyi shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ dag pa dran pa yan chad stagon ltar byas nas/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa yin te/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs par mos la skye( badz+ra be ga a kra ma hu/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang shar gyi lha snam la 'dug ༵༵ ji /mas su rdo rmi/ sna dan/ spyu ༵/rtsu steng ༵ dho ༵/wo ༵ /mas so/ —330—

so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nas/ dmar mos 'byud pa/'dab ma bzhi la shar du spyo las thod dbyug snyes mtshan pa las/ gti mug nas/nag mos 'byud pa/ lho ru ma las thod dbyug mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna nas/ser mos 'byud pa/nub tu me las thod dbyug mes mtshan pa las/'dod chagasanas/ dkar mos 'byud pa/ byang du da las thod dbyug das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog nas/ ljang mos 'khyud pa/ dpa 'bo thams cad nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum dang / bdag nyid gnyis su med par gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas/ ut+pa ko3snya/ snyoms pa zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad bkug zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang / khams lnga dang / dbang po drug rnam par shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag yongs su sbyangs nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid sgrib pa thams cad dang rnam par bral ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs su gyur pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer dang bcas pa slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur pa mkha' nang du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ oṃ dhīXsgyiXnas/ swāhā/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo —331—

yab yum gsang ba'i lam nas spros/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum la thim/ oṃ mo rnyan krita hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra tī huX dzaX mkha' nang gi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum phyir phyung / shar gyi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum la thim/ de bzhi du sbyar te/pi shu nan pi shu na/ mkha' nang gi ser sna/ lho'i ser sna/ rā gan rā ga mkha' nang gi 'dod chags/ nub kyi 'dod chags/ ir pya na ir rtsi/mkha' nang gi phrag dog byang gi phrag dog skye tshe āXhūX/ lan bzhi/ mkha' nang gi bum pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhi'i bum pa bzhi/ tseX(sti/༷༷huX/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa phyir phyung / phyi'i gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim/snying gar huX nas/brlabs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ dzaXhūX baX hoX'i bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhi/ yangarang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX rol mo dang bcas pas/ hiXsgyiX bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/hruXsgyiX gcig gi bsrung ba'i sgo phye/ oṃ hiXha bho mahā kro dha ā ga tsā ā ca/as ma ta pū dza pra ti gro stun+ta pra sā dha me dhī mun ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes rdo rje'i gur gya nang du spyan drangs/ hiXsgyiX gcig bzlas pas sgo bcings/ yab yum bcu'i sngags re re'i mthar/ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ zhes sbyar te mchod yon phul/ pur+sha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ sangasargyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlabs te/dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dzaXhūX baX hoXgatso bo yab yum la lan gsum gsum/ lhag ma lha bzhi/ bum pa bzhi/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dmigs nas re re brjod de/ yang dag par bsre bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs —332—

sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i nas/sha lta āXhūX/ gi bar gyis gong bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /eX sh-i/༷༷sgyiXtshiX de bzhin du/ sngags kyi zhabs bsil zhes dang / oṃ hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/chu dang thang las skyes pa yi//me tog dam pa 'di dag ni//mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oX ku ma ra rū pi ṇi dzaXdzaXlhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung //bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni//mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /8 ldi ha he phaṭa/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi//oX hi p+ta nas/ swāhā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni//mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na//ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /rma : nas/gaX kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i kha zas 'di/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oX badz+ra3 we tu āXhuX/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oX badz+ra sha lta āXhūX/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul//bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog/oX badz+ra wa snyu ye āXhuX/gzung 'dzin nga rgyal bcom pa'i stag lpags dang / /nyon mongs sha khrag zad pa'i thod skam dang / /bdud rigs gshin —333—

rje bsad pa'i mgo bo'i 'phreng / /dug lnga 'joms byed gdug pa'i sbrul rgyan 'bul/ /oṃ byā gh+ra tsarma wā sa ni āXbyuX glu( badz+ra shu ska ka pā la mu ku ṭa āXriX oṃ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa mā la a bha ra ṇa āXhuX/ 8( aṣ+ṭa nā ga rwadza yis laX/ka ra āXhuX/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog /ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing rnams yongs bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod/ /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āXhuX/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'am gling gzhan dag /ga bor lo rin chen gyis bkang ba/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te//zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sam ye āXhūX/ nor bu/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo/ lha ste/ khyim bdag griha pa ti/ glang po/ snya snye/ rta mchog a shwa/ dmag dpon/ pu dra ṇa/ spyo sbyar/ gas yang ma rdzo pa'i rnam pa ni/ rnga yab rdul yab sbrang yab dang / /khyams dang skyed mos tshal dag dang / /gzim mal dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babs dang ni bla re sogs/ /bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs dang / /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas mchod/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'dzo ba//rin chen lag pa nam mkha'i mdzod//blo yisablangs te 'bul bar bgyi//yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ mar bum bteg la/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto phye bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin rings gdan dang ldan/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /—334—

'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang / /dri ngad ldan pa'i kha brgyan can/ /bdud rtsildan pa yis kyang ma cer/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mchode par bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod de/ phyi mchod rnams so/ /bstod pa ni/ a ye kye kye nas/ yongs la gzigs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ gti mug rdo rje nas/ dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gyi bar dang /brtse dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par sbyong / /nyon mongs kun dag ye shes dngos/ /rdo rje ro langs mar phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje zhi ba byang chub sems/ /gti mug rdo rje nyid dbyer med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag mo che/ /rdo rje tsartsi kār phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes ni/ /zhe sdang bdag po thugs dbyer med/ /mi phyed rnam rtog rab gcod ma/ /rdo rje phag mor khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsung ni ye shes che/ /pad+ma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'dod gas chen po nyid sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mthar mdzad khyod la bstod/ /rdo rje las ni kun grol ba/ /phrag dog rdo rje dbyer med sku/ /thams cad rdo rje btang snyoms ni/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgeg sogs rdo rje lha mo brgyad/ /snod dang gang ba'i bum par sprul/ /sna tshogs 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /mchod ldan de dag rnams la bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang par sprul//'jigs tshogs lta kun 'joms byed pa'i//rdo rje'i bzhi dang bcas la 'dud/ /ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /nyes spangs —335—

pad+ma'i 'khor yug ste/ /bdud 'jims bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar la bstod/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lor cas bstod pas/ bdud bzhi 'joms shing las kun 'grub pa dang / /lha mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpa' bo ni/ /bde chen gzhin rje gshed dpal thob par shog /ces bstod/ de nas nang ma rdzo byin gyis brlabs te/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dang bi rū pa/ /ḍom+bhi heruka dang dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /blo gros bzang po da rlan ā tshwa rlu/ /glo bo lotsā shes rab rin chen dang / /thugs sras sa pa lo smo mchog ldan dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang ga lnga1na nu tshul khrin/sa zhabs/ /tshul khrin/sa rgyal man ni mkhan chen grub she dang //shes rab rgya mtsho yon tan dpal bzang dang //byang sems mchog grub rje btsun grol mchoge zhabs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug kun dga'i mtshan/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul/ /o ā hū/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad sogs dang / mtshan sngags sam snying po rnams kyis dkyil 'khor rnams la 'bul/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi dang sogs dang / sgos kyi chos skyong la snying pos phul/ gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung bar sogs dang / gzhan yang phyogs skyong ba bcolnga/lha chen po brgyad sogs kyis phul/gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba sogs kyis phul/gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug sogs kyi mthar/ o a rlu ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā lha yi ko3ha/zhes bdud rtsi myang ba rnams so//mngon rtogs ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te bde bsgom/de nas sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar nang gtor rnams a rmyu tas bsangs rganas/ chen por gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i nas/na dza zhes pa'i bar gyis phul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang nang mchod dang / gti —336—
