mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ mchod spyin sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bar 'diramagon po lcam dral sogs chos skyong rnams dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang / phyogs skyong la yang nang gtor 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha sbyan 'dren gyi tshig bor nas/lhag ma gtor chog sgrub thabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma ni/ gtor ma che ba sha chang ba dan sogs kyis brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas pa phyi rol tu bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang / gtor ma byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/phyogs skyong ba 'khore dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/hiXsgyiX'i mthar/oX dā sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kwa r+ṣa ya dzaX gtor snod kyi phyogasabacur 'khod pa ni nas/ thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar lkoX nas/ gsol bar gyur/ oX in+t+ra ya nas/ phe swāhā/oX dā sha di ka 'e1 ka pā la sa pa ri ‘wā ra khyuX zhes mgo bor sbyar la ar+ghaṃ nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pe'i rmumachod pa rnams gtor snod du blug 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni nas/'dud kyi bar gyis bstod/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang bcas 'dir/ /'khod pa de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar rigs par gyur pa yi/ /dri dang me tog sogs sa tor ma/ /so sor bzhes te sems can la//byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la//gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol//mchodi spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rdo rje slob dpon bdagagis sems can thams cad gyi don gyi phyir zhes pa nas/ song zhig ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ slob mas mchod yon gyi lhag ma 'gro phyogs su sgreng ste/ oX hruXbi shu khyu spu'i sngags —337—

brjod cing / gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ slob dpon gyis mtshams rngam byed cing / gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/mthar slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du 'ongs/dkyil 'khor bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ hūX mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo lto sprad de dral ba sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang /tsho( badz+ra gi yi/ ṭa ya rba(ma ya pra be sha ya hūX/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis nub nas shar sgo da sgo de bzhi du byang nas lho sgo dang /shar nas nub sgo dang /lto nas byang sgo dbye bas mos/me tog dor/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog blangs nas/ spyi bor bcings pa'i gar stabs bya/sems can kun la dngos grub ni/ /ma lus dang bas stsa'/ du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs shing / phyag bya/gsum pa ni/dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang /dbang bskur ba gnyis las/dang po ni/maṇ+ḍal phul/ mā ma gī dang lhan cig sbyor/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ lkoX tsak+ṣu ban+ta wa rā ma na ya huX gis mig dar bcing /a khaX lī ra huX gis me tog hrīXsgyiX'i sngags kyis bsangs/ rang nyid gti mug lten rje gshed du gyur/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar huX nag po dang /mgrin pa pad+ma'i lte bar āXdamar po dang / spyi bor 'khor lo'i nye bar oX dkar po/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang / slar yang hiXsgyiXbazlas/las bum gyi chus bsang ngo /de nas/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin zhes dri zhing / bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags zhes rdzo btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lteb la hūX gis mtshan pa/ oX sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdorje snying gar gtsos la/ su ra te sa ma ya stu ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaX/ deng khyod de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa la —338—

smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa yang mi bya'o/ /de nas oṃ ya man+ta spo ta hūX zhes pas khrid nas/āXkhaX bī ra hūX zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas ྅zhe la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes dang /rdo rje snying gar bzhug la/de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni//de ma thag tu dral te gshegs//zhes dang /dung chos kyi chu blud cing / oṃ badz+ra u da ka tha/ bdun bzlas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /ces dang / deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ngas 'di gyis shig ces bgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ ྅ske ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ dmyal bar gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bo baX las chu'i dkyil 'khore dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la/ haXdakar po sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snying gar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa la huX nag po thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ lte bar raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru —339—

gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa la āXdamar po gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ rkang 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan kyis mtshan pa la dzhaiXdamar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba/ rlung dang dzhaiX'i 'od zer gyis nye ba'i me drag tu sbar/ snying ga'i sa bsregs te rab tu 'bar ba'i ngo bo gyur pa la/ spyi bo'i chu'i dkyil 'khor las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs pas tshim zhing bde bas khyab/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gang zhing / dzhaiXyi 'od zer rlung dang bcas pas lus nam mkhar 'degs bzhin par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rnam pas ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs/zhes brjod/rdo rje bsor la dril bu dkrol/oX hiXsgyiXbikri tā na na huX huX phaṭa phaṭa ā be sha ya staX bha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya/ huX hwaX.āXdzhaiXhūX phaṭa/ glo drag tu brjod cing / rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /mthar tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ go spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhan pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug pa bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /oṃ pra titsā badz+ra hoX spyo dor/ u dum wa ra man+ta ra/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang ma li ka /kaṇ+ḍi ka yi 'phreng ba 'di/ /legs par gnos la bus zungs shig /oṃ pra ti gro hā stuX i maX satwa mahā pa la/ zhes spyi bor bzhag snyingagar zla ba la huX/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med —340—

pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /ces gdong g.yogs phye/ da ni dad pa'ishugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos po kun gyis phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis//zhes lta bar bskul/thal mo sbyar la/oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ /hoXhoXhoX go ched du brjod/gnyis pa la/ bzhi pa las/ bum pa'i dbang la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong pa ni rigs lnga'i dbang ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /mchos/ kyang bdag la stsa'/ du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bum chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdus la/las bum gyi chu dang /khyiXsgyiXs bsangs/ skye( swa bhā wa sogs/bdag dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i gdan la/ ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa las/zhe sdang gzhin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po la/ yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'byud pa/ dbyug pa dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūX/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dam tshig pa rnams dang ro —341—

gcig tu gyur/ dzaXhuX paṃ hoX dbang rdzas kyi zhe sdang gshin rje gshed zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogasabacu'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang btsun mor bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /spa gsol ba bakhaso rbe'i rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu/bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+ma ra lhung ba/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ rdo rje ma drug khro bo'i dbang po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ slob ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs/de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis glu dang gar dang /me tog gi tshogs la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje tsartsi kā la sogs pa yum bzhi po rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba thogs te/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar mos shig bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni der khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces me tog dor/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa//sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad —342—

kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi sa ṣañtsa maX/ zhes rdo rje dngabacas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba'i yal 'dab kyis bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing 'thung du bcug de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang /dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nyid la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra pukhre āXhuX/ nas/ ne wi te āXhūX/ dngos su mchod pa lngas mchod par yang bya'o/ /de ltar na mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang / zhe sdang dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob 'gyur gyi nus pa bsos btab/ zhe sdang gzhin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /zhes brjod/ 'di man chad la/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa nas shis brjod kyi bar mi dgos/ gzhan stong par sbyangs pa nas rtogs pa bskyed pa'i bar rigs 'gre bar byas te/ 'don pa spo ba'i tshul brjod na/bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ma las dbyug pa mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna tshon rje gshed ser po la/ yul phag mo ser mos 'phyud pa/ser sna gnyen rje gshed kyi rnam par/ ser sna gshin rje gshed zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan ཿngas/ dar dpyangs bkon la/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ a bhi khiñtsa mi/ dbang gi lha las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i tshogs rnams byung / dbu rgyan gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ bum pa'i chus kyang gtor te/ oX badz+ra a bhi khri nyu mi/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi/ nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang / zhes so/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rnams rdo rje/ me las dbyug pa mes mtshan pa lag—343—

'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la/ yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ rdo rjer/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje bzung / /rdo rje snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du gtugs la/lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ skye( badz+ra sogs gong bzhin chus kyang dbang bskur te/'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/'od dpag med rdo rje'i/'dod chags/ 'du shes/so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi/zhes so/ /dril bu'i dbang la/ dbang rdzas dril bur da las dbyug pa das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum go ri ljang mos 'byud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ dril bur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi rdzi myu mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ dril bu lag pa g.yon par gtad/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/don yod grub pa dril bu'i/ phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/don grub kyi phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi/lko so//ming dbang ni/dbang rdzas med pa'i phyir dbang rdzas dang 'brel ba'i tshig gang yang brjod mi dgos/ bdag nyid dam slob ma/ slo las dbyug pa snyes mtshan pa las/ gti mug gshi/na rje gde/da dkar po la/ yum tsartsi kā nag mos 'phyud pa zhes dang / rdor dril bsnol ba lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ mgo steng du 'khrol bzhin pas/ mdze badz+ra satwa stuX a bhi khri nyu mi badz+ra na maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal rwa mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/rnam par snang mdzad ming gi gti mug gzugs phung / rnam par snang mdzad kyi/—344—

gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi/ zhes so/ /mthar 'di skad du/ dbang bskur ba 'di dag gi bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang / sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyi bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ rigs lnga'i sdom bang yang bya/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid zhe sdang gnyen rje gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'khyud pa sogs gong bzhi/ hūXlas byung ba'i rdo rje bdud thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i ral grir byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung / /zhes gtad la/thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni//rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /go rdo rje'i de kho na nyid bsgo/aXlas byung ba'i dril bu thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sgrub phyir/ /bu yis yang dag gus pas bzung / /khyod kyi slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes gtad nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur//wo dril bu'i de nyid brjod/ rang nyid bcom —345—

ldan 'das gshin rje gshed rang snang ye shes kyi phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs ma lo bcu drug 'e1na pa lta bu la yang dag par 'khyu da pa'i bde ba dam pa thob pa ni/ lha sku dang / bde ba dang / stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes 'di ni bum pa'i dbang gi gtso bo'o/ /'byud rgya byed/ yid kyi lus brtan de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshigarab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags//zhes brjod la don bshad/de nas/dbang bskur rdo rje sogs sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur ba las/ khyad par ni rnam rgyal chen po dung chos kyi dbang bskur ba dang / sngags kyang / glu( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye swāhā/ glu rna sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā tsar+ya a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes dang / rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ dza : ba ho o su pra rnge badz+ra ye hū swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rol mo'i sgradang4sa pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de nas de kho na nyid brjod par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bden pa bzhi/ /zur bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzha ste/ /sgo bzhi bdud bzhi bskrag par mdzad/ /rta babs bzhi ni bsdu ba bzhi/ /zhes dkyil 'bor gyi de nyid dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa bar mdzad/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed gzugs su/ /zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan: /gti mug gshin rje /gti mug gis mnan: /gti mug thams cad: /bcom ldan: /phra ma gzhin rje /phra ma yis mnan 'gro: /phra ma thams cad: /bcom ldan: /'dod chags gshin rje: /'dod chags kyis mnan 'go /'dod chags thams cad /bcom ldan /phrag dog gshin rje: /phrag dog gis mnan —346—

'gro: /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ /byams pa tsartsi kār gsungs te/ /phag mo de bzhin snying rje'o/ /dbyangs can dga' bar shes bya ste/ /btang snyoms go ri'i gzugs su'o/ /chags sogs gzhan 'gyur sku mdog dmar/ /dus gsum mkhyen pan spyan gsum ste/ /mtha' gnyis rtog spangs phyag gnyis te/ /thabs dang shes rab yang dag spyor/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/slob dpon gyi las bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / bza' bdang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / bsrung ba dang / phyir bzlog dang / dkyil 'khore sgrub pa dang / slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las rnams sgrubs shig ces brjod/ de rjes su mtha' rten la rjes gnang dang / brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan pa dang / gsang ba bsgrogs pa dang /dbugs dbyung ba'o//dang po ni/sems can kun la phan don phyir//'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor//de bzhi du/rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor//lko brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'phyud pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rjer gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bcing / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra dhi ༵ ༵ pa ni/ dzā bhi lji gā ༵ ༵ rdo pa' sna ba dzhai / ༵ hi hu ha ne bka' / ///'dir ni ngas khyod —347—

lung bstan bya/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye r+ghaṃ mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya stuX/ sgyir bhu waXsuXgang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/ 'di nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang / sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so/ /lko dad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de baXsaX 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya dā na hū ཾ phaṭa /lnga pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis//sdig pa kun las nges par grol//de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas//bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir//srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das//rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa//gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas//dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar bzung / /'di ni ma —348—

byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring khyod nyid dkyil snyen ra gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin//rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya//sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor//ces brjod/ de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing / bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed rim dang thun mong gi dngos grub las tshogs dang bcas pa sgrub pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel legs par tshogs nga ra bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stso zhe// /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong gi sngags kyis gdong g.yogs ཿnga / slob dpon bcom ldan gshin rje gshed dang / yum rdorje ro langs mar gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas/ at+pa ko3ha/ rjes chags snyoms par zhugs pa'i mchog tu dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thig le nor bu las/ mtho bong dang ming med kyis blangs te/ byin par mos shig btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod de ltar shes kyis kye/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /o.ā hu/ zhes thod pa dang po nas bdud rtsi byin/ a ho mahā su kha/ zhes rjes zlos bya/shes rab kyi mkha' nang na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyang khar babs par —349—

mos/ zhes brjod la/ ka pā laganyis pa nas bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas 'brugasum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol lo/ /de ltar na/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khore du zhugs shing / gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ ngag gi dri ma dag rdzogs rim steng sgo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs gong bzhi/gsum pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ /mgon ladabang ni bskur ba ltar/ /bla med byang chub gnas bya'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur stso'i// /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gong bzhin mig dar bcing de nas/ rig ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dngos grub kyi don dang /khyed rang rnams la gtad par mos shig gzung ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang das nga/ yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral ma byed cis /red de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yod ma yin//de nas/lha mo des kyang /dri chen dri chu bza' ba ste/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/bud med mchog gus de bzhin du/ /bha ga'i pad+ma ra tsuspa ni/ /bu khyod sprob yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig /ces dris par mos la/ dri chen dri chu sogasabaza' ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med mchoge tu rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la tsuspa ni/ /zhes lan btab/ de nas des/ e ma nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams/cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho gas brten byed na/ /de yam dun na nga gnas —350—

te/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañdza mo k+ṣa ho/ spyo gsung bar bsam/ de nas de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa yis byang chub sems/ /dzisrid 'byin par mi byed pa/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyan mi 'chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa//byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /rnam shes phung po rgyal 'gyur bas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod//mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i kun sbyor dang / /reg byas kyis ni rmad byung che'i/ /dga' ba skyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa'o/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brtan par gyis/ /pad+ma'i nam mkha' rdo rje yi/ /lte bas mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ /ye shes skye ba gang yin te/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes bya ste/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyu/ra ro/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyid gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod cing don ༅da/ bdag nyid dang / rig ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'khor lo'i gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' nas/ at+pa ko3haX/ lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dam pa mngon du byas/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / yid kyi dri ma/ rdzogs rim —351—

pho nya'i lam sgom pa la/ 'bras bu chos sku sogs/ bzhi pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phu‘spru lkabyang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/de nas 'di skad ces/ dbang bzhi pa'i don ni/rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med//nam mkha' dang ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /cho se 'di bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de nyid bsgom pa'i tshul ni/rnal 'byor dbang phyug birnya pas/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /'di ni thog ma dbus tha med/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ bzhi pa'i dbang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku sogs/de nas dam tshig brjod cing / gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa nas/'chi ba khyed la med/ /srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /stan la mchoge tu yang dag 'gyur//dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung / /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros nas sbun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par btang mi bya/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan ga stonas la mi smad do/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sum mi dbyung / /—352—

gdug la byams pa rtag tu spangs/ /chos nyid tshad bzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya//rtag tu dam tshig rten par bya//shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / /rnal gam 'byar spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs brten/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med gyur pa na/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor des bris la//bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags//deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyu/ra ba the tsho rdo pa med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pa//kun gyis tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /de ring bdud 9pres rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu rab bzhugs so/ /de ring khyod nyid sangs rgyas nyid//thob par 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster rten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams brten par 'gyur//zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /ces lan gsum bya/ gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ cho se rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /—353—

kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ni gsum brjod do//slob ma sta gon dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba ni dbang chog 'khrul ba'i dri bral du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ skye( hiXsgyiXnas/ ha/ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / gong bzhin nang mchod dang / a ye kye kye sogasakyis bstod cing / sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi dngos grub dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsa'/ du gsol/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can rnams bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byore pa dang sogs kyis bzod pa gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs lan gsum gyi mthar glu( badz+ra muX zhes ye shes pa rnams ba/zhegs/ dzaXspyiXbaX hoX dam tshig pa rang la thim/ lha'i nga rgyal dang / stong nyid lta ba brtan pos/ ā ka ro'i sngags dang / chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ /lko brjod cing / rdo rje'i rtse mos shar sgo nas brtsams te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dbye'o/ /mthar las rjes mi mngon pa byung zhing / phur bu dngos su btab tshe/skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzā gī lo ta gī la ya/ sarba ru badz+ra dha ra udz+nyā pa ya ti huX huX hūX huX phaṭa hoX zhes phyung / ru ru sbu ru sogs kyis shul 'o mas bgagayid kyis btab pa la mi dgos so/ /rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel dang / ras bris kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas smon lam dang bkra shis gyocher bya'o/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed 'jam dpal dpa' po yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa'i dge ba —354—

yis/ /'gro kun lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos po ni/ /zung 'jug snying po'i gnas la reg pa shog /ces pa'ang don gnyer can mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu so bzhi son pa na/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// //par yig 'di ni kun dga' legs pas bris/ /'di bris dge bas 'gro rnams ma lus pa/ lta thar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /bkra shis/

ma cedro ga tu gsang ba bzhu / gas/na mo gu ru we/ chos dbyings ye shes zhe sdang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs phung rnam dag gti mug gshin rje gshe/da la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo phra ma gzhin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo//'dod chags rnam dag 'dod chags gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang shes lnga gnas gyur phrag dog gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'di bshad par bya'o/ /'dir slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi bzhed pa rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi rim sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la bsags sbyang gnyis ni/ shin tu spros med kyi 'khrid yig kho bos sbyar bar shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi bzhed pas rtogs pa'i lta ba la/ bskyed rim kyi skabs su dpyad pa sngon song yang bshad la/ rdzogs rim gyi lta ba ni nag po le'u tha ma'i 'grel par dpa' bo sa ra he'i do ha'i lung drangs shing de dang mthun par bshad pa ltar yin pas rgyas par do ha mdzod du rtogs par bya dgos la/ slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pa'ang de ltar yin no/ /rim pa gnyis la stong nyid sgom thabs mi 'dra ba'i tshul dngos gzhi la/dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor dang po/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni rjes su —356—

rnal 'byor/ byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor ni shin tu rnal 'byor/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor ni rnal 'byor chen po ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po la gsum ste/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang / snang ba byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang /zung 'jug byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zag dbang po 'bring gis bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa nyid la sems 'dzin pa'am/ gang zag dang po rab dang tha mas ni lhan skyes 'ba' zhig la sems 'dzin te/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms yod na'ang mthar rtsa ba'i gcig pu la bsdu/ de nas 'di ltar bdag nyid skad cig tsam gyis gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sku gdan dang bcas pa me ri'i bar du gsal bar bskyed de/ de nyid la yud tsam sems gtad/ de nas 'phro bcad la/ yang sngar bzhin bsgom/ de ltar yang nas yang du skyar gyin gsal btab/ dmigs skor gcigade la cung zad sems zin nas sku de yang sha khrag gdos bcas med par/kha dog gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ 'ja' tshon ltar yal yal ba/ me dpung ltar 'od du gsal gsal ba bsgom/ dmigs skor gnyis/de la cung zad sems zin nas/ 'di ni tha mal gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba ma yin gyi/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed kyi ngo bo rang sems gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes nga rgyal brtan po yang yang bskyed/dmigs skor gsum mo/ /—357—

gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa la gnas pas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad la phog pas/ snod bcud thams cad gdod ma nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gnas pa la da lta'i snang ba'i sgrib g.yogs 'di sangs shing dag ste/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang /bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal btab/ de thams cad kyang ye shes kyi ngo bo yin snyam mos pa drag tu bya/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyis bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha skur lam me gsal ba la sems gtad/ de la der 'dzin med par mnyam par bzhag de nas 'di rnams kyang snang la rang bzhin med par sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ yang de kha'i ngang la jam me mnyam par bzhag dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi rim pa la/ dngos dang yan lag gnyis/ dang po la spyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po la rlung sbyor bzhi ste/ dang po byā gh+ra ni/ skyil krung dang /lag pa mnyam bzhag byas la/ha zhes rlud kha nas dal bus phyir bsal ba lan gsum byas la/ rdzogs pa dang phyir mnan/ yang dal bus nang du 'dren/ rngub pa rdzogs pa dang / rkang pa'i pus mo gnyis dang lag pa khu tshur gnyis sa la btsugs te lus skur ba'i ngang nas gre ba'i sbubs nas brgyud de sna nas hūṃ zhes sgra dang bcas te rlung bus shing / slar lus gnad dkyus dang mthun par bcas nas rlung nang du drangs shing thub tshad du bzung ba'o/ /'di la dmigs pa dbu ma —358—

kho na gsal btab/de'i nang du ba dmar po dang a dkar po yar 'gro mar 'gro byed cing steng 'og tu dbu ma phu rdugs kyi sne la thug thug pa dang mthar de gnyis 'dres pa'i thig le la sems 'dzin skad do/ /gnyis pa bā rā ha ni/ skyil krung gi pus mo gnyis la lag mthil gnyis bkab/ thog mar rlung cung zad bzung la/ rlung phyir gtor ba dang lhan cig sngar gyi lus gnad de kha'i steng nas/bar lhu mchan khung dang rtsib logs la brdeg pa dang /sna nas phag gi skad lta bu/dbugs thengs re lan mang du 'don pa'o//'di la yang dmigs pa rang lus lha sku rtsa gsum lte ba'i a las me 'bar/ spyi bo'i ha zhu bas dbu ma gang ba la sems gtod ces phyogs glang gsar ma'i ngo sprod zur 'debs las bshad/gsum pa mu sa la ni/ lus gnad de dang 'dra ba la steng rlung rdzogs par brngubs shing drag tu bzung / rgyu zhabs kyi thad la drag tu sdigs/ lto ba dang lus g.yas bcu g.yon bcu/ lte 'og gi phyogs bzhir lag len bzhin brdeg go /'di la yang dmigs pa ni sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor la ra dmar po/ lte ba'i dbus dang rtsa 'dab brgyad la/ ya spyo ma me da dza sa do sa snying ga'i dbus dang 'dab brgyad la hū ya stso ni ra/ ṇa yo na rī/ spyi bo'i dbus dang 'dab ma bzhi la ha hu hu hū hu rnams so/ /dbu ma sngon po khong stong / ro ma rak+ta dang rkyang ma thig les gang ba bsgoms nas 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa spyi dang mthun par byed do/ /zhes 'chad do/ /bzhi pa a trore sbyor ba ni/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i rting pa bshang lam du reg —359—

tsam gyis rgyab mdun bar gyi 'phang rtsa sdem/ g.yas pa de'i mdun du bzhag gsung ste/ de go zlog la'ang sbyar/ lag pa gnyis kyis bol gong gnyis la 'jus/ stod cung zad sgur zhing / sked pa ltong gi bya/ rlung ro bsal ste/ thog mar sna bug g.yas—nas rlung drag tu rngubs de nas g.yon nas rngubs/ gnyis kar nas dus gcig tu yang rngubs te/ yang de go zlog pa'ang byed/ dal bus g.yas su bskor zhing g.yas su drag tu sdig ro ma'i rlung rnams dbu mar sib sib 'gro bar bsam/ g.yon du bskor zhing g.yon du drag tu sdig rkyang ma'i rlung rnams dbu mar sib sib 'gro bar bsam/ de bzhin du dbus su g.yas skor du bskor te mdun du sdig yang dbus su g.yon skor du bskor te rgyab tu sdig de lta bu lan mang du bya ste/ rlung thub tshad du drag tu bzung ngo / /'di la yang dmigs pa snying ga'i thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam las dmigs/ lus dang thig le je che je chung byed pa la sems gtod pa yin zhes 'chad do/ / de ltar rlung sbyor bzhi po'i dmigs pa de rnams rtsa ba'i khrid yig na med/ lam gyi rkang la nges par dgos pa rang min yang bogs 'don du 'gyur ba dang / man ngag tu 'dod pas skabs re bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyun gyi rkang la mi rtog pa nyid bsngags so/ /de ltar bzhi po de dag dang por dal ba'i sgo nas yang yang bskyar gyin bya/ cung zad goms nas shugs bskyed de/ gcig rting la gcig bar ma chad pa 'bad rtsol drag pos rtag tu pyi ste/nyi ma gcig la de nyid tshar bzhi brgya tsam song na/rab zla ba phyed/ 'bring zla gcig tha ma zla ba phyed dang gnyis kyis rtsa rlung rnams legs par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /—360—

gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ 'ga' zhig rlung thengs gcig la sbyor ba bzhi car tshang bar bzhed pa dang / kha cig so sor bzhes pa sogs/ lugs mi gcig tsam 'ga' re 'dug na'ang / rlung thengs gcig la bzhi car tshang bar byed pa dgongs pa snang ste/ lus gnad snga ma ltar bcas la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs sngon du 'gro bas lta stangs smin mtshams su gtad/rang lus gshin rje gshed kyi sku dar dmar gyi rkyal ba lta bu stong sang nge ba la sems gtad de/ rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas phyir 'gro bar mos pas rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ de nas 'od kyi rnam pas lus gang bar mos pa dang / nang du chud tshad du ring du rngub pa ni dgang ba/brngubs zin pa na mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zad sgrim pa'i ngos nas lte bar gnon pa dang mchil ma cung zad cig sgra med du mid pa ni dgug pa/de nyid la thub tshad du bzung zhing mi thub pa snyam pa'i zug rngu byung ba'i tshe yang rngub chung byed cing gnon pa ni zhi ba/ de nas dal bus rlung phyir bsal te/ lta stangs gtsug tor gyi thad kar blta zhing /sems rang babs su lhod kyi klod nas 'jog pa ni/ rengs pa ste 'di la rlung phyir 'jog pa yun je ring dang / de tshe lta stangs dang rlung sngar bzhin bcun pas/ rlung gnas pa sogs gzhan rnams kyi bogs thon cing yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ rlung sbyor la drag tu 'bad pa'i mjug tu kha sna gnyis car nas rlung ro bsal ba lan gsum tsam byas nas/ dbugs thengs nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyis bar du lus mi sgul/ rlung rang so/ sems rang babs kyi ngang la bzhag go /—361—

de lta bu'i rlung gi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gang zag des/ gnyis pa lam gyi yan lag 'pho ba sbyang ba ni gnyis te/ gong du 'pho ba dang / bla mar 'pho ba'o/ /dang po ni stan bde ba la 'jug ste/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i lus kyi nang stong sang nge ba/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma gro sog tsam/mda' smyug ltar drang ba phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i mar sna lte ba dang yar sna tshangs bug tu zug pa/ spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal bar bsgoms la/ mos gus drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba yun ring du btab/ dbu ma'i nang gi snying gar hū dmar po/ nye bar ya yig brtsegs ma gnyis zhabs sprad cing mgo gyes pa/ kha phrag der hi yig de'i steng du rang sems hu dmar po/ de'i steng du ka de yang ya rnams sngon po/ hi dmar po/ ka dkar po'o/ /de ltar gsal btab cing / rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe ngag tu hika ces brjod pas/ ya bzhis hi phul/ des hū phul/ kas steng nas drangs te/ snying gar sleb pa na hu dang hika snying ga'i hū la thim/ hū yig rlung dang bcas pa spyi bo'i tshangs bug la thug thug reg par bsam/rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe/slar mar ldog ste/snying ga'i thad du sleb pa dang snying ka'i hū las hu chad/ sngar gyi snying ga'i hū de snying ga rang du chags/ gzhan rnams sngar bzhin lte bar 'khod par bsam/ de 'dra lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam re bskyar nas bya'o/ /de lta bu thun bzhir sbyangs pas/ spyi gtsug na kar kar ba dang / tsha thang thang ba dang / 'bur ba dang chu ser 'thon pa dang / tshangs bug kha phye ba rnams 'byung ngo / /rtags de dag byung nas/ nyin re la thun re bsgoms pas chog cing /—362—

thun gyi gzhug thams cad du snying ga dang / nye ba'i hu gnyis po drag tu gsal 'debs pa gal che/gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi ltas byung na dang por phyi'i 'chi blu rnams bya/ des ma ldog na srog rtsol rdo rje bzlas pa'am/ bum pa can gyi sbyor ba 'bum phrag gcig gis 'chi ba blu ba rnams bya/ de'i man ngag ni snying gar nyi ma la hū dmar po gcig bsgoms te/ steng 'og gi rlung thams cad de nyid la sib sib thim par bsams pa'o/ /de'i kyang blu bar ma nus na/ sngon 'gro rnams sbyangs shing / spyi bor bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas rnams ngo bo gcig tu bsgom/mdun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs te spyi bo'i bla ma la bstim/ mchod pa phul/ gsol ba drag tu btab/ g.yin dmigs pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i hu las hū mang po spros/ bu ga dgu/ smin mtshams/ lte ba/ spyi gtsug gi phyi'i sgo rnams hu re res bkag de nas yar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dang rlud phyi rol tu drag tu dgag pa yang nas yang du bya/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ 'di nyid kyis dbyings su 'pho ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'pho dmigs rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ dang por lus gnad cing bde bar bcos la/ byams snying rje drag tu bsgom/ rang gi lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ rang lus la gces 'dzin dang / snyems 'khrigs rdul tsam yang med par dum bur gtubs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por mos/ bla ma yi dam/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad la sbyin/ rang lus dang dgra gnyen/ snang ba thams cad la zhen pa bcad/ spyi —363—

bor bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du bzhugs par mos/ rang lus rtsa dbu ma dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal btab/ lte bar hū dmar po bsgom de nyid spyi bor nas nye ba'i bar du yar 'gro mar 'gro lan 'ga' re byas la/ tshangs bug nas rgyangs te sbur nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ de ltar yang nas yang du drag tu bsgom par bya'o/ /yang 'pho ba'i gzhung las 'byung ba la/ phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ snod gzhal yas khang bcud lhar bsgom/ rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma'i rtsa dbu ma'i mas snar rang gi dbu ma'i yas sna chud tsam dang / hu gis sgo dgu bkag pa byed pa ni khyad par de dmigs pa dang po'o/ /rtsa ro ma kwa li dang rkyang ma ā lis bkag snying gar rlung dkyil zla gam la hūṃ sngon po bsgoms nas hika dang bcas te dbyings su 'pho ba ni gnyis pa'o//rkang pa rlung dkyil du mos skyil krung ngang nas pus btsugs bya/ lte ba zla ba la hū sngon po/snying gar hū dmar po/de'i 'od kyis sgo dgu bkag stobs gyi hū dang bcas te yi dam gyi thugs kar 'pho ba ste gsum pa'o/ /yang stong gzugs la mnyam par bzhag nas dbyings rig bsre ba ni bzhi pa'o/ / yang rang lhar gsal mdun du shing sdong rtse mo ri rab dang mnyam pa gcig gi rtser bla ma gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par bzhugs/ snying ga'i bla ma'i thugs kar bstim pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba la/ bla ma rang sems nam mkha' gsum dbyer med gcig tu sres pa la sems 'jog pa ni byin rlabs kyi gzhung ba las 'byung ba ste lnga pa'o/ /—364—

—gsum pa byin rlabs kyi rim pa la rang lus thabs ldan spros med dang 'dra/ gzhan lus shes rab la bsnyen sgrub las gsum la sbyor la phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ ji ltar sbyong tshul/ bsnyen pa'i thabs/ man ngag gi gnad/ ye shes bskyang ba'i thabs rnams yin te de dag ni gzhan du shes so/ /bzhi pa ye shes kyi rim pa la sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / 'phros don gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro rnams gong bzhin byas/ lus gnad bcas la/rlung rang babs su bzhag sems kyang rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du spangs te/ rang babs su lhod de klod la mnyam par bzhag bying rgod gcod tshul spyi dang 'dra/dmigs skor gcigade nas sems kyi ngo bo la cher te bltas pas gsal sing nge ba ngos gzung zhing bsgom/ dmigs skor gnyis/gsal ba de nyid btsal bas gang du yang ma grub pa la mnyam par bzhag dmigs bskor gsum/gang yang ma grub cing ci yang ma yin pa de nyid rtsal ma 'gags pa thams cad du 'char du btub pa/shar tsam na bdag gzhan dang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stongs pa de kha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag dmigs skor bzhi'o/ /de dag la legs par 'byongs na/ nang gi khams phra rags dbu mar thim nas/ sku dang 'od gsal zung 'jug tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dngos gzhi zab gsal gnyis su med par bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro gong ltar las/ rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam lhan skyes su bsgom/sngar gyi lta ba'i ngang dang ma —365—

bral bar/ snying gar ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar/ zla ba la a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar gyi skur gyur pa la sems bzung / dmigs skor gcigalha skur snang ba ma 'gags pa'i steng du sngar gyi lta ba bskyangs/ de nas de thams cad 'od du zhu/ me long la ha btab pa yal ba'i tshul gyis mtha' nas rim gyis sbyangs nas/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal pa la thim/ yum yab la thim/ dmigs bskor gnyis/rang ye shes sems dpal la thim/ dmigs skor gsum/ye shes sems dpa' de pad+ma la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de yang a la thim/ dmigs skor bzhi/a yang nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa'i tshul gyis thal ba'i ngang du sngar bzhin mnyam par bzhag la lta ba bskyangs/ dmigs skor lnga ste 'od gsal sgom pa'o /yang stong pa'i ngang las/a yig dkar po byung /de las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sogs skad cig tsam gyis byung ba la sems gtad/ de ltar yang dang yang du bsgom pa yin no/ /dmigs skor drug pa ste zung 'jug sgom pa'o/ /'di skabs rnal 'byor la dbang 'byor ba yin na/ lta ba dang rnal 'byor gong ma rnams kyis thob pa'i bde cha gsal cha snang cha rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang nas/ bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can mngon rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa —366—

yud tsam gyis bsgoms te/ 'od gsal tu bsdu ba la sogs pa gong bzhin bsgoms/ bskyed rdzogs phan tshun du rgyas 'debs pa zhes bya ba yin gsung /gsum pa 'phros don ni/ phyir zlog drug pa'i gzhung las byung ba ste/ dgra gdon nad 'jigs pa sems lhongs sogs gang byung yang rang sems su shes nas gang sgyur sgyur yin snyam pas res 'ga' rang sems phar bsres/ res 'ga' de rang la thim/ gang ltar yang mthar dbyibs su yal/ dbyings rig sres nas bzhag go /res 'ga' gnod byed dang gnod byed nyid du dmigs nas sgyu ma lta bur bsam/ yang bar chad kyi chos de bla ma'am yi dam du bsgom/ sgyu ma lta bu dang rang sems su ro mnyam par shes/ gnod bya gnod byed gdod nas yod ma myong ba la mnyam par bzhag go/yang bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab/ bdag dang gnod byed sogs thams cad logs logs su grub pa med/ rang sems gcig pu'i cho 'phrul yin thams cad ngos gzung med pas stong par ro mnyam/gdod nas yod ma myong / rang bzhin chos nyid ye shes kyi snang cha ma 'gags pa ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen rnam par rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma khro bo yab yum kyi dkyil 'khor du gdod nas lhun grub tu shes pas spang blang las grol ba de ka la mnyam par bzhag go /yang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje dung dung ba bsgom/ snying rje de yang dbyings dang bsres te mnyam par bzhag pas bar chad dngos grub tu longs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na 'dir ni rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi dmigs khrid lag len gsal bar bkod de/go don rnam bzhag dang man ngag gi gnad mang po/ glo bo lo smo ba shes rab rin —367—

chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa na shin tu gsal bas/ de nyid bla ma'i zhal lung gis legs par brgyan te/ zhib tu nyan cing lag khrid du thebs par bya'o/ /'di ni spyir bskyed rim gang la yang sbyor du rung mod gtso bor grub thob dpal 'dzin nyid kyi bzhed gzhung dmar nag 'jigs gsum dang shin tu 'brel che la/yang sgos su gshed dmar bcu gsum ma nyid la sbyor ro/ /'di ltar bris pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag dang sems can thams cad dngos grub mchog la reg par gyur cig sa khams tsartsi kā yi gzugs la blta/ /byams pa phag mos snyan 'gyur glu len cing / /smon lam dbyangs can dri yis yid tshim nas/ /'dus ma byas pa go ris ro mchog sbyor/ /kun khyab rdo rje ro langs mas/ /stobs bcu ma he'i gdan la bkod//gnyis med bde chen rol ba yis//gshin rje gshed po'i sar 'god shog /tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs/ /lta ngan bzhi dang bdud bzhi 'joms/ /bsdu dngos rnams bzhi'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /gegs med dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /chos 'byung bdud rtsi ka pā la/ /gzugs sogs 'dod ma'i lha mo yis/ /zag med bde chen longs spyod rgyas/ /srid zhi'i bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la 'dol byung du sbyar ba'o// //glo bo lo smo ba'i gtong thun de nges par ltos shig/ma ṅga la/4—368—

༄༅/ /spros med kyi khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/na mo gu ru shrī ya mā ri a dī ta tsa rā ṇa ya/ dpa'/ sgo ldan rdo rje'i dbang phyug mchog gi 'od gsal rdo rje dbyug pas mtha' dag srid gsum nyon mongs ni/ /ma rungs sder bcas phye mar btags nas bde chen mcho ni chas bdud bzhi dpung tshogs mthar byed khyim du mngon par bos/ /zag med bde chen nyams brgya'i ros gang rtag tu gsol phyir zla phyed lta dkar thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag /brkyang bskum stabs kyis 'chi bdag grong khyer rlag par mdzad nas sgrub la srid zhi las grol dngos grub stsole/ /de 'dra gang yin bla ma gshin rje gshed/ /skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /dngos grub 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing / /de la bshud nas de yi lung bzhin bshad/ /dpal stobs kyi dbang phyug bi rū pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag 'di la phyogs 'dzin gyis rnam par bslad pas rang nyid kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba lhur byed pa kho na mang bar mthong yang / chos 'di nyid kyi lo paṇa rnams kyi bzhed pa rang lugs gtsang ma ni nyung bar snang ngo / /gzhung nyid du dmigs pa'i rim pa rnams shin tu gsal bar bzhugs shing / phyogs 'dir snyan brgyud ye ger 'god pa'i thog ma glo bo lo tsā ba chen po shes rab rin chen gyi gtong thun nyid dpang du bzhag ste/ nyams len gyi rgyud pa —369—

ma chad par byon pa'i bla ma'i man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du dmigs tho tsam zhig brjod na/ 'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la gnyis/tshogs bsags pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir yig brgya bzla ba'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang gi mdun du seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su bla ma bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dang /de'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa la/ lus mang por sprul nas phyag byas par bsams te/ gang gi drin gyis sogs bstod pa ci shes bya/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phul bar bsam/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma lan re phul ba'i rjes su dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ bdag gi rgyud la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shin tu spros med kyi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/mthar de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo'i nas mar la thim/ lus sems bde 'bol gyis song bar bsam/ rgyas pa la spro na/ mdun du mchod yul gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa 'god pa dang / dbus su bla ma/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/g.yon du dge 'dun/ bar bar du chos skyong bsrung ma rnams bskyed/ mchod pa re re zhing lan gsum gsum 'bul ba dang / bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba lan —370—

brgyad brgyad gdab/ gzhan rnams la lan bdun 'debs pa sogs/ spros med kyi gtong thun dang yig chung nas 'byung ba bzhin du ci rigs par nyams su blang ngo / /gnyis pa ni rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can brgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ thugs kar pad zla'i gdan la/ hu dkar po la yi ge brgya pas bskor ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / lus kyi nang gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bu ga dgu nas phyir brdas shing / rang lus 'ja' tshon lta bur 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ci nus su bzla/ mthar hu dang yig 'bru thams cad zhu ba'i 'od kyis lus gang / lus sems thams cad bde ba chen pos khyab par bsam/ mdun du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bzhugs par mos la/ phyag 'tshal bdud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /zhes sogs bshags pa byas la/ de rnams kyis kyang rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go /zhes dbugs phyung / de thams cad rang la thim/sdig sgrib gyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar bden med du shes par byas la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar thun bzhi la sogs par bsgoms pas/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags byung byung du 'bad do/ /maṇ+ḍal gsol —371—

'debs dang / yig brgya'i bzlas sgom ni snga phyi gang byas kyang 'dra'i/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang por rang byin gyis brlab pa'i tshogs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kyi byin rlabs bla ma la thob par byas la/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi spros med kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa/ rjes rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi brten par byed pa'o/ /dang po la spros pa bcad pa dang / dngos grub blang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ hu zhes brjod pas bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ seng khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma ma he'i gshin rje rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa bsnams pas khams gsum 'dul ba/ g.yon bdud kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa yum la 'phyud pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ma he dmar po dregs shing khros pa'i steng du gshin rje nag po thod dbyug thogs pa kha bub tu bskyel nas gnon pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan dang mi mgo'i phreng ba can/sbyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rang snang gi yum mam/ rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi phreng ba dang / se ral kha spangs pa'i sprul gyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/—372—

brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/mtha' skor du 'khod/yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gzhin rje gshed kyi skur gyur gong gi mtha' skor du 'khod/ de ni spros pa bcad pa'i yul bsam pa'o/ /spros pa gcod pa dngos la/ mchod pa gsum las/dang po yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa ni/phyag rgya dang bcas/o badz+ra pu sprel ā skyo/ glu rna badz+ra dhu pe ā hū/ ma rna badz+ra ā shwe1 ke ā hū/ glu rna badz+ra ga rnye ā hū/ tse( badz+ra ni bi du ā skyo/ zhes brjod pas me tog la sogs pas mchod rdzas bzang po nam mkha' gang ba tsam sprul te phul bar bsam/ yang o rū pa badz+re ṇi ā hu/ o shas badz+re ṇi ā skyo/ o gan+ta badz+re ṇi ā skyo/ oṃ rā sa badz+re ṇi ā skyo/ o sparnye badz+re ṇi ā hū/ o dharmā dha tu badz+re ṇi ā hū/ zhes brjod pas/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya/chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i rigs kyi lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa sprul nas 'dod yon drug gi mchod pas mchod cing mnyes par bsam/gnyis pa chags sdang gi yul dbul ba ni/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba rang gi longs spyod bdog pa'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma la phul bar bsams la/ kyai dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ byams pa'i gnyen bshes thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/sdang ba'i dgra dang gdon bgegs thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar ma'i 'gro ba rnams dang bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad dbul par bgyi'o/ /'dzin chags ser sna dang bral bar —373—

byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gis bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pa gong bzhin gsol ba btab/gsum pa lus dbul ba ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa cig byung / des rang gi thod pa phral/ mdun du mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du thod pa bkal ba stong gsum gyi 'jig rten tsam du gyur/lus lhag ma dum bur gtubs/ nang khrol dang bcas pa thams cad thod pa'i nang du 'phangs/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus ni med/ rlung sems tsam las bcom ldan 'das gzhan rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ des oṃ ā hu zhes brjod pas/ thod pa'i nang gi rang lus kyi dum bu rnams bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ de nas oṃ ā hūṃ zhes dang por rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'bul/ de nas yi dam dang sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyong bsrung ma rigs drug gi tshogs dang bcas pa la 'bul/ yi ge 'bru gsum mang du brjod/ thams cad zag med kyi bde bas tshim zhing dgyes par bsam/gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pas thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pas gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod pas bla ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhagaganyis pa spros med la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos —374—

bdun bcas/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag sems nam mkha' la chal te sgyur/las song ba 'dra gcig la sems dang rnam rtog dang nam mkha' dbyer med stong nyid rang bzhin gyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rang la bzo bcos med par cham me so khad de mnyam par bzhag dmigs skor gcigagal te rnam rtog gi spun langs na/ rab kyi gang shar de'i rang bzhin lta shes par byas pa'i ngang la bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du rang sor bzhag rnam rtog gang byung 'a nga de'i rang bzhin stong gsal spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'dug par de la bzo bcos med par sor 'jog tu bskyangs/ 'di cung zad myong ba skyes nas ngo sprad de sgom pa yin gyi/ thog mar sgom thub pa dkon pas/ 'dir dmigs pa spong mi dgos/ skabs 'dis tshig gi 'brel chags pa la brten nas bris pa yin/ 'bring de ltar mngon du byed mi nus pas/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo la cher te bltas pas/ de nyid rang log la song ste/ shes pa gsal stong du 'char ba de'i ngang la bzhag dmigs skor gnyis/dbang po tha mas ni rnam rtog de nyid kyi skye 'gag gnas gsum la brtags te/ dang por skye ba'i tshul ji lta bu/ gnas pa'i tshe yul dus kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa ji ltar gnas shes pa'i ngo bor yod snyam na'ang ji ltar 'dug 'gag pa'i tshe ji ltar 'gag ces btsal zhing brtags pas ci yang ma rnyed pa de kha'i ngang la rang bzhin gsal stong ngos zir par byas te mnyam par bzhagadamigs skor gsum mo/ /de yang sems kyi gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin —375—

pas/ de la gang du yang ma bcos par bzhag na/ rang bzhin spros bral mngon du 'gyur zhing / blos byas kyi bzang ngan ji ltar bcos kyang / gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs las phyin ci log tu 'gro ba yin no/ /de'i phyir spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings la rang babs su 'jog pa ni/shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya'o/ /ngo sprod skor gcigartog pa'i spros pa dang bral ba chos dbyings ye shes/ stong par rtogs pa me long ye shes/ rang gi rig pa sor rtog ye shes/ gsal cha sna tshogs par 'char bar nus pa bya sgrub ye shes/ de rnams dbyer med mnyam nyid ye shes so//ngo sprod skor gnyis/yang stong pa mi rtog pa chos sku/ rig pa longs sku/ gsang ba sprul skru/dbyer med bde chen ngo bo nyid kyi skur thag bcad/ ngo sprod skor gsum pa'o//gong du bshad pa'i dbang po rab kyi dmigs pa 'dir bstan te/ de yang sems kyi 'char sgo yul snang dang rnam rtog gi rnam 'gyur ci shar yang / de dag thams cad rang bzhin gang gis kyang ma bsgribs pa shin tu gsal ba/ gnas dus kha dog dbyibs sogs ngos bzung thams cad dang bral bas stong pa/ rig pa'i rtsal gang du yang ma 'gags pa'i mtshan nyid can/ rang gis rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma'i ngo bo rang shar ba de/ rang ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis bzo bcos med par skyong ba ni lam/ 'di'i gnad kyi snying po yin no/ /ngo sprod skor bzhi pa'o//de ltar dmigs skor gsum ngo sprod bzhi'i don bsgom pa thams cad la 'jug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshams su chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar —376—

shes par bya'o/ /'di dag ni yig rnying ltar sa bon tsam smos pa yin gyi rgyas par bla ma mchog gi zhal las blang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni rnam rtog drag pos sems gtsubs pa'am/ nyams nga'i rnam pa ci shar yang / 'di nyid la 'bad pas nges par sel zhing / spros med dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi thun 'jug tu yang / lan re nges par sgom dgos pa yin no/ /de yang rang gshin rje gshed kyi sku khong stong du gsal btab/ rnam rtog thams cad bu ga dgu nas 'tshub ma lta bu'i rnam pas sur gyis bcug nas snying gar 'dus pas 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu song / de yang dkar la 'gril ba gsal la 'tsher ba mthe bong gi tshad tsam gcig tu gyur/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab steng 'og thams cad du skad cig kyang sdod pa'i skabs med par shugs drag pos yar 'gro mar 'gro byed par bsam de nas snying dkar nag gi mtshams nas bu ga zhig har gyis phye nas/ skyes bu stobs can gyis mda' 'phangs pa'am skar mda' 'pho ba lta bu'i shugs kyis phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du dkar yer gyis sleb par bsam/ der cung zhig ngal gso/ lus gshin rje gshed kyi sku khong stong de las kyi rlung gis brdas te nub bde ba can gyi zhing du skad cig tsam gyis sleb/ oṃ ā hu zhes brjod/ rang sems 'od kyi gong bur gnas pa de nam mkha' la phyams kyis khyab nas/ de ka'i ngang de nas spros pa'i dbyings thams cad dang bral ba la sngar bzhin mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes la/ sems bskyed pa'i thabs dang / bar chad bsal ba'i —377—

chos gnyis las/ dang po la drug ste/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor/ srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor te drug las/dang po byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed du bsgom/ spyi bor rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bla ma bzhugs pa la/ mos gus dung ba bya zhing / dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa dang /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las kyang ches bka' drin che ba'i tshul bsams te/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po gcad du med pa/ skad cig kyang ma yengs par/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma dam pas/bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/zhes pa la sogs pa gsol ba ci nus su btab/ mos gus kyis blo bsgyur nas shes pa des chad pa'i dus su bla ma rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du mos nas/ lhod kyis klod la bzhag go /thun mtshams thams cad du yang / nam dran res kyis de kho na bzhin du gsol ba 'debs/ mtshan mo nyal ba na/ spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas bla ma spyi bo nas mar byon/ snying 'od kyi gur khang du gsal ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa la/ mos gus kyi gdung ba dang bcas te sems bzhag nas/ de kha'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya ste/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa dang bar chad bsrung ba la sogs pa phan yon mang po dang ldan pa yin no/ /nyal rnal —378—

'byor 'di dkyus na med zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /nyin mtshan thun thun mtshams gang la'ang mos gus drag po'i stobs kyis rna zu/ rtog rags pa 'gags nas sems lhan ne gnas pa'i dus su spros bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yun ring du bskyang ngo / /gnyis pa mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad sogs spyod lam cha mnyam/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas he rang nyid gzhan rje gshed du bsam/ bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la gsol ba btab/ rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra lta bu zhig mdun du dmigs te/ de rang gi tshe 'di dngos kyi ma lta bu rang gang brtse ba gcig tu bsam/ lus sems rtse gceg tu bsgoms la/ bdag la gnod pa byed pa 'di snying re rje/ 'di bdag gi lha dro na can gyi ma yin shin tu brtse bas phan dpag tu med pa btags snyam du byas rtsi// ngag tu yang bdag la gnod pa byed pa 'di snying re rje/ zhes lan brgya'am lnga 1bcu'am nyer gcig tsam bgrang ngo / /yang rgyu mtshan cis snying rje snyam na/ 'di skye rngo spro dpag tu med par ma yin la/ma byas res kyi phan dpag tu med pa btags pas snying re rje snyam du bsam zhing / yang sngar bzhin brjod la bsgom/ yang ci1sa snying rje na/ de ltar drin che ba yin pa la/ da ltar smyon pa ltar rang dbang med pas/ ma bu'i 'brel ba can du ma shes par bdag bu la gnod pa byed pa 'di snying re rje snyam du bsan zhing gong bzhin ngag tu brjod/ yang cis snying rje na/ de lta zag gnod pa byas pas/ las ngan gyi dbang gis dmyal bar 'gro ba snying re rje hūṃ/ma du bsam zhing sngar bzhin brjod/ de ltar rgyu mtshan bsam zhing snying rje ba ྅ mas te/ rang dbang med par —379—

mchi ma 'byung zhing ba sbu ldang ba dang / lus zungs mi thub pa tsam byung byung gi bar du 'bad/ thun 'jug tu gnod byed 'dis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed la/ sems can thams cad 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par yang bsam/ de ltar snang ba de thams cad kyang rang gi sems su shes par byas te/ sngar bzhin spros med kyi ngang bskyang ngo / /gnod byed kyis mtshon nas dgra gnyen bar ma rnams dang sems can thams cad la rim gyis bslab bo/ /gsum pa rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems te/ rgyun gyi nyams len rkyen dang bsre ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs sems dang / rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa rnams byas la/ sems can thams cad blo'i yul du bsams nas/ sngar bzhin snying rje drag tu bsgom/ de rnams la gang gis gnod na/ sdig pa dang sdug bsngal gyis gnod/cis phan na bde ba dang dge bas phan par shes nas/sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin pa dang /bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can la smin te/ sems can rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pas/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces ngag tu brjod/ de yang sems can gyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin/ bdag nyid kyi dge ba dang bde skyid —380—

thams cad snying ga nas phar nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi rnam par spros/sems can thams cad la phog pas thams cad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang thob par bsam mo/ /de nyid yang nas yang du rtag tu bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rkyen thog tu dbab pa/ nad thog tu dbab pa/gdon thog tu dbab pa/ 'di gsum car la yang sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ dang po ni rkyen gyi stobs kyis nyon mongs pa dang / sdug bsngal dang /sems skyo zhing blo mi chags pa dang / bya ba ma grub pa dang / yid mi bde ba ci byung yang / de kha'i steng du rigs mthun gtso bor gyur pa'i khams gsum gyi las ngan sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad bsdus pa'i dmigs pa smon lam dang sbrags nas byed pa yin te/ dper na/ rang rgyud la zhe sdang skyes pa'i tshe sems can zhe sdang can rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang bdag gi 'di la smin par gyur cig sems can thams cad zhe sdang dang bral bar gyur cigagazhan yang rgyu las dang nyon mongs ji snyed yod pa thams cad bdag gi zhe sdang 'di la smin par gyur cig bye brag tu dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal nas brtsams te rigs drug gi sdug bsngal re re nas bsams nas/ de thams cad bdag gi 'di la smin par gyur cig ces ngag tu brjod cing yid la drag tu bsam/ thun 'jog khar lha sku dang spros med la sems mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /des mtshon pa'i gnyis pa nad la yang / gang na ba de nyid kyi rigs mthun pa'i nad rnams thog mar bdag gi de la smin par bsam/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdug bsngal thams cad bsdu ba'i dmigs pa sngar —381—

bzhin bya/ gsum pa bdag la gdon gyi gnod pa yod na yang / sems can gdon gyi gnod pa can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnams bdag gi 'di'i steng du 'dus par gyur cig snyam drag tu bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdug bsngal thams cad bsdu ba'i dmigs pa ni gong dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa bi dha ra rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ram srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor ni/skyabs sems lha bsgom bla ma dran pa ste/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bzhi po gong bzhin byas la/ lus gnad spyi dang 'dra/ rang nyid skyon rje gshed kyi sku 'ja' 'od las grub pa khong stong dar dmar gyi rkyal pa lta bu stong sang nge ba sgom pa zhag 'ga' byed/ dmigs skor gcigade nas 'jam rlung bzung ste rlung rengs 'dul ba dang / yan lag lnga pa bya/ dmigs skor gnyis/de nas yang de bzhin du bsgoms la/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas/lag len bzhin hū gsum gyis stod kyi rlung ro bsal/ ha gsum gyis smad kyi rlung ro bsal/ bgang ba ni/ rlung sgra med du bsas pas/ rlung 'od zer sna lnga pa'i rnam pas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du khrig mer gyis gang bar bsams la/ mi bde ba med kyi bar du bzung / mi bde ba skyes na phyir gseng ba ste dmigs skor gsum/de nas zhi ba'i spyor ba la bslab par bya ste/ gzhan rnams thams cad gong bzhin las/rlung bzung bas cung zad mi bde ba skyes pa na/bzung ba de nyid —382—

ma shor ba'i ngang nas/ slar drag tu rngub mthen dkrug bya dmigs skor bzhi'o/ /de nas rlung sbyor de ka'i ngang nas 'khrul 'khor bzhi po 'di ci rigs zhig bya ste/ de la dang po srubs shing bsrub pa ni/ lag mthil gnyis pus mo la bkab/ lus g.yas gyen du bteg la lag pa brla steng la bsdo/da cing gsang gnas su bsrub/ rtsa g.yas kyi rlung dbu mar sib kyis song bar bsam/ rang lus g.yon gyen du bteg la gsang gnas su srub/ rtsa g.yon gyi rlung dbu mar sib kyis song bar bsam pa'o /de yang dang po dal bus bya/ de nas drag tu byed pa lan gsum sogs bya ste/ dmigs skor lnga'o/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho bskyod pa ni/ bgang gzhil snga ma ltar byas la/ lag mthil gnyis pus mo so so la bkab la/ 'og rlung bskum la gsus pa zlum po ldir gyis byas te/ g.yas su lan gsum 'khor lo ltar bskor zhing / g.yas su sprug de bzhin du g.yon du bskor zhing / g.yon du sprug ma thub na dal gyis gtong ba lan gsum bya'o/ /gsum pa bsad pa nor lha gnyis ni/ tsog pur bsdad la/ lag pa g.yas kyis g.yon pa'i 'khrig ma la bzung tsog pu'i pus mo la 'khyud la/ rang byung gi sgom thag bcings te/ bgang gzhil sngar ltar byas la/ steng 'og gi rlung bcings te/ dang po g.yas su gcu ba gnyis/ de nas g.yon du gcu ba gnyis te bzhi/ gdan dang ma bral bar lus thams cad g.yas su bskor ba gnyis/g.yon du bskor ba gnyis te brgyad pus mos phar phul rgur nas lto ba nang du 'then pa gnyis/ rked pa bkan pa phyir 'phul ba gnyis te/ bcu gnyis gyen du —383—

mthen nas 'phar ba gnyis/ 'og tu brdab pa gnyis te bcu drug go/mthar rlung dal bus gtong ba lan gsum bya'o/ /bzhi pa yan lag brkyang bskum ni/ skyil krung bgang gzhil sngar ltar byas la/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ ro stod phyi la bkan/ mig bgrad la/ kos ko brang dang rna ba phrag pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng dang / ltag pa ro stod la reg pa'i mgo bo g.yas su lan gsum bskor/ de nas lag pa rdo rje khu tshur so sor bcings pa gnya' gong du bsnol ba'i steng nas/ g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing thad kar rgyang rgyang 'phang / slar bskum pa gnya' gong du bsnol nas yang brkyang ba lan gsum bya ste/ lag pa brkyang ba'i dus su sor mo phral la brkyang / bskum pa'i dus su khu tshur bcing ngo / /de nas langs la rkang pa gnyis gshibs/ lag gnyis rked par bzhag rlung bzung la rkang pa g.yas mdun du lan gsum brkyang bskum sprug g.yon rgyab tu lan gsum brkyang bskum sprugayang g.yas rgyab tu lan gsum brkyang bskum sprug g.yon mdun du lan gsum brkyang bskum sprug rlung dal gyis btang ba lan gcig bya'o/ /de yang rkang pa brkyangs dus sor mo rnams bskum/ bskum du sor mo rnams brkyang ngo / /de ltar srubs shing bsrub pa nas brtsams te lan bcu la sogs pa bya/ de yang dang po shugs chung la grangs nyung la dal bar bya/ goms nas grangs mang zhing / 'chun dang rtsal bskyed la gcig rjes la gcig drag tu bya/ thams cad la rlung ma thub na dal gyis btang / rlung ro bsal la shes pa klod de spros med kyi steng du bzhag go /'on kyang 'dir man ngag phyag bzhes ni 'di bzhi po la rlung phyir 'dzin re —384—

dang nang 'dzin re te 'khrul 'khor brgyad du mdzad de gnad chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /de rnams kyis ni rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa dang / rtsa mdud grol bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung zhing / rim gyis mngon par shes pa lnga skye bar khyur ro/ /lnga pa rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ slob dpon nyid kyis gzhung las/ dab / pa'i bzhi mnyam blangs byas te/ /gla ba yis ni dug med 'gyur/ /gan dzi dang ni a ru ra/ /lga skya mar dang lhan cig sbyar/ /gsang sngags bzla zhing zhag bdun sgrub/ /ces gsungs te/ de yang mar srang bdun/ bu ram srang bdun/ lga skya ji ltar 'os pa/sbrang srang gsum/lug khur ma/ba ru ra/a ru ra gser mdogamu zi srang gang / sha dang sngo rngad la sogs pa ma zos pa'i bzhi mnyam bsags pa lan gsum du bton nas rdo leb gtsang ma'i khar brdal la/ bskams pa dang zhib tu btags pa/ sbrang bu ram sogs mngar gsum gyis mgo bsdus nas/ril bu sha ba'i ril ma tsam byas la/ rkyal pa srub med par blugs te/ sa la ma reg par mdun gyi nam mkha' la dpyangs te bzhag rang smra ba bcad la yi ge 'bru gsum gyi sgrub pa zhag bdun bya'o/ /snga dro'i cha la bdun bdu rtsa bsten/bcud len gyi bslab bya la gnas pas dmigs pa gsal khams rgyas spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /dug 'don pa ni/ rdza'am rdo'i snod gtsang mar bzhi mnyam gyi phye ma la dri chu dron mo blug nas legs par bsnur ba dwangs su gzhug de nas khu ba bzhur la dbo/ yang dri chu bar ba blug cing dwangs pa dbo/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byas pas dug bton la/ de nas bskam mo gsung /—385—

drug pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa gnyis te rang lus thabs ldan dang / gzhan lus shes rab bo/ /dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la yang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro rnams gong bzhin byas la/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ yar sna spyi bo dang / mar sna lhe bar zug pa/ mas snar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba/ me lce rtse mo sor bzhi tshun chad dbu ma'i nang du 'bar zhing / me lce'i lag rnams phyi la yang lhag lhag yod pa/ snyug 'dom gyi bcad kha la me sbar nas kha thur du bstan pa lta bu zhig bsgoms la/ rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor ba lte bar kha spyor du bzung bas/ rlung rnams lte ba'i me la thim par bsam/dmigs pa me lce la rtse gcig tu gtad na me lte cung zad g.yo ba'i rkyen gyis bde ba skyes par bsam/ dbang gi ye shes kyi nyams myong yod na dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag de ltar rlung thengs 'ga'i bar du dmigs pa shin tu 'jur bar byas te/ de'i nyams myong dang shin tu spros med kyi ye shes bsres la mnyam par bzhag de ltar yang yang bsgom/gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro sogs 'dra ba la/ dbu ma'i yas sna spyi bos slar mdun phyogs na phar 'khyogs te smin mtshams su zug pa/ mas sna gsang gnas su sleb cing nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar 'khyogs pa zhig gsal btab nas/ sngar bzhin rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du rngubs te/ gsang ba'i bar du rlung dmag drag tu mnan/ yang yar 'then te/ stod du drangs/ slar lte ba kha sbyor phyir drag tu bskyed pa la ring du bslab/ yang de go zlog phyir bzung ba la yang bslab bo/ /—386—

dmigs pa ni/ rlung 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam par sna sgo nas yar song / smin mtshams nas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ spyi bo nas ling ga'i rtse mo'i bar du 'od zer sna lnga du ba ltar khyu lu lu dbu ma'i nang nas 'gro ba dang / nor bu 'khyil ba 'ja' 'od kyi thig le lta bu la sems gtad/ yang steng du spos dud ltar 'gro bar bsam mo /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni logs su gsal la bla ma'i zhal las kyang blang bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor la tshig 'byed nas kha 'gengs pa ni rang lugs su mi 'gro la/ shar ba'i rmi lam ma yin zer ba de la ni snying po ci yang mi snang ngo // //gnyis pa g.yin lus shes rab ni rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa bar chad bsal ba'i chos la/ bar chad kyi rgyu ni bdag 'dzin nyon mongs las dang bcas pa'o/ /rkyen ni gnas dang grogs ngan pa dang / tshe 'di'i bya ba sna tshogs pa la zhen pa dang / chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtogs pas khyer ba dang / bag med pa'i spyod pa sogs sna tshogs kyis bar chad sngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /ngo bo ni na tsha sdug bsngal dang chos min gyi rnam par rtog pa sems lhongs sna tshogs dang bcas pa 'byung ba'o/ /sel ba'i thabs ni/ nad gdon sdug bsngal nyon mongs thams cad rang sems su shes nas bla ma'i man ngag gis blo thag bcad pa'o/ /sel ba'i tshad bar chad de dag rtsa ba nas bzlog cing zhi ba'am/'phral nyid du ma zhi yang / de rnams ting nge 'dzin grogs su 'gro zhing / gnas la bag phebs pa dang / khong blo bde bar 'gyur ba'o/ /bar chad bsal ba'i man —387—

ngag la mos gus la brten pa dang / rang lus sbyin pa dang / spros med nyid la brten pa dang / rten brten pa so sor 'byed pa dang / rnam rtog dbyings su gcod pa la brten nas bar chad bsal ba ste lnga dang / brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i bsgom pa ste drug las/dang po ni skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ spyir sems can thams cad dang khyad par gnod byed yod na/ de nyid la sgos su snying rje drag tu bsgom/ 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya'o snyam pa dang / 'di kun 'khor ba las thar ba gcig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes blos ling gis bkal la bzhag rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos kyi rnam pa nyid dam/ rdo rje 'chang ngam/ gzhin rje gshed dmar gyi rnam pa gang du bsgom kyang rung / de la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bstim/ mos gus drag pos lus longs spyod thams cad phul bar bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bar chad 'di lam du longs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba ci nus btab/ bla ma rang la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la spros med kyi ngang bskyangs shing mnyam par bzhagaganyis pa ni/ gdon la sogs pa'i rnam rtog gi sbun langs pa'i tshe/rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ rang gi lus la gces par 'dzin pa snyems 'khrigs rdul tsam yang med par dum bur gtubs/ sha khrag gi tshogs nam mkha' khengs pa —388—

tsam du gyur/ nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam gyi tshogs spyan drangs/ rang lus kyi sha khrag gi phud bdud rtsir bsgyur nas phul bar bsam/ o ā hū zhes brjod/gnod byed rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu la sogs pa'i srid pa gsum gyi mgron thams cad spyan drangs/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sha khrag gi tshogs rnams zos 'thungs pas/ zag med kyi bde bas tshim zhing dgyes par bsam/ o ā hū zhes brjod/ bdag dang gnod byed dang ston mo thams cad mi dmigs par dbyings su mnyam par bzhagagasum pa ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma ltar byas la/ lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes par byas shing / bar chad rnams sngar gyi thabs drug sogs kyis bsal bar bya ste/ rnam rtog shas che na rnam rtog 'od gsal/mos gus chung na byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ zhe sdang ches na mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ bdag 'dzin ches na rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor/ 'byung ba 'khrugs na srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor/ lus zungs ngan na rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor/ 'dod chags shas che na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor rnams gnyen por btang zhing / mthar spros med nyid kyi dbyings su bskyal bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyis kyang ma sel na/ rig pa hur phyung zhing / dpangs btod la ngar bton/nad gdon nyon mongs rnam rtog la sogs gang ma sel ba de'i steng du dbyings rig bsres nas gang shar de la gcer phog tu ngo bzung la spros med kyi ye shes kyi ngang du yang dang yang du mnyam par bzhag go /bzhi pa ni/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar las/ gang bar chad du snang ba'i rnam rtog —389—

de bu ga dgu nas sur gyis bcug par bsam pa sogs rnam rtog 'od gsal ltar bsgom nas dbyings su bskyangs/ 'jigs pa dang zhus pa dang / skyug bro ba la sogs pa rnam rtog gi yul gang yin pa de thams cad rang sems su thag bcad la mnyam par bzhag yang gnod byed sems can yod na skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang sems snying gi dkyil 'khor du 'od mar me'i rtse mo ltar yod pa de snying gi thad nas bu ga phye nas dgra'am bgegs la sogs pa gang yin de'i snying gi dkyil 'khor du skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar song nas/ de dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres/de yang nam mkha' la yal te spros bral gyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhagalnga pa ni/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar las sems skad cig kyang ma g.yengs par byas la bar chad du snang ba'i rnam rtog de nyid la sems gtad pas der 'dzin gtad yal du song ba'i ngang la spros med kyi ye shes sngar bzhin bskyangs/ gzhan yang rnam rtog gang shar de nyid la sor 'jog tu bskyangs pas/ rnam rtog de nyid ye shes su gnas 'gyur te/ nga nyid gnyis med kyi ye shes yin na khyod skyon du lta'am zhes rnam rtog de nyid kyi rang la ngo sprad pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /yang kha cig gong du bstan pa'i gnod byed la sogs pa sems can la snying rje sgom pa de nyid dmigs thun logs su bskyangs nas skabs 'dir las dang po pa'i skabs nyid la chos tshan drug tu 'chad pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis snying rje bsgom pa de gzhan lnga car gyi sngon 'gror gtong ba 'di/ glo bo lo tsā ba chen po'i gtong thun gyi dgongs pa yang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /—390—

drug pa ni/ de rnams la myong ba thon cing cung zad brtan pa thob nas/'jig rten dang mthun pa'i rnam gzhag legs nyes sna tshogs su 'dzin pa skad skad po 'di hrul por spu nig nas smyon pa'i spyod pas/ 'dre dang gnod spyin dang srin po gnas pa'i sa la sogs pa/ gnas nges med du dus kyang nges pa med par spyod lam sna tshogs pas rgyus pa na/ bde sdug nyams mtho dman sna tshogs dang / lus ngag sems kyi 'gyur ba ci yang zhig 'byung ste/ de thams cad sngar gyi thabs de dag la brten nas dbyings su bcad cing bskral bas/ spros med kyi ye shes mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /lar chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa bshig cing bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas chod pa zhig dgos so/ /de thams cad blo yul du go ba gcig pus mi phan pas/ rtse gcig tu 'bad pa chen pos rgyud thog tu sbyar nas nyams su len pa la thun dang thun mtshams med cing snang ba thams cad la bsre zhing bsgoms na/'phral du mngon du byed pa yin no/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/shin du spros med bla ma'i gsung / /blo yi yul du go na yang / /spros bcas rtsub mos bskyod pa'i tshe/ /blo la spros med kyis ma reg /blo ni phal par brtan par gnas//de tshe spros pa sprod med du/ /ro gcig mnyam pa nyid du thim/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar dmigs pa sgom tshul dmigs phyed par byas zin la/ nyams len phyag bzhes go rgyu rnams glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gtong thun du shes par bya'o/ //'dir smras pa/ 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud/ /zab mo'i mthar thug spros pa med pa'i lam/ /grub pa'i mthar thug bir wa pa yi gzhung / /man ngag mthar thug bla ma'i gsungs bzhin bkod/ /kun —391—

rdzob gzhan 'khrul dpung bcas rnam par bcom/ /bdag 'dzin gshin rje'i gshed gyur bgegs kyi dgra/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug gang de'i rgyal srid la/ /mngon 'dod ldan pa gang dag 'dir zhugs shig /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha la dge ba'i bzhes gnyen mkhyen rab pa dang / gzhan yang rnal 'byor lhur byed pa mang pos nye bar bskul nas rang lo nyer bdun pa mchu'i zla ba mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag dge legs 'phel/—392—

dpe sgrig 'gam 'khyar pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/pe5 du ni/si/la 'a ni nil5nideb nga gsum pa/—༄༅/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/( 1 1(45)dpal brtsegs bod yi sa dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/tshekrung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par gzhi dang po bsgrigasaspyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par pa ra thengs dang po btabadapar grangs 001———1500rwa bya2gyu978——7——80253——013——3(2 51——gsung 'bum cha tshang ( deb 1—45yod ) la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul nga/du dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam/ las gnang bar snyi/nga thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mchan tho/ kam dkyi go rim snar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
